## II.5. CHIRPS-Original Data Calibration and Blending

```{r}
# CHIRPS-Original Data Calibration and Blending
# This script implements multiple techniques to improve correlation and create blended datasets
# Methods: Bias correction, quantile mapping, linear calibration, and optimal blending

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(gridExtra)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(mgcv)  # For GAM smoothing

# Install required packages if not available
required_packages <- c("mgcv", "quantreg")
for(pkg in required_packages) {
  if(!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    cat(paste("Installing package:", pkg, "\n"))
    install.packages(pkg)
  }
}

# Try to load fitdistrplus (optional for gamma correction)
fitdistr_available <- requireNamespace("fitdistrplus", quietly = TRUE)
if(!fitdistr_available) {
  cat("Note: fitdistrplus not available - gamma correction will use linear fallback\n")
}

# Advanced calibration functions

# 1. Linear Bias Correction
apply_linear_correction <- function(overlapping_data) {
  # Fit linear model: Original = a + b * CHIRPS
  lm_model <- lm(original_rainfall ~ chirps_rainfall, data = overlapping_data)
  
  corrected_data <- overlapping_data %>%
    mutate(
      chirps_linear_corrected = predict(lm_model, newdata = data.frame(chirps_rainfall = chirps_rainfall)),
      linear_correction_method = "Linear Regression"
    )
  
  return(list(
    data = corrected_data,
    model = lm_model,
    coefficients = coef(lm_model)
  ))
}

# 2. Quantile Mapping Correction
apply_quantile_mapping <- function(overlapping_data, n_quantiles = 100) {
  # Calculate quantiles for both datasets
  chirps_quantiles <- quantile(overlapping_data$chirps_rainfall, 
                              probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_quantiles), na.rm = TRUE)
  original_quantiles <- quantile(overlapping_data$original_rainfall, 
                                probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_quantiles), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Create mapping function
  quantile_map <- approxfun(chirps_quantiles, original_quantiles, 
                           method = "linear", rule = 2)
  
  corrected_data <- overlapping_data %>%
    mutate(
      chirps_quantile_mapped = pmax(0, quantile_map(chirps_rainfall)),
      quantile_mapping_method = "Quantile Mapping"
    )
  
  return(list(
    data = corrected_data,
    chirps_quantiles = chirps_quantiles,
    original_quantiles = original_quantiles,
    mapping_function = quantile_map
  ))
}

# 3. Gamma Distribution Correction (for rainfall-specific distributions)
apply_gamma_correction <- function(overlapping_data) {
  # Check if fitdistrplus is available
  if (!requireNamespace("fitdistrplus", quietly = TRUE)) {
    cat("   ⚠️ fitdistrplus package not available - using linear correction\n")
    return(apply_linear_correction(overlapping_data))
  }
  
  # Fit gamma distributions to both datasets (excluding zeros)
  positive_original <- overlapping_data$original_rainfall[overlapping_data$original_rainfall > 0]
  positive_chirps <- overlapping_data$chirps_rainfall[overlapping_data$chirps_rainfall > 0]
  
  if(length(positive_original) < 10 || length(positive_chirps) < 10) {
    # Fallback to linear correction if not enough positive values
    return(apply_linear_correction(overlapping_data))
  }
  
  # Fit gamma parameters
  original_gamma <- fitdistrplus::fitdist(positive_original, "gamma", method = "mle")
  chirps_gamma <- fitdistrplus::fitdist(positive_chirps, "gamma", method = "mle")
  
  # Apply gamma correction
  corrected_data <- overlapping_data %>%
    mutate(
      chirps_gamma_corrected = ifelse(
        chirps_rainfall > 0,
        qgamma(pgamma(chirps_rainfall, 
                     shape = chirps_gamma$estimate[1], 
                     rate = chirps_gamma$estimate[2]),
               shape = original_gamma$estimate[1], 
               rate = original_gamma$estimate[2]),
        0
      ),
      gamma_correction_method = "Gamma Distribution Mapping"
    )
  
  return(list(
    data = corrected_data,
    original_gamma = original_gamma,
    chirps_gamma = chirps_gamma
  ))
}

# 4. GAM-based Non-linear Correction
apply_gam_correction <- function(overlapping_data) {
  # Check if data has sufficient positive values for Gamma family
  positive_count <- sum(overlapping_data$original_rainfall > 0)
  
  if(positive_count < 10) {
    cat("   ⚠️ Insufficient positive values for GAM - using linear correction\n")
    return(apply_linear_correction(overlapping_data))
  }
  
  # Use gaussian family for simplicity and robustness
  gam_model <- mgcv::gam(original_rainfall ~ s(chirps_rainfall, k = min(10, positive_count)), 
                        data = overlapping_data)
  
  corrected_data <- overlapping_data %>%
    mutate(
      chirps_gam_corrected = pmax(0, predict(gam_model, newdata = data.frame(chirps_rainfall = chirps_rainfall))),
      gam_correction_method = "GAM Smoothing"
    )
  
  return(list(
    data = corrected_data,
    model = gam_model
  ))
}

# 5. Optimal Weighted Blending
calculate_optimal_blend <- function(overlapping_data, methods_data) {
  # Calculate performance metrics for each method
  methods <- c("chirps_linear_corrected", "chirps_quantile_mapped", "chirps_gamma_corrected", "chirps_gam_corrected")
  
  performance_metrics <- map_dfr(methods, ~{
    if(.x %in% names(methods_data) && !all(is.na(methods_data[[.x]]))) {
      correlation <- cor(overlapping_data$original_rainfall, methods_data[[.x]], use = "complete.obs")
      rmse <- sqrt(mean((overlapping_data$original_rainfall - methods_data[[.x]])^2, na.rm = TRUE))
      mae <- mean(abs(overlapping_data$original_rainfall - methods_data[[.x]]), na.rm = TRUE)
      
      data.frame(
        method = .x,
        correlation = ifelse(is.na(correlation), 0, correlation),
        rmse = ifelse(is.na(rmse) || is.infinite(rmse), 1000, rmse),
        mae = ifelse(is.na(mae) || is.infinite(mae), 1000, mae)
      )
    }
  }) %>%
    filter(!is.na(correlation) & correlation > 0)
  
  if(nrow(performance_metrics) == 0) {
    # Fallback to original CHIRPS if no methods work
    return(list(
      blended_values = overlapping_data$chirps_rainfall,
      weights = data.frame(method = "chirps_rainfall", weight = 1.0, correlation = 0, rmse = 1000),
      final_correlation = cor(overlapping_data$original_rainfall, overlapping_data$chirps_rainfall, use = "complete.obs"),
      final_rmse = sqrt(mean((overlapping_data$original_rainfall - overlapping_data$chirps_rainfall)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
    ))
  }
  
  # Calculate weights based on inverse RMSE (better methods get higher weights)
  performance_metrics <- performance_metrics %>%
    mutate(
      weight = (1/rmse) / sum(1/rmse, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  # Create optimal blend
  optimal_blend <- rep(0, nrow(overlapping_data))
  for(i in 1:nrow(performance_metrics)) {
    method_col <- performance_metrics$method[i]
    weight <- performance_metrics$weight[i]
    if(method_col %in% names(methods_data)) {
      optimal_blend <- optimal_blend + (methods_data[[method_col]] * weight)
    }
  }
  
  return(list(
    blended_values = optimal_blend,
    weights = performance_metrics,
    final_correlation = cor(overlapping_data$original_rainfall, optimal_blend, use = "complete.obs"),
    final_rmse = sqrt(mean((overlapping_data$original_rainfall - optimal_blend)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  ))
}

# Main calibration function for each station
calibrate_station_data <- function(rainfall_data, chirps_data, station_col) {
  cat(paste("🔧 Calibrating station:", station_col, "\n"))
  
  # Get overlapping data - remove duplicates first
  overlapping_data <- rainfall_data %>%
    select(Date, all_of(station_col)) %>%
    rename(original_rainfall = all_of(station_col)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(original_rainfall)) %>%
    distinct(Date, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%  # Remove duplicate dates
    arrange(Date) %>%
    inner_join(chirps_data %>% distinct(Date, .keep_all = TRUE), by = "Date") %>%  # Remove duplicate dates from CHIRPS too
    filter(!is.na(original_rainfall) & !is.na(chirps_rainfall)) %>%
    mutate(Station = station_col)
  
  if(nrow(overlapping_data) < 20) {
    cat(paste("   ⚠️ Insufficient data for", station_col, "- skipping calibration\n"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Apply all correction methods
  linear_result <- apply_linear_correction(overlapping_data)
  quantile_result <- apply_quantile_mapping(overlapping_data)
  
  # Try gamma correction with error handling
  gamma_result <- tryCatch({
    apply_gamma_correction(overlapping_data)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(paste("   ⚠️ Gamma correction failed for", station_col, "- using linear instead\n"))
    linear_result
  })
  
  # Try GAM correction with error handling
  gam_result <- tryCatch({
    apply_gam_correction(overlapping_data)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(paste("   ⚠️ GAM correction failed for", station_col, "- using linear instead\n"))
    linear_result
  })
  
  # Combine all corrected data - handle missing columns gracefully
  all_methods_data <- overlapping_data
  
  # Add linear correction
  if(!is.null(linear_result$data) && "chirps_linear_corrected" %in% names(linear_result$data)) {
    all_methods_data <- all_methods_data %>%
      left_join(select(linear_result$data, Date, chirps_linear_corrected), 
                by = "Date", relationship = "many-to-many")
  } else {
    all_methods_data$chirps_linear_corrected <- all_methods_data$chirps_rainfall
  }
  
  # Add quantile mapping
  if(!is.null(quantile_result$data) && "chirps_quantile_mapped" %in% names(quantile_result$data)) {
    all_methods_data <- all_methods_data %>%
      left_join(select(quantile_result$data, Date, chirps_quantile_mapped), 
                by = "Date", relationship = "many-to-many")
  } else {
    all_methods_data$chirps_quantile_mapped <- all_methods_data$chirps_rainfall
  }
  
  # Add gamma correction
  if(!is.null(gamma_result$data) && "chirps_gamma_corrected" %in% names(gamma_result$data)) {
    all_methods_data <- all_methods_data %>%
      left_join(select(gamma_result$data, Date, chirps_gamma_corrected), 
                by = "Date", relationship = "many-to-many")
  } else {
    all_methods_data$chirps_gamma_corrected <- all_methods_data$chirps_rainfall
  }
  
  # Add GAM correction
  if(!is.null(gam_result$data) && "chirps_gam_corrected" %in% names(gam_result$data)) {
    all_methods_data <- all_methods_data %>%
      left_join(select(gam_result$data, Date, chirps_gam_corrected), 
                by = "Date", relationship = "many-to-many")
  } else {
    all_methods_data$chirps_gam_corrected <- all_methods_data$chirps_rainfall
  }
  
  # Calculate optimal blend
  optimal_result <- calculate_optimal_blend(overlapping_data, all_methods_data)
  
  # Add optimal blend to data
  final_data <- all_methods_data %>%
    mutate(
      chirps_optimal_blend = optimal_result$blended_values,
      original_correlation = cor(original_rainfall, chirps_rainfall, use = "complete.obs"),
      optimal_correlation = optimal_result$final_correlation,
      correlation_improvement = optimal_result$final_correlation - cor(original_rainfall, chirps_rainfall, use = "complete.obs")
    )
  
  return(list(
    data = final_data,
    linear_model = linear_result,
    quantile_model = quantile_result,
    gamma_model = gamma_result,
    gam_model = gam_result,
    optimal_blend = optimal_result,
    station = station_col
  ))
}

# Function to create comprehensive comparison plots
create_calibration_comparison_plot <- function(calibration_result) {
  if(is.null(calibration_result)) return(NULL)
  
  data <- calibration_result$data
  station_name <- calibration_result$station
  
  # Original vs Corrected scatter plots
  scatter_data <- data %>%
    select(Date, original_rainfall, chirps_rainfall, chirps_linear_corrected, 
           chirps_quantile_mapped, chirps_gamma_corrected, chirps_gam_corrected, 
           chirps_optimal_blend) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("chirps"), names_to = "method", values_to = "corrected_rainfall") %>%
    mutate(
      method = case_when(
        method == "chirps_rainfall" ~ "Original CHIRPS",
        method == "chirps_linear_corrected" ~ "Linear Corrected",
        method == "chirps_quantile_mapped" ~ "Quantile Mapped",
        method == "chirps_gamma_corrected" ~ "Gamma Corrected",
        method == "chirps_gam_corrected" ~ "GAM Corrected",
        method == "chirps_optimal_blend" ~ "Optimal Blend"
      ),
      method = factor(method, levels = c("Original CHIRPS", "Linear Corrected", 
                                       "Quantile Mapped", "Gamma Corrected", 
                                       "GAM Corrected", "Optimal Blend"))
    )
  
  # Calculate correlations for each method - only for available methods
  correlations <- scatter_data %>%
    group_by(method) %>%
    summarise(
      correlation = cor(original_rainfall, corrected_rainfall, use = "complete.obs"),
      n_points = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(correlation) & n_points > 5) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0("r=", round(correlation, 3), " (n=", n_points, ")"))
  
  # Filter scatter_data to only available methods
  scatter_data <- scatter_data %>%
    inner_join(correlations %>% select(method), by = "method")
  
  if(nrow(scatter_data) == 0) {
    cat(paste("   ⚠️ No valid data for scatter plot for station:", station_name, "\n"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Scatter plot
  scatter_plot <- ggplot(scatter_data, aes(x = original_rainfall, y = corrected_rainfall)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8, color = "#2E86AB") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "#E74C3C", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "#7B68EE", size = 1) +
    geom_text(data = correlations, aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = label), 
              hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "#7B68EE", fontface = "bold") +
    facet_wrap(~method, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Calibration Methods Comparison:", station_name),
      subtitle = "Each panel shows Original vs Corrected CHIRPS data",
      x = "Original Rainfall (mm)",
      y = "Corrected CHIRPS Rainfall (mm)",
      caption = "Red dashed line = perfect agreement | Blue line = linear fit | r = correlation"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray60"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # Time series comparison
  ts_data <- data %>%
    select(Date, original_rainfall, chirps_rainfall, chirps_optimal_blend) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Date, names_to = "series", values_to = "rainfall") %>%
    mutate(
      series = case_when(
        series == "original_rainfall" ~ "Original",
        series == "chirps_rainfall" ~ "CHIRPS (Raw)",
        series == "chirps_optimal_blend" ~ "CHIRPS (Calibrated)"
      ),
      series = factor(series, levels = c("Original", "CHIRPS (Raw)", "CHIRPS (Calibrated)"))
    )
  
  ts_plot <- ggplot(ts_data, aes(x = Date, y = rainfall, color = series)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.7, size = 0.6) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.4) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Time Series Comparison:", station_name),
      subtitle = "Original vs Raw CHIRPS vs Calibrated CHIRPS",
      x = "Date",
      y = "Rainfall (mm)",
      color = "Data Source"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray60"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Original" = "#2E86AB", "CHIRPS (Raw)" = "#E74C3C", "CHIRPS (Calibrated)" = "#27AE60")) +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y")
  
  # Performance metrics plot
  performance_data <- data.frame(
    Method = c("Original CHIRPS", "Linear Corrected", "Quantile Mapped", 
               "Gamma Corrected", "GAM Corrected", "Optimal Blend"),
    Correlation = c(
      cor(data$original_rainfall, data$chirps_rainfall, use = "complete.obs"),
      cor(data$original_rainfall, data$chirps_linear_corrected, use = "complete.obs"),
      cor(data$original_rainfall, data$chirps_quantile_mapped, use = "complete.obs"),
      cor(data$original_rainfall, data$chirps_gamma_corrected, use = "complete.obs"),
      cor(data$original_rainfall, data$chirps_gam_corrected, use = "complete.obs"),
      calibration_result$optimal_blend$final_correlation
    ),
    RMSE = c(
      sqrt(mean((data$original_rainfall - data$chirps_rainfall)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      sqrt(mean((data$original_rainfall - data$chirps_linear_corrected)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      sqrt(mean((data$original_rainfall - data$chirps_quantile_mapped)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      sqrt(mean((data$original_rainfall - data$chirps_gamma_corrected)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      sqrt(mean((data$original_rainfall - data$chirps_gam_corrected)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      calibration_result$optimal_blend$final_rmse
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = Method))
  
  perf_plot <- ggplot(performance_data, aes(x = Method)) +
    geom_col(aes(y = Correlation), fill = "#27AE60", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(y = Correlation, label = round(Correlation, 3)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Performance Metrics:", station_name),
      subtitle = "Higher correlation = better performance",
      x = "Calibration Method",
      y = "Correlation with Original Data"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray60"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    ylim(0, 1)
  
  # Combine all plots
  combined_plot <- grid.arrange(
    scatter_plot, ts_plot, perf_plot,
    heights = c(2, 1, 1),
    ncol = 1
  )
  
  return(list(
    scatter = scatter_plot,
    timeseries = ts_plot,
    performance = perf_plot,
    combined = combined_plot,
    performance_data = performance_data
  ))
}

# Function to apply calibration to full dataset (including non-overlapping periods)
apply_calibration_to_full_data <- function(rainfall_data, chirps_data, calibration_result, station_col) {
  if(is.null(calibration_result)) return(NULL)
  
  # Get all data for the station
  station_data <- rainfall_data %>%
    select(Date, all_of(station_col)) %>%
    rename(original_rainfall = all_of(station_col))
  
  # Merge with CHIRPS data
  full_data <- chirps_data %>%
    left_join(station_data, by = "Date") %>%
    arrange(Date) %>%
    filter(!is.na(chirps_rainfall)) %>%
    mutate(Station = station_col)
  
  # Apply the optimal calibration model to all CHIRPS data
  # Use the linear model as it's most generalizable
  linear_model <- calibration_result$linear_model$model
  
  calibrated_full_data <- full_data %>%
    mutate(
      chirps_calibrated = pmax(0, predict(linear_model, newdata = data.frame(chirps_rainfall = chirps_rainfall))),
      # Create final blended series: use original when available, calibrated CHIRPS when not
      final_rainfall = ifelse(!is.na(original_rainfall), original_rainfall, chirps_calibrated),
      data_source = case_when(
        !is.na(original_rainfall) ~ "Original",
        is.na(original_rainfall) & !is.na(chirps_calibrated) ~ "Calibrated CHIRPS",
        TRUE ~ "Missing"
      )
    )
  
  return(calibrated_full_data)
}

# Main execution function
execute_calibration_analysis <- function(rainfall_data, chirps_data, rainfall_cols) {
  cat("🚀 Starting comprehensive CHIRPS calibration and blending analysis...\n")
  
  # Calibrate all stations
  calibration_results <- map(rainfall_cols, ~{
    calibrate_station_data(rainfall_data, chirps_data, .x)
  })
  names(calibration_results) <- rainfall_cols
  
  # Remove NULL results
  calibration_results <- calibration_results[!sapply(calibration_results, is.null)]
  
  # Create comparison plots for all stations
  cat("📊 Creating calibration comparison plots...\n")
  comparison_plots <- map(calibration_results, create_calibration_comparison_plot)
  names(comparison_plots) <- names(calibration_results)
  
  # Apply calibration to full datasets
  cat("🔧 Applying calibration to full datasets...\n")
  calibrated_full_data <- map2(calibration_results, names(calibration_results), ~{
    apply_calibration_to_full_data(rainfall_data, chirps_data, .x, .y)
  })
  names(calibrated_full_data) <- names(calibration_results)
  
  # Create summary of improvements
  improvement_summary <- map_dfr(calibration_results, ~{
    if(!is.null(.x)) {
      data.frame(
        Station = .x$station,
        Original_Correlation = .x$data$original_correlation[1],
        Calibrated_Correlation = .x$data$optimal_correlation[1],
        Improvement = .x$data$correlation_improvement[1],
        Original_RMSE = sqrt(mean((.x$data$original_rainfall - .x$data$chirps_rainfall)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
        Calibrated_RMSE = .x$optimal_blend$final_rmse,
        RMSE_Reduction = sqrt(mean((.x$data$original_rainfall - .x$data$chirps_rainfall)^2, na.rm = TRUE)) - .x$optimal_blend$final_rmse,
        n_observations = nrow(.x$data)
      )
    }
  }) %>%
    arrange(desc(Improvement))
  
  return(list(
    calibration_results = calibration_results,
    comparison_plots = comparison_plots,
    calibrated_full_data = calibrated_full_data,
    improvement_summary = improvement_summary
  ))
}

# Save function
save_calibration_results <- function(analysis_results, output_dir = "chirps_calibration_results") {
  # Create directory
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Save improvement summary
  write.csv(analysis_results$improvement_summary, 
            file.path(output_dir, "calibration_improvement_summary.csv"), 
            row.names = FALSE)
  
  # Save individual station results
  stations_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "individual_stations")
  if (!dir.exists(stations_dir)) {
    dir.create(stations_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Save plots and data
  iwalk(analysis_results$comparison_plots, ~{
    if(!is.null(.x)) {
      # Save plots
      ggsave(file.path(stations_dir, paste0(.y, "_calibration_comparison.jpeg")), 
             .x$combined, width = 16, height = 20, dpi = 300)
      ggsave(file.path(stations_dir, paste0(.y, "_scatter_comparison.jpeg")), 
             .x$scatter, width = 15, height = 10, dpi = 300)
      ggsave(file.path(stations_dir, paste0(.y, "_timeseries_comparison.jpeg")), 
             .x$timeseries, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
      ggsave(file.path(stations_dir, paste0(.y, "_performance_metrics.jpeg")), 
             .x$performance, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
      
      # Save performance data
      write.csv(.x$performance_data, 
                file.path(stations_dir, paste0(.y, "_performance_data.csv")), 
                row.names = FALSE)
    }
  })
  
  # Save calibrated full datasets
  iwalk(analysis_results$calibrated_full_data, ~{
    if(!is.null(.x)) {
      write.csv(.x, file.path(stations_dir, paste0(.y, "_calibrated_full_dataset.csv")), 
                row.names = FALSE)
    }
  })
  
  cat("💾 All calibration results saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
}

# Execute the analysis
cat("🌟 CHIRPS-Original Data Calibration and Blending Analysis\n")
cat(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n")

# Run the analysis (assuming data is loaded)
final_analysis <- execute_calibration_analysis(rainfall_data_filtered, chirps_data, rainfall_cols)

# Display improvement summary
cat("\n📈 CALIBRATION IMPROVEMENT SUMMARY:\n")
print(final_analysis$improvement_summary)

# Save results
save_calibration_results(final_analysis)
```

# III. Multi-Dataset Time Series Visualization with Gap Filling

## III.1. Dataset Integration and Hierarchy

**Description:** Integration of four satellite/reanalysis precipitation products (ERA5_Land, CHIRPS, GPM_IMERG, PERSIANN_CDR) with original station observations. Establishes data priority hierarchy where original observations take precedence, followed by ERA5_Land, CHIRPS, GPM_IMERG, and PERSIANN_CDR for gap-filling. Each dataset undergoes quality assessment and correlation analysis against ground truth measurements to determine reliability and optimal use cases.

```{r}
# Multi-Dataset Time Series Visualization with Gap Filling
# This script combines original rainfall station data with multiple precipitation datasets 
# (ERA5_Land, CHIRPS, GPM_IMERG, PERSIANN_CDR) to compare reliability and fill gaps
# Original data takes priority over satellite/reanalysis data when both exist
# Analysis limited to 2000-2025 period

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(gridExtra)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(corrr)

# Set output directory
output_base_dir <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/Precipitation_Analysis"

# Load multi-dataset precipitation data
cat("📥 Loading multi-dataset precipitation data...\n")
multi_precip_data <- read_csv(file.path(output_base_dir, "combined_precipitation_data.csv")) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(date, format = "%d/%m/%Y")) %>%
  filter(year(Date) >= 2000 & year(Date) <= 2025) %>%
  select(Date, ERA5_Land, CHIRPS, GPM_IMERG, PERSIANN_CDR) %>%
  arrange(Date)

cat("✅ Multi-dataset precipitation data loaded:", nrow(multi_precip_data), "records from 2000-2025\n")
cat("   Datasets available: ERA5_Land, CHIRPS, GPM_IMERG, PERSIANN_CDR\n")

# Filter original rainfall data to 2000-2025
rainfall_data_filtered <- rainfall_data %>%
  filter(year(Date) >= 2000 & year(Date) <= 2025)

cat("✅ Original rainfall data filtered:", nrow(rainfall_data_filtered), "records from 2000-2025\n")

# Define dataset colors for consistent visualization
dataset_colors <- c(
  "Original" = "#2E86AB",
  "ERA5_Land" = "#E74C3C", 
  "CHIRPS" = "#F39C12",
  "GPM_IMERG" = "#27AE60",
  "PERSIANN_CDR" = "#9B59B6"
)

# Function to combine station data with multiple datasets
combine_station_with_multiple_datasets <- function(rainfall_data, multi_precip_data, station_col) {
  # Get station data
  station_data <- rainfall_data %>%
    select(Date, all_of(station_col)) %>%
    rename(original_rainfall = all_of(station_col)) %>%
    arrange(Date)
  
  # Merge with multi-dataset precipitation data
  combined_data <- station_data %>%
    full_join(multi_precip_data, by = "Date") %>%
    arrange(Date) %>%
    mutate(
      # Create data source indicator (priority: Original > ERA5_Land > CHIRPS > GPM_IMERG > PERSIANN_CDR)
      data_source = case_when(
        !is.na(original_rainfall) ~ "Original",
        is.na(original_rainfall) & !is.na(ERA5_Land) ~ "ERA5_Land",
        is.na(original_rainfall) & is.na(ERA5_Land) & !is.na(CHIRPS) ~ "CHIRPS",
        is.na(original_rainfall) & is.na(ERA5_Land) & is.na(CHIRPS) & !is.na(GPM_IMERG) ~ "GPM_IMERG",
        is.na(original_rainfall) & is.na(ERA5_Land) & is.na(CHIRPS) & is.na(GPM_IMERG) & !is.na(PERSIANN_CDR) ~ "PERSIANN_CDR",
        TRUE ~ "Missing"
      ),
      
      # Create combined rainfall prioritizing original data, then by hierarchy
      combined_rainfall = case_when(
        !is.na(original_rainfall) ~ original_rainfall,
        is.na(original_rainfall) & !is.na(ERA5_Land) ~ ERA5_Land,
        is.na(original_rainfall) & is.na(ERA5_Land) & !is.na(CHIRPS) ~ CHIRPS,
        is.na(original_rainfall) & is.na(ERA5_Land) & is.na(CHIRPS) & !is.na(GPM_IMERG) ~ GPM_IMERG,
        is.na(original_rainfall) & is.na(ERA5_Land) & is.na(CHIRPS) & is.na(GPM_IMERG) & !is.na(PERSIANN_CDR) ~ PERSIANN_CDR,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      
      # Create separate columns for plotting (no linking) - each dataset only shows where original is missing
      original_for_plot = ifelse(!is.na(original_rainfall), original_rainfall, NA),
      era5_for_plot = ifelse(is.na(original_rainfall) & !is.na(ERA5_Land), ERA5_Land, NA),
      chirps_for_plot = ifelse(is.na(original_rainfall) & !is.na(CHIRPS), CHIRPS, NA),
      gpm_for_plot = ifelse(is.na(original_rainfall) & !is.na(GPM_IMERG), GPM_IMERG, NA),
      persiann_for_plot = ifelse(is.na(original_rainfall) & !is.na(PERSIANN_CDR), PERSIANN_CDR, NA)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Date))
  
  return(combined_data)
}

# Function to calculate correlations between datasets and observed data
calculate_dataset_correlations <- function(rainfall_data, multi_precip_data, rainfall_cols) {
  cat("📊 Calculating correlations between datasets and observed data...\n")
  
  correlation_results <- map_dfr(rainfall_cols, ~{
    station_col <- .x
    cat(paste("   Processing station:", station_col, "\n"))
    
    # Combine data for this station
    combined_data <- combine_station_with_multiple_datasets(rainfall_data, multi_precip_data, station_col)
    
    # Calculate correlations only for overlapping non-NA data
    correlations <- tibble(
      Station = station_col,
      ERA5_Land_Correlation = ifelse(
        sum(!is.na(combined_data$original_rainfall) & !is.na(combined_data$ERA5_Land)) >= 10,
        cor(combined_data$original_rainfall, combined_data$ERA5_Land, use = "complete.obs"),
        NA_real_
      ),
      CHIRPS_Correlation = ifelse(
        sum(!is.na(combined_data$original_rainfall) & !is.na(combined_data$CHIRPS)) >= 10,
        cor(combined_data$original_rainfall, combined_data$CHIRPS, use = "complete.obs"),
        NA_real_
      ),
      GPM_IMERG_Correlation = ifelse(
        sum(!is.na(combined_data$original_rainfall) & !is.na(combined_data$GPM_IMERG)) >= 10,
        cor(combined_data$original_rainfall, combined_data$GPM_IMERG, use = "complete.obs"),
        NA_real_
      ),
      PERSIANN_CDR_Correlation = ifelse(
        sum(!is.na(combined_data$original_rainfall) & !is.na(combined_data$PERSIANN_CDR)) >= 10,
        cor(combined_data$original_rainfall, combined_data$PERSIANN_CDR, use = "complete.obs"),
        NA_real_
      ),
      # Count overlapping observations for each dataset
      ERA5_Land_Overlap = sum(!is.na(combined_data$original_rainfall) & !is.na(combined_data$ERA5_Land)),
      CHIRPS_Overlap = sum(!is.na(combined_data$original_rainfall) & !is.na(combined_data$CHIRPS)),
      GPM_IMERG_Overlap = sum(!is.na(combined_data$original_rainfall) & !is.na(combined_data$GPM_IMERG)),
      PERSIANN_CDR_Overlap = sum(!is.na(combined_data$original_rainfall) & !is.na(combined_data$PERSIANN_CDR))
    )
    
    return(correlations)
  })
  
  return(correlation_results)
}

# Function to create enhanced multi-dataset time series plot (line gauge style)
create_enhanced_multi_dataset_timeseries <- function(rainfall_data, multi_precip_data, station_col, 
                                                   max_gap_months = 3, add_loess = TRUE, loess_span = 0.3) {
  # Combine station data with multiple datasets
  combined_data <- combine_station_with_multiple_datasets(rainfall_data, multi_precip_data, station_col)
  
  if (nrow(combined_data) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + 
           ggtitle(paste("No valid data for station:", station_col)) +
           theme_minimal())
  }
  
  # Prepare data for plotting - each dataset separately (line gauge style)
  original_plot_data <- combined_data %>%
    select(Date, original_for_plot) %>%
    filter(!is.na(original_for_plot)) %>%
    arrange(Date)
  
  era5_plot_data <- combined_data %>%
    select(Date, era5_for_plot) %>%
    filter(!is.na(era5_for_plot)) %>%
    arrange(Date)
  
  chirps_plot_data <- combined_data %>%
    select(Date, chirps_for_plot) %>%
    filter(!is.na(chirps_for_plot)) %>%
    arrange(Date)
  
  gpm_plot_data <- combined_data %>%
    select(Date, gpm_for_plot) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gpm_for_plot)) %>%
    arrange(Date)
  
  persiann_plot_data <- combined_data %>%
    select(Date, persiann_for_plot) %>%
    filter(!is.na(persiann_for_plot)) %>%
    arrange(Date)
  
  # Prepare combined data for LOESS (prioritizing original)
  loess_data <- combined_data %>%
    select(Date, combined_rainfall) %>%
    filter(!is.na(combined_rainfall)) %>%
    arrange(Date)
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Add LOESS smooth trend line first (using combined data)
    {if(add_loess && nrow(loess_data) > 10) 
      geom_smooth(data = loess_data, aes(x = Date, y = combined_rainfall),
                  method = "loess", span = loess_span, se = TRUE, 
                  color = "#7B68EE", fill = "#7B68EE", alpha = 0.2, 
                  linetype = "solid", size = 1.2)} +
    
    # Add dataset line gauges (vertical lines from 0 to value) in order of priority
    {if(nrow(persiann_plot_data) > 0)
      geom_segment(data = persiann_plot_data, aes(x = Date, xend = Date, y = 0, yend = persiann_for_plot), 
                   alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8, color = dataset_colors[["PERSIANN_CDR"]])} +
    
    {if(nrow(gpm_plot_data) > 0)
      geom_segment(data = gpm_plot_data, aes(x = Date, xend = Date, y = 0, yend = gpm_for_plot), 
                   alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8, color = dataset_colors[["GPM_IMERG"]])} +
    
    {if(nrow(chirps_plot_data) > 0)
      geom_segment(data = chirps_plot_data, aes(x = Date, xend = Date, y = 0, yend = chirps_for_plot), 
                   alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8, color = dataset_colors[["CHIRPS"]])} +
    
    {if(nrow(era5_plot_data) > 0)
      geom_segment(data = era5_plot_data, aes(x = Date, xend = Date, y = 0, yend = era5_for_plot), 
                   alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8, color = dataset_colors[["ERA5_Land"]])} +
    
    # Add original line gauges (blue vertical lines from 0 to value, on top)
    {if(nrow(original_plot_data) > 0)
      geom_segment(data = original_plot_data, aes(x = Date, xend = Date, y = 0, yend = original_for_plot), 
                   alpha = 0.9, size = 1.0, color = dataset_colors[["Original"]])} +
    
    # Styling
    labs(
      title = paste("Enhanced Multi-Dataset Rainfall Time Series:", station_col),
      subtitle = paste("Original data (blue) + Multi-dataset gap-filling | 2000-2025"),
      x = "Date",
      y = "Rainfall (mm)",
      caption = paste("Original obs:", nrow(original_plot_data), 
                     "| ERA5:", nrow(era5_plot_data),
                     "| CHIRPS:", nrow(chirps_plot_data),
                     "| GPM:", nrow(gpm_plot_data),
                     "| PERSIANN:", nrow(persiann_plot_data))
    ) +
    
    # Theme
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "gray50"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.3),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    ) +
    
    # Scale formatting
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y", expand = c(0.02, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0))
  
  # Add manual legend for datasets
  legend_y_positions <- seq(from = 1.2, by = 0.3, length.out = 5)
  legend_labels <- c("█ Original data", "█ ERA5_Land", "█ CHIRPS", "█ GPM_IMERG", "█ PERSIANN_CDR")
  legend_colors <- unname(dataset_colors)
  
  for (i in 1:5) {
    p <- p + annotate("text", x = min(combined_data$Date, na.rm = TRUE), 
                      y = Inf, label = legend_labels[i], 
                      color = legend_colors[i], hjust = 0, vjust = legend_y_positions[i], size = 3)
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to create all enhanced multi-dataset time series plots
create_all_enhanced_multi_plots <- function(rainfall_data, multi_precip_data, rainfall_cols, max_gap_months = 3, ncols = 2) {
  cat("🎯 Creating enhanced multi-dataset time series plots...\n")
  
  # Create individual plots
  plot_list <- map(rainfall_cols, ~{
    cat(paste("   Processing station:", .x, "\n"))
    create_enhanced_multi_dataset_timeseries(rainfall_data, multi_precip_data, .x, max_gap_months)
  })
  names(plot_list) <- rainfall_cols
  
  # Calculate number of rows needed
  nrows <- ceiling(length(plot_list) / ncols)
  
  # Create combined plot
  combined_plot <- do.call(grid.arrange, c(plot_list, ncol = ncols, nrow = nrows))
  
  return(list(
    individual_plots = plot_list,
    combined_plot = combined_plot
  ))
}

# Enhanced data availability summary function for multiple datasets
create_enhanced_multi_availability_summary <- function(rainfall_data, multi_precip_data, rainfall_cols) {
  availability_summary <- map_dfr(rainfall_cols, ~{
    combined_data <- combine_station_with_multiple_datasets(rainfall_data, multi_precip_data, .x)
    
    combined_data %>%
      summarise(
        Station = .x,
        Total_Days = n(),
        Original_Records = sum(data_source == "Original", na.rm = TRUE),
        ERA5_Land_Records = sum(data_source == "ERA5_Land", na.rm = TRUE),
        CHIRPS_Records = sum(data_source == "CHIRPS", na.rm = TRUE),
        GPM_IMERG_Records = sum(data_source == "GPM_IMERG", na.rm = TRUE),
        PERSIANN_CDR_Records = sum(data_source == "PERSIANN_CDR", na.rm = TRUE),
        Missing_Records = sum(data_source == "Missing", na.rm = TRUE),
        Original_Percent = round((Original_Records / Total_Days) * 100, 1),
        ERA5_Land_Percent = round((ERA5_Land_Records / Total_Days) * 100, 1),
        CHIRPS_Percent = round((CHIRPS_Records / Total_Days) * 100, 1),
        GPM_IMERG_Percent = round((GPM_IMERG_Records / Total_Days) * 100, 1),
        PERSIANN_CDR_Percent = round((PERSIANN_CDR_Records / Total_Days) * 100, 1),
        Total_Coverage_Percent = round(((Original_Records + ERA5_Land_Records + CHIRPS_Records + 
                                       GPM_IMERG_Records + PERSIANN_CDR_Records) / Total_Days) * 100, 1),
        First_Original = ifelse(Original_Records > 0, 
                               as.character(min(Date[data_source == "Original"], na.rm = TRUE)), 
                               NA),
        Last_Original = ifelse(Original_Records > 0, 
                              as.character(max(Date[data_source == "Original"], na.rm = TRUE)), 
                              NA),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }) %>%
    arrange(desc(Total_Coverage_Percent))
  
  return(availability_summary)
}

# Function to create enhanced overview plot with multiple datasets (line gauge style)
create_enhanced_multi_overview_plot <- function(rainfall_data, multi_precip_data, rainfall_cols) {
  # Prepare combined data for all stations
  overview_data <- map_dfr(rainfall_cols, ~{
    combined_data <- combine_station_with_multiple_datasets(rainfall_data, multi_precip_data, .x)
    combined_data %>%
      mutate(Station = .x) %>%
      select(Date, Station, original_for_plot, era5_for_plot, chirps_for_plot, 
             gpm_for_plot, persiann_for_plot, data_source)
  }) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(original_for_plot, era5_for_plot, chirps_for_plot, 
                         gpm_for_plot, persiann_for_plot), 
                names_to = "data_type", values_to = "rainfall") %>%
    filter(!is.na(rainfall)) %>%
    mutate(
      data_type = case_when(
        data_type == "original_for_plot" ~ "Original",
        data_type == "era5_for_plot" ~ "ERA5_Land",
        data_type == "chirps_for_plot" ~ "CHIRPS",
        data_type == "gpm_for_plot" ~ "GPM_IMERG",
        data_type == "persiann_for_plot" ~ "PERSIANN_CDR"
      )
    )
  
  # Create overview plot (line gauge style - vertical lines from 0 to value)
  p <- ggplot(overview_data, aes(x = Date, y = rainfall, color = data_type)) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = Date, xend = Date, y = 0, yend = rainfall), 
                alpha = 0.7, size = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~Station, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
    labs(
      title = "Enhanced Multi-Dataset Rainfall Time Series Overview - All Stations (2000-2025)",
      subtitle = "Blue: Original | Red: ERA5_Land | Orange: CHIRPS | Green: GPM_IMERG | Purple: PERSIANN_CDR",
      x = "Date",
      y = "Rainfall (mm)",
      color = "Data Source",
      caption = "Line gauge visualization - vertical bars from zero to rainfall value"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray60"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    ) +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "5 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = dataset_colors)
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to create correlation comparison plot
create_correlation_comparison_plot <- function(correlation_results) {
  # Reshape correlation data for plotting
  correlation_long <- correlation_results %>%
    select(Station, ends_with("_Correlation")) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("_Correlation"), 
                names_to = "Dataset", values_to = "Correlation") %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset = str_replace(Dataset, "_Correlation", ""),
      Dataset = factor(Dataset, levels = c("ERA5_Land", "CHIRPS", "GPM_IMERG", "PERSIANN_CDR"))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Correlation))
  
  # Create correlation comparison plot
  p <- ggplot(correlation_long, aes(x = Station, y = Correlation, fill = Dataset)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    labs(
      title = "Dataset Reliability Comparison - Correlations with Observed Data",
      subtitle = "Higher correlation indicates better agreement with rain gauge observations",
      x = "Station",
      y = "Correlation Coefficient (r)",
      fill = "Dataset",
      caption = "Only stations with ≥10 overlapping observations shown"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray60"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = dataset_colors[c("ERA5_Land", "CHIRPS", "GPM_IMERG", "PERSIANN_CDR")]) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.2))
  
  return(p)
}

            file.path(output_dir, "dataset_correlation_results.csv"),

}
```

## III.2. Multi-Dataset Visualization

```{r}
# Scatter Plots for Precipitation Dataset Comparison
# This standalone script creates publication-ready scatter plots comparing satellite/reanalysis 
# datasets with observed rainfall data, including R, R², and RMSE statistics
# Analysis limited to 2000-2025 period

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(gridExtra)
library(scales)

# Set output directory
output_base_dir <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/Precipitation_Analysis"

# Load multi-dataset precipitation data
cat("📥 Loading multi-dataset precipitation data...\n")
multi_precip_data <- read_csv(file.path(output_base_dir, "combined_precipitation_data.csv")) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(date, format = "%d/%m/%Y")) %>%
  filter(year(Date) >= 2000 & year(Date) <= 2025) %>%
  select(Date, ERA5_Land, CHIRPS, GPM_IMERG, PERSIANN_CDR) %>%
  arrange(Date)

# Filter original rainfall data to 2000-2025
rainfall_data_filtered <- rainfall_data %>%
  filter(year(Date) >= 2000 & year(Date) <= 2025)

# Define dataset colors for consistent visualization
dataset_colors <- c(
  "ERA5_Land" = "#E74C3C", 
  "CHIRPS" = "#F39C12",
  "GPM_IMERG" = "#27AE60",
  "PERSIANN_CDR" = "#9B59B6"
)

# Function to calculate comprehensive statistics (R, R², RMSE)
calculate_comprehensive_stats <- function(obs, pred) {
  # Remove NAs
  valid_data <- !is.na(obs) & !is.na(pred)
  obs_clean <- obs[valid_data]
  pred_clean <- pred[valid_data]
  
  if (length(obs_clean) < 10) {
    return(list(r = NA, r_squared = NA, rmse = NA, n = length(obs_clean)))
  }
  
  r <- cor(obs_clean, pred_clean, use = "complete.obs")
  r_squared <- r^2
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((obs_clean - pred_clean)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  n <- length(obs_clean)
  
  return(list(r = r, r_squared = r_squared, rmse = rmse, n = n))
}

# Function to create Nature-style scatter plots for each dataset
create_nature_scatter_plots <- function(rainfall_data, multi_precip_data, station_col) {
  cat(paste("Creating scatter plots for station:", station_col, "\n"))
  
  # Get station data and merge with multi-dataset
  station_data <- rainfall_data %>%
    select(Date, all_of(station_col)) %>%
    rename(observed = all_of(station_col)) %>%
    arrange(Date)
  
  combined_data <- station_data %>%
    inner_join(multi_precip_data, by = "Date") %>%
    filter(!is.na(observed))
  
  if (nrow(combined_data) == 0) {
    cat(paste("No overlapping data for station:", station_col, "\n"))
    return(list())
  }
  
  # Prepare data for each dataset
  datasets <- c("ERA5_Land", "CHIRPS", "GPM_IMERG", "PERSIANN_CDR")
  
  plot_list <- map(datasets, ~{
    dataset_name <- .x
    
    # Get overlapping data for this dataset
    scatter_data <- combined_data %>%
      select(Date, observed, all_of(dataset_name)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[dataset_name]])) %>%
      rename(predicted = all_of(dataset_name))
    
    if (nrow(scatter_data) < 10) {
      return(ggplot() + 
             ggtitle(paste(dataset_name, "- Insufficient data (n <10)")) +
             theme_void() +
             theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)))
    }
    
    # Calculate statistics
    stats <- calculate_comprehensive_stats(scatter_data$observed, scatter_data$predicted)
    
    # Determine axis limits
    max_val <- max(c(scatter_data$observed, scatter_data$predicted), na.rm = TRUE)
    min_val <- 0  # Start from 0 for precipitation
    axis_limit <- c(min_val, max_val * 1.05)
    
    # Create scatter plot in Nature style
    p <- ggplot(scatter_data, aes(x = observed, y = predicted)) +
      # Add 1:1 line first
      geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", 
                  size = 1.0, alpha = 0.8) +
      
      # Add points with transparency
      geom_point(color = dataset_colors[[dataset_name]], alpha = 0.7, size = 2.0, 
                stroke = 0.3, shape = 16) +
      
      # Add regression line
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", size = 1.2, 
                 linetype = "solid", alpha = 0.8) +
      
      # Add statistics text box in top-left
      annotate("rect", 
               xmin = axis_limit[1], 
               xmax = axis_limit[1] + 0.45 * (axis_limit[2] - axis_limit[1]),
               ymin = axis_limit[2] - 0.25 * (axis_limit[2] - axis_limit[1]), 
               ymax = axis_limit[2],
               fill = "white", color = "black", alpha = 0.9, size = 0.5) +
      
      annotate("text", 
               x = axis_limit[1] + 0.02 * (axis_limit[2] - axis_limit[1]), 
               y = axis_limit[2] - 0.05 * (axis_limit[2] - axis_limit[1]),
               label = paste0("r = ", sprintf("%.3f", stats$r), "\n",
                             "R² = ", sprintf("%.3f", stats$r_squared), "\n",
                             "RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", stats$rmse), " mm\n",
                             "n = ", format(stats$n, big.mark = ",")),
               hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4.5, 
               fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
      
      # Styling in Nature format
      labs(
        title = dataset_name,
        x = "Observed rainfall (mm)",
        y = "Predicted rainfall (mm)"
      ) +
      
      # Nature journal style theme
      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        # Plot elements
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                                 margin = margin(b = 10)),
        
        # Axis elements
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 1.0),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.8),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
        
        # Panel elements
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1.0),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        
        # Remove unnecessary elements
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        strip.background = element_blank()
      ) +
      
      # Scale formatting
      scale_x_continuous(
        limits = axis_limit,
        expand = c(0.02, 0),
        breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 5)
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = axis_limit,
        expand = c(0.02, 0),
        breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 5)
      ) +
      
      # Ensure square aspect ratio
      coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
    
    return(p)
  })
  
  names(plot_list) <- datasets
  return(plot_list)
}

# Function to create scatter plots for all stations
create_all_scatter_plots <- function(rainfall_data, multi_precip_data, rainfall_cols) {
  cat("🎯 Creating Nature-style scatter plots for all stations...\n")
  
  all_plots <- map(rainfall_cols, ~{
    create_nature_scatter_plots(rainfall_data, multi_precip_data, .x)
  })
  names(all_plots) <- rainfall_cols
  
  return(all_plots)
}

# Function to save individual scatter plots
save_scatter_plots <- function(all_plots, output_dir = NULL) {
  if (is.null(output_dir)) {
    output_dir <- file.path(output_base_dir, "nature_style_scatter_plots")
  }
  
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  cat("💾 Saving Nature-style scatter plots...\n")
  
  # Save individual plots for each station and dataset
  iwalk(all_plots, ~{
    station_plots <- .x
    station_name <- .y
    
    # Create station directory
    station_dir <- file.path(output_dir, station_name)
    if (!dir.exists(station_dir)) {
      dir.create(station_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    }
    
    # Save each dataset plot for this station
    iwalk(station_plots, ~{
      dataset_plot <- .x
      dataset_name <- .y
      
      if (!is.null(dataset_plot) && length(dataset_plot$layers) > 0) {
        filename <- file.path(station_dir, paste0("scatter_", dataset_name, "_", station_name, ".png"))
        ggsave(filename, dataset_plot, 
               width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300, units = "in",
               bg = "white")
        cat(paste("   ✅ Saved:", basename(filename), "\n"))
      }
    })
  })
  
  cat("✅ All scatter plots saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
}

# Function to create combined overview scatter plots (4x4 grid for each station)
create_station_overview_plots <- function(all_plots, output_dir = NULL) {
  if (is.null(output_dir)) {
    output_dir <- file.path(output_base_dir, "nature_style_scatter_plots")
  }
  
  cat("📊 Creating station overview plots...\n")
  
  iwalk(all_plots, ~{
    station_plots <- .x
    station_name <- .y
    
    # Filter out empty plots
    valid_plots <- keep(station_plots, ~!is.null(.x) && length(.x$layers) > 0)
    
    if (length(valid_plots) == 0) {
      cat(paste("No valid plots for station:", station_name, "\n"))
      return()
    }
    
    # Create combined plot
    if (length(valid_plots) > 0) {
      # Arrange plots in a 2x2 grid
      combined_plot <- do.call(grid.arrange, c(valid_plots, ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
                                              top = paste("Dataset Comparison -", station_name)))
      
      # Save combined plot
      filename <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("overview_", station_name, ".png"))
      ggsave(filename, combined_plot, 
             width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 300, units = "in",
             bg = "white")
      cat(paste("   ✅ Saved overview:", basename(filename), "\n"))
    }
  })
}

# Function to calculate best dataset for each station and create combined dataset
create_best_dataset_combination <- function(rainfall_data, multi_precip_data, rainfall_cols) {
  cat("🔍 Determining best dataset for each station...\n")
  
  # Calculate comprehensive stats for all stations and datasets
  best_dataset_results <- map_dfr(rainfall_cols, ~{
    station_col <- .x
    cat(paste("   Analyzing station:", station_col, "\n"))
    
    # Get station data and merge
    station_data <- rainfall_data %>%
      select(Date, all_of(station_col)) %>%
      rename(observed = all_of(station_col)) %>%
      arrange(Date)
    
    combined_data <- station_data %>%
      inner_join(multi_precip_data, by = "Date") %>%
      filter(!is.na(observed))
    
    if (nrow(combined_data) == 0) {
      return(tibble(Station = station_col, Best_Dataset = NA, Best_R = NA, 
                   Best_R_Squared = NA, Best_RMSE = NA, Best_N = NA))
    }
    
    # Calculate stats for each dataset
    datasets <- c("ERA5_Land", "CHIRPS", "GPM_IMERG", "PERSIANN_CDR")
    
    stats_results <- map_dfr(datasets, ~{
      dataset_name <- .x
      
      # Get data for this dataset
      dataset_data <- combined_data %>%
        select(observed, all_of(dataset_name)) %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[dataset_name]]))
      
      if (nrow(dataset_data) < 10) {
        return(tibble(Dataset = dataset_name, R = NA, R_Squared = NA, RMSE = NA, N = 0))
      }
      
      stats <- calculate_comprehensive_stats(dataset_data$observed, dataset_data[[dataset_name]])
      
      return(tibble(
        Dataset = dataset_name,
        R = stats$r,
        R_Squared = stats$r_squared,
        RMSE = stats$rmse,
        N = stats$n
      ))
    })
    
    # Find best dataset (highest R²)
    best_dataset <- stats_results %>%
      filter(!is.na(R_Squared)) %>%
      arrange(desc(R_Squared)) %>%
      slice(1)
    
    if (nrow(best_dataset) == 0) {
      return(tibble(Station = station_col, Best_Dataset = NA, Best_R = NA, 
                   Best_R_Squared = NA, Best_RMSE = NA, Best_N = NA))
    }
    
    return(tibble(
      Station = station_col,
      Best_Dataset = best_dataset$Dataset,
      Best_R = best_dataset$R,
      Best_R_Squared = best_dataset$R_Squared,
      Best_RMSE = best_dataset$RMSE,
      Best_N = best_dataset$N
    ))
  })
  
  return(best_dataset_results)
}

# Function to create combined datasets with best-fit data
create_combined_best_datasets <- function(rainfall_data, multi_precip_data, rainfall_cols, 
                                        best_dataset_results, output_dir = NULL) {
  if (is.null(output_dir)) {
    output_dir <- file.path(output_base_dir, "nature_style_scatter_plots")
  }
  
  cat("📤 Creating combined datasets with best-fit data...\n")
  
  # Create combined datasets directory
  datasets_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "combined_best_datasets")
  if (!dir.exists(datasets_dir)) {
    dir.create(datasets_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Create combined dataset for each station
  iwalk(rainfall_cols, ~{
    station_col <- .x
    
    # Get best dataset for this station
    station_best <- best_dataset_results %>%
      filter(Station == station_col)
    
    if (nrow(station_best) == 0 || is.na(station_best$Best_Dataset)) {
      cat(paste("   ⚠️ No best dataset found for station:", station_col, "\n"))
      return()
    }
    
    best_dataset_name <- station_best$Best_Dataset
    
    # Get station data
    station_data <- rainfall_data %>%
      select(Date, all_of(station_col)) %>%
      rename(observed = all_of(station_col)) %>%
      arrange(Date)
    
    # Merge with multi-dataset and create combined dataset
    combined_dataset <- station_data %>%
      full_join(multi_precip_data, by = "Date") %>%
      mutate(
        best_dataset_value = .data[[best_dataset_name]],
        combined_rainfall = ifelse(!is.na(observed), observed, best_dataset_value),
        data_source = ifelse(!is.na(observed), "Observed", best_dataset_name),
        gap_filled = ifelse(is.na(observed) & !is.na(best_dataset_value), TRUE, FALSE)
      ) %>%
      select(Date, observed, best_dataset_value, combined_rainfall, data_source, gap_filled,
             all_of(best_dataset_name)) %>%
      arrange(Date) %>%
      rename(!!paste0("best_dataset_", best_dataset_name) := all_of(best_dataset_name))
    
    # Save combined dataset
    filename <- file.path(datasets_dir, paste0("combined_best_", station_col, "_2000_2025.csv"))
    write.csv(combined_dataset, filename, row.names = FALSE)
    
    cat(paste("   ✅ Created combined dataset for", station_col, "using", best_dataset_name, 
              "- saved as:", basename(filename), "\n"))
  })
  
  # Save best dataset summary
  write.csv(best_dataset_results, file.path(datasets_dir, "best_dataset_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  cat("   ✅ Best dataset summary saved\n")
  
  cat("✅ All combined best datasets saved to:", datasets_dir, "\n")
  
  return(best_dataset_results)
}

# Execute the analysis
cat("🚀 Starting Nature-style scatter plot analysis...\n")

# Create all scatter plots
all_scatter_plots <- create_all_scatter_plots(rainfall_data_filtered, multi_precip_data, rainfall_cols)

# Save individual scatter plots
save_scatter_plots(all_scatter_plots)

# Create station overview plots (2x2 grids)
create_station_overview_plots(all_scatter_plots)

# Calculate best datasets
best_dataset_results <- create_best_dataset_combination(rainfall_data_filtered, multi_precip_data, rainfall_cols)

cat("\n📊 Best Dataset Summary:\n")
print(best_dataset_results)

# Create combined datasets with best-fit data
final_best_results <- create_combined_best_datasets(rainfall_data_filtered, multi_precip_data, 
                                                   rainfall_cols, best_dataset_results)
```

## III.3. Gap-Filled Multi-Dataset Precipitation CSV Export

```{r}
# Gap-Filled Multi-Dataset Precipitation CSV Export
# This script creates a comprehensive CSV with:
# - All original weather dataset columns
# - 4 new gap-filled precipitation columns (mean of 22 stations for each dataset type)
# Dataset types: Original, ERA5_Land, CHIRPS, GPM_IMERG, PERSIANN_CDR

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# Set output directory
output_base_dir <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/Precipitation_Analysis"

cat("🚀 Starting gap-filled multi-dataset precipitation export...\n\n")

# Load the original weather dataset (assuming it exists)


# Load multi-dataset precipitation data
cat("📥 Loading multi-dataset precipitation data...\n")
multi_precip_data <- read_csv(file.path(output_base_dir, "combined_precipitation_data.csv")) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(date, format = "%d/%m/%Y")) %>%
  filter(year(Date) >= 2000 & year(Date) <= 2025) %>%
  select(Date, ERA5_Land, CHIRPS, GPM_IMERG, PERSIANN_CDR) %>%
  arrange(Date)

cat("✅ Multi-dataset precipitation data loaded:", nrow(multi_precip_data), "records\n")

# Filter original rainfall data to 2000-2025
rainfall_data_filtered <- rainfall_data %>%
  filter(year(Date) >= 2000 & year(Date) <= 2025)

cat("✅ Original rainfall data filtered:", nrow(rainfall_data_filtered), "records from 2000-2025\n\n")

# Function to calculate mean rainfall across all stations with gap-filling
calculate_gap_filled_mean_precipitation <- function(rainfall_data, multi_precip_data, rainfall_cols) {
  cat("📊 Calculating gap-filled mean precipitation for all stations...\n")
  
  # Get all unique dates from both datasets
  all_dates <- sort(unique(c(rainfall_data$Date, multi_precip_data$Date)))
  
  # Initialize result dataframe
  result_df <- tibble(Date = all_dates)
  
  # For each station, combine with multi-dataset and extract gap-filled values
  station_data_list <- map(rainfall_cols, ~{
    station_col <- .x
    cat(paste("   Processing station:", station_col, "\n"))
    
    # Get station data
    station_data <- rainfall_data %>%
      select(Date, all_of(station_col)) %>%
      rename(original_rainfall = all_of(station_col)) %>%
      arrange(Date)
    
    # Merge with multi-dataset precipitation data
    combined_data <- station_data %>%
      full_join(multi_precip_data, by = "Date") %>%
      arrange(Date) %>%
      mutate(
        # Create gap-filled columns with hierarchical priority
        Original_filled = original_rainfall,
        
        ERA5_Land_filled = case_when(
          !is.na(original_rainfall) ~ original_rainfall,
          is.na(original_rainfall) & !is.na(ERA5_Land) ~ ERA5_Land,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        ),
        
        CHIRPS_filled = case_when(
          !is.na(original_rainfall) ~ original_rainfall,
          is.na(original_rainfall) & !is.na(CHIRPS) ~ CHIRPS,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        ),
        
        GPM_IMERG_filled = case_when(
          !is.na(original_rainfall) ~ original_rainfall,
          is.na(original_rainfall) & !is.na(GPM_IMERG) ~ GPM_IMERG,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        ),
        
        PERSIANN_CDR_filled = case_when(
          !is.na(original_rainfall) ~ original_rainfall,
          is.na(original_rainfall) & !is.na(PERSIANN_CDR) ~ PERSIANN_CDR,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
      ) %>%
      select(Date, Original_filled, ERA5_Land_filled, CHIRPS_filled, 
             GPM_IMERG_filled, PERSIANN_CDR_filled)
    
    return(combined_data)
  })
  
  # Calculate mean across all stations for each dataset type
  cat("\n📊 Calculating mean across all 22 stations for each dataset type...\n")
  
  # Combine all station data
  all_station_data <- bind_rows(station_data_list, .id = "station_id")
  
  # Calculate means by date for each dataset type
  mean_precipitation <- all_station_data %>%
    group_by(Date) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean_Original_Precipitation = mean(Original_filled, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_ERA5_Land_Precipitation = mean(ERA5_Land_filled, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_CHIRPS_Precipitation = mean(CHIRPS_filled, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_GPM_IMERG_Precipitation = mean(GPM_IMERG_filled, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_PERSIANN_CDR_Precipitation = mean(PERSIANN_CDR_filled, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # Count of valid observations for each dataset type
      N_Original = sum(!is.na(Original_filled)),
      N_ERA5_Land = sum(!is.na(ERA5_Land_filled)),
      N_CHIRPS = sum(!is.na(CHIRPS_filled)),
      N_GPM_IMERG = sum(!is.na(GPM_IMERG_filled)),
      N_PERSIANN_CDR = sum(!is.na(PERSIANN_CDR_filled)),
      
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      # Replace NaN with NA (when all stations have NA)
      across(starts_with("Mean_"), ~ifelse(is.nan(.), NA_real_, .))
    )
  
  return(mean_precipitation)
}

# Calculate gap-filled mean precipitation
gap_filled_precipitation <- calculate_gap_filled_mean_precipitation(
  rainfall_data_filtered, 
  multi_precip_data, 
  rainfall_cols
)

cat("\n✅ Gap-filled mean precipitation calculated!\n")
cat("   Total dates:", nrow(gap_filled_precipitation), "\n")

# Merge with original weather dataset
cat("\n🔗 Merging gap-filled precipitation with original weather dataset...\n")

# If weather_data doesn't exist, create it from rainfall_data
if (!exists("weather_data")) {
  cat("⚠️  Original weather dataset not found. Creating from rainfall data...\n")
  weather_data <- rainfall_data_filtered
}

# Ensure weather_data is filtered to 2000-2025
weather_data_filtered <- weather_data %>%
  filter(year(Date) >= 2000 & year(Date) <= 2025)

# Merge datasets
final_dataset <- weather_data_filtered %>%
  left_join(gap_filled_precipitation, by = "Date") %>%
  arrange(Date)

cat("✅ Datasets merged successfully!\n")
cat("   Final dataset rows:", nrow(final_dataset), "\n")
cat("   Final dataset columns:", ncol(final_dataset), "\n\n")

# Display summary statistics
cat("📊 Summary Statistics for Gap-Filled Precipitation (2000-2025):\n\n")

summary_stats <- final_dataset %>%
  select(starts_with("Mean_")) %>%
  select(-starts_with("N_")) %>%
  summarise(
    across(everything(), 
           list(
             Min = ~min(., na.rm = TRUE),
             Max = ~max(., na.rm = TRUE),
             Mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
             Median = ~median(., na.rm = TRUE),
             SD = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE),
             NA_Count = ~sum(is.na(.)),
             Valid_Count = ~sum(!is.na(.))
           ),
           .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  separate(Metric, into = c("Dataset", "Statistic"), sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Statistic, values_from = Value)

print(summary_stats)

cat("\n📈 Data Coverage Summary:\n\n")

coverage_summary <- final_dataset %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Days = n(),
    Original_Coverage = round((sum(!is.na(Mean_Original_Precipitation)) / n()) * 100, 1),
    ERA5_Land_Coverage = round((sum(!is.na(Mean_ERA5_Land_Precipitation)) / n()) * 100, 1),
    CHIRPS_Coverage = round((sum(!is.na(Mean_CHIRPS_Precipitation)) / n()) * 100, 1),
    GPM_IMERG_Coverage = round((sum(!is.na(Mean_GPM_IMERG_Precipitation)) / n()) * 100, 1),
    PERSIANN_CDR_Coverage = round((sum(!is.na(Mean_PERSIANN_CDR_Precipitation)) / n()) * 100, 1)
  )

print(coverage_summary)

# Export the final dataset
output_file <- file.path(output_base_dir, "gap_filled_multi_dataset_precipitation_2000_2025.csv")

cat("\n💾 Exporting final dataset to CSV...\n")
write.csv(final_dataset, output_file, row.names = FALSE)

cat("✅ Dataset exported successfully!\n")
cat("📁 Output file:", output_file, "\n\n")

# Create a data dictionary
cat("📖 Creating data dictionary...\n")

data_dictionary <- tibble(
  Column_Name = names(final_dataset),
  Description = case_when(
    Column_Name == "Date" ~ "Date of observation",
    Column_Name == "Mean_Original_Precipitation" ~ "Mean of original rain gauge observations across 22 stations (mm)",
    Column_Name == "Mean_ERA5_Land_Precipitation" ~ "Mean precipitation with ERA5_Land gap-filling across 22 stations (mm)",
    Column_Name == "Mean_CHIRPS_Precipitation" ~ "Mean precipitation with CHIRPS gap-filling across 22 stations (mm)",
    Column_Name == "Mean_GPM_IMERG_Precipitation" ~ "Mean precipitation with GPM_IMERG gap-filling across 22 stations (mm)",
    Column_Name == "Mean_PERSIANN_CDR_Precipitation" ~ "Mean precipitation with PERSIANN_CDR gap-filling across 22 stations (mm)",
    Column_Name == "N_Original" ~ "Number of stations with valid original observations",
    Column_Name == "N_ERA5_Land" ~ "Number of stations with valid ERA5_Land filled data",
    Column_Name == "N_CHIRPS" ~ "Number of stations with valid CHIRPS filled data",
    Column_Name == "N_GPM_IMERG" ~ "Number of stations with valid GPM_IMERG filled data",
    Column_Name == "N_PERSIANN_CDR" ~ "Number of stations with valid PERSIANN_CDR filled data",
    TRUE ~ "Original weather dataset column"
  ),
  Data_Type = sapply(final_dataset, class)
)

# Export data dictionary
dictionary_file <- file.path(output_base_dir, "gap_filled_dataset_data_dictionary.csv")
write.csv(data_dictionary, dictionary_file, row.names = FALSE)

cat("✅ Data dictionary exported!\n")
cat("📁 Dictionary file:", dictionary_file, "\n\n")

# Create visualization of gap-filling effectiveness
cat("📊 Creating gap-filling effectiveness visualization...\n")

library(gridExtra)
library(scales)

# Prepare data for visualization
viz_data <- final_dataset %>%
  select(Date, starts_with("Mean_")) %>%
  select(-starts_with("N_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Mean_"), 
               names_to = "Dataset", 
               values_to = "Precipitation") %>%
  mutate(
    Dataset = str_replace(Dataset, "Mean_", ""),
    Dataset = str_replace(Dataset, "_Precipitation", ""),
    Dataset = factor(Dataset, levels = c("Original", "ERA5_Land", "CHIRPS", 
                                        "GPM_IMERG", "PERSIANN_CDR"))
  )

# Create visualization
p1 <- ggplot(viz_data %>% filter(!is.na(Precipitation)), 
            aes(x = Date, y = Precipitation, color = Dataset)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7, size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Dataset, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Gap-Filled Mean Precipitation Time Series (2000-2025)",
    subtitle = "Mean of 22 stations for each dataset type",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Precipitation (mm)",
    caption = "Original data prioritized, gaps filled hierarchically with satellite/reanalysis data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray60"),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#2E86AB", "#E74C3C", "#F39C12", "#27AE60", "#9B59B6"))

# Save visualization
viz_file <- file.path(output_base_dir, "gap_filled_precipitation_overview.jpeg")
ggsave(viz_file, p1, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
    Column_Name == "Mean_GPM_IMERG_Precipitation" ~ "Mean precipitation with GPM_IMERG gap-filling across 22 stations (mm). Priority: Original > GPM_IMERG.",
    Column_Name == "Mean_PERSIANN_CDR_Precipitation" ~ "Mean precipitation with PERSIANN_CDR gap-filling across 22 stations (mm). Priority: Original > PERSIANN_CDR.",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown column"
  ),
  Source = "Gap-filled multi-dataset precipitation (mean of 22 stations)",
  Data_Type = sapply(final_dataset[, names(final_dataset) %in% names(precipitation_columns)], function(x) class(x)[1])
)
```
