## IV.1. Extreme Precipitation Indices Analysis

**Description:** Computation of precipitation extremes for each dataset: total precipitation, consecutive wet days (CWD), consecutive dry days (CDD), simple daily intensity index (SDII), heavy rainfall days (R10, R20), maximum 1-day and 5-day rainfall (Rx1, Rx5), very wet days (R95p), extremely wet days (R99p), wet/dry day counts, mean/median daily precipitation, and coefficient of variation. Indices calculated for growing season periods (planting to harvest) enabling direct linkage to crop yield data. This analysis enables comparison of extreme event detection across datasets.

```{r}
# Comprehensive Precipitation Extreme Indices Comparison Script
# Comparing 4 gap-filled precipitation datasets: ERA5_Land, CHIRPS, GPM_IMERG, PERSIANN_CDR

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(zoo)
library(gridExtra)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

cat("================================================================================\n")
cat("=== PRECIPITATION EXTREME INDICES COMPARISON - ALL 4 DATASETS ===\n")
cat("================================================================================\n\n")

# Check if required datasets exist
if (!exists("data")) {
  stop("Error: 'data' (yield dataset) not found. Please load your yield dataset first.")
}

if (!exists("weather_data")) {
  stop("Error: 'weather_data' not found. Please load the weather dataset first.")
}

cat("✓ Both datasets found in environment\n")
cat("Yield data dimensions:", nrow(data), "rows ×", ncol(data), "columns\n")
cat("Weather data dimensions:", nrow(weather_data), "rows ×", ncol(weather_data), "columns\n\n")

# Define the 4 precipitation datasets to compare
precip_datasets <- c(
  "Mean_ERA5_Land_Precipitation",
  "Mean_CHIRPS_Precipitation", 
  "Mean_GPM_IMERG_Precipitation",
  "Mean_PERSIANN_CDR_Precipitation"
)

# Verify all precipitation columns exist
missing_cols <- precip_datasets[!precip_datasets %in% names(weather_data)]
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Error: Missing precipitation columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

cat("✓ All 4 precipitation datasets found:\n")
for (i in seq_along(precip_datasets)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %d. %s\n", i, precip_datasets[i]))
}
cat("\n")

# Function to safely convert dates
convert_date_safely <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(as.Date(character(0)))
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) return(x)
  
  x[x %in% c("#N/A", "#VALEUR!", "#NULL!", "#DIV/0!", "", "NA")] <- NA
  
  dates <- as.Date(x, format = "%d/%m/%Y")
  failed_indices <- is.na(dates) & !is.na(x)
  if (any(failed_indices)) {
    dates[failed_indices] <- as.Date(x[failed_indices], format = "%Y-%m-%d")
  }
  
  still_failed <- is.na(dates) & !is.na(x)
  if (any(still_failed)) {
    numeric_dates <- as.numeric(x[still_failed])
    if (any(!is.na(numeric_dates))) {
      dates[still_failed][!is.na(numeric_dates)] <- 
        as.Date("1899-12-30") + numeric_dates[!is.na(numeric_dates)]
    }
  }
  
  return(dates)
}

# Function to calculate consecutive days
calc_consecutive_days <- function(condition_vector) {
  if (length(condition_vector) == 0 || all(is.na(condition_vector))) return(0)
  condition_clean <- ifelse(is.na(condition_vector), FALSE, condition_vector)
  if (!any(condition_clean)) return(0)
  rle_result <- rle(condition_clean)
  max_consecutive <- max(rle_result$lengths[rle_result$values], na.rm = TRUE)
  return(ifelse(is.finite(max_consecutive), max_consecutive, 0))
}

# Function to calculate rolling maximum for n-day rainfall
calc_rolling_max <- function(values, n) {
  if (length(values) < n || all(is.na(values))) return(NA)
  values_clean <- ifelse(is.na(values), 0, values)
  if (length(values_clean) < n) return(sum(values_clean, na.rm = TRUE))
  rolling_sums <- zoo::rollsum(values_clean, k = n, align = "left", fill = NA)
  return(max(rolling_sums, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Enhanced function to calculate ONLY precipitation extreme indices
calculate_precip_extreme_indices <- function(plant_date, harvest_date, weather_df, precip_col) {
  
  if (is.na(plant_date) || is.na(harvest_date) || plant_date >= harvest_date) {
    return(list(
      precipitation_total = NA, growing_period_days = NA,
      CWD = NA, CDD = NA, SDII = NA, R10 = NA, R20 = NA,
      Rx1 = NA, Rx5 = NA, R95p = NA, R99p = NA,
      wet_days_count = NA, dry_days_count = NA,
      mean_daily_precip = NA, median_daily_precip = NA,
      precip_cv = NA  # Coefficient of variation
    ))
  }
  
  # Filter weather data for the growing period
  period_weather <- weather_df[weather_df$Date >= plant_date & weather_df$Date <= harvest_date, ]
  
  if (nrow(period_weather) == 0 || !precip_col %in% names(period_weather)) {
    return(list(
      precipitation_total = NA, growing_period_days = as.numeric(harvest_date - plant_date),
      CWD = NA, CDD = NA, SDII = NA, R10 = NA, R20 = NA,
      Rx1 = NA, Rx5 = NA, R95p = NA, R99p = NA,
      wet_days_count = NA, dry_days_count = NA,
      mean_daily_precip = NA, median_daily_precip = NA,
      precip_cv = NA
    ))
  }
  
  # Extract precipitation data
  precip <- period_weather[[precip_col]]
  precip_clean <- ifelse(is.na(precip), 0, precip)
  
  # Basic statistics
  growing_days <- as.numeric(harvest_date - plant_date)
  total_precip <- sum(precip_clean, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_precip <- mean(precip_clean, na.rm = TRUE)
  median_precip <- median(precip_clean, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_precip <- sd(precip_clean, na.rm = TRUE)
  cv_precip <- ifelse(mean_precip > 0, (sd_precip / mean_precip) * 100, NA)
  
  # CWD: Consecutive wet days (≥1mm)
  wet_days <- precip_clean >= 1
  CWD <- calc_consecutive_days(wet_days)
  wet_days_count <- sum(wet_days, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # CDD: Consecutive dry days (<1mm)
  dry_days <- precip_clean < 1
  CDD <- calc_consecutive_days(dry_days)
  dry_days_count <- sum(dry_days, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # SDII: Simple daily rainfall intensity (total rainfall / wet days)
  SDII <- ifelse(wet_days_count > 0, total_precip / wet_days_count, NA)
  
  # R10: Heavy rainfall days (≥10mm)
  R10 <- sum(precip_clean >= 10, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # R20: Very heavy rainfall days (≥20mm)
  R20 <- sum(precip_clean >= 20, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Rx1: Max 1-day rainfall
  Rx1 <- max(precip_clean, na.rm = TRUE)
  Rx1 <- ifelse(is.finite(Rx1), Rx1, NA)
  
  # Rx5: Max 5-day rainfall
  Rx5 <- calc_rolling_max(precip_clean, 5)
  
  # Calculate percentiles for the growing season
  wet_precip <- precip_clean[precip_clean > 0]
  if (length(wet_precip) >= 5) {
    p95 <- quantile(wet_precip, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
    p99 <- quantile(wet_precip, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
    R95p <- sum(precip_clean[precip_clean > p95], na.rm = TRUE)
    R99p <- sum(precip_clean[precip_clean > p99], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    R95p <- NA
    R99p <- NA
  }
  
  # Return all indices
  result <- list(
    precipitation_total = total_precip,
    growing_period_days = growing_days,
    CWD = CWD,
    CDD = CDD,
    SDII = SDII,
    R10 = R10,
    R20 = R20,
    Rx1 = Rx1,
    Rx5 = Rx5,
    R95p = R95p,
    R99p = R99p,
    wet_days_count = wet_days_count,
    dry_days_count = dry_days_count,
    mean_daily_precip = mean_precip,
    median_daily_precip = median_precip,
    precip_cv = cv_precip
  )
  
  # Convert NaN to NA
  result <- lapply(result, function(x) if(is.nan(x)) NA else x)
  return(result)
}

# Convert dates in yield data
cat("=== CONVERTING DATES IN YIELD DATA ===\n")
data$planting_date <- convert_date_safely(data$planting_date)
data$harvest_date <- convert_date_safely(data$harvest_date)

cat("Planting date range:", as.character(range(data$planting_date, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
cat("Harvest date range:", as.character(range(data$harvest_date, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
cat("Valid planting dates:", sum(!is.na(data$planting_date)), "\n")
cat("Valid harvest dates:", sum(!is.na(data$harvest_date)), "\n\n")

# Calculate indices for all 4 datasets
cat("================================================================================\n")
cat("=== CALCULATING PRECIPITATION EXTREME INDICES FOR ALL 4 DATASETS ===\n")
cat("================================================================================\n\n")

n_total <- nrow(data)
all_results <- list()

for (dataset_name in precip_datasets) {
  
  dataset_short_name <- gsub("Mean_", "", gsub("_Precipitation", "", dataset_name))
  cat(sprintf("Processing dataset: %s\n", dataset_short_name))
  
  # Initialize results for this dataset
  dataset_results <- data.frame(
    precipitation_total = rep(NA_real_, n_total),
    growing_period_days = rep(NA_real_, n_total),
    CWD = rep(NA_real_, n_total),
    CDD = rep(NA_real_, n_total),
    SDII = rep(NA_real_, n_total),
    R10 = rep(NA_real_, n_total),
    R20 = rep(NA_real_, n_total),
    Rx1 = rep(NA_real_, n_total),
    Rx5 = rep(NA_real_, n_total),
    R95p = rep(NA_real_, n_total),
    R99p = rep(NA_real_, n_total),
    wet_days_count = rep(NA_real_, n_total),
    dry_days_count = rep(NA_real_, n_total),
    mean_daily_precip = rep(NA_real_, n_total),
    median_daily_precip = rep(NA_real_, n_total),
    precip_cv = rep(NA_real_, n_total)
  )
  
  # Process each observation
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  chunk_size <- ceiling(n_total / 20)
  
  for (i in 1:n_total) {
    if (i %% chunk_size == 0 || i == n_total) {
      elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs"))
      progress <- round(100 * i / n_total, 1)
      cat(sprintf("  Progress: %d/%d (%s%%) - %.1f sec\r", i, n_total, progress, elapsed))
      flush.console()
    }
    
    indices <- calculate_precip_extreme_indices(
      plant_date = data$planting_date[i],
      harvest_date = data$harvest_date[i],
      weather_df = weather_data,
      precip_col = dataset_name
    )
    
    for (var_name in names(indices)) {
      if (var_name %in% names(dataset_results)) {
        dataset_results[i, var_name] <- indices[[var_name]]
      }
    }
  }
  
  total_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs"))
  cat(sprintf("\n  ✓ Completed in %.1f seconds\n\n", total_time))
  
  # Add dataset identifier and store results
  colnames(dataset_results) <- paste0(colnames(dataset_results), "_", dataset_short_name)
  all_results[[dataset_short_name]] <- dataset_results
}

# Combine all results
cat("=== COMBINING ALL RESULTS ===\n")
combined_results <- do.call(cbind, all_results)
data_with_all_precip_indices <- cbind(data, combined_results)

cat("Original data columns:", ncol(data), "\n")
cat("Precipitation indices added:", ncol(combined_results), "\n")
cat("Final dataset columns:", ncol(data_with_all_precip_indices), "\n\n")

# Save the comprehensive dataset
output_filename <- "sugarcane_yield_with_all_precip_extreme_indices.csv"
cat("=== SAVING COMPREHENSIVE DATASET ===\n")
write.csv(data_with_all_precip_indices, output_filename, row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("✓ Dataset saved as '%s' (%.2f MB)\n\n", output_filename, 
            file.size(output_filename) / 1024^2))
```

# Nature journal style theme
theme_nature <- function(base_size = 8) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      # Text elements
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 4)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 6)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
      
      # Grid and panel
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.2),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
      
      # Margins
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4),
      legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    )
}

# Function to get column name for dataset and index
get_col_name <- function(index, dataset) {
  # Pattern: DATASET.index_DATASET
  col_pattern1 <- paste0(dataset, ".", index, "_", dataset)
  if (col_pattern1 %in% names(data)) return(col_pattern1)
  
  # Try without underscore in dataset name
  dataset_no_underscore <- gsub("_", "", dataset)
  col_pattern2 <- paste0(dataset, ".", index, "_", dataset_no_underscore)
  if (col_pattern2 %in% names(data)) return(col_pattern2)
  
  # Try with underscore removed from prefix too
  col_pattern3 <- paste0(dataset_no_underscore, ".", index, "_", dataset_no_underscore)
  if (col_pattern3 %in% names(data)) return(col_pattern3)
  
  # Try original simple pattern
  col_pattern4 <- paste0(index, "_", dataset)
  if (col_pattern4 %in% names(data)) return(col_pattern4)
  
  # Try searching with grep
  search_patterns <- c(
    paste0("^", dataset, "\\.", index, "_"),
    paste0("^", index, "_", dataset, "$")
  )
  
  for (pattern in search_patterns) {
    matches <- grep(pattern, names(data), value = TRUE)
    if (length(matches) > 0) return(matches[1])
  }
  
  return(NULL)
}

# Calculate summary statistics

        Index = idx,

        Column = col,
        Mean = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        Median = median(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        SD = sd(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        Min = min(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        Max = max(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        Q25 = quantile(values, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        Q75 = quantile(values, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        N_valid = sum(!is.na(values)),
        N_total = length(values)
      ))
    }
  }
}

            Comparison = paste(datasets[i], "vs", datasets[j]),
            Correlation = cor(vals_i, vals_j),
            RMSE = sqrt(mean((vals_i - vals_j)^2)),
            MAE = mean(abs(vals_i - vals_j)),
            Bias = mean(vals_j - vals_i)
          ))
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

p_cor <- ggplot(agreement_data, aes(x = Index, y = Correlation, color = Comparison)) +

# V. Seasonal Time Series Decomposition Analysis for Rainfall Data

## V.1. Seasonal Time Series Decomposition Analysis for Rainfall Data \[original data\]

```{r}
# Seasonal Time Series Decomposition Analysis for Rainfall Data
# This script performs comprehensive seasonal decomposition showing:
# - Original data with seasonal patterns
# - Long-term trend
# - Seasonal component
# - Residuals/noise

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(gridExtra)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(forecast)
library(zoo)
library(hydroTSM)
library(plotly)

# Function to prepare time series data for decomposition
prepare_ts_data <- function(data, station_col, freq = 12) {
  # Prepare data
  ts_data <- data %>%
    select(Date, all_of(station_col)) %>%
    rename(rainfall = all_of(station_col)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(rainfall) & !is.na(Date)) %>%
    arrange(Date) %>%
    mutate(
      year = year(Date),
      month = month(Date),
      year_month = as.Date(paste(year, month, "01", sep = "-"))
    )
  
  if (nrow(ts_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Aggregate to monthly data (if needed)
  monthly_data <- ts_data %>%
    group_by(year_month) %>%
    summarise(
      rainfall = mean(rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
      count = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(count >= 5)  # Only months with sufficient data
  
  if (nrow(monthly_data) < 24) return(NULL)  # Need at least 2 years
  
  # Create regular time series
  start_year <- year(min(monthly_data$year_month))
  start_month <- month(min(monthly_data$year_month))
  
  # Create complete monthly sequence
  complete_dates <- seq(min(monthly_data$year_month), 
                       max(monthly_data$year_month), by = "month")
  
  complete_data <- data.frame(year_month = complete_dates) %>%
    left_join(monthly_data, by = "year_month") %>%
    mutate(rainfall = ifelse(is.na(rainfall), NA, rainfall))
  
  # Convert to ts object
  ts_object <- ts(complete_data$rainfall, 
                 start = c(start_year, start_month), 
                 frequency = freq)
  
  return(list(
    ts_object = ts_object,
    data_frame = complete_data,
    station = station_col,
    start_date = min(monthly_data$year_month),
    end_date = max(monthly_data$year_month)
  ))
}

# Function to perform seasonal decomposition
perform_decomposition <- function(ts_prepared, method = "stl") {
  if (is.null(ts_prepared)) return(NULL)
  
  ts_obj <- ts_prepared$ts_object
  
  # Handle missing values by interpolation (simple approach)
  if (any(is.na(ts_obj))) {
    ts_obj <- na.approx(ts_obj, na.rm = FALSE, rule = 2)
  }
  
  # Perform decomposition based on method
  if (method == "stl") {
    decomp <- stl(ts_obj, s.window = "periodic", t.window = 13, robust = TRUE)
    decomp_df <- data.frame(
      date = as.Date(time(ts_obj)),
      observed = as.numeric(ts_obj),
      trend = as.numeric(decomp$time.series[, "trend"]),
      seasonal = as.numeric(decomp$time.series[, "seasonal"]),
      residual = as.numeric(decomp$time.series[, "remainder"])
    )
  } else if (method == "classical") {
    decomp <- decompose(ts_obj, type = "additive")
    decomp_df <- data.frame(
      date = as.Date(time(ts_obj)),
      observed = as.numeric(ts_obj),
      trend = as.numeric(decomp$trend),
      seasonal = as.numeric(decomp$seasonal),
      residual = as.numeric(decomp$random)
    )
  }
  
  # Calculate trend + seasonal for better visualization
  decomp_df$trend_seasonal <- decomp_df$trend + decomp_df$seasonal
  
  return(list(
    decomposition = decomp,
    data = decomp_df,
    station = ts_prepared$station,
    method = method
  ))
}

# Function to create decomposition plots
create_decomposition_plot <- function(decomp_result) {
  if (is.null(decomp_result)) return(ggplot() + ggtitle("No data available"))
  
  decomp_data <- decomp_result$data
  station_name <- decomp_result$station
  
  # Create individual component plots
  p1 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = observed), color = "#2E86AB", alpha = 0.7, size = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(y = trend_seasonal), color = "#E74C3C", size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(title = paste("Original Data +", decomp_result$method, "Fit"),
         subtitle = "Blue: Observed data, Red: Trend + Seasonal",
         y = "Rainfall (mm)", x = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
  
  p2 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date, y = trend)) +
    geom_line(color = "#27AE60", size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(title = "Long-term Trend", y = "Trend (mm)", x = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
  
  p3 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date, y = seasonal)) +
    geom_line(color = "#9B59B6", size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(title = "Seasonal Component", y = "Seasonal (mm)", x = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
  
  p4 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date, y = residual)) +
    geom_line(color = "#E67E22", alpha = 0.6, size = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(title = "Residuals", y = "Residuals (mm)", 
         x = "Date",
         caption = paste("Station:", station_name)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
  
  # Combine plots
  combined_plot <- grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 1,
                               top = paste("Seasonal Decomposition:", station_name))
  
  return(list(
    combined = combined_plot,
    individual = list(original = p1, trend = p2, seasonal = p3, residual = p4)
  ))
}

# Function to create seasonal pattern analysis
create_seasonal_analysis <- function(decomp_result) {
  if (is.null(decomp_result)) return(NULL)
  
  decomp_data <- decomp_result$data %>%
    mutate(
      month_num = lubridate::month(date),
      month = factor(month_num, levels = 1:12, 
                    labels = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
                              "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")),
      year = lubridate::year(date)
    )
  
  # Monthly boxplot
  p1 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = month, y = observed)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = month), alpha = 0.7, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 3, 
                fill = "red", color = "darkred") +
    labs(title = "Monthly Rainfall Distribution",
         subtitle = "Red diamonds show monthly means",
         x = "Month", y = "Rainfall (mm)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d()
  
  # Seasonal component by month
  p2 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = month, y = seasonal)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = month), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = "Seasonal Effect by Month",
         subtitle = "Deviation from annual mean",
         x = "Month", y = "Seasonal Effect (mm)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d()
  
  # Annual trend
  annual_summary <- decomp_data %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(
      annual_rainfall = sum(observed, na.rm = TRUE),
      annual_trend = mean(trend, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  p3 <- ggplot(annual_summary, aes(x = year)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = annual_rainfall), color = "#2E86AB", size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(aes(y = annual_rainfall), method = "loess", se = TRUE, 
                color = "#E74C3C", fill = "#E74C3C", alpha = 0.2) +
    labs(title = "Annual Rainfall Totals with Trend",
         x = "Year", y = "Annual Rainfall (mm)") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  combined_seasonal <- grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 1)
  
  return(list(
    combined = combined_seasonal,
    individual = list(monthly_dist = p1, seasonal_effect = p2, annual_trend = p3),
    summary_data = list(monthly = decomp_data, annual = annual_summary)
  ))
}

# Function to process all stations
process_all_stations <- function(rainfall_data, rainfall_cols, method = "stl") {
  cat("🔄 Processing seasonal decomposition for all stations...\n")
  
  # Process each station
  all_results <- map(rainfall_cols, function(station) {
    cat("   Processing:", station, "\n")
    
    # Prepare time series
    ts_prep <- prepare_ts_data(rainfall_data, station)
    if (is.null(ts_prep)) {
      cat("   ⚠️ Insufficient data for", station, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Perform decomposition
    decomp_result <- perform_decomposition(ts_prep, method = method)
    if (is.null(decomp_result)) {
      cat("   ⚠️ Decomposition failed for", station, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Create plots
    decomp_plots <- create_decomposition_plot(decomp_result)
    seasonal_analysis <- create_seasonal_analysis(decomp_result)
    
    return(list(
      station = station,
      decomposition = decomp_result,
      plots = decomp_plots,
      seasonal_analysis = seasonal_analysis
    ))
  })
  
  # Filter out NULL results
  all_results <- all_results[!sapply(all_results, is.null)]
  names(all_results) <- sapply(all_results, function(x) x$station)
  
  return(all_results)
}

# Function to create summary statistics
create_decomposition_summary <- function(all_results) {
  summary_stats <- map_dfr(all_results, function(result) {
    if (is.null(result)) return(NULL)
    
    decomp_data <- result$decomposition$data
    
    data.frame(
      Station = result$station,
      Data_Points = nrow(decomp_data),
      Start_Date = min(decomp_data$date),
      End_Date = max(decomp_data$date),
      Mean_Rainfall = round(mean(decomp_data$observed, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Trend_Range = round(max(decomp_data$trend, na.rm = TRUE) - 
                         min(decomp_data$trend, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Seasonal_Amplitude = round(max(decomp_data$seasonal, na.rm = TRUE) - 
                                min(decomp_data$seasonal, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Residual_StdDev = round(sd(decomp_data$residual, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  
  return(summary_stats)
}

# Main execution
cat("🎯 Starting comprehensive seasonal decomposition analysis...\n")

# Process all stations with STL decomposition
decomposition_results <- process_all_stations(rainfall_data, rainfall_cols, method = "stl")

# Create summary statistics
summary_stats <- create_decomposition_summary(decomposition_results)

cat("\n📊 Decomposition Summary:\n")
print(summary_stats)

# Display results for first few stations
if (length(decomposition_results) > 0) {
  cat("\n🎨 Decomposition plots created for", length(decomposition_results), "stations\n")
  cat("   ✅ Long-term trends extracted\n")
  cat("   ✅ Seasonal patterns identified\n")
  cat("   ✅ Residual analysis completed\n")
  cat("   ✅ Monthly distribution analysis included\n")
  
  # Example: Display first station's decomposition
  if (length(decomposition_results) >= 1) {
    cat("\n📈 Displaying decomposition for first station:", names(decomposition_results)[1], "\n")
    # The plots are already created and stored in decomposition_results[[1]]$plots
  }
}

# Function to save all results
save_decomposition_results <- function(decomposition_results, summary_stats, 
                                     output_dir = "seasonal_decomposition_results") {
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Save individual station plots
  iwalk(decomposition_results, ~{
    station_name <- .y
    
    # Save decomposition plot
    decomp_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("decomposition_", station_name, ".jpeg"))
    ggsave(decomp_file, .x$plots$combined, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)
    
    # Save seasonal analysis
    seasonal_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("seasonal_analysis_", station_name, ".jpeg"))
    ggsave(seasonal_file, .x$seasonal_analysis$combined, width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 300)
    
    # Save data
    data_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("decomposition_data_", station_name, ".csv"))
    write.csv(.x$decomposition$data, data_file, row.names = FALSE)
  })
  
  # Save summary
  write.csv(summary_stats, file.path(output_dir, "decomposition_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("💾 All decomposition results saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
}

# Uncomment to save results
save_decomposition_results(decomposition_results, summary_stats)
```

## V.2. Seasonal Time Series Decomposition Analysis for Combined Rainfall Data

```{r}
# Seasonal Time Series Decomposition Analysis for Combined Rainfall Data
# This script performs comprehensive seasonal decomposition on the combined dataset
# (original station data + CHIRPS gap-filling) showing:
# - Original data with seasonal patterns using combined dataset
# - Long-term trend analysis
# - Seasonal component extraction
# - Residuals/noise analysis
# - Data source tracking (original vs CHIRPS)

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(gridExtra)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(forecast)
library(zoo)
library(hydroTSM)
library(plotly)

# Load CHIRPS data (same as before)
cat("📥 Loading CHIRPS precipitation data...\n")
chirps_data <- read_csv("combined_precipitation_1985_2025.csv") %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  filter(year(Date) >= 2000 & year(Date) <= 2025) %>%
  select(Date, precipitation) %>%
  rename(chirps_rainfall = precipitation)

# Filter original rainfall data to 2000-2025
rainfall_data_filtered <- rainfall_data %>%
  filter(year(Date) >= 2000 & year(Date) <= 2025)

# Function to combine station data with CHIRPS data (same as before)
combine_station_with_chirps <- function(rainfall_data, chirps_data, station_col) {
  station_data <- rainfall_data %>%
    select(Date, all_of(station_col)) %>%
    rename(original_rainfall = all_of(station_col)) %>%
    arrange(Date)
  
  combined_data <- station_data %>%
    full_join(chirps_data, by = "Date") %>%
    arrange(Date) %>%
    mutate(
      combined_rainfall = ifelse(!is.na(original_rainfall), original_rainfall, chirps_rainfall),
      data_source = case_when(
        !is.na(original_rainfall) & !is.na(chirps_rainfall) ~ "Original",
        !is.na(original_rainfall) & is.na(chirps_rainfall) ~ "Original",
        is.na(original_rainfall) & !is.na(chirps_rainfall) ~ "CHIRPS",
        TRUE ~ "Missing"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Date), data_source != "Missing")
  
  return(combined_data)
}

# Enhanced function to prepare time series data for decomposition with source tracking
prepare_enhanced_ts_data <- function(rainfall_data, chirps_data, station_col, freq = 12) {
  # Get combined data
  combined_data <- combine_station_with_chirps(rainfall_data, chirps_data, station_col)
  
  if (nrow(combined_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Prepare data with source information
  ts_data <- combined_data %>%
    select(Date, combined_rainfall, data_source) %>%
    rename(rainfall = combined_rainfall) %>%
    filter(!is.na(rainfall)) %>%
    arrange(Date) %>%
    mutate(
      year = year(Date),
      month = month(Date),
      year_month = as.Date(paste(year, month, "01", sep = "-"))
    )
  
  if (nrow(ts_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Aggregate to monthly data with source tracking
  monthly_data <- ts_data %>%
    group_by(year_month) %>%
    summarise(
      rainfall = mean(rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
      count = n(),
      original_days = sum(data_source == "Original"),
      chirps_days = sum(data_source == "CHIRPS"),
      dominant_source = ifelse(original_days >= chirps_days, "Original", "CHIRPS"),
      source_mix_ratio = round(original_days / (original_days + chirps_days), 2),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(count >= 5)  # Only months with sufficient data
  
  if (nrow(monthly_data) < 24) return(NULL)  # Need at least 2 years
  
  # Create regular time series
  start_year <- year(min(monthly_data$year_month))
  start_month <- month(min(monthly_data$year_month))
  
  # Create complete monthly sequence
  complete_dates <- seq(min(monthly_data$year_month), 
                       max(monthly_data$year_month), by = "month")
  
  complete_data <- data.frame(year_month = complete_dates) %>%
    left_join(monthly_data, by = "year_month") %>%
    mutate(rainfall = ifelse(is.na(rainfall), NA, rainfall))
  
  # Convert to ts object
  ts_object <- ts(complete_data$rainfall, 
                 start = c(start_year, start_month), 
                 frequency = freq)
  
  return(list(
    ts_object = ts_object,
    data_frame = complete_data,
    station = station_col,
    start_date = min(monthly_data$year_month),
    end_date = max(monthly_data$year_month),
    source_info = monthly_data
  ))
}

# Enhanced decomposition function with source tracking
perform_enhanced_decomposition <- function(ts_prepared, method = "stl") {
  if (is.null(ts_prepared)) return(NULL)
  
  ts_obj <- ts_prepared$ts_object
  
  # Handle missing values by interpolation
  if (any(is.na(ts_obj))) {
    ts_obj <- na.approx(ts_obj, na.rm = FALSE, rule = 2)
  }
  
  # Perform decomposition based on method
  if (method == "stl") {
    decomp <- stl(ts_obj, s.window = "periodic", t.window = 13, robust = TRUE)
    decomp_df <- data.frame(
      date = as.Date(time(ts_obj)),
      observed = as.numeric(ts_obj),
      trend = as.numeric(decomp$time.series[, "trend"]),
      seasonal = as.numeric(decomp$time.series[, "seasonal"]),
      residual = as.numeric(decomp$time.series[, "remainder"])
    )
  } else if (method == "classical") {
    decomp <- decompose(ts_obj, type = "additive")
    decomp_df <- data.frame(
      date = as.Date(time(ts_obj)),
      observed = as.numeric(ts_obj),
      trend = as.numeric(decomp$trend),
      seasonal = as.numeric(decomp$seasonal),
      residual = as.numeric(decomp$random)
    )
  }
  
  # Add source information
  decomp_df <- decomp_df %>%
    left_join(
      ts_prepared$source_info %>% select(year_month, dominant_source, source_mix_ratio),
      by = c("date" = "year_month")
    )
  
  # Calculate trend + seasonal for better visualization
  decomp_df$trend_seasonal <- decomp_df$trend + decomp_df$seasonal
  
  return(list(
    decomposition = decomp,
    data = decomp_df,
    station = ts_prepared$station,
    method = method,
    source_summary = ts_prepared$source_info
  ))
}

# Enhanced function to create decomposition plots with source information
create_enhanced_decomposition_plot <- function(decomp_result) {
  if (is.null(decomp_result)) return(ggplot() + ggtitle("No data available"))
  
  decomp_data <- decomp_result$data
  station_name <- decomp_result$station
  
  # Create individual component plots with source coloring
  p1 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = observed, color = dominant_source), alpha = 0.7, size = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(y = trend_seasonal), color = "#E74C3C", size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(title = paste("Enhanced Data +", decomp_result$method, "Fit"),
         subtitle = "Original data (blue), CHIRPS data (red), Combined fit (red line)",
         y = "Rainfall (mm)", x = NULL, color = "Data Source") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "top") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Original" = "#2E86AB", "CHIRPS" = "#E74C3C"))
  
  p2 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date, y = trend)) +
    geom_line(color = "#27AE60", size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(title = "Long-term Trend (Combined Dataset)", y = "Trend (mm)", x = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
  
  p3 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date, y = seasonal)) +
    geom_line(color = "#9B59B6", size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(title = "Seasonal Component", y = "Seasonal (mm)", x = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
  
  p4 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date, y = residual)) +
    geom_line(color = "#E67E22", alpha = 0.6, size = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(title = "Residuals", y = "Residuals (mm)", 
         x = "Date",
         caption = paste("Station:", station_name, "| Combined Original + CHIRPS Data")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
  
  # Combine plots
  combined_plot <- grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 1,
                               top = paste("Enhanced Seasonal Decomposition:", station_name))
  
  return(list(
    combined = combined_plot,
    individual = list(original = p1, trend = p2, seasonal = p3, residual = p4)
  ))
}

# Enhanced seasonal pattern analysis with source tracking
create_enhanced_seasonal_analysis <- function(decomp_result) {
  if (is.null(decomp_result)) return(NULL)
  
  decomp_data <- decomp_result$data %>%
    mutate(
      month_num = lubridate::month(date),
      month = factor(month_num, levels = 1:12, 
                    labels = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
                              "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")),
      year = lubridate::year(date)
    )
  
  # Monthly boxplot with source information
  p1 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = month, y = observed)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.alpha = 0.5, fill = "lightblue") +
    geom_point(aes(color = dominant_source, size = source_mix_ratio), 
               alpha = 0.7, position = position_jitter(width = 0.2)) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 3, 
                fill = "red", color = "darkred") +
    labs(title = "Monthly Rainfall Distribution (Enhanced Dataset)",
         subtitle = "Points colored by dominant source, size by original data ratio",
         x = "Month", y = "Rainfall (mm)", 
         color = "Dominant Source", size = "Original Ratio") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Original" = "#2E86AB", "CHIRPS" = "#E74C3C")) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 4))
  
  # Seasonal component by month
  p2 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = month, y = seasonal)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, fill = "lightgreen") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = "Seasonal Effect by Month (Enhanced Dataset)",
         subtitle = "Deviation from annual mean using combined data",
         x = "Month", y = "Seasonal Effect (mm)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # Annual trend with data source composition
  annual_summary <- decomp_data %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(
      annual_rainfall = sum(observed, na.rm = TRUE),
      annual_trend = mean(trend, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_original_ratio = mean(source_mix_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  p3 <- ggplot(annual_summary, aes(x = year)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = annual_rainfall), color = "#2E86AB", size = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(y = annual_rainfall, size = avg_original_ratio), 
               color = "#2E86AB", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(aes(y = annual_rainfall), method = "loess", se = TRUE, 
                color = "#E74C3C", fill = "#E74C3C", alpha = 0.2) +
    labs(title = "Annual Rainfall Totals with Trend (Enhanced Dataset)",
         subtitle = "Point size indicates average proportion of original data",
         x = "Year", y = "Annual Rainfall (mm)", size = "Original Data Ratio") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 6))
  
  # Data source composition over time
  p4 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date, y = source_mix_ratio)) +
    geom_line(color = "#9B59B6", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(title = "Data Source Composition Over Time",
         subtitle = "1.0 = All original data, 0.0 = All CHIRPS data",
         x = "Date", y = "Original Data Ratio") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  combined_seasonal <- grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2)
  
  return(list(
    combined = combined_seasonal,
    individual = list(monthly_dist = p1, seasonal_effect = p2, 
                     annual_trend = p3, source_composition = p4),
    summary_data = list(monthly = decomp_data, annual = annual_summary)
  ))
}

# Enhanced processing function for all stations
process_all_enhanced_stations <- function(rainfall_data, chirps_data, rainfall_cols, method = "stl") {
  cat("🔄 Processing enhanced seasonal decomposition for all stations...\n")
  
  # Process each station
  all_results <- map(rainfall_cols, function(station) {
    cat("   Processing:", station, "\n")
    
    # Prepare enhanced time series
    ts_prep <- prepare_enhanced_ts_data(rainfall_data, chirps_data, station)
    if (is.null(ts_prep)) {
      cat("   ⚠️ Insufficient data for", station, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Perform enhanced decomposition
    decomp_result <- perform_enhanced_decomposition(ts_prep, method = method)
    if (is.null(decomp_result)) {
      cat("   ⚠️ Decomposition failed for", station, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Create enhanced plots
    decomp_plots <- create_enhanced_decomposition_plot(decomp_result)
    seasonal_analysis <- create_enhanced_seasonal_analysis(decomp_result)
    
    return(list(
      station = station,
      decomposition = decomp_result,
      plots = decomp_plots,
      seasonal_analysis = seasonal_analysis
    ))
  })
  
  # Filter out NULL results
  all_results <- all_results[!sapply(all_results, is.null)]
  names(all_results) <- sapply(all_results, function(x) x$station)
  
  return(all_results)
}

# Enhanced summary statistics with source information
create_enhanced_decomposition_summary <- function(all_results) {
  summary_stats <- map_dfr(all_results, function(result) {
    if (is.null(result)) return(NULL)
    
    decomp_data <- result$decomposition$data
    source_summary <- result$decomposition$source_summary
    
    data.frame(
      Station = result$station,
      Data_Points = nrow(decomp_data),
      Start_Date = min(decomp_data$date),
      End_Date = max(decomp_data$date),
      Mean_Rainfall = round(mean(decomp_data$observed, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Original_Data_Percent = round(mean(decomp_data$source_mix_ratio, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
      CHIRPS_Data_Percent = round((1 - mean(decomp_data$source_mix_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100, 1),
      Trend_Range = round(max(decomp_data$trend, na.rm = TRUE) - 
                         min(decomp_data$trend, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Seasonal_Amplitude = round(max(decomp_data$seasonal, na.rm = TRUE) - 
                                min(decomp_data$seasonal, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Residual_StdDev = round(sd(decomp_data$residual, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  
  return(summary_stats)
}

# Main execution
cat("🎯 Starting enhanced seasonal decomposition analysis with combined dataset...\n")

# Process all stations with enhanced STL decomposition
enhanced_decomposition_results <- process_all_enhanced_stations(
  rainfall_data_filtered, chirps_data, rainfall_cols, method = "stl")

# Create enhanced summary statistics
enhanced_summary_stats <- create_enhanced_decomposition_summary(enhanced_decomposition_results)

cat("\n📊 Enhanced Decomposition Summary (2000-2025):\n")
print(enhanced_summary_stats)

# Display results summary
if (length(enhanced_decomposition_results) > 0) {
  cat("\n🎨 Enhanced decomposition plots created for", length(enhanced_decomposition_results), "stations\n")
  cat("   ✅ Long-term trends extracted from combined dataset\n")
  cat("   ✅ Seasonal patterns identified using gap-filled data\n")
  cat("   ✅ Residual analysis completed\n")
  cat("   ✅ Data source tracking included\n")
  cat("   ✅ Monthly distribution analysis with source information\n")
  
  # Show data composition
  total_original <- sum(enhanced_summary_stats$Original_Data_Percent * 
                       enhanced_summary_stats$Data_Points) / 
                   sum(enhanced_summary_stats$Data_Points)
  cat(paste("   📈 Overall data composition:", round(total_original, 1), 
            "% original,", round(100 - total_original, 1), "% CHIRPS\n"))
}

# Enhanced function to save all results
save_enhanced_decomposition_results <- function(decomposition_results, summary_stats, 
                                               output_dir = "enhanced_seasonal_decomposition_2000_2025") {
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Save individual station plots
  iwalk(decomposition_results, ~{
    station_name <- .y
    
    # Save enhanced decomposition plot
    decomp_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("enhanced_decomposition_", station_name, ".jpeg"))
    ggsave(decomp_file, .x$plots$combined, width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 300)
    
    # Save enhanced seasonal analysis
    seasonal_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("enhanced_seasonal_analysis_", station_name, ".jpeg"))
    ggsave(seasonal_file, .x$seasonal_analysis$combined, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
    
    # Save enhanced data
    data_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("enhanced_decomposition_data_", station_name, ".csv"))
    write.csv(.x$decomposition$data, data_file, row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save source summary
    source_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("source_summary_", station_name, ".csv"))
    write.csv(.x$decomposition$source_summary, source_file, row.names = FALSE)
  })
  
  # Save enhanced summary
  write.csv(summary_stats, file.path(output_dir, "enhanced_decomposition_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("💾 All enhanced decomposition results saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
}

# Save enhanced results
save_enhanced_decomposition_results(enhanced_decomposition_results, enhanced_summary_stats)
```

# Overlapping Histogram Distributions for All Precipitation Indices
# Standalone script for comparing all 4 datasets
# Nature-style publication-quality plots

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

cat("================================================================================\n")
cat("=== OVERLAPPING HISTOGRAM COMPARISON - ALL PRECIPITATION INDICES ===\n")
cat("================================================================================\n\n")

# Nature journal style theme
theme_nature <- function(base_size = 8) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      # Text elements
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 4)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 6)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
      
      # Grid and panel
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.2),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
      
      # Margins
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4),
      legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    )
}

# Load the comprehensive dataset
cat("=== LOADING DATA ===\n")
if (!file.exists("sugarcane_yield_with_all_precip_extreme_indices.csv")) {
  stop("Error: 'sugarcane_yield_with_all_precip_extreme_indices.csv' not found!")

                    all_cols, value = TRUE)

  R10 = "Heavy Rainfall Days (≥10mm)",
  R20 = "Very Heavy Rainfall Days (≥20mm)",
  Rx1 = "Max 1-day Rainfall (mm)",
  Rx5 = "Max 5-day Rainfall (mm)",
  R95p = "Very Wet Days (>95th percentile) (mm)",
  R99p = "Extremely Wet Days (>99th percentile) (mm)",
  wet_days_count = "Number of Wet Days (≥1mm)",
  dry_days_count = "Number of Dry Days (<1mm)",
  mean_daily_precip = "Mean Daily Precipitation (mm)",
  median_daily_precip = "Median Daily Precipitation (mm)",
  precip_cv = "Precipitation Coefficient of Variation (%)"
)

# Function to get column name
get_col_name <- function(index, dataset) {
  col_pattern1 <- paste0(dataset, ".", index, "_", dataset)
  if (col_pattern1 %in% names(data)) return(col_pattern1)
  
  dataset_no_underscore <- gsub("_", "", dataset)
  col_pattern2 <- paste0(dataset, ".", index, "_", dataset_no_underscore)
  if (col_pattern2 %in% names(data)) return(col_pattern2)
  
  col_pattern3 <- paste0(dataset_no_underscore, ".", index, "_", dataset_no_underscore)
  if (col_pattern3 %in% names(data)) return(col_pattern3)
  
  col_pattern4 <- paste0(index, "_", dataset)
  if (col_pattern4 %in% names(data)) return(col_pattern4)
  
  search_patterns <- c(
    paste0("^", dataset, "\\.", index, "_"),
    paste0("^", index, "_", dataset, "$")
  )
  
  for (pattern in search_patterns) {
    matches <- grep(pattern, names(data), value = TRUE)
    if (length(matches) > 0) return(matches[1])
  }
  
  return(NULL)
}

      )
      temp_df <- temp_df[!is.na(temp_df$Value), ]

  # Create plot if we have data from multiple datasets

# Generate summary statistics table
