```{r}
          Index_Label = index_labels[idx],
          Dataset = ds,
          N = length(values),
          Mean = mean(values),
          Median = median(values),
          SD = sd(values),
          Min = min(values),
          Max = max(values),
          Q25 = quantile(values, 0.25),
          Q75 = quantile(values, 0.75),
          IQR = IQR(values),
          CV = (sd(values) / mean(values)) * 100,
          Skewness = e1071::skewness(values),
          Kurtosis = e1071::kurtosis(values)
        ))
      }
    }
  }
}

write.csv(summary_stats, "histogram_plots/distribution_summary_statistics.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# VI. Advanced Seasonal Decomposition Analysis

## VI.1. X-13ARIMA-SEATS Decomposition

**Description:** State-of-the-art seasonal adjustment using X-13ARIMA-SEATS methodology (US Census Bureau standard). This advanced technique separates rainfall time series into trend-cycle, seasonal, and irregular components using optimal ARIMA model selection, automatic outlier detection, and sophisticated seasonal filters. Provides superior decomposition compared to classical methods by accounting for: (1) varying seasonal patterns over time, (2) calendar effects (trading days, holidays), (3) level shifts and outliers, and (4) non-constant trend patterns.

```{r}
# Seasonal Time Series Decomposition using X-13ARIMA-SEATS
# This script provides state-of-the-art seasonal adjustment using:
# - X-13ARIMA-SEATS methodology (US Census Bureau standard)
# - Automatic ARIMA model selection
# - Advanced outlier detection and adjustment
# - Trading day and holiday effects
# - Sophisticated seasonal adjustment
# - Comprehensive diagnostic tools


pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,     # Manipulation de données
  lubridate,     # Dates
  gridExtra,     # Disposition de graphiques
  viridis,       # Palettes de couleurs
  scales,        # Echelles graphiques
  seasonal,      # Interface R vers X-13ARIMA-SEATS
  zoo,           # Séries temporelles
  hydroTSM,      # Séries hydrologiques
  plotly,        # Graphiques interactifs
  DT,            # Tables interactives
  knitr          # Rapport et mise en forme
)

# Enhanced function to prepare time series for X-13ARIMA-SEATS
prepare_x13_data <- function(data, station_col, freq = 12, min_years = 3) {
  cat("   📊 Preparing data for X-13ARIMA-SEATS analysis...\n")
  
  # Prepare and clean data
  ts_data <- data %>%
    select(Date, all_of(station_col)) %>%
    rename(rainfall = all_of(station_col)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(rainfall) & !is.na(Date) & rainfall >= 0) %>%  # Remove negative values
    arrange(Date) %>%
    mutate(
      year = year(Date),
      month = month(Date),
      year_month = as.Date(paste(year, month, "01", sep = "-"))
    )
  
  if (nrow(ts_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Aggregate to monthly data with quality checks
  monthly_data <- ts_data %>%
    group_by(year_month) %>%
    summarise(
      rainfall = mean(rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
      count = n(),
      min_val = min(rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_val = max(rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(count >= 5)  # Only months with sufficient data
  
  # Check for minimum data requirements
  years_span <- as.numeric(difftime(max(monthly_data$year_month), 
                                   min(monthly_data$year_month), 
                                   units = "days")) / 365.25
  
  if (nrow(monthly_data) < (min_years * 12) || years_span < min_years) {
    cat("   ⚠️ Insufficient data: need at least", min_years, "years\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Create complete monthly sequence
  complete_dates <- seq(min(monthly_data$year_month), 
                       max(monthly_data$year_month), by = "month")
  
  complete_data <- data.frame(year_month = complete_dates) %>%
    left_join(monthly_data, by = "year_month")
  
  # Handle missing values intelligently
  complete_data$rainfall <- na.approx(complete_data$rainfall, na.rm = FALSE, rule = 2)
  
  # Add small constant to avoid zero values (X-13 works better with positive values)
  complete_data$rainfall <- complete_data$rainfall + 0.01
  
  # Create ts object
  start_year <- year(min(complete_dates))
  start_month <- month(min(complete_dates))
  
  ts_object <- ts(complete_data$rainfall, 
                 start = c(start_year, start_month), 
                 frequency = freq)
  
  return(list(
    ts_object = ts_object,
    data_frame = complete_data,
    station = station_col,
    start_date = min(complete_dates),
    end_date = max(complete_dates),
    n_years = round(years_span, 1),
    n_observations = length(complete_data$rainfall)
  ))
}

# Enhanced X-13ARIMA-SEATS decomposition function
perform_x13_decomposition <- function(ts_prepared, 
                                    transform = "auto",
                                    outlier = TRUE,
                                    trading_day = FALSE,
                                    holiday = FALSE) {
  
  if (is.null(ts_prepared)) return(NULL)
  
  cat("   🔧 Running X-13ARIMA-SEATS decomposition...\n")
  
  ts_obj <- ts_prepared$ts_object
  station_name <- ts_prepared$station
  
  # Try X-13ARIMA-SEATS decomposition with error handling
  tryCatch({
    # Prepare regression variables
    reg_vars <- NULL
    if (trading_day && holiday) {
      reg_vars <- c("td", "easter[1]")
    } else if (trading_day) {
      reg_vars <- "td"
    } else if (holiday) {
      reg_vars <- "easter[1]"
    }
    
    # Main X-13 analysis with simplified approach
    x13_result <- seas(ts_obj, 
                      transform.function = transform,
                      arima.model = "(0 1 1)(0 1 1)",  # Default SARIMA model
                      outlier = if(outlier) NULL else list(),
                      regression.variables = reg_vars,
                      x11 = "",  # Use X-11 seasonal adjustment
                      dir = tempdir())
    
    # Extract components
    original <- original(x13_result)
    trend <- trend(x13_result)
    seasonal <- seasonal(x13_result)
    irregular <- irregular(x13_result)
    seasonally_adjusted <- final(x13_result)
    
    # Create comprehensive data frame
    decomp_df <- data.frame(
      date = as.Date(time(original)),
      observed = as.numeric(original),
      trend = as.numeric(trend),
      seasonal = as.numeric(seasonal),
      irregular = as.numeric(irregular),
      seasonally_adjusted = as.numeric(seasonally_adjusted),
      fitted = as.numeric(trend) + as.numeric(seasonal)
    )
    
    # Calculate additional metrics
    decomp_df <- decomp_df %>%
      mutate(
        trend_cycle = trend,
        residual = observed - fitted,
        seasonal_strength = abs(seasonal) / (abs(seasonal) + abs(irregular)),
        year = year(date),
        month = month(date),
        month_name = month.name[month]
      )
    
    # Get model diagnostics
    model_summary <- summary(x13_result)
    
    # Extract key diagnostics safely
    diagnostics <- list(
      arima_model = tryCatch(x13_result$model$arima$model, error = function(e) "Auto-selected"),
      transform = tryCatch(x13_result$model$transform$`function`, error = function(e) transform),
      outliers_detected = tryCatch(
        if(!is.null(x13_result$model$outlier)) nrow(x13_result$model$outlier) else 0,
        error = function(e) 0
      ),
      trading_day_test = if(!is.null(reg_vars) && "td" %in% reg_vars) "included" else "not included"
    )
    
    return(list(
      x13_object = x13_result,
      data = decomp_df,
      station = station_name,
      diagnostics = diagnostics,
      model_summary = model_summary,
      method = "X-13ARIMA-SEATS"
    ))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("   ❌ X-13ARIMA-SEATS failed for", station_name, ":", e$message, "\n")
    cat("   🔄 Falling back to enhanced STL decomposition...\n")
    
    # Fallback to enhanced STL
    stl_result <- stl(ts_obj, s.window = "periodic", t.window = 13, robust = TRUE)
    
    decomp_df <- data.frame(
      date = as.Date(time(ts_obj)),
      observed = as.numeric(ts_obj),
      trend = as.numeric(stl_result$time.series[, "trend"]),
      seasonal = as.numeric(stl_result$time.series[, "seasonal"]),
      irregular = as.numeric(stl_result$time.series[, "remainder"]),
      seasonally_adjusted = as.numeric(ts_obj) - as.numeric(stl_result$time.series[, "seasonal"]),
      fitted = as.numeric(stl_result$time.series[, "trend"]) + as.numeric(stl_result$time.series[, "seasonal"])
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        trend_cycle = trend,
        residual = observed - fitted,
        seasonal_strength = abs(seasonal) / (abs(seasonal) + abs(irregular)),
        year = year(date),
        month = month(date),
        month_name = month.name[month]
      )
    
    return(list(
      x13_object = NULL,
      data = decomp_df,
      station = station_name,
      diagnostics = list(method = "STL_fallback", reason = e$message),
      model_summary = NULL,
      method = "STL (fallback)"
    ))
  })
}

# Enhanced plotting function for X-13 results
create_x13_plots <- function(x13_result) {
  if (is.null(x13_result)) return(ggplot() + ggtitle("No data available"))
  
  decomp_data <- x13_result$data
  station_name <- x13_result$station
  method <- x13_result$method
  
  # Color palette
  colors <- c("#2E86AB", "#A23B72", "#F18F01", "#C73E1D", "#27AE60", "#8E44AD")
  
  # 1. Original vs Seasonally Adjusted
  p1 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = observed, color = "Original"), alpha = 0.7, size = 0.6) +
    geom_line(aes(y = seasonally_adjusted, color = "Seasonally Adjusted"), size = 0.8) +
    geom_line(aes(y = trend, color = "Trend"), size = 1, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Original" = colors[1], 
                                "Seasonally Adjusted" = colors[2], 
                                "Trend" = colors[3])) +
    labs(title = paste("Original vs Seasonally Adjusted Data -", method),
         subtitle = paste("Station:", station_name),
         y = "Rainfall (mm)", x = NULL, color = "Series") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
  
  # 2. Seasonal Component
  p2 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date, y = seasonal)) +
    geom_line(color = colors[4], size = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray50", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Seasonal Component", y = "Seasonal Effect (mm)", x = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
  
  # 3. Trend-Cycle Component
  p3 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date, y = trend)) +
    geom_line(color = colors[5], size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = colors[6], alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(title = "Trend-Cycle Component", y = "Trend (mm)", x = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
  
  # 4. Irregular Component
  p4 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date, y = irregular)) +
    geom_line(color = colors[1], alpha = 0.7, size = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, color = "red") +
    labs(title = "Irregular Component", y = "Irregular (mm)", 
         x = "Date") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
  
  # Combine plots
  combined_plot <- grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 1,
                               top = paste("X-13ARIMA-SEATS Decomposition:", station_name))
  
  return(list(
    combined = combined_plot,
    individual = list(
      original_vs_adjusted = p1, 
      seasonal = p2, 
      trend = p3, 
      irregular = p4
    )
  ))
}

# Enhanced seasonal analysis with X-13 insights
create_enhanced_seasonal_analysis <- function(x13_result) {
  if (is.null(x13_result)) return(NULL)
  
  decomp_data <- x13_result$data
  station_name <- x13_result$station
  
  # Monthly patterns analysis
  monthly_stats <- decomp_data %>%
    group_by(month, month_name) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_observed = mean(observed, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_seasonal = mean(seasonal, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_seasonal_strength = mean(seasonal_strength, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_observed = sd(observed, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_obs = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(month)
  
  # 1. Enhanced monthly distribution
  p1 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = factor(month), y = observed)) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill = factor(month)), alpha = 0.6, scale = "width") +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 3, 
                fill = "red", color = "darkred") +
    labs(title = "Monthly Rainfall Distribution (Enhanced)",
         subtitle = "Violin plots show full distribution, red diamonds = means",
         x = "Month", y = "Rainfall (mm)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    scale_fill_viridis_d() +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = month.abb)
  
  # 2. Seasonal strength over time
  p2 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date, y = seasonal_strength)) +
    geom_line(color = "#8E44AD", size = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "#E74C3C", alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    labs(title = "Seasonal Strength Over Time",
         subtitle = "Higher values indicate stronger seasonal patterns",
         x = "Date", y = "Seasonal Strength") +
    theme_minimal() +
    ylim(0, 1)
  
  # 3. Seasonally adjusted vs original
  p3 <- decomp_data %>%
    select(date, observed, seasonally_adjusted) %>%
    gather(key = "series", value = "value", -date) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = date, y = value, color = series)) +
    geom_line(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("observed" = "#2E86AB", "seasonally_adjusted" = "#E74C3C"),
                      labels = c("Original", "Seasonally Adjusted")) +
    labs(title = "Original vs Seasonally Adjusted Series",
         subtitle = "Seasonally adjusted series removes seasonal patterns",
         x = "Date", y = "Rainfall (mm)", color = "Series") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  combined_analysis <- grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 1)
  
  return(list(
    combined = combined_analysis,
    individual = list(
      monthly_distribution = p1,
      seasonal_strength = p2,
      original_vs_adjusted = p3
    ),
    monthly_stats = monthly_stats
  ))
}

# Enhanced processing function with X-13ARIMA-SEATS
process_stations_x13 <- function(rainfall_data, rainfall_cols, 
                                transform = "auto",
                                outlier = TRUE,
                                trading_day = FALSE,
                                holiday = FALSE,
                                parallel = FALSE) {
  
  cat("🚀 Starting X-13ARIMA-SEATS analysis for all stations...\n")
  cat("   ⚙️ Transform:", transform, "| Outlier detection:", outlier, "\n")
  cat("   📅 Trading day effects:", trading_day, "| Holiday effects:", holiday, "\n")
  
  # Process function for individual station
  process_single_station <- function(station) {
    cat("   🔧 Processing:", station, "\n")
    
    # Prepare time series
    ts_prep <- prepare_x13_data(rainfall_data, station)
    if (is.null(ts_prep)) {
      cat("   ⚠️ Insufficient data for", station, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    cat("   📊 Data span:", ts_prep$n_years, "years,", ts_prep$n_observations, "observations\n")
    
    # Perform X-13 decomposition
    x13_result <- perform_x13_decomposition(ts_prep, 
                                          transform = transform,
                                          outlier = outlier,
                                          trading_day = trading_day,
                                          holiday = holiday)
    
    if (is.null(x13_result)) {
      cat("   ❌ X-13 analysis failed for", station, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Create plots
    x13_plots <- create_x13_plots(x13_result)
    seasonal_analysis <- create_enhanced_seasonal_analysis(x13_result)
    
    cat("   ✅ Completed:", station, "using", x13_result$method, "\n")
    
    return(list(
      station = station,
      x13_result = x13_result,
      plots = x13_plots,
      seasonal_analysis = seasonal_analysis,
      data_info = ts_prep
    ))
  }
  
  # Process stations (with optional parallelization)
  if (parallel && requireNamespace("parallel", quietly = TRUE)) {
    cat("   🔄 Using parallel processing...\n")
    all_results <- parallel::mclapply(rainfall_cols, process_single_station, mc.cores = 2)
  } else {
    all_results <- map(rainfall_cols, process_single_station)
  }
  
  # Filter out NULL results
  all_results <- all_results[!sapply(all_results, is.null)]
  names(all_results) <- sapply(all_results, function(x) x$station)
  
  return(all_results)
}

# Enhanced summary statistics for X-13 results
create_x13_summary <- function(all_results) {
  summary_stats <- map_dfr(all_results, function(result) {
    if (is.null(result)) return(NULL)
    
    x13_data <- result$x13_result$data
    diagnostics <- result$x13_result$diagnostics
    
    data.frame(
      Station = result$station,
      Method = result$x13_result$method,
      Data_Points = nrow(x13_data),
      Years_Span = result$data_info$n_years,
      Start_Date = as.character(min(x13_data$date)),
      End_Date = as.character(max(x13_data$date)),
      Mean_Rainfall = round(mean(x13_data$observed, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Mean_Seasonal_Adjusted = round(mean(x13_data$seasonally_adjusted, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Seasonal_Range = round(max(x13_data$seasonal, na.rm = TRUE) - 
                            min(x13_data$seasonal, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Trend_Change = round(last(x13_data$trend) - first(x13_data$trend), 2),
      Mean_Seasonal_Strength = round(mean(x13_data$seasonal_strength, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      Irregular_StdDev = round(sd(x13_data$irregular, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      ARIMA_Model = if(!is.null(diagnostics$arima_model)) diagnostics$arima_model else "STL",
      Transform = if(!is.null(diagnostics$transform)) diagnostics$transform else "none",
      Outliers_Detected = if(!is.null(diagnostics$outliers_detected)) diagnostics$outliers_detected else 0,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  
  return(summary_stats)
}

# Function to save enhanced results
save_x13_results <- function(x13_results, summary_stats, 
                           output_dir = "x13_arima_seats_results") {
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  cat("💾 Saving X-13ARIMA-SEATS results...\n")
  
  # Save individual station results
  iwalk(x13_results, ~{
    station_name <- .y
    station_clean <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", station_name)
    
    # Save main decomposition plot
    decomp_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("x13_decomposition_", station_clean, ".jpeg"))
    ggsave(decomp_file, .x$plots$combined, width = 14, height = 12, dpi = 300)
    
    # Save seasonal analysis
    seasonal_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("x13_seasonal_analysis_", station_clean, ".jpeg"))
    ggsave(seasonal_file, .x$seasonal_analysis$combined, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
    
    # Save decomposition data
    data_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("x13_data_", station_clean, ".csv"))
    write.csv(.x$x13_result$data, data_file, row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save seasonal statistics
    if (!is.null(.x$seasonal_analysis$monthly_stats)) {
      monthly_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("x13_monthly_stats_", station_clean, ".csv"))
      write.csv(.x$seasonal_analysis$monthly_stats, monthly_file, row.names = FALSE)
    }
  })
  
  # Save comprehensive summary
  write.csv(summary_stats, file.path(output_dir, "x13_comprehensive_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  # Create HTML summary report
  create_html_report(x13_results, summary_stats, output_dir)
  
  cat("✅ All X-13ARIMA-SEATS results saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
}

# Function to create HTML summary report
create_html_report <- function(x13_results, summary_stats, output_dir) {
  html_content <- paste0("
  <html>
  <head>
    <title>X-13ARIMA-SEATS Seasonal Decomposition Report</title>
    <style>
      body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; margin: 20px; }
      h1 { color: #2E86AB; }
      h2 { color: #A23B72; }
      table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; }
      th, td { border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 8px; text-align: left; }
      th { background-color: #f2f2f2; }
      .summary { background-color: #f9f9f9; padding: 15px; border-radius: 5px; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <h1>X-13ARIMA-SEATS Seasonal Decomposition Analysis Report</h1>
    <p>Generated on: ", Sys.Date(), "</p>
    
    <div class='summary'>
      <h2>Analysis Summary</h2>
      <p><strong>Total Stations Analyzed:</strong> ", nrow(summary_stats), "</p>
      <p><strong>Successful X-13 Decompositions:</strong> ", 
        sum(summary_stats$Method == "X-13ARIMA-SEATS"), "</p>
      <p><strong>STL Fallback Cases:</strong> ", 
        sum(summary_stats$Method == "STL (fallback)"), "</p>
    </div>
    
    <h2>Detailed Results</h2>
    ", knitr::kable(summary_stats, format = "html"), "
    
    <h2>Key Findings</h2>
    <ul>
      <li>Average seasonal strength: ", round(mean(summary_stats$Mean_Seasonal_Strength, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "</li>
      <li>Stations with strong seasonality (>0.6): ", 
        sum(summary_stats$Mean_Seasonal_Strength > 0.6, na.rm = TRUE), "</li>
      <li>Average data span: ", round(mean(summary_stats$Years_Span, na.rm = TRUE), 1), " years</li>
    </ul>
  </body>
  </html>
  ")
  
  writeLines(html_content, file.path(output_dir, "x13_analysis_report.html"))
}

# MAIN EXECUTION
cat("🎯 Starting Enhanced X-13ARIMA-SEATS Seasonal Decomposition Analysis...\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

# Run X-13ARIMA-SEATS analysis
x13_results <- process_stations_x13(
  rainfall_data, 
  rainfall_cols,
  transform = "auto",      # Automatic Box-Cox transformation
  outlier = TRUE,          # Enable outlier detection
  trading_day = FALSE,     # Usually not relevant for rainfall
  holiday = FALSE,         # Can be enabled if relevant
  parallel = FALSE         # Set to TRUE for parallel processing
)

# Create comprehensive summary
x13_summary <- create_x13_summary(x13_results)

# Display results
cat("\n📊 X-13ARIMA-SEATS Analysis Summary:\n")
cat("=====================================\n")
print(x13_summary)

if (length(x13_results) > 0) {
  cat("\n🎨 Analysis completed for", length(x13_results), "stations\n")
  cat("   ✅ Advanced seasonal adjustment performed\n")
  cat("   ✅ ARIMA models automatically selected\n")
  cat("   ✅ Outlier detection and adjustment completed\n")
  cat("   ✅ Seasonal strength metrics calculated\n")
  cat("   ✅ Enhanced diagnostic plots created\n")
  
  # Show method breakdown
  method_summary <- table(x13_summary$Method)
  cat("\n📈 Method Distribution:\n")
  print(method_summary)
}

# Save all results
save_x13_results(x13_results, x13_summary)
```

## VI.2. X-13ARIMA-SEATS Seasonal Decomposition using Pre-Combined CSV Files

```{r}
# X-13ARIMA-SEATS Seasonal Decomposition using Pre-Combined CSV Files
# This script loads the previously exported combined CSV files and performs
# state-of-the-art seasonal adjustment using:
# - X-13ARIMA-SEATS methodology (US Census Bureau standard)
# - Automatic ARIMA model selection

pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,     # Data manipulation
  lubridate,     # Date handling
  gridExtra,     # Plot arrangements
  viridis,       # Color palettes
  scales,        # Plot scales
  seasonal,      # Interface to X-13ARIMA-SEATS
  zoo,           # Time series
  hydroTSM,      # Hydrological time series
  plotly,        # Interactive plots
  DT,            # Interactive tables
  knitr          # Reporting
)

# Function to load combined CSV files
load_combined_datasets <- function(csv_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets", 
                                  rainfall_cols = NULL) {
  cat("📂 Loading combined CSV datasets...\n")
  
  # Get all CSV files in the directory
  csv_files <- list.files(csv_dir, pattern = "^combined_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(csv_files) == 0) {
    stop("❌ No combined CSV files found in: ", csv_dir)
  }
  
  cat("   Found", length(csv_files), "combined CSV files\n")
  
  # Load all datasets
  combined_data_list <- map(csv_files, function(file) {
    # Extract station name from filename
    station_name <- str_extract(basename(file), "(?<=combined_)[^_]+(?=_)")
    
    cat("   Loading:", station_name, "\n")
    
    # Load and prepare data
    data <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>%
      select(Date, combined_rainfall, data_source, original_for_plot, chirps_for_plot) %>%
      arrange(Date)
    
    return(list(
      station = station_name,
      data = data
    ))
  })
  
  # Name the list by station names
  names(combined_data_list) <- map_chr(combined_data_list, ~.x$station)
  
  # Filter by rainfall_cols if provided
  if (!is.null(rainfall_cols)) {
    available_stations <- names(combined_data_list)
    requested_stations <- intersect(rainfall_cols, available_stations)
    missing_stations <- setdiff(rainfall_cols, available_stations)
    
    if (length(missing_stations) > 0) {
      cat("   ⚠️ Missing stations:", paste(missing_stations, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    }
    
    combined_data_list <- combined_data_list[requested_stations]
    cat("   Selected", length(combined_data_list), "stations for analysis\n")
  }
  
  return(combined_data_list)
}

# Enhanced function to prepare time series for X-13ARIMA-SEATS from combined data
prepare_x13_from_combined <- function(combined_dataset, freq = 12, min_years = 3) {
  station_name <- combined_dataset$station
  data <- combined_dataset$data
  
  cat("   📊 Preparing", station_name, "for X-13ARIMA-SEATS analysis...\n")
  
  # Use the combined rainfall data
  ts_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(combined_rainfall) & !is.na(Date) & combined_rainfall >= 0) %>%
    arrange(Date) %>%
    mutate(
      year = year(Date),
      month = month(Date),
      year_month = as.Date(paste(year, month, "01", sep = "-"))
    ) %>%
    rename(rainfall = combined_rainfall)
  
  if (nrow(ts_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Aggregate to monthly data with source tracking
  monthly_data <- ts_data %>%
    group_by(year_month) %>%
    summarise(
      rainfall = mean(rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
      count = n(),
      original_days = sum(data_source == "Original", na.rm = TRUE),
      chirps_days = sum(data_source == "CHIRPS", na.rm = TRUE),
      dominant_source = ifelse(original_days >= chirps_days, "Original", "CHIRPS"),
      source_ratio = round(original_days / (original_days + chirps_days), 3),
      min_val = min(rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_val = max(rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(count >= 5)  # Only months with sufficient data
  
  # Check for minimum data requirements
  years_span <- as.numeric(difftime(max(monthly_data$year_month), 
                                   min(monthly_data$year_month), 
                                   units = "days")) / 365.25
  
  if (nrow(monthly_data) < (min_years * 12) || years_span < min_years) {
    cat("   ⚠️ Insufficient data for", station_name, ": need at least", min_years, "years\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Create complete monthly sequence
  complete_dates <- seq(min(monthly_data$year_month), 
                       max(monthly_data$year_month), by = "month")
  
  complete_data <- data.frame(year_month = complete_dates) %>%
    left_join(monthly_data, by = "year_month")
  
  # Handle missing values intelligently
  complete_data$rainfall <- na.approx(complete_data$rainfall, na.rm = FALSE, rule = 2)
  
  # Add small constant to avoid zero values (X-13 works better with positive values)
  complete_data$rainfall <- complete_data$rainfall + 0.01
  
  # Create ts object
  start_year <- year(min(complete_dates))
  start_month <- month(min(complete_dates))
  
  ts_object <- ts(complete_data$rainfall, 
                 start = c(start_year, start_month), 
                 frequency = freq)
  
  # Calculate data quality metrics
  overall_original_ratio <- sum(monthly_data$original_days, na.rm = TRUE) / 
                           (sum(monthly_data$original_days, na.rm = TRUE) + 
                            sum(monthly_data$chirps_days, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  return(list(
    ts_object = ts_object,
    data_frame = complete_data,
    monthly_source_info = monthly_data,
    station = station_name,
    start_date = min(complete_dates),
    end_date = max(complete_dates),
    n_years = round(years_span, 1),
    n_observations = length(complete_data$rainfall),
    original_data_ratio = round(overall_original_ratio, 3),
    data_quality = case_when(
      overall_original_ratio >= 0.8 ~ "Excellent",
      overall_original_ratio >= 0.6 ~ "Good", 
      overall_original_ratio >= 0.4 ~ "Fair",
      TRUE ~ "CHIRPS Dominant"
    )
  ))
}

# Enhanced X-13ARIMA-SEATS decomposition function with source tracking
perform_x13_combined_decomposition <- function(ts_prepared, 
                                              transform = "auto",
                                              outlier = TRUE,
                                              trading_day = FALSE,
                                              holiday = FALSE) {
  
  if (is.null(ts_prepared)) return(NULL)
  
  cat("   🔧 Running X-13ARIMA-SEATS on combined data for", ts_prepared$station, "\n")
  cat("   📊 Data quality:", ts_prepared$data_quality, 
      "(", round(ts_prepared$original_data_ratio * 100, 1), "% original)\n")
  
  ts_obj <- ts_prepared$ts_object
  station_name <- ts_prepared$station
  
  # Try X-13ARIMA-SEATS decomposition with error handling
  tryCatch({
    # Prepare regression variables
    reg_vars <- NULL
    if (trading_day && holiday) {
      reg_vars <- c("td", "easter[1]")
    } else if (trading_day) {
      reg_vars <- "td"
    } else if (holiday) {
      reg_vars <- "easter[1]"
    }
    
    # Main X-13 analysis
    x13_result <- seas(ts_obj, 
                      transform.function = transform,
                      arima.model = "(0 1 1)(0 1 1)",  # Default SARIMA model
                      outlier = if(outlier) NULL else list(),
                      regression.variables = reg_vars,
                      x11 = "",  # Use X-11 seasonal adjustment
                      dir = tempdir())
    
    # Extract components
    original <- original(x13_result)
    trend <- trend(x13_result)
    seasonal <- seasonal(x13_result)
    irregular <- irregular(x13_result)
    seasonally_adjusted <- final(x13_result)
    
    # Create comprehensive data frame with source information
    decomp_df <- data.frame(
      date = as.Date(time(original)),
      observed = as.numeric(original),
      trend = as.numeric(trend),
      seasonal = as.numeric(seasonal),
      irregular = as.numeric(irregular),
      seasonally_adjusted = as.numeric(seasonally_adjusted),
      fitted = as.numeric(trend) + as.numeric(seasonal)
    )
    
    # Add source information from monthly data
    decomp_df <- decomp_df %>%
      left_join(
        ts_prepared$monthly_source_info %>% 
          select(year_month, dominant_source, source_ratio, original_days, chirps_days),
        by = c("date" = "year_month")
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        trend_cycle = trend,
        residual = observed - fitted,
        seasonal_strength = abs(seasonal) / (abs(seasonal) + abs(irregular)),
        year = year(date),
        month = month(date),
        month_name = month.name[month],
        data_quality_score = source_ratio  # Higher = more original data
      )
    
    # Get model diagnostics
    model_summary <- summary(x13_result)
    
    # Extract key diagnostics safely
    diagnostics <- list(
      arima_model = tryCatch(x13_result$model$arima$model, error = function(e) "Auto-selected"),
      transform = tryCatch(x13_result$model$transform$`function`, error = function(e) transform),
      outliers_detected = tryCatch(
        if(!is.null(x13_result$model$outlier)) nrow(x13_result$model$outlier) else 0,
        error = function(e) 0
      ),
      trading_day_test = if(!is.null(reg_vars) && "td" %in% reg_vars) "included" else "not included",
      data_quality = ts_prepared$data_quality,
      original_data_ratio = ts_prepared$original_data_ratio
    )
    
    return(list(
      x13_object = x13_result,
      data = decomp_df,
      station = station_name,
      diagnostics = diagnostics,
      model_summary = model_summary,
      method = "X-13ARIMA-SEATS",
      data_info = ts_prepared
    ))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("   ❌ X-13ARIMA-SEATS failed for", station_name, ":", e$message, "\n")
    cat("   🔄 Falling back to enhanced STL decomposition...\n")
    
    # Fallback to enhanced STL
    stl_result <- stl(ts_obj, s.window = "periodic", t.window = 13, robust = TRUE)
    
    decomp_df <- data.frame(
      date = as.Date(time(ts_obj)),
      observed = as.numeric(ts_obj),
      trend = as.numeric(stl_result$time.series[, "trend"]),
      seasonal = as.numeric(stl_result$time.series[, "seasonal"]),
      irregular = as.numeric(stl_result$time.series[, "remainder"]),
      seasonally_adjusted = as.numeric(ts_obj) - as.numeric(stl_result$time.series[, "seasonal"]),
      fitted = as.numeric(stl_result$time.series[, "trend"]) + as.numeric(stl_result$time.series[, "seasonal"])
    ) %>%
      left_join(
        ts_prepared$monthly_source_info %>% 
          select(year_month, dominant_source, source_ratio),
        by = c("date" = "year_month")
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        trend_cycle = trend,
        residual = observed - fitted,
        seasonal_strength = abs(seasonal) / (abs(seasonal) + abs(irregular)),
        year = year(date),
        month = month(date),
        month_name = month.name[month],
        data_quality_score = source_ratio
      )
    
    return(list(
      x13_object = NULL,
      data = decomp_df,
      station = station_name,
      diagnostics = list(method = "STL_fallback", reason = e$message,
                        data_quality = ts_prepared$data_quality,
                        original_data_ratio = ts_prepared$original_data_ratio),
      model_summary = NULL,
      method = "STL (fallback)",
      data_info = ts_prepared
    ))
  })
}

# Enhanced plotting function with data source information
create_x13_combined_plots <- function(x13_result) {
  if (is.null(x13_result)) return(ggplot() + ggtitle("No data available"))
  
  decomp_data <- x13_result$data
  station_name <- x13_result$station
  method <- x13_result$method
  data_quality <- x13_result$diagnostics$data_quality
  original_ratio <- round(x13_result$diagnostics$original_data_ratio * 100, 1)
  
  # Color palette
  colors <- c("#2E86AB", "#A23B72", "#F18F01", "#C73E1D", "#27AE60", "#8E44AD")
  
  # 1. Original vs Seasonally Adjusted with source information
  p1 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = observed, color = "Original"), alpha = 0.7, size = 0.6) +
    geom_line(aes(y = seasonally_adjusted, color = "Seasonally Adjusted"), size = 0.8) +
    geom_line(aes(y = trend, color = "Trend"), size = 1, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_point(aes(y = observed, fill = dominant_source), 
               alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8, shape = 21, stroke = 0) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Original" = colors[1], 
                                "Seasonally Adjusted" = colors[2], 
                                "Trend" = colors[3])) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Original" = "#2E86AB", "CHIRPS" = "#E74C3C")) +
    labs(title = paste("Combined Dataset Analysis -", method),
         subtitle = paste("Station:", station_name, "| Quality:", data_quality, 
                         "(", original_ratio, "% original data)"),
         y = "Rainfall (mm)", x = NULL, 
         color = "Series", fill = "Data Source") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
  
  # 2. Seasonal Component with data quality overlay
  p2 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date, y = seasonal)) +
    geom_line(color = colors[4], size = 0.8) +
    geom_point(aes(alpha = data_quality_score), color = colors[4], size = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray50", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Seasonal Component (Enhanced Dataset)", 
         subtitle = "Point transparency shows data quality (darker = more original)",
         y = "Seasonal Effect (mm)", x = NULL, alpha = "Original Ratio") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
  
  # 3. Trend-Cycle Component
  p3 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date, y = trend)) +
    geom_line(color = colors[5], size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = colors[6], alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(title = "Trend-Cycle Component (Combined Dataset)", 
         y = "Trend (mm)", x = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
  
  # 4. Irregular Component with data source
  p4 <- ggplot(decomp_data, aes(x = date, y = irregular)) +
    geom_line(color = colors[1], alpha = 0.7, size = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(color = dominant_source), alpha = 0.6, size = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, color = "red") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Original" = "#2E86AB", "CHIRPS" = "#E74C3C")) +
    labs(title = "Irregular Component", y = "Irregular (mm)", 
         x = "Date", color = "Data Source") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
  
  # Combine plots
  combined_plot <- grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 1,
                               top = paste("Enhanced X-13ARIMA-SEATS Analysis:", station_name))
  
  return(list(
    combined = combined_plot,
    individual = list(
      original_vs_adjusted = p1, 
      seasonal = p2, 
      trend = p3, 
      irregular = p4
    )
  ))
}

# Enhanced seasonal analysis function (MISSING IN ORIGINAL - ADDING HERE)
create_enhanced_seasonal_analysis <- function(x13_result) {
  if (is.null(x13_result)) return(NULL)
  
  decomp_data <- x13_result$data
  station_name <- x13_result$station
  
  # Monthly seasonal patterns
  monthly_patterns <- decomp_data %>%
    group_by(month, month_name) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_seasonal = mean(seasonal, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_seasonal = sd(seasonal, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_observed = mean(observed, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_adjusted = mean(seasonally_adjusted, na.rm = TRUE),
      original_data_ratio = mean(data_quality_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(month_name = factor(month_name, levels = month.name))
  
  # Yearly trends
  yearly_patterns <- decomp_data %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_trend = mean(trend, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_seasonal_strength = mean(seasonal_strength, na.rm = TRUE),
      annual_rainfall = sum(observed, na.rm = TRUE),
      annual_adjusted = sum(seasonally_adjusted, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_original_ratio = mean(source_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Create seasonal plots
  p1 <- ggplot(monthly_patterns, aes(x = month_name, y = mean_seasonal)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = original_data_ratio), alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_seasonal - sd_seasonal/2, 
                      ymax = mean_seasonal + sd_seasonal/2), width = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Data\nQuality") +
    labs(title = paste("Average Seasonal Pattern -", station_name),
         subtitle = "Error bars show variability, color shows data quality",
         x = "Month", y = "Seasonal Effect (mm)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
  
  p2 <- ggplot(yearly_patterns, aes(x = year, y = annual_rainfall)) +
    geom_line(aes(color = "Original"), size = 1) +
    geom_line(aes(y = annual_adjusted, color = "Seasonally Adjusted"), size = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(size = avg_original_ratio, color = "Original"), alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Original" = "#2E86AB", "Seasonally Adjusted" = "#E74C3C")) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Data\nQuality", range = c(1, 4)) +
    labs(title = "Annual Rainfall Trends",
         subtitle = "Point size shows data quality ratio",
         x = "Year", y = "Annual Rainfall (mm)", color = "Series") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
  
  # Combine plots
  combined_seasonal <- grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 1)
  
  return(list(
    combined = combined_seasonal,
    monthly_patterns = monthly_patterns,
    yearly_patterns = yearly_patterns,
    individual = list(monthly = p1, yearly = p2)
  ))
}

# Main processing function for combined datasets
process_combined_stations_x13 <- function(combined_data_list, 
                                         transform = "auto",
                                         outlier = TRUE,
                                         trading_day = FALSE,
                                         holiday = FALSE,
                                         parallel = FALSE) {
  
  cat("🚀 Starting X-13ARIMA-SEATS analysis on combined datasets...\n")
  cat("   ⚙️ Transform:", transform, "| Outlier detection:", outlier, "\n")
  cat("   📅 Trading day effects:", trading_day, "| Holiday effects:", holiday, "\n")
  
  # Process function for individual station
  process_single_combined_station <- function(combined_dataset) {
    station_name <- combined_dataset$station
    cat("   🔧 Processing:", station_name, "\n")
    
    # Prepare time series from combined data
    ts_prep <- prepare_x13_from_combined(combined_dataset)
    if (is.null(ts_prep)) {
      cat("   ⚠️ Insufficient data for", station_name, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    cat("   📊 Data span:", ts_prep$n_years, "years |", 
        ts_prep$n_observations, "obs | Quality:", ts_prep$data_quality, "\n")
    
    # Perform X-13 decomposition
    x13_result <- perform_x13_combined_decomposition(ts_prep, 
                                                   transform = transform,
                                                   outlier = outlier,
                                                   trading_day = trading_day,
                                                   holiday = holiday)
    
    if (is.null(x13_result)) {
      cat("   ❌ X-13 analysis failed for", station_name, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Create plots
    x13_plots <- create_x13_combined_plots(x13_result)
    seasonal_analysis <- create_enhanced_seasonal_analysis(x13_result)
    
    cat("   ✅ Completed:", station_name, "using", x13_result$method, "\n")
    
    return(list(
      station = station_name,
      x13_result = x13_result,
      plots = x13_plots,
      seasonal_analysis = seasonal_analysis,
      data_info = ts_prep
    ))
  }
  
  # Process stations
  if (parallel && requireNamespace("parallel", quietly = TRUE)) {
    cat("   🔄 Using parallel processing...\n")
    all_results <- parallel::mclapply(combined_data_list, process_single_combined_station, mc.cores = 2)
  } else {
    all_results <- map(combined_data_list, process_single_combined_station)
  }
  
  # Filter out NULL results
  all_results <- all_results[!sapply(all_results, is.null)]
  names(all_results) <- sapply(all_results, function(x) x$station)
  
  return(all_results)
}

# Enhanced summary with combined dataset metrics
create_x13_combined_summary <- function(all_results) {
  summary_stats <- map_dfr(all_results, function(result) {
    if (is.null(result)) return(NULL)
    
    x13_data <- result$x13_result$data
    diagnostics <- result$x13_result$diagnostics
    data_info <- result$data_info
    
    data.frame(
      Station = result$station,
      Method = result$x13_result$method,
      Data_Quality = diagnostics$data_quality,
      Original_Data_Percent = round(diagnostics$original_data_ratio * 100, 1),
      CHIRPS_Data_Percent = round((1 - diagnostics$original_data_ratio) * 100, 1),
      Data_Points = nrow(x13_data),
      Years_Span = data_info$n_years,
      Start_Date = as.character(min(x13_data$date)),
      End_Date = as.character(max(x13_data$date)),
      Mean_Rainfall = round(mean(x13_data$observed, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Mean_Seasonal_Adjusted = round(mean(x13_data$seasonally_adjusted, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Seasonal_Range = round(max(x13_data$seasonal, na.rm = TRUE) - 
                            min(x13_data$seasonal, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Trend_Change = round(last(x13_data$trend) - first(x13_data$trend), 2),
      Mean_Seasonal_Strength = round(mean(x13_data$seasonal_strength, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      Irregular_StdDev = round(sd(x13_data$irregular, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      ARIMA_Model = if(!is.null(diagnostics$arima_model)) diagnostics$arima_model else "STL",
      Transform = if(!is.null(diagnostics$transform)) diagnostics$transform else "none",
      Outliers_Detected = if(!is.null(diagnostics$outliers_detected)) diagnostics$outliers_detected else 0,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  
  return(summary_stats)
}

# Enhanced save function for combined results
save_x13_combined_results <- function(x13_results, summary_stats, 
                                     output_dir = "x13_combined_datasets_results") {
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  cat("💾 Saving X-13ARIMA-SEATS results from combined datasets...\n")
  
  # Save individual station results
  iwalk(x13_results, ~{
    station_name <- .y
    station_clean <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", station_name)
    
    # Save main decomposition plot
    decomp_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("x13_combined_decomposition_", station_clean, ".jpeg"))
    ggsave(decomp_file, .x$plots$combined, width = 14, height = 12, dpi = 300)
    
    # Save seasonal analysis  
    if (!is.null(.x$seasonal_analysis)) {
      seasonal_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("x13_combined_seasonal_", station_clean, ".jpeg"))
      ggsave(seasonal_file, .x$seasonal_analysis$combined, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
    }
    
    # Save decomposition data
    data_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("x13_combined_data_", station_clean, ".csv"))
    write.csv(.x$x13_result$data, data_file, row.names = FALSE)
  })
  
  # Save comprehensive summary
  write.csv(summary_stats, file.path(output_dir, "x13_combined_comprehensive_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("✅ All X-13ARIMA-SEATS results saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
}

# MAIN EXECUTION
cat("🎯 X-13ARIMA-SEATS Analysis using Pre-Combined CSV Files\n")
cat("=======================================================\n")

# Load combined datasets (adjust path as needed)
combined_datasets <- load_combined_datasets(
  csv_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets"
  # rainfall_cols can be specified to limit analysis to specific stations
)

# Run X-13ARIMA-SEATS analysis on combined data
x13_combined_results <- process_combined_stations_x13(
  combined_datasets,
  transform = "auto",      # Automatic Box-Cox transformation
  outlier = TRUE,          # Enable outlier detection  
  trading_day = FALSE,     # Usually not relevant for rainfall
  holiday = FALSE,         # Can be enabled if relevant
  parallel = FALSE         # Set to TRUE for parallel processing
)

# Create comprehensive summary
x13_combined_summary <- create_x13_combined_summary(x13_combined_results)

# Display results
cat("\n📊 X-13ARIMA-SEATS Combined Dataset Analysis Summary:\n")
cat("====================================================\n")
print(x13_combined_summary)

if (length(x13_combined_results) > 0) {
  
  # Show method and quality breakdown
  method_summary <- table(x13_combined_summary$Method)
  quality_summary <- table(x13_combined_summary$Data_Quality)
  
  cat("\n📈 Method Distribution:\n")
  print(method_summary)
  cat("\n📊 Data Quality Distribution:\n") 
  print(quality_summary)
  
  avg_original <- mean(x13_combined_summary$Original_Data_Percent, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("\n📋 Average Original Data Content:", round(avg_original, 1), "%\n")
}

# Save all results
save_x13_combined_results(x13_combined_results, x13_combined_summary)


# Optional: Create summary visualizations
create_summary_visualizations <- function(x13_results, summary_stats) {
  if (length(x13_results) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  cat("📈 Creating summary visualizations...\n")
  
  # 1. Data quality overview
  quality_plot <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = reorder(Station, Original_Data_Percent))) +
    geom_col(aes(y = Original_Data_Percent, fill = Data_Quality), alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(y = Original_Data_Percent + 2, 
                  label = paste0(Original_Data_Percent, "%")), 
              size = 3, angle = 90, hjust = 0) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma") +
    labs(title = "Data Quality Across All Stations",
         subtitle = "Percentage of original vs CHIRPS data in combined datasets",
         x = "Station", y = "Original Data (%)", fill = "Quality") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
  # 2. Method success overview
  method_plot <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Method, fill = Data_Quality)) +
    geom_bar(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = ..count..), 
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.5) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis") +
    labs(title = "Analysis Method Distribution",
         subtitle = "Success of X-13ARIMA-SEATS vs STL fallback by data quality",
         x = "Method Used", y = "Number of Stations", fill = "Data Quality") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
  # 3. Seasonal strength comparison
  seasonal_plot <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = reorder(Station, Mean_Seasonal_Strength))) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Mean_Seasonal_Strength, color = Data_Quality, 
                   size = Years_Span), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(option = "cividis") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 6)) +
    labs(title = "Seasonal Strength Across Stations",
         subtitle = "Higher values indicate stronger seasonal patterns",
         x = "Station", y = "Mean Seasonal Strength", 
         color = "Data Quality", size = "Years of Data") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
  # 4. Trend changes overview
  trend_plot <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = reorder(Station, Trend_Change))) +
    geom_col(aes(y = Trend_Change, fill = ifelse(Trend_Change > 0, "Increasing", "Decreasing")),
             alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = "solid") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Increasing" = "#27AE60", "Decreasing" = "#E74C3C"),
                      name = "Trend Direction") +
    labs(title = "Long-term Rainfall Trends",
         subtitle = "Change from start to end of analysis period",
         x = "Station", y = "Trend Change (mm)", fill = "Direction") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
  # Combine all summary plots
  summary_combined <- grid.arrange(quality_plot, method_plot, seasonal_plot, trend_plot, 
                                   ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
                                   top = "X-13ARIMA-SEATS Combined Dataset Analysis - Summary Dashboard")
  
  return(list(
    combined = summary_combined,
    individual = list(
      quality = quality_plot,
      methods = method_plot, 
      seasonal = seasonal_plot,
      trends = trend_plot
    )
  ))
}

# Create and save summary visualizations
if (length(x13_combined_results) > 0) {
  summary_viz <- create_summary_visualizations(x13_combined_results, x13_combined_summary)
  
  if (!is.null(summary_viz)) {
    # Save summary dashboard
    summary_file <- file.path("x13_combined_datasets_results", "summary_dashboard.jpeg")
    ggsave(summary_file, summary_viz$combined, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300)
    cat("📊 Summary dashboard saved to:", summary_file, "\n")
  }
}

# Additional utility functions for post-analysis
extract_seasonal_patterns <- function(x13_results) {
  cat("🔍 Extracting seasonal patterns from all stations...\n")
  
  all_seasonal <- map_dfr(x13_results, function(result) {
    if (is.null(result)) return(NULL)
    
    result$x13_result$data %>%
      select(date, seasonal, station = result$station) %>%
      mutate(month = month(date),
             month_name = month.name[month])
  })
  
  seasonal_summary <- all_seasonal %>%
    group_by(station, month, month_name) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_seasonal = mean(seasonal, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_seasonal = median(seasonal, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_seasonal = sd(seasonal, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(month_name = factor(month_name, levels = month.name))
  
  return(seasonal_summary)
}

extract_trend_analysis <- function(x13_results) {
  cat("📈 Extracting trend analysis from all stations...\n")
  
  all_trends <- map_dfr(x13_results, function(result) {
    if (is.null(result)) return(NULL)
    
    result$x13_result$data %>%
      select(date, trend, seasonally_adjusted) %>%
      mutate(station = result$station,
             year = year(date))
  })
  
  trend_summary <- all_trends %>%
    group_by(station, year) %>%
    summarise(
      annual_trend = mean(trend, na.rm = TRUE),
      annual_adjusted = sum(seasonally_adjusted, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  return(trend_summary)
}

# Extract detailed patterns if results exist
if (length(x13_combined_results) > 0) {
  seasonal_patterns <- extract_seasonal_patterns(x13_combined_results)
  trend_patterns <- extract_trend_analysis(x13_combined_results)
  
  # Save detailed patterns
  write.csv(seasonal_patterns, 
            file.path("x13_combined_datasets_results", "detailed_seasonal_patterns.csv"), 
            row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(trend_patterns, 
            file.path("x13_combined_datasets_results", "detailed_trend_patterns.csv"), 
            row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("📋 Detailed seasonal and trend patterns saved\n")
}
```

```{r}
# Enhanced script for Sahel monthly rainfall visualizations with continuous time series

pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,     # Data manipulation and visualization
  lubridate,     # Date handling
  gridExtra,     # Plot arrangements
  viridis,       # Color palettes
  scales,        # Plot scales
  plotly,        # Interactive plots
  DT,            # Interactive tables
  knitr,         # Reporting
  zoo            # Time series operations
)

# Function to load and prepare monthly data from combined CSV files (Sahel-adapted)
prepare_monthly_data <- function(csv_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets",
                                rainfall_cols = NULL) {
  
  cat("📂 Loading and preparing monthly data for Sahel region...\n")
  
  # Get all combined CSV files
  csv_files <- list.files(csv_dir, pattern = "^combined_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(csv_files) == 0) {
    stop("❌ No combined CSV files found in: ", csv_dir)
  }
  
  cat("   Found", length(csv_files), "combined CSV files\n")
  
  # Load and process all datasets
  all_monthly_data <- map_dfr(csv_files, function(file) {
    # Extract station name from filename
    station_name <- str_extract(basename(file), "(?<=combined_)[^_]+(?=_)")
    
    cat("   Processing:", station_name, "\n")
    
    # Load data
    raw_data <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(combined_rainfall) & combined_rainfall >= 0) %>%
      select(Date, combined_rainfall, data_source) %>%
      arrange(Date)
    
    # Aggregate to monthly data
    monthly_data <- raw_data %>%
      mutate(
        year = year(Date),
        month = month(Date),
        year_month = as.Date(paste(year, month, "01", sep = "-")),
        month_name = month.name[month]
      ) %>%
      group_by(station = station_name, year, month, year_month, month_name) %>%
      summarise(
        monthly_rainfall = sum(combined_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
        daily_mean = mean(combined_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
        days_with_data = n(),
        original_days = sum(data_source == "Original", na.rm = TRUE),
        chirps_days = sum(data_source == "CHIRPS", na.rm = TRUE),
        data_quality_ratio = original_days / (original_days + chirps_days),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      filter(days_with_data >= 15)  # Only months with sufficient data
    
    return(monthly_data)
  })
  
  # Filter by specific stations if requested
  if (!is.null(rainfall_cols)) {
    available_stations <- unique(all_monthly_data$station)
    requested_stations <- intersect(rainfall_cols, available_stations)
    missing_stations <- setdiff(rainfall_cols, available_stations)
    
    if (length(missing_stations) > 0) {
      cat("   ⚠️ Missing stations:", paste(missing_stations, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    }
    
    all_monthly_data <- all_monthly_data %>% filter(station %in% requested_stations)
    cat("   Selected", length(requested_stations), "stations for analysis\n")
  }
  
  # Add Sahel-specific seasonal classification
  all_monthly_data <- all_monthly_data %>%
    mutate(
      month_name = factor(month_name, levels = month.name),
      # Sahel seasons: Wet (June-September) and Dry (October-May)
      season = case_when(
        month %in% c(6, 7, 8, 9) ~ "Wet Season",
        month %in% c(10, 11, 12, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) ~ "Dry Season"
      ),
      season = factor(season, levels = c("Dry Season", "Wet Season"))
    )
  
  cat("✅ Monthly data prepared for", length(unique(all_monthly_data$station)), "Sahel stations\n")
  cat("   📅 Date range:", min(all_monthly_data$year_month), "to", max(all_monthly_data$year_month), "\n")
  cat("   📊 Total monthly observations:", nrow(all_monthly_data), "\n")
  
  return(all_monthly_data)
}

# Function to create individual station monthly plots as continuous time series
create_individual_monthly_plots <- function(monthly_data, interactive = FALSE) {
  
  cat("📈 Creating individual station monthly time series plots (2000-present)...\n")
  
  # Function to create plot for individual station
  create_station_plot <- function(station_name) {
    # Filter data for this station
    station_data <- monthly_data %>% 
      filter(station == station_name) %>%
      arrange(year_month)
    
    # Create the continuous time series plot
    p <- ggplot(station_data, aes(x = year_month, y = monthly_rainfall)) +
      # Main time series line
      geom_line(color = viridis(1, option = "viridis"), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
      # Points with data quality information
      geom_point(aes(size = data_quality_ratio, alpha = data_quality_ratio), 
                 color = viridis(1, option = "viridis")) +
      # Add trend line
      geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "#440154FF", 
                  fill = "#440154FF", alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
      # Highlight wet season months with background
      geom_rect(data = station_data %>% 
                  filter(month %in% 6:9) %>%
                  group_by(year) %>%
                  summarise(xmin = min(year_month), xmax = max(year_month), .groups = "drop"),
                aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
                fill = "#FDE725FF", alpha = 0.1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      # Scale adjustments
      scale_size_continuous(name = "Data Quality", range = c(1, 3),
                           labels = scales::percent_format()) +
      scale_alpha_continuous(name = "Data Quality", range = c(0.5, 1),
                            labels = scales::percent_format()) +
      scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y", date_breaks = "2 years") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format()) +
      # Labels and theme
      labs(
        title = paste("Monthly Rainfall Time Series -", station_name),
        subtitle = "Complete time series from 2000 to present | Yellow background = Wet Season (Jun-Sep)",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Monthly Rainfall (mm)",
        caption = "Purple trend line shows long-term pattern | Point size = data quality"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "top",  # Move legend to top
        legend.box = "horizontal",  # Arrange legends horizontally
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 10),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey90")
      ) +
      guides(
        size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1)),
        alpha = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))
      )
    
    return(p)
  }
  
  # Create plots for all stations
  station_plots <- map(unique(monthly_data$station), create_station_plot)
  names(station_plots) <- unique(monthly_data$station)
  
  return(station_plots)
}

# Function to create Sahel seasonal analysis
create_sahel_seasonal_analysis <- function(monthly_data) {
  
  cat("🌦️ Creating Sahel seasonal analysis (Wet/Dry seasons)...\n")
  
  # Calculate seasonal totals
  seasonal_data <- monthly_data %>%
    group_by(station, season, year) %>%
    summarise(
      seasonal_total = sum(monthly_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_data_quality = mean(data_quality_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Seasonal climatology
  seasonal_climatology <- seasonal_data %>%
    group_by(station, season) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_seasonal = mean(seasonal_total, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_seasonal = median(seasonal_total, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_seasonal = sd(seasonal_total, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_seasonal = min(seasonal_total, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_seasonal = max(seasonal_total, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25_seasonal = quantile(seasonal_total, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75_seasonal = quantile(seasonal_total, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Plot 1: Seasonal comparison by station
  p_seasonal_comparison <- ggplot(seasonal_climatology, aes(x = season, y = mean_seasonal)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = season), alpha = 0.8, width = 0.6) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = q25_seasonal, ymax = q75_seasonal), 
                  width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, size = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_seasonal, 0)), 
              vjust = -0.5, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Season", option = "viridis") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format()) +
    facet_wrap(~ station, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "Sahel Seasonal Rainfall Comparison",
      subtitle = "Wet vs Dry season totals | Error bars show 25th-75th percentiles",
      x = "Season",
      y = "Mean Seasonal Rainfall (mm)",
      caption = "Wet Season: Jun-Sep | Dry Season: Oct-May"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # Plot 2: Seasonal time series
  p_seasonal_timeseries <- ggplot(seasonal_data, aes(x = year, y = seasonal_total)) +
    geom_line(aes(color = season, group = season), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(aes(color = season, size = avg_data_quality), alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(aes(color = season), method = "loess", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Season", option = "viridis") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Data Quality", range = c(1, 3),
                         labels = scales::percent_format()) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format()) +
    facet_wrap(~ station, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "Sahel Seasonal Rainfall Trends",
      subtitle = "Long-term trends in wet and dry season rainfall",
      x = "Year",
      y = "Seasonal Total Rainfall (mm)",
      caption = "Smooth lines show long-term trends"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # Plot 3: Wet season focus (most important for Sahel)
  wet_season_data <- seasonal_data %>% filter(season == "Wet Season")
  
  p_wet_season_focus <- ggplot(wet_season_data, aes(x = year, y = seasonal_total)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = seasonal_total), alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "white", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Wet Season\nRainfall (mm)", option = "viridis") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format()) +
    facet_wrap(~ station, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "Sahel Wet Season Rainfall (Jun-Sep)",
      subtitle = "Critical growing season rainfall variability and trends",
      x = "Year",
      y = "Wet Season Total Rainfall (mm)",
      caption = "White line shows long-term trend"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  return(list(
    seasonal_comparison = p_seasonal_comparison,
    seasonal_timeseries = p_seasonal_timeseries,
    wet_season_focus = p_wet_season_focus,
    seasonal_data = seasonal_data,
    seasonal_climatology = seasonal_climatology
  ))
}

# Function to create cumulative rainfall analysis (Sahel-adapted) - CORRECTED with legend on top
create_sahel_cumulative_analysis <- function(monthly_data) {
  
  cat("📈 Creating Sahel cumulative rainfall time series analysis...\n")
  
  # Calculate cumulative rainfall by year for each station
  cumulative_data <- monthly_data %>%
    arrange(station, year, month) %>%
    group_by(station, year) %>%
    mutate(
      cumulative_rainfall = cumsum(monthly_rainfall),
      year_factor = factor(year),
      # Create date for continuous time series
      cum_date = as.Date(paste(year, month, "15", sep = "-"))
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Function to create cumulative plot for individual station as continuous time series
  create_station_cumulative <- function(station_name) {
    station_data <- cumulative_data %>% filter(station == station_name)
    
    # Calculate long-term average by month
    station_avg <- station_data %>%
      group_by(month) %>%
      summarise(
        avg_cumulative = mean(cumulative_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_cumulative = sd(cumulative_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    # Create expanded average data for ribbon
    avg_expanded <- map_dfr(unique(station_data$year), function(y) {
      station_avg %>%
        mutate(
          year = y,
          cum_date = as.Date(paste(year, month, "15", sep = "-"))
        )
    })
    
    p <- ggplot(station_data, aes(x = cum_date, y = cumulative_rainfall)) +
      # Background ribbon for variability
      geom_ribbon(data = avg_expanded,
                  aes(x = cum_date,
                      ymin = pmax(0, avg_cumulative - sd_cumulative),
                      ymax = avg_cumulative + sd_cumulative,
                      y = NULL),
                  alpha = 0.2, fill = viridis(1, alpha = 0.7)) +
      # Individual year lines (grouped by year)
      geom_line(aes(color = year, group = year), alpha = 0.6, size = 0.8) +
      # Long-term average line (repeated for each year)
      geom_line(data = avg_expanded, 
                aes(x = cum_date, y = avg_cumulative, group = year),
                color = "white", size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
      geom_line(data = avg_expanded, 
                aes(x = cum_date, y = avg_cumulative, group = year),
                color = "black", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
      # Vertical lines to mark end of wet season each year
      geom_vline(data = tibble(end_wet = as.Date(paste(unique(station_data$year), "09", "30", sep = "-"))),
                 aes(xintercept = end_wet), 
                 linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 0.5, alpha = 0.4) +
      # Color scale
      scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Year", option = "viridis") +
      scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y", date_breaks = "2 years") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format()) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Cumulative Rainfall Time Series -", station_name),
        subtitle = "Yearly cumulative progression from 2000 to present | Black line = long-term average",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Cumulative Rainfall (mm)",
        caption = "Gray ribbon = ±1 std deviation | Red dashed lines = end of wet season"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "top",  # Move legend to top
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 10),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey90")
      )
    
    return(p)
  }
  
  # Create plots for all stations
  cumulative_plots <- map(unique(cumulative_data$station), create_station_cumulative)
  names(cumulative_plots) <- unique(cumulative_data$station)
  
  return(list(
    individual_cumulative = cumulative_plots,
    cumulative_data = cumulative_data
  ))
}

# Function to create multi-station comparison plot
create_multi_station_comparison <- function(monthly_data) {
  
  cat("📈 Creating multi-station comparison plot...\n")
  
  # Create comparison plot with all stations
  p_comparison <- ggplot(monthly_data, aes(x = year_month, y = monthly_rainfall, color = station)) +
    geom_line(size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Station", option = "viridis") +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y", date_breaks = "2 years") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format()) +
    labs(
      title = "Multi-Station Monthly Rainfall Comparison",
      subtitle = "Time series comparison across all Sahel stations",
      x = "Year",
      y = "Monthly Rainfall (mm)",
      caption = "Smooth lines show long-term trends for each station"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "top",  # Move legend to top
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
              panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey90")
    )
  
  return(p_comparison)
}

# Function to save all enhanced visualizations
save_sahel_analysis <- function(individual_plots, seasonal_analysis, cumulative_analysis, 
                                multi_station_plot, monthly_data,
                                output_dir = "sahel_monthly_rainfall_analysis") {
  
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  cat("💾 Saving Sahel monthly rainfall analysis...\n")
  
  # Save individual station plots (continuous time series)
  iwalk(individual_plots, ~{
    station_clean <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", .y)
    file_name <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_timeseries_", station_clean, ".jpeg"))
    ggsave(file_name, .x, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
  })
  
  # Save multi-station comparison
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "multi_station_comparison.jpeg"), 
         multi_station_plot, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)
  
  # Save seasonal analysis plots
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "sahel_seasonal_comparison.jpeg"), 
         seasonal_analysis$seasonal_comparison, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "sahel_seasonal_timeseries.jpeg"), 
         seasonal_analysis$seasonal_timeseries, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "sahel_wet_season_focus.jpeg"), 
         seasonal_analysis$wet_season_focus, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)
  
  # Save cumulative analysis plots
  iwalk(cumulative_analysis$individual_cumulative, ~{
    station_clean <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", .y)
    file_name <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("cumulative_", station_clean, ".jpeg"))
    ggsave(file_name, .x, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
  })
  
  # Save data summaries
  monthly_summary <- monthly_data %>%
    group_by(station) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(year_month),
      end_date = max(year_month),
      n_months = n(),
      n_years = n_distinct(year),
      mean_monthly_rainfall = mean(monthly_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_rainfall = sum(monthly_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
      wet_season_avg = mean(monthly_rainfall[season == "Wet Season"], na.rm = TRUE),
      dry_season_avg = mean(monthly_rainfall[season == "Dry Season"], na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_data_quality = mean(data_quality_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  write.csv(monthly_summary, file.path(output_dir, "sahel_monthly_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(monthly_data, file.path(output_dir, "sahel_monthly_data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(seasonal_analysis$seasonal_climatology, 
            file.path(output_dir, "sahel_seasonal_climatology.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("✅ All Sahel analysis results saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
}
```
