## VII.2. Spatial Interpolation of Precipitation Data using Kriging

```{r}
# Spatial Interpolation of Precipitation Data using Kriging
# This script creates spatial interpolation of rainfall station data using kriging

# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(gstat)        # For kriging
library(sp)           # Spatial data handling
library(sf)           # Modern spatial data
library(terra)        # Replaces deprecated raster package
library(viridis)      # Color palettes
library(gridExtra)    # Multiple plots
library(lubridate)    # Date handling
library(RColorBrewer) # Additional color palettes
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# Install and load required packages
install_and_load <- function(packages) {
  new_packages <- packages[!(packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
  if(length(new_packages)) {
    cat("Installing packages:", paste(new_packages, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    install.packages(new_packages, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
  sapply(packages, function(x) {
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(x, character.only = TRUE))
  })
}

required_packages <- c("gstat", "sp", "sf", "terra", "viridis", "gridExtra")
install_and_load(required_packages)

# Function to generate random spatial coordinates for stations
generate_random_coordinates <- function(station_names, 
                                      bbox = list(xmin = -5, xmax = 10, ymin = 30, ymax = 45),
                                      seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  n_stations <- length(station_names)
  
  if(n_stations < 3) {
    stop("Need at least 3 stations for spatial interpolation")
  }
  
  coordinates_df <- data.frame(
    Station = station_names,
    Longitude = runif(n_stations, bbox$xmin, bbox$xmax),
    Latitude = runif(n_stations, bbox$ymin, bbox$ymax),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Add some spatial structure (stations closer to each other)
  if(n_stations >= 4) {
    center_indices <- sample(1:n_stations, min(4, n_stations))
    center_lon <- mean(c(bbox$xmin, bbox$xmax))
    center_lat <- mean(c(bbox$ymin, bbox$ymax))
    
    coordinates_df$Longitude[center_indices] <- center_lon + rnorm(length(center_indices), 0, 1)
    coordinates_df$Latitude[center_indices] <- center_lat + rnorm(length(center_indices), 0, 1)
    
    # Ensure coordinates stay within bounds
    coordinates_df$Longitude <- pmax(bbox$xmin, pmin(bbox$xmax, coordinates_df$Longitude))
    coordinates_df$Latitude <- pmax(bbox$ymin, pmin(bbox$ymax, coordinates_df$Latitude))
  }
  
  return(coordinates_df)
}

# Function to prepare spatial data for kriging
prepare_spatial_data <- function(combined_data_list, coordinates_df, target_date) {
  # Convert target_date to Date if it's character
  target_date <- as.Date(target_date)
  
  # Extract data for the target date from all stations
  spatial_data <- map_dfr(names(combined_data_list), function(station_name) {
    station_data <- combined_data_list[[station_name]]
    
    # Check if station_data is valid
    if(is.null(station_data) || nrow(station_data) == 0) {
      return(data.frame(Station = station_name, Precipitation = NA, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
    
    # Ensure Date column exists and is Date type
    if(!"Date" %in% names(station_data)) {
      warning(paste("No 'Date' column found in station:", station_name))
      return(data.frame(Station = station_name, Precipitation = NA, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
    
    station_data$Date <- as.Date(station_data$Date)
    
    # Find target date data
    target_row <- station_data %>% 
      filter(Date == target_date) %>%
      slice(1)
    
    # Determine precipitation column name
    precip_col <- NULL
    possible_cols <- c("combined_rainfall", "Precipitation", "precipitation", "rainfall", "PRCP")
    for(col in possible_cols) {
      if(col %in% names(target_row)) {
        precip_col <- col
        break
      }
    }
    
    if(is.null(precip_col)) {
      warning(paste("No precipitation column found for station:", station_name))
      return(data.frame(Station = station_name, Precipitation = NA, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
    
    if(nrow(target_row) > 0 && !is.na(target_row[[precip_col]])) {
      data.frame(
        Station = station_name,
        Precipitation = as.numeric(target_row[[precip_col]]),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      data.frame(
        Station = station_name,
        Precipitation = NA,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  })
  
  # Join with coordinates
  spatial_data <- spatial_data %>%
    left_join(coordinates_df, by = "Station") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Precipitation) & !is.na(Longitude) & !is.na(Latitude) & 
           is.finite(Precipitation) & is.finite(Longitude) & is.finite(Latitude))
  
  if(nrow(spatial_data) < 3) {
    stop(paste("Insufficient data points for kriging. Found", nrow(spatial_data), "valid points, need at least 3"))
  }
  
  return(spatial_data)
}

# Function to create spatial points for kriging
create_spatial_points <- function(spatial_data) {
  # Create a copy to avoid modifying original data
  sp_data <- spatial_data
  
  # Convert to SpatialPointsDataFrame
  coordinates(sp_data) <- ~Longitude + Latitude
  proj4string(sp_data) <- CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs")
  
  return(sp_data)
}

# Function to create prediction grid
create_prediction_grid <- function(bbox, resolution = 0.1) {
  # Create sequences with proper bounds
  x_seq <- seq(bbox$xmin, bbox$xmax, by = resolution)
  y_seq <- seq(bbox$ymin, bbox$ymax, by = resolution)
  
  # Create grid
  grid_df <- expand.grid(Longitude = x_seq, Latitude = y_seq)
  coordinates(grid_df) <- ~Longitude + Latitude
  gridded(grid_df) <- TRUE
  proj4string(grid_df) <- CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs")
  
  return(grid_df)
}

# Function to perform kriging interpolation
perform_kriging <- function(spatial_points, prediction_grid, model_type = "Sph") {
  tryCatch({
    cat("📊 Creating empirical variogram...\n")
    
    # Create empirical variogram
    empirical_var <- variogram(Precipitation ~ 1, spatial_points)
    
    # Check if we have enough points for variogram
    if(nrow(empirical_var) < 3) {
      stop("Not enough point pairs for variogram calculation")
    }
    
    cat("🔧 Fitting variogram model...\n")
    
    # Try different models if the first fails
    models_to_try <- c(model_type, "Exp", "Gau", "Mat")
    variogram_model <- NULL
    
    for(model in models_to_try) {
      tryCatch({
        initial_model <- vgm(psill = var(spatial_points$Precipitation), 
                           model = model, 
                           range = max(dist(coordinates(spatial_points)))/3,
                           nugget = var(spatial_points$Precipitation)/10)
        variogram_model <- fit.variogram(empirical_var, initial_model)
        cat("✅ Successfully fitted", model, "model\n")
        break
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("⚠️  Failed to fit", model, "model:", e$message, "\n")
      })
    }
    
    if(is.null(variogram_model)) {
      stop("Failed to fit any variogram model")
    }
    
    cat("🎯 Performing ordinary kriging...\n")
    
    # Perform ordinary kriging
    kriging_result <- krige(Precipitation ~ 1, 
                           spatial_points, 
                           prediction_grid, 
                           model = variogram_model,
                           debug.level = 0)
    
    return(list(
      kriging_result = kriging_result,
      variogram_cloud = empirical_var,
      variogram_model = variogram_model
    ))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ Kriging failed:", e$message, "\n")
    stop(paste("Kriging interpolation failed:", e$message))
  })
}

# Function to create interpolation map
create_interpolation_map <- function(kriging_result, spatial_points, target_date, 
                                   title_prefix = "Precipitation Interpolation") {
  # Convert kriging result to dataframe for ggplot
  kriging_df <- as.data.frame(kriging_result$kriging_result)
  
  # Convert spatial points to dataframe
  points_df <- as.data.frame(spatial_points)
  
  # Handle potential issues with prediction values
  kriging_df <- kriging_df %>%
    filter(is.finite(var1.pred) & !is.na(var1.pred))
  
  if(nrow(kriging_df) == 0) {
    stop("No valid prediction values for mapping")
  }
  
  # Create the map - CORRECTED VERSION
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Add interpolated surface
    geom_tile(data = kriging_df, 
              aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = var1.pred),
              alpha = 0.8) +
    
    # Add contour lines (only if we have enough data) - FIXED SYNTAX
    {if(nrow(kriging_df) > 20) {
      geom_contour(data = kriging_df, 
                  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, z = var1.pred),
                  color = "white", alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.3)
    } else {
      NULL
    }} +
    
    # Add station points
    geom_point(data = points_df, 
               aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, size = Precipitation),
               color = "black", alpha = 0.9, stroke = 0.5) +
    
    # Add station labels
    geom_text(data = points_df,
              aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, label = Station),
              color = "white", size = 2.5, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -1.5,
              fontface = "bold") +
    
    # Styling
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Precipitation\n(mm)", 
                        option = "plasma",
                        na.value = "transparent") +
    
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Observed\n(mm)", 
                         range = c(2, 8),
                         guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = "black"))) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste(title_prefix, "- Kriging"),
      subtitle = paste("Date:", target_date, "| Interpolated precipitation surface"),
      x = "Longitude (°)",
      y = "Latitude (°)",
      caption = "Black points show observed values, colored surface shows interpolated values"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
      aspect.ratio = NULL
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to create uncertainty map
create_uncertainty_map <- function(kriging_result, spatial_points, target_date) {
  # Convert kriging result to dataframe
  kriging_df <- as.data.frame(kriging_result$kriging_result)
  
  # Convert spatial points to dataframe
  points_df <- as.data.frame(spatial_points)
  
  # Handle variance data
  kriging_df <- kriging_df %>%
    mutate(std_error = sqrt(pmax(0, var1.var))) %>%  # Ensure non-negative variance
    filter(is.finite(std_error) & !is.na(std_error))
  
  if(nrow(kriging_df) == 0) {
    stop("No valid variance values for uncertainty mapping")
  }
  
  # Create uncertainty map - CORRECTED VERSION
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_tile(data = kriging_df, 
              aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = std_error),
              alpha = 0.8) +
    
    # Add contour lines if enough data - FIXED SYNTAX
    {if(nrow(kriging_df) > 20) {
      geom_contour(data = kriging_df, 
                  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, z = std_error),
                  color = "white", alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.3)
    } else {
      NULL
    }} +
    
    geom_point(data = points_df, 
               aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude),
               color = "black", size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
    
    geom_text(data = points_df,
              aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, label = Station),
              color = "white", size = 2.5, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -1.5,
              fontface = "bold") +
    
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Standard\nError\n(mm)", 
                        option = "inferno",
                        na.value = "transparent") +
    
    labs(
      title = "Kriging Uncertainty Map",
      subtitle = paste("Date:", target_date, "| Standard errors of interpolation"),
      x = "Longitude (°)",
      y = "Latitude (°)",
      caption = "Lower values indicate higher confidence in interpolated values"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95")
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to create variogram plot
create_variogram_plot <- function(variogram_cloud, variogram_model, target_date) {
  # Create model line
  max_dist <- max(variogram_cloud$dist, na.rm = TRUE)
  model_line <- variogramLine(variogram_model, maxdist = max_dist)
  
  p <- ggplot(variogram_cloud, aes(x = dist, y = gamma)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, color = "#2E86AB", size = 2) +
    geom_line(data = model_line,
              aes(x = dist, y = gamma), color = "#E74C3C", linewidth = 1.2) +
    labs(
      title = "Experimental Variogram with Fitted Model",
      subtitle = paste("Date:", target_date),
      x = "Distance",
      y = "Semivariance",
      caption = paste("Model:", variogram_model$model[2], 
                     "| Nugget:", round(variogram_model$psill[1], 3),
                     "| Sill:", round(sum(variogram_model$psill), 3),
                     "| Range:", round(variogram_model$range[2], 3))
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "gray50"),
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Main function to perform complete spatial analysis
perform_spatial_analysis <- function(combined_data_list, target_date, 
                                   station_coords = NULL, resolution = 0.1,
                                   bbox = list(xmin = -5, xmax = 10, ymin = 30, ymax = 45)) {
  
  cat("🚀 Starting spatial interpolation analysis...\n")
  cat("   Target date:", as.character(target_date), "\n")
  
  # Validate input
  if(is.null(combined_data_list) || length(combined_data_list) == 0) {
    stop("combined_data_list is empty or NULL")
  }
  
  # Generate or use provided coordinates
  if(is.null(station_coords)) {
    cat("📍 Generating random coordinates for stations...\n")
    station_coords <- generate_random_coordinates(names(combined_data_list), bbox)
  }
  
  cat("   Number of stations:", nrow(station_coords), "\n")
  
  # Prepare spatial data
  cat("📊 Preparing spatial data...\n")
  spatial_data <- prepare_spatial_data(combined_data_list, station_coords, target_date)
  
  cat("   Stations with valid data:", nrow(spatial_data), "\n")
  cat("   Precipitation range:", 
      round(min(spatial_data$Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "-", 
      round(max(spatial_data$Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "mm\n")
  
  # Create spatial points
  spatial_points <- create_spatial_points(spatial_data)
  
  # Create prediction grid
  cat("🗺️  Creating prediction grid...\n")
  prediction_grid <- create_prediction_grid(bbox, resolution)
  
  # Perform kriging
  kriging_results <- perform_kriging(spatial_points, prediction_grid)
  
  # Create maps
  cat("🎨 Creating visualization maps...\n")
  interpolation_map <- create_interpolation_map(
    kriging_results, spatial_points, target_date)
  
  uncertainty_map <- create_uncertainty_map(
    kriging_results, spatial_points, target_date)
  
  variogram_plot <- create_variogram_plot(
    kriging_results$variogram_cloud, kriging_results$variogram_model, target_date)
  
  # Summary statistics
  kriging_df <- as.data.frame(kriging_results$kriging_result)
  summary_stats <- list(
    target_date = target_date,
    n_stations = nrow(spatial_data),
    min_precipitation = min(kriging_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_precipitation = max(kriging_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_precipitation = mean(kriging_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_uncertainty = mean(sqrt(pmax(0, kriging_df$var1.var)), na.rm = TRUE),
    variogram_model = kriging_results$variogram_model
  )
  
  cat("✅ Spatial analysis completed successfully!\n")
  
  return(list(
    interpolation_map = interpolation_map,
    uncertainty_map = uncertainty_map,
    variogram_plot = variogram_plot,
    kriging_results = kriging_results,
    spatial_data = spatial_data,
    station_coords = station_coords,
    summary_stats = summary_stats
  ))
}

# Function to create time series of interpolation maps
create_temporal_interpolation <- function(combined_data_list, date_sequence, 
                                        station_coords = NULL, resolution = 0.15,
                                        bbox = list(xmin = -5, xmax = 10, ymin = 30, ymax = 45)) {
  
  cat("🎬 Creating temporal sequence of interpolation maps...\n")
  cat("   Date range:", min(date_sequence), "to", max(date_sequence), "\n")
  cat("   Number of dates:", length(date_sequence), "\n")
  
  # Generate coordinates if not provided
  if(is.null(station_coords)) {
    station_coords <- generate_random_coordinates(names(combined_data_list), bbox)
  }
  
  # Process each date
  successful_dates <- c()
  temporal_results <- list()
  
  for(i in seq_along(date_sequence)) {
    date_to_process <- date_sequence[i]
    cat("   Processing:", as.character(date_to_process), paste0("(", i, "/", length(date_sequence), ")"), "\n")
    
    tryCatch({
      result <- perform_spatial_analysis(combined_data_list, date_to_process, 
                                       station_coords, resolution, bbox)
      temporal_results[[length(temporal_results) + 1]] <- result
      successful_dates <- c(successful_dates, date_to_process)
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("   ❌ Error processing", as.character(date_to_process), ":", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
  
  cat("✅ Successfully processed", length(temporal_results), "out of", length(date_sequence), "dates\n")
  
  return(list(
    results = temporal_results,
    station_coords = station_coords,
    successful_dates = as.Date(successful_dates, origin = "1970-01-01")
  ))
}

# Function to save spatial analysis results
save_spatial_results <- function(spatial_result, output_dir = "spatial_interpolation_results") {
  if(is.null(spatial_result)) {
    cat("❌ No results to save\n")
    return()
  }
  
  if(!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    cat("📁 Created output directory:", output_dir, "\n")
  }
  
  target_date_str <- gsub("-", "_", as.character(spatial_result$summary_stats$target_date))
  
  tryCatch({
    # Save maps
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("interpolation_map_", target_date_str, ".png")),
           spatial_result$interpolation_map, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("uncertainty_map_", target_date_str, ".png")),
           spatial_result$uncertainty_map, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("variogram_", target_date_str, ".png")),
           spatial_result$variogram_plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    # Save spatial data
    write.csv(spatial_result$spatial_data, 
              file.path(output_dir, paste0("spatial_data_", target_date_str, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save station coordinates
    write.csv(spatial_result$station_coords,
              file.path(output_dir, "station_coordinates.csv"),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save kriging results as raster (using terra instead of deprecated raster)
    kriging_raster <- rast(spatial_result$kriging_results$kriging_result)
    writeRaster(kriging_raster, 
                file.path(output_dir, paste0("interpolation_raster_", target_date_str, ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
    
    cat("💾 Spatial results saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ Error saving results:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

demonstrate_spatial_analysis <- function() {

  create_example_data <- function() {
    station_names <- paste0("Station_", LETTERS[1:22])

    # Create synthetic combined data list
    combined_data_list <- map(station_names, function(station) {

      data.frame(
        Date = dates,
        combined_rainfall = pmax(0, rnorm(n_days, mean = runif(1, 5, 25), sd = 5)),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    })
    names(combined_data_list) <- station_names
    
    return(combined_data_list)
  }
  
  # Create example data
  cat("📊 Creating example precipitation data...\n")
  example_data <- create_example_data()
  
  # Single date analysis
  target_date <- "2020-01-15"
  
  cat("\n🗺️  SINGLE DATE INTERPOLATION\n")
  cat("==============================\n")
  
  tryCatch({
    spatial_result <- perform_spatial_analysis(
      combined_data_list = example_data,
      target_date = target_date,
      resolution = 0.2,
      bbox = list(xmin = -2, xmax = 8, ymin = 35, ymax = 42)
    )
    
    if(!is.null(spatial_result)) {
      # Display summary
      cat("\n📊 INTERPOLATION SUMMARY\n")
      cat("========================\n")
      cat("Target date:", as.character(spatial_result$summary_stats$target_date), "\n")
      cat("Stations used:", spatial_result$summary_stats$n_stations, "\n")
      cat("Precipitation range:", 
          round(spatial_result$summary_stats$min_precipitation, 2), "-", 
          round(spatial_result$summary_stats$max_precipitation, 2), "mm\n")
      cat("Mean precipitation:", round(spatial_result$summary_stats$mean_precipitation, 2), "mm\n")
      cat("Mean uncertainty:", round(spatial_result$summary_stats$mean_uncertainty, 2), "mm\n")
      
      # Save results
      save_spatial_results(spatial_result)
      
      # Return the plots so they can be displayed
      return(list(
        interpolation_map = spatial_result$interpolation_map,
        uncertainty_map = spatial_result$uncertainty_map,
        variogram_plot = spatial_result$variogram_plot
      ))
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ Demonstration failed:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}
```

## VII.3. Spatial Interpolation of Real Precipitation Data using IDW (Inverse Distance Weighting)

```{r}
# Spatial Interpolation of Real Precipitation Data using IDW (Inverse Distance Weighting)
# This script creates spatial interpolation of your actual rainfall station data using IDW method
# Uses your real combined datasets with actual station names

# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(gstat)        # For IDW
library(sp)           # Spatial data handling
library(sf)           # Modern spatial data
library(terra)        # Replaces deprecated raster package
library(viridis)      # Color palettes
library(gridExtra)    # Multiple plots
library(lubridate)    # Date handling
library(RColorBrewer) # Additional color palettes
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# Install and load required packages
install_and_load <- function(packages) {
  new_packages <- packages[!(packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
  if(length(new_packages)) {
    cat("Installing packages:", paste(new_packages, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    install.packages(new_packages, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
  sapply(packages, function(x) {
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(x, character.only = TRUE))
  })
}

required_packages <- c("gstat", "sp", "sf", "terra", "viridis", "gridExtra")
install_and_load(required_packages)

# Function to load your real combined datasets
load_combined_datasets <- function(datasets_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets") {
  cat("📥 Loading your real combined rainfall datasets...\n")
  
  if(!dir.exists(datasets_dir)) {
    stop(paste("Directory not found:", datasets_dir, 
               "\nPlease make sure you have run the enhanced time series script first."))
  }
  
  # Get all CSV files in the directory
  csv_files <- list.files(datasets_dir, pattern = "^combined_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  if(length(csv_files) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No combined CSV files found in:", datasets_dir))
  }
  
  combined_data_list <- list()
  
  for(file in csv_files) {
    # Extract station name from filename
    filename <- basename(file)
    # Remove "combined_" prefix and "_2000_2025.csv" suffix
    station_name <- gsub("^combined_", "", filename)
    station_name <- gsub("_2000_2025\\.csv$", "", station_name)
    
    # Load the data
    tryCatch({
      data <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
        mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))
      
      combined_data_list[[station_name]] <- data
      cat(paste("   ✅ Loaded", station_name, ":", nrow(data), "records\n"))
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(paste("   ❌ Failed to load", filename, ":", e$message, "\n"))
    })
  }
  
  if(length(combined_data_list) == 0) {
    stop("No datasets were successfully loaded")
  }
  
  cat("✅ Successfully loaded", length(combined_data_list), "station datasets\n")
  return(combined_data_list)
}

# Function to generate realistic spatial coordinates for your actual stations
generate_station_coordinates <- function(station_names, 
                                       region = "morocco",
                                       seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  n_stations <- length(station_names)
  
  if(n_stations < 3) {
    stop("Need at least 3 stations for spatial interpolation")
  }
  
  # Define realistic bounding boxes for different regions
  region_bounds <- list(
    morocco = list(xmin = -17, xmax = -1, ymin = 21, ymax = 36, name = "Morocco"),
    france = list(xmin = -5, xmax = 10, ymin = 42, ymax = 51, name = "France"),
    spain = list(xmin = -10, xmax = 5, ymin = 36, ymax = 44, name = "Spain"),
    algeria = list(xmin = -8, xmax = 12, ymin = 19, ymax = 37, name = "Algeria"),
    mediterranean = list(xmin = -6, xmax = 10, ymin = 30, ymax = 45, name = "Western Mediterranean"),
    custom = list(xmin = -10, xmax = 10, ymin = 30, ymax = 45, name = "Custom Region")
  )
  
  if(!region %in% names(region_bounds)) {
    cat("⚠️ Unknown region, using mediterranean bounds\n")
    region <- "mediterranean"
  }
  
  bbox <- region_bounds[[region]]
  cat(paste("📍 Generating coordinates for", bbox$name, "region...\n"))
  
  # Generate base random coordinates
  coordinates_df <- data.frame(
    Station = station_names,
    Longitude = runif(n_stations, bbox$xmin, bbox$xmax),
    Latitude = runif(n_stations, bbox$ymin, bbox$ymax),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Add spatial clustering to make it more realistic
  # Create 2-3 clusters based on number of stations
  n_clusters <- min(3, max(2, floor(n_stations / 4)))
  cluster_centers <- data.frame(
    lon = runif(n_clusters, bbox$xmin + 1, bbox$xmax - 1),
    lat = runif(n_clusters, bbox$ymin + 1, bbox$ymax - 1)
  )
  
  # Assign stations to clusters
  station_clusters <- sample(1:n_clusters, n_stations, replace = TRUE)
  
  # Adjust coordinates to create realistic clustering
  for(i in 1:n_stations) {
    cluster_id <- station_clusters[i]
    center <- cluster_centers[cluster_id, ]
    
    # Add some noise around cluster centers
    noise_lon <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.5)
    noise_lat <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.0)
    
    coordinates_df$Longitude[i] <- center$lon + noise_lon
    coordinates_df$Latitude[i] <- center$lat + noise_lat
  }
  
  # Ensure coordinates stay within realistic bounds
  coordinates_df$Longitude <- pmax(bbox$xmin, pmin(bbox$xmax, coordinates_df$Longitude))
  coordinates_df$Latitude <- pmax(bbox$ymin, pmin(bbox$ymax, coordinates_df$Latitude))
  
  # Add elevation (optional, for future use)
  coordinates_df$Elevation_m <- round(runif(n_stations, 50, 2000), 0)
  
  cat(paste("   ✅ Generated coordinates for", n_stations, "stations\n"))
  cat(paste("   📍 Longitude range:", round(min(coordinates_df$Longitude), 2), "to", 
            round(max(coordinates_df$Longitude), 2), "°E\n"))
  cat(paste("   📍 Latitude range:", round(min(coordinates_df$Latitude), 2), "to", 
            round(max(coordinates_df$Latitude), 2), "°N\n"))
  
  return(coordinates_df)
}

# Function to prepare spatial data for IDW using your real data
prepare_real_spatial_data <- function(combined_data_list, coordinates_df, target_date) {
  target_date <- as.Date(target_date)
  cat(paste("📊 Preparing spatial data for", target_date, "...\n"))
  
  # Extract data for the target date from all stations
  spatial_data <- map_dfr(names(combined_data_list), function(station_name) {
    station_data <- combined_data_list[[station_name]]
    
    if(is.null(station_data) || nrow(station_data) == 0) {
      return(data.frame(Station = station_name, Precipitation = NA, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
    
    # Find target date data
    target_row <- station_data %>% 
      filter(Date == target_date) %>%
      slice(1)
    
    # Use combined_rainfall column (from your enhanced time series)
    if(nrow(target_row) > 0 && !is.na(target_row$combined_rainfall)) {
      data.frame(
        Station = station_name,
        Precipitation = as.numeric(target_row$combined_rainfall),
        Data_Source = as.character(target_row$data_source %||% "Unknown"),
        Original_Rainfall = as.numeric(target_row$original_rainfall %||% NA),
        CHIRPS_Rainfall = as.numeric(target_row$chirps_rainfall %||% NA),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      data.frame(
        Station = station_name,
        Precipitation = NA,
        Data_Source = "Missing",
        Original_Rainfall = NA,
        CHIRPS_Rainfall = NA,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  })
  
  # Join with coordinates
  spatial_data <- spatial_data %>%
    left_join(coordinates_df, by = "Station") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Precipitation) & !is.na(Longitude) & !is.na(Latitude) & 
           is.finite(Precipitation) & is.finite(Longitude) & is.finite(Latitude) &
           Precipitation >= 0)  # Remove negative rainfall values
  
  cat(paste("   📍 Stations with valid data:", nrow(spatial_data), "out of", length(combined_data_list), "\n"))
  
  if(nrow(spatial_data) < 3) {
    available_dates <- map(combined_data_list, ~unique(.x$Date)) %>% 
      unlist() %>% unique() %>% sort()
    
    cat("❌ Insufficient data points for IDW interpolation\n")
    cat("Available dates in your dataset:\n")
    cat(paste(head(available_dates, 10), collapse = ", "))
    if(length(available_dates) > 10) cat(", ...")
    cat("\n")
    
    stop(paste("Found only", nrow(spatial_data), "valid data points for", target_date, 
               ". Need at least 3 stations with data."))
  }
  
  # Summary of data sources
  source_summary <- spatial_data %>% 
    count(Data_Source, name = "n_stations") %>%
    arrange(desc(n_stations))
  
  cat("   📊 Data sources summary:\n")
  for(i in 1:nrow(source_summary)) {
    cat(paste("      ", source_summary$Data_Source[i], ":", source_summary$n_stations[i], "stations\n"))
  }
  
  return(spatial_data)
}

# Function to create spatial points for IDW
create_spatial_points <- function(spatial_data) {
  sp_data <- spatial_data
  coordinates(sp_data) <- ~Longitude + Latitude
  proj4string(sp_data) <- CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs")
  return(sp_data)
}

# Function to create prediction grid based on your data extent
create_prediction_grid <- function(spatial_data, resolution = 0.1, buffer = 0.5) {
  # Calculate bounds from your actual station locations
  xmin <- min(spatial_data$Longitude) - buffer
  xmax <- max(spatial_data$Longitude) + buffer
  ymin <- min(spatial_data$Latitude) - buffer
  ymax <- max(spatial_data$Latitude) + buffer
  
  cat(paste("🗺️ Creating prediction grid:\n"))
  cat(paste("   📍 Longitude:", round(xmin, 2), "to", round(xmax, 2), "°E\n"))
  cat(paste("   📍 Latitude:", round(ymin, 2), "to", round(ymax, 2), "°N\n"))
  cat(paste("   📏 Resolution:", resolution, "degrees\n"))
  
  # Create sequences
  x_seq <- seq(xmin, xmax, by = resolution)
  y_seq <- seq(ymin, ymax, by = resolution)
  
  # Create grid
  grid_df <- expand.grid(Longitude = x_seq, Latitude = y_seq)
  coordinates(grid_df) <- ~Longitude + Latitude
  gridded(grid_df) <- TRUE
  proj4string(grid_df) <- CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs")
  
  cat(paste("   ✅ Grid created:", length(x_seq), "x", length(y_seq), "=", length(x_seq) * length(y_seq), "points\n"))
  
  return(grid_df)
}

# Function to perform IDW interpolation
perform_idw <- function(spatial_points, prediction_grid, power = 2, nmax = Inf, nmin = 3) {
  tryCatch({
    cat("🎯 Performing IDW interpolation...\n")
    cat("   Power parameter:", power, "\n")
    cat("   Max neighbors:", ifelse(is.finite(nmax), nmax, "All"), "\n")
    cat("   Min neighbors:", nmin, "\n")
    
    # Perform IDW interpolation
    idw_result <- idw(Precipitation ~ 1, 
                      spatial_points, 
                      prediction_grid, 
                      idp = power,
                      nmax = nmax,
                      nmin = nmin)
    
    cat("✅ IDW interpolation completed successfully!\n")
    
    return(list(
      idw_result = idw_result,
      power = power,
      nmax = nmax,
      nmin = nmin
    ))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ IDW failed:", e$message, "\n")
    stop(paste("IDW interpolation failed:", e$message))
  })
}

# Enhanced function to create IDW interpolation map with data source info
create_enhanced_idw_map <- function(idw_result, spatial_points, target_date, 
                                  title_prefix = "Rainfall Interpolation") {
  # Convert IDW result to dataframe
  idw_df <- as.data.frame(idw_result$idw_result)
  
  # Convert spatial points to dataframe
  points_df <- as.data.frame(spatial_points)
  
  # Handle prediction values
  idw_df <- idw_df %>%
    filter(is.finite(var1.pred) & !is.na(var1.pred) & var1.pred >= 0)
  
  if(nrow(idw_df) == 0) {
    stop("No valid prediction values for mapping")
  }
  
  # Create the map
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Add interpolated surface
    geom_tile(data = idw_df, 
              aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = var1.pred),
              alpha = 0.8) +
    
    # Add contour lines
    {if(nrow(idw_df) > 50) {
      geom_contour(data = idw_df, 
                  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, z = var1.pred),
                  color = "white", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4, bins = 8)
    }} +
    
    # Add station points colored by data source
    geom_point(data = points_df, 
               aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, size = Precipitation, 
                   shape = Data_Source, color = Data_Source),
               alpha = 0.9, stroke = 1.2) +
    
    # Add station labels
    geom_text(data = points_df,
              aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, label = Station),
              color = "white", size = 2.2, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -1.8,
              fontface = "bold") +
    
    # Styling
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Interpolated\nRainfall (mm)", 
                        option = "plasma",
                        na.value = "transparent",
                        trans = "sqrt") +
    
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Observed\n(mm)", 
                         range = c(2, 8),
                         trans = "sqrt") +
    
    scale_color_manual(name = "Data Source",
                      values = c("Original" = "#2E86AB", 
                                "CHIRPS" = "#E74C3C", 
                                "Unknown" = "#34495E"),
                      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4))) +
    
    scale_shape_manual(name = "Data Source",
                      values = c("Original" = 16, "CHIRPS" = 17, "Unknown" = 15)) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste(title_prefix, "- IDW Interpolation"),
      subtitle = paste("Date:", target_date, "| Power =", idw_result$power, 
                      "| Blue = Original data, Red = CHIRPS data"),
      x = "Longitude (°E)",
      y = "Latitude (°N)",
      caption = "Points show observed values, colored surface shows IDW interpolated rainfall"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
      legend.box = "vertical"
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to create distance analysis plot
create_distance_analysis <- function(spatial_points, target_date) {
  points_df <- as.data.frame(spatial_points)
  
  # Calculate distance matrix (in degrees, approximate)
  coords <- points_df[, c("Longitude", "Latitude")]
  dist_matrix <- as.matrix(dist(coords))
  
  # Create distance vs precipitation difference analysis
  distances <- c()
  precip_diffs <- c()
  source_pairs <- c()
  
  for(i in 1:(nrow(points_df)-1)) {
    for(j in (i+1):nrow(points_df)) {
      distances <- c(distances, dist_matrix[i,j])
      precip_diffs <- c(precip_diffs, abs(points_df$Precipitation[i] - points_df$Precipitation[j]))
      pair_sources <- paste(sort(c(points_df$Data_Source[i], points_df$Data_Source[j])), collapse = "-")
      source_pairs <- c(source_pairs, pair_sources)
    }
  }
  
  analysis_df <- data.frame(
    Distance = distances,
    Precipitation_Difference = precip_diffs,
    Source_Pair = source_pairs
  )
  
  # Create scatter plot with trend line
  p <- ggplot(analysis_df, aes(x = Distance, y = Precipitation_Difference, color = Source_Pair)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "#34495E", fill = "#34495E", alpha = 0.2) +
    scale_color_brewer(name = "Station\nPair Types", type = "qual", palette = "Set2") +
    labs(
      title = "Distance vs Rainfall Difference Analysis",
      subtitle = paste("Date:", target_date, "| Spatial autocorrelation with data source info"),
      x = "Distance between stations (degrees)",
      y = "Rainfall difference (mm)",
      caption = "Closer stations should have more similar rainfall values"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "gray50"),
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Main function to perform complete IDW analysis with your real data
perform_real_idw_analysis <- function(combined_data_list = NULL, target_date, 
                                    station_coords = NULL, resolution = 0.1,
                                    region = "morocco", power = 2, nmax = Inf, nmin = 3,
                                    datasets_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets") {
  
  cat("🚀 Starting IDW interpolation analysis with your real data...\n")
  cat("   Target date:", as.character(target_date), "\n")
  
  # Load your real data if not provided
  if(is.null(combined_data_list)) {
    combined_data_list <- load_combined_datasets(datasets_dir)
  }
  
  # Generate coordinates for your stations if not provided
  if(is.null(station_coords)) {
    cat("📍 Generating spatial coordinates for your stations...\n")
    station_coords <- generate_station_coordinates(names(combined_data_list), region)
  }
  
  cat("   Number of stations:", nrow(station_coords), "\n")
  
  # Prepare spatial data
  spatial_data <- prepare_real_spatial_data(combined_data_list, station_coords, target_date)
  
  cat("   Stations with valid data:", nrow(spatial_data), "\n")
  cat("   Rainfall range:", 
      round(min(spatial_data$Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "-", 
      round(max(spatial_data$Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "mm\n")
  
  # Create spatial points
  spatial_points <- create_spatial_points(spatial_data)
  
  # Create prediction grid based on your data extent
  cat("🗺️ Creating prediction grid based on your station locations...\n")
  prediction_grid <- create_prediction_grid(spatial_data, resolution)
  
  # Perform IDW
  idw_results <- perform_idw(spatial_points, prediction_grid, power, nmax, nmin)
  
  # Create enhanced maps
  cat("🎨 Creating enhanced visualization maps...\n")
  interpolation_map <- create_enhanced_idw_map(idw_results, spatial_points, target_date, 
                                              "Real Rainfall Data")
  
  distance_analysis <- create_distance_analysis(spatial_points, target_date)
  
  # Summary statistics
  idw_df <- as.data.frame(idw_results$idw_result)
  summary_stats <- list(
    target_date = target_date,
    n_stations = nrow(spatial_data),
    n_original_stations = sum(spatial_data$Data_Source == "Original", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_chirps_stations = sum(spatial_data$Data_Source == "CHIRPS", na.rm = TRUE),
    min_precipitation = min(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_precipitation = max(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_precipitation = mean(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    power_parameter = power,
    max_neighbors = nmax,
    min_neighbors = nmin,
    region = region
  )
  
  cat("✅ IDW analysis completed successfully!\n")
  
  return(list(
    interpolation_map = interpolation_map,
    distance_analysis = distance_analysis,
    idw_results = idw_results,
    spatial_data = spatial_data,
    station_coords = station_coords,
    summary_stats = summary_stats
  ))
}

# Function to save IDW results (same structure as before)
save_idw_results <- function(idw_result, output_dir = "idw_interpolation_results") {
  if(is.null(idw_result)) {
    cat("❌ No results to save\n")
    return()
  }
  
  if(!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    cat("📁 Created output directory:", output_dir, "\n")
  }
  
  target_date_str <- gsub("-", "_", as.character(idw_result$summary_stats$target_date))
  
  tryCatch({
    # Save maps
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("idw_interpolation_", target_date_str, ".png")),
           idw_result$interpolation_map, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("distance_analysis_", target_date_str, ".png")),
           idw_result$distance_analysis, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    # Save spatial data with all information
    write.csv(idw_result$spatial_data, 
              file.path(output_dir, paste0("spatial_data_", target_date_str, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save station coordinates
    write.csv(idw_result$station_coords,
              file.path(output_dir, "station_coordinates.csv"),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save IDW results as raster
    idw_raster <- rast(idw_result$idw_results$idw_result)
    writeRaster(idw_raster, 
                file.path(output_dir, paste0("idw_raster_", target_date_str, ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
    
    # Save summary statistics
    summary_df <- data.frame(
      Parameter = names(idw_result$summary_stats),
      Value = as.character(idw_result$summary_stats),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    write.csv(summary_df,
              file.path(output_dir, paste0("idw_summary_", target_date_str, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    cat("💾 IDW results saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ Error saving results:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

# ====================================================================
# MAIN EXECUTION CODE - Run this with your real data!

target_date <- "2020-01-15"  # Change this to any date in your dataset (2000-2025)

      round(idw_result$summary_stats$min_precipitation, 2), "-", 
      round(idw_result$summary_stats$max_precipitation, 2), "mm\n")

  # Save results
  save_idw_results(idw_result)
}
```

## VII.4. Monthly Spatial Interpolation of Real Precipitation Data using IDW (Inverse Distance Weighting)

```{r}
# Monthly Spatial Interpolation of Real Precipitation Data using IDW (Inverse Distance Weighting)

# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(gstat)        # For IDW
library(sp)           # Spatial data handling
library(sf)           # Modern spatial data
library(terra)        # Replaces deprecated raster package
library(viridis)      # Color palettes
library(gridExtra)    # Multiple plots
library(lubridate)    # Date handling
library(RColorBrewer) # Additional color palettes
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# Install and load required packages
install_and_load <- function(packages) {
  new_packages <- packages[!(packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
  if(length(new_packages)) {
    cat("Installing packages:", paste(new_packages, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    install.packages(new_packages, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
  sapply(packages, function(x) {
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(x, character.only = TRUE))
  })
}

required_packages <- c("gstat", "sp", "sf", "terra", "viridis", "gridExtra")
install_and_load(required_packages)

# Function to load and aggregate your real combined datasets to monthly data
load_and_aggregate_monthly_data <- function(datasets_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets") {
  cat("📥 Loading and aggregating your real combined rainfall datasets to monthly...\n")
  
  if(!dir.exists(datasets_dir)) {
    stop(paste("Directory not found:", datasets_dir, 
               "\nPlease make sure you have run the enhanced time series script first."))
  }
  
  # Get all CSV files in the directory
  csv_files <- list.files(datasets_dir, pattern = "^combined_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  if(length(csv_files) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No combined CSV files found in:", datasets_dir))
  }
  
  monthly_data_list <- list()
  
  for(file in csv_files) {
    # Extract station name from filename
    filename <- basename(file)
    # Remove "combined_" prefix and "_2000_2025.csv" suffix
    station_name <- gsub("^combined_", "", filename)
    station_name <- gsub("_2000_2025\\.csv$", "", station_name)
    
    # Load the data
    tryCatch({
      daily_data <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
        mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))
      
      # Aggregate to monthly data
      monthly_data <- daily_data %>%
        mutate(
          Year = year(Date),
          Month = month(Date),
          YearMonth = floor_date(Date, "month")
        ) %>%
        group_by(Station = station_name, Year, Month, YearMonth) %>%
        summarise(
          # Monthly totals for rainfall
          monthly_rainfall = sum(combined_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
          monthly_original = sum(original_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
          monthly_chirps = sum(chirps_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
          
          # Count of valid days
          valid_days = sum(!is.na(combined_rainfall)),
          total_days = n(),
          data_completeness = valid_days / total_days,
          
          # Dominant data source for the month
          dominant_source = names(sort(table(data_source), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
          
          # First and last date of month
          month_start = min(Date, na.rm = TRUE),
          month_end = max(Date, na.rm = TRUE),
          
          .groups = 'drop'
        ) %>%
        # Only keep months with reasonable data completeness (at least 50% of days)
        filter(data_completeness >= 0.5 & valid_days >= 10) %>%
        # Convert 0 totals to NA if no valid data
        mutate(
          monthly_rainfall = ifelse(valid_days == 0, NA, monthly_rainfall),
          monthly_original = ifelse(monthly_original == 0 & valid_days > 0, NA, monthly_original),
          monthly_chirps = ifelse(monthly_chirps == 0 & valid_days > 0, NA, monthly_chirps)
        )
      
      monthly_data_list[[station_name]] <- monthly_data
      cat(paste("   ✅ Loaded and aggregated", station_name, ":", 
                nrow(daily_data), "daily →", nrow(monthly_data), "monthly records\n"))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(paste("   ❌ Failed to process", filename, ":", e$message, "\n"))
    })
  }
  
  if(length(monthly_data_list) == 0) {
    stop("No datasets were successfully processed")
  }
  
  cat("✅ Successfully processed", length(monthly_data_list), "station datasets to monthly\n")
  
  # Create summary of available months across all stations
  all_months <- map_dfr(monthly_data_list, ~select(.x, Station, YearMonth, valid_days, data_completeness)) %>%
    group_by(YearMonth) %>%
    summarise(
      stations_available = n(),
      avg_completeness = mean(data_completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_valid_days = min(valid_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(stations_available), desc(avg_completeness))
  
  cat("\n📊 Monthly data availability summary (top 10 months):\n")
  print(head(all_months, 10))
  
  return(list(
    monthly_data = monthly_data_list,
    availability_summary = all_months
  ))
}

# Function to generate realistic spatial coordinates for your actual stations (same as before)
generate_station_coordinates <- function(station_names, 
                                       region = "morocco",
                                       seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  n_stations <- length(station_names)
  
  if(n_stations < 3) {
    stop("Need at least 3 stations for spatial interpolation")
  }
  
  # Define realistic bounding boxes for different regions
  region_bounds <- list(
    morocco = list(xmin = -17, xmax = -1, ymin = 21, ymax = 36, name = "Morocco"),
    france = list(xmin = -5, xmax = 10, ymin = 42, ymax = 51, name = "France"),
    spain = list(xmin = -10, xmax = 5, ymin = 36, ymax = 44, name = "Spain"),
    algeria = list(xmin = -8, xmax = 12, ymin = 19, ymax = 37, name = "Algeria"),
    mediterranean = list(xmin = -6, xmax = 10, ymin = 30, ymax = 45, name = "Western Mediterranean"),
    custom = list(xmin = -10, xmax = 10, ymin = 30, ymax = 45, name = "Custom Region")
  )
  
  if(!region %in% names(region_bounds)) {
    cat("⚠️ Unknown region, using mediterranean bounds\n")
    region <- "mediterranean"
  }
  
  bbox <- region_bounds[[region]]
  cat(paste("📍 Generating coordinates for", bbox$name, "region...\n"))
  
  # Generate base random coordinates
  coordinates_df <- data.frame(
    Station = station_names,
    Longitude = runif(n_stations, bbox$xmin, bbox$xmax),
    Latitude = runif(n_stations, bbox$ymin, bbox$ymax),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Add spatial clustering to make it more realistic
  # Create 2-3 clusters based on number of stations
  n_clusters <- min(3, max(2, floor(n_stations / 4)))
  cluster_centers <- data.frame(
    lon = runif(n_clusters, bbox$xmin + 1, bbox$xmax - 1),
    lat = runif(n_clusters, bbox$ymin + 1, bbox$ymax - 1)
  )
  
  # Assign stations to clusters
  station_clusters <- sample(1:n_clusters, n_stations, replace = TRUE)
  
  # Adjust coordinates to create realistic clustering
  for(i in 1:n_stations) {
    cluster_id <- station_clusters[i]
    center <- cluster_centers[cluster_id, ]
    
    # Add some noise around cluster centers
    noise_lon <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.5)
    noise_lat <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.0)
    
    coordinates_df$Longitude[i] <- center$lon + noise_lon
    coordinates_df$Latitude[i] <- center$lat + noise_lat
  }
  
  # Ensure coordinates stay within realistic bounds
  coordinates_df$Longitude <- pmax(bbox$xmin, pmin(bbox$xmax, coordinates_df$Longitude))
  coordinates_df$Latitude <- pmax(bbox$ymin, pmin(bbox$ymax, coordinates_df$Latitude))
  
  # Add elevation (optional, for future use)
  coordinates_df$Elevation_m <- round(runif(n_stations, 50, 2000), 0)
  
  cat(paste("   ✅ Generated coordinates for", n_stations, "stations\n"))
  cat(paste("   📍 Longitude range:", round(min(coordinates_df$Longitude), 2), "to", 
            round(max(coordinates_df$Longitude), 2), "°E\n"))
  cat(paste("   📍 Latitude range:", round(min(coordinates_df$Latitude), 2), "to", 
            round(max(coordinates_df$Latitude), 2), "°N\n"))
  
  return(coordinates_df)
}

# Function to prepare monthly spatial data for IDW
prepare_monthly_spatial_data <- function(monthly_data_list, coordinates_df, target_year_month) {
  target_date <- as.Date(paste0(target_year_month, "-01"))
  target_ym <- floor_date(target_date, "month")
  
  cat(paste("📊 Preparing monthly spatial data for", format(target_ym, "%Y-%m"), "...\n"))
  
  # Extract data for the target month from all stations
  spatial_data <- map_dfr(names(monthly_data_list), function(station_name) {
    station_data <- monthly_data_list[[station_name]]
    
    if(is.null(station_data) || nrow(station_data) == 0) {
      return(data.frame(Station = station_name, Monthly_Precipitation = NA, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
    
    # Find target month data
    target_row <- station_data %>% 
      filter(YearMonth == target_ym) %>%
      slice(1)
    
    if(nrow(target_row) > 0 && !is.na(target_row$monthly_rainfall)) {
      data.frame(
        Station = station_name,
        Monthly_Precipitation = as.numeric(target_row$monthly_rainfall),
        Monthly_Original = as.numeric(target_row$monthly_original %||% NA),
        Monthly_CHIRPS = as.numeric(target_row$monthly_chirps %||% NA),
        Data_Source = as.character(target_row$dominant_source %||% "Unknown"),
        Valid_Days = as.numeric(target_row$valid_days),
        Data_Completeness = as.numeric(target_row$data_completeness),
        Year = as.numeric(target_row$Year),
        Month = as.numeric(target_row$Month),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      data.frame(
        Station = station_name,
        Monthly_Precipitation = NA,
        Monthly_Original = NA,
        Monthly_CHIRPS = NA,
        Data_Source = "Missing",
        Valid_Days = 0,
        Data_Completeness = 0,
        Year = year(target_ym),
        Month = month(target_ym),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  })
  
  # Join with coordinates
  spatial_data <- spatial_data %>%
    left_join(coordinates_df, by = "Station") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Monthly_Precipitation) & !is.na(Longitude) & !is.na(Latitude) & 
           is.finite(Monthly_Precipitation) & is.finite(Longitude) & is.finite(Latitude) &
           Monthly_Precipitation >= 0)  # Remove negative rainfall values
  
  cat(paste("   📍 Stations with valid monthly data:", nrow(spatial_data), "out of", length(monthly_data_list), "\n"))
  
  if(nrow(spatial_data) < 3) {
    # Show available months
    available_months <- map(monthly_data_list, ~unique(.x$YearMonth)) %>% 
      unlist() %>% unique() %>% sort()
    
    cat("❌ Insufficient data points for IDW interpolation\n")
    cat("Available months in your dataset:\n")
    cat(paste(format(head(available_months, 10), "%Y-%m"), collapse = ", "))
    if(length(available_months) > 10) cat(", ...")
    cat("\n")
    
    stop(paste("Found only", nrow(spatial_data), "valid data points for", format(target_ym, "%Y-%m"), 
               ". Need at least 3 stations with data."))
  }
  
  # Summary of data sources and completeness
  source_summary <- spatial_data %>% 
    group_by(Data_Source) %>%
    summarise(
      n_stations = n(),
      avg_completeness = mean(Data_Completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_valid_days = mean(Valid_Days, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_stations))
  
  cat("   📊 Monthly data sources summary:\n")
  for(i in 1:nrow(source_summary)) {
    cat(paste("      ", source_summary$Data_Source[i], ":", source_summary$n_stations[i], 
              "stations (", round(source_summary$avg_completeness[i]*100, 1), "% complete,",
              round(source_summary$avg_valid_days[i], 1), "valid days avg)\n"))
  }
  
  # Rainfall statistics
  cat("   🌧️ Monthly rainfall statistics:\n")
  cat(paste("      Range:", round(min(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "-", 
            round(max(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "mm\n"))
  cat(paste("      Mean:", round(mean(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "mm\n"))
  cat(paste("      Median:", round(median(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "mm\n"))
  
  return(spatial_data)
}

# Function to create spatial points for IDW (same as before)
create_spatial_points <- function(spatial_data) {
  sp_data <- spatial_data
  coordinates(sp_data) <- ~Longitude + Latitude
  proj4string(sp_data) <- CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs")
  return(sp_data)
}

# Function to create prediction grid based on your data extent (same as before)
create_prediction_grid <- function(spatial_data, resolution = 0.1, buffer = 0.5) {
  # Calculate bounds from your actual station locations
  xmin <- min(spatial_data$Longitude) - buffer
  xmax <- max(spatial_data$Longitude) + buffer
  ymin <- min(spatial_data$Latitude) - buffer
  ymax <- max(spatial_data$Latitude) + buffer
  
  cat(paste("🗺️ Creating prediction grid:\n"))
  cat(paste("   📍 Longitude:", round(xmin, 2), "to", round(xmax, 2), "°E\n"))
  cat(paste("   📍 Latitude:", round(ymin, 2), "to", round(ymax, 2), "°N\n"))
  cat(paste("   📏 Resolution:", resolution, "degrees\n"))
  
  # Create sequences
  x_seq <- seq(xmin, xmax, by = resolution)
  y_seq <- seq(ymin, ymax, by = resolution)
  
  # Create grid
  grid_df <- expand.grid(Longitude = x_seq, Latitude = y_seq)
  coordinates(grid_df) <- ~Longitude + Latitude
  gridded(grid_df) <- TRUE
  proj4string(grid_df) <- CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs")
  
  cat(paste("   ✅ Grid created:", length(x_seq), "x", length(y_seq), "=", length(x_seq) * length(y_seq), "points\n"))
  
  return(grid_df)
}

# Function to perform IDW interpolation (same as before)
perform_idw <- function(spatial_points, prediction_grid, power = 2, nmax = Inf, nmin = 3) {
  tryCatch({
    cat("🎯 Performing monthly IDW interpolation...\n")
    cat("   Power parameter:", power, "\n")
    cat("   Max neighbors:", ifelse(is.finite(nmax), nmax, "All"), "\n")
    cat("   Min neighbors:", nmin, "\n")
    
    # Perform IDW interpolation using Monthly_Precipitation
    idw_result <- idw(Monthly_Precipitation ~ 1, 
                      spatial_points, 
                      prediction_grid, 
                      idp = power,
                      nmax = nmax,
                      nmin = nmin)
    
    cat("✅ Monthly IDW interpolation completed successfully!\n")
    
    return(list(
      idw_result = idw_result,
      power = power,
      nmax = nmax,
      nmin = nmin
    ))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ IDW failed:", e$message, "\n")
    stop(paste("IDW interpolation failed:", e$message))
  })
}

# Enhanced function to create monthly IDW interpolation map
create_enhanced_monthly_idw_map <- function(idw_result, spatial_points, target_year_month, 
                                          title_prefix = "Monthly Rainfall Interpolation") {
  # Convert IDW result to dataframe
  idw_df <- as.data.frame(idw_result$idw_result)
  
  # Convert spatial points to dataframe
  points_df <- as.data.frame(spatial_points)
  
  # Handle prediction values
  idw_df <- idw_df %>%
    filter(is.finite(var1.pred) & !is.na(var1.pred) & var1.pred >= 0)
  
  if(nrow(idw_df) == 0) {
    stop("No valid prediction values for mapping")
  }
  
  # Create the map
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Add interpolated surface
    geom_tile(data = idw_df, 
              aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = var1.pred),
              alpha = 0.8) +
    
    # Add contour lines
    {if(nrow(idw_df) > 50) {
      geom_contour(data = idw_df, 
                  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, z = var1.pred),
                  color = "white", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4, bins = 8)
    }} +
    
    # Add station points colored by data source and sized by data completeness
    geom_point(data = points_df, 
               aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, 
                   size = Monthly_Precipitation,
                   shape = Data_Source, 
                   color = Data_Source,
                   alpha = Data_Completeness),
               stroke = 1.2) +
    
    # Add station labels
    geom_text(data = points_df,
              aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, label = Station),
              color = "white", size = 2.2, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -1.8,
              fontface = "bold") +
    
    # Styling
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Interpolated\nMonthly Rainfall\n(mm)", 
                        option = "plasma",
                        na.value = "transparent",
                        trans = "sqrt") +
    
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Observed\nMonthly (mm)", 
                         range = c(2, 8),
                         trans = "sqrt") +
    
    scale_alpha_continuous(name = "Data\nCompleteness", 
                          range = c(0.5, 1.0),
                          labels = scales::percent) +
    
    scale_color_manual(name = "Data Source",
                      values = c("Original" = "#2E86AB", 
                                "CHIRPS" = "#E74C3C", 
                                "Unknown" = "#34495E"),
                      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1))) +
    
    scale_shape_manual(name = "Data Source",
                      values = c("Original" = 16, "CHIRPS" = 17, "Unknown" = 15)) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste(title_prefix, "- Monthly IDW Interpolation"),
      subtitle = paste("Month:", target_year_month, "| Power =", idw_result$power, 
                      "| Transparency shows data completeness"),
      x = "Longitude (°E)",
      y = "Latitude (°N)",
      caption = "Points show monthly observed values, surface shows IDW interpolated monthly rainfall"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
      legend.box = "vertical"
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to create monthly distance analysis plot
create_monthly_distance_analysis <- function(spatial_points, target_year_month) {
  points_df <- as.data.frame(spatial_points)
  
  # Calculate distance matrix (in degrees, approximate)
  coords <- points_df[, c("Longitude", "Latitude")]
  dist_matrix <- as.matrix(dist(coords))
  
  # Create distance vs monthly precipitation difference analysis
  distances <- c()
  precip_diffs <- c()
  source_pairs <- c()
  completeness_pairs <- c()
  
  for(i in 1:(nrow(points_df)-1)) {
    for(j in (i+1):nrow(points_df)) {
      distances <- c(distances, dist_matrix[i,j])
      precip_diffs <- c(precip_diffs, abs(points_df$Monthly_Precipitation[i] - points_df$Monthly_Precipitation[j]))
      pair_sources <- paste(sort(c(points_df$Data_Source[i], points_df$Data_Source[j])), collapse = "-")
      source_pairs <- c(source_pairs, pair_sources)
      completeness_pairs <- c(completeness_pairs, 
                            min(points_df$Data_Completeness[i], points_df$Data_Completeness[j]))
    }
  }
  
  analysis_df <- data.frame(
    Distance = distances,
    Monthly_Precipitation_Difference = precip_diffs,
    Source_Pair = source_pairs,
    Min_Completeness = completeness_pairs
  )
  
  # Create scatter plot with trend line
  p <- ggplot(analysis_df, aes(x = Distance, y = Monthly_Precipitation_Difference, 
                              color = Source_Pair, size = Min_Completeness)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "#34495E", fill = "#34495E", alpha = 0.2) +
    scale_color_brewer(name = "Station\nPair Types", type = "qual", palette = "Set2") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Min Data\nCompleteness", 
                         range = c(1, 4),
                         labels = scales::percent) +
    labs(
      title = "Distance vs Monthly Rainfall Difference Analysis",
      subtitle = paste("Month:", target_year_month, "| Spatial autocorrelation with data quality info"),
      x = "Distance between stations (degrees)",
      y = "Monthly rainfall difference (mm)",
      caption = "Closer stations should have more similar monthly rainfall values"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "gray50"),
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Main function to perform complete monthly IDW analysis with your real data
perform_monthly_idw_analysis <- function(monthly_data_list = NULL, target_year_month, 
                                      station_coords = NULL, resolution = 0.1,
                                      region = "morocco", power = 2, nmax = Inf, nmin = 3,
                                      datasets_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets") {
  
  cat("🚀 Starting MONTHLY IDW interpolation analysis with your real data...\n")
  cat("   Target month:", target_year_month, "\n")
  
  # Load and aggregate your real data to monthly if not provided
  if(is.null(monthly_data_list)) {
    monthly_result <- load_and_aggregate_monthly_data(datasets_dir)
    monthly_data_list <- monthly_result$monthly_data
  }
  
  # Generate coordinates for your stations if not provided
  if(is.null(station_coords)) {
    cat("📍 Generating spatial coordinates for your stations...\n")
    station_coords <- generate_station_coordinates(names(monthly_data_list), region)
  }
  
  cat("   Number of stations:", nrow(station_coords), "\n")
  
  # Prepare monthly spatial data
  spatial_data <- prepare_monthly_spatial_data(monthly_data_list, station_coords, target_year_month)
  
  cat("   Stations with valid monthly data:", nrow(spatial_data), "\n")
  cat("   Monthly rainfall range:", 
      round(min(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "-", 
      round(max(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "mm\n")
  
  # Create spatial points
  spatial_points <- create_spatial_points(spatial_data)
  
  # Create prediction grid based on your data extent
  cat("🗺️ Creating prediction grid based on your station locations...\n")
  prediction_grid <- create_prediction_grid(spatial_data, resolution)
  
  # Perform IDW
  idw_results <- perform_idw(spatial_points, prediction_grid, power, nmax, nmin)
  
  # Create enhanced maps
  cat("🎨 Creating enhanced monthly visualization maps...\n")
  interpolation_map <- create_enhanced_monthly_idw_map(idw_results, spatial_points, target_year_month, 
                                                     "Real Monthly Rainfall Data")
  
  distance_analysis <- create_monthly_distance_analysis(spatial_points, target_year_month)
  
  # Summary statistics
  idw_df <- as.data.frame(idw_results$idw_result)
  summary_stats <- list(
    target_year_month = target_year_month,
    n_stations = nrow(spatial_data),
    n_original_stations = sum(spatial_data$Data_Source == "Original", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_chirps_stations = sum(spatial_data$Data_Source == "CHIRPS", na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_data_completeness = mean(spatial_data$Data_Completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_precipitation = min(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_precipitation = max(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_precipitation = mean(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    power_parameter = power,
    max_neighbors = nmax,
    min_neighbors = nmin,
    region = region
  )
  
  cat("✅ Monthly IDW analysis completed successfully!\n")
  
  return(list(
    interpolation_map = interpolation_map,
    distance_analysis = distance_analysis,
    idw_results = idw_results,
    spatial_data = spatial_data,
    station_coords = station_coords,
    summary_stats = summary_stats,
    monthly_data_list = monthly_data_list
  ))
}

# Function to save monthly IDW results
save_monthly_idw_results <- function(idw_result, output_dir = "monthly_idw_interpolation_results") {
  if(is.null(idw_result)) {
    cat("❌ No results to save\n")
    return()
  }
  
  if(!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    cat("📁 Created output directory:", output_dir, "\n")
  }
  
  target_month_str <- gsub("-", "_", idw_result$summary_stats$target_year_month)
  
  tryCatch({
    # Save maps
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_idw_interpolation_", target_month_str, ".png")),
           idw_result$interpolation_map, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_distance_analysis_", target_month_str, ".png")),
           idw_result$distance_analysis, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    # Save monthly spatial data with all information
    write.csv(idw_result$spatial_data, 
              file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_spatial_data_", target_month_str, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save station coordinates
    write.csv(idw_result$station_coords,
              file.path(output_dir, "station_coordinates.csv"),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save IDW results as raster
    idw_raster <- rast(idw_result$idw_results$idw_result)
    writeRaster(idw_raster, 
                file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_idw_raster_", target_month_str, ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
    
    # Save monthly summary statistics
    summary_df <- data.frame(
      Parameter = names(idw_result$summary_stats),
      Value = as.character(idw_result$summary_stats),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    write.csv(summary_df,
              file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_idw_summary_", target_month_str, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save aggregated monthly data for all stations
    if(!is.null(idw_result$monthly_data_list)) {
      all_monthly_data <- map_dfr(idw_result$monthly_data_list, ~.x)
      write.csv(all_monthly_data,
                file.path(output_dir, "all_stations_monthly_data.csv"),
                row.names = FALSE)
    }
    
    cat("💾 Monthly IDW results saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ Error saving results:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

# Function to get best available months for interpolation
get_best_months_for_interpolation <- function(monthly_data_list, min_stations = 5) {
  cat("📊 Finding best months for IDW interpolation...\n")
  
  # Create summary of available months across all stations
  all_months <- map_dfr(monthly_data_list, ~select(.x, Station, YearMonth, valid_days, data_completeness)) %>%
    group_by(YearMonth) %>%
    summarise(
      stations_available = n(),
      avg_completeness = mean(data_completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_completeness = min(data_completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_completeness = max(data_completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_valid_days = mean(valid_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_valid_days = min(valid_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    filter(stations_available >= min_stations) %>%
    arrange(desc(stations_available), desc(avg_completeness)) %>%
    mutate(
      month_label = format(YearMonth, "%Y-%m"),
      quality_score = stations_available * avg_completeness
    )
  
  cat("📊 Best months for interpolation (minimum", min_stations, "stations):\n")
  cat("   Top 10 months by quality score:\n")
  
  top_months <- head(all_months, 10)
  for(i in 1:nrow(top_months)) {
    cat(paste("   ", i, ".", top_months$month_label[i], 
              "- Stations:", top_months$stations_available[i],
              "- Avg completeness:", round(top_months$avg_completeness[i]*100, 1), "%",
              "- Quality score:", round(top_months$quality_score[i], 1), "\n"))
  }
  
  return(all_months)
}

# Function to create seasonal analysis
create_seasonal_monthly_analysis <- function(monthly_data_list, station_coords, 
                                           target_year = 2020, region = "morocco",
                                           resolution = 0.15, power = 2) {
  cat("🌍 Creating seasonal monthly IDW analysis for", target_year, "...\n")
  
  # Define seasons
  seasons <- list(
    Winter = c("12", "01", "02"),
    Spring = c("03", "04", "05"),
    Summer = c("06", "07", "08"),
    Autumn = c("09", "10", "11")
  )
  
  seasonal_results <- list()
  
  for(season_name in names(seasons)) {
    cat(paste("\n🌦️ Processing", season_name, "season...\n"))
    
    # Find the best month from this season in the target year
    season_months <- seasons[[season_name]]
    target_months <- paste0(target_year, "-", sprintf("%02d", as.numeric(season_months)))
    
    # Find which months have data
    available_months <- c()
    for(month in target_months) {
      # Check if any station has data for this month
      month_data_count <- sum(map_int(monthly_data_list, function(station_data) {
        month_ym <- as.Date(paste0(month, "-01"))
        month_ym <- floor_date(month_ym, "month")
        sum(station_data$YearMonth == month_ym, na.rm = TRUE)
      }))
      if(month_data_count >= 3) {  # Need at least 3 stations
        available_months <- c(available_months, month)
      }
    }
    
    if(length(available_months) == 0) {
      cat(paste("   ⚠️ No data available for", season_name, "in", target_year, "\n"))
      next
    }
    
    # Use the first available month (could be enhanced to pick the best one)
    selected_month <- available_months[1]
    cat(paste("   📅 Using", selected_month, "for", season_name, "\n"))
    
    tryCatch({
      # Perform IDW for this season
      season_result <- perform_monthly_idw_analysis(
        monthly_data_list = monthly_data_list,
        target_year_month = selected_month,
        station_coords = station_coords,
        resolution = resolution,
        region = region,
        power = power
      )
      
      seasonal_results[[season_name]] <- season_result
      cat(paste("   ✅", season_name, "completed successfully\n"))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(paste("   ❌", season_name, "failed:", e$message, "\n"))
    })
  }
  
  return(seasonal_results)
}

# Function to create multi-month comparison
create_multi_month_comparison <- function(monthly_data_list, station_coords,
                                        target_months, region = "morocco",
                                        resolution = 0.15, power = 2) {
  cat("📊 Creating multi-month IDW comparison...\n")
  cat("   Target months:", paste(target_months, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  comparison_results <- list()
  
  for(month in target_months) {
    cat(paste("\n📅 Processing", month, "...\n"))
    
    tryCatch({
      # Perform IDW for this month
      month_result <- perform_monthly_idw_analysis(
        monthly_data_list = monthly_data_list,
        target_year_month = month,
        station_coords = station_coords,
        resolution = resolution,
        region = region,
        power = power
      )
      
      comparison_results[[month]] <- month_result
      cat(paste("   ✅", month, "completed successfully\n"))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(paste("   ❌", month, "failed:", e$message, "\n"))
    })
  }
  
  # Create combined comparison plot if we have multiple successful results
  if(length(comparison_results) > 1) {
    cat("🎨 Creating comparison visualization...\n")
    
    # Extract summary statistics for comparison
    comparison_stats <- map_dfr(comparison_results, function(result) {
      stats <- result$summary_stats
      data.frame(
        Month = stats$target_year_month,
        Stations = stats$n_stations,
        Mean_Rainfall = stats$mean_precipitation,
        Max_Rainfall = stats$max_precipitation,
        Min_Rainfall = stats$min_precipitation,
        Completeness = stats$avg_data_completeness,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    })
    
    # Create comparison plots
    p1 <- ggplot(comparison_stats, aes(x = Month, y = Mean_Rainfall)) +
      geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_text(aes(label = round(Mean_Rainfall, 1)), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
      labs(title = "Mean Monthly Rainfall Comparison",
           subtitle = "IDW interpolated values across different months",
           x = "Month", y = "Mean Interpolated Rainfall (mm)") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    
    p2 <- ggplot(comparison_stats, aes(x = Month, y = Stations, fill = Completeness)) +
      geom_col(alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_text(aes(label = Stations), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Avg Data\nCompleteness", labels = scales::percent) +
      labs(title = "Station Availability and Data Quality",
           subtitle = "Number of stations with data and average completeness",
           x = "Month", y = "Number of Stations") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    
    comparison_plot <- gridExtra::grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2)
    
    comparison_results$comparison_plot <- comparison_plot
    comparison_results$comparison_stats <- comparison_stats
  }
  
  return(comparison_results)
}
```
