```{r}
# Set your parameters
target_year_month <- "2021-08"   # Change this to any year-month in your dataset (2000-2025)
region <- "morocco"              # Options: "morocco", "france", "spain", "algeria", "mediterranean", "custom"

# Run monthly IDW analysis with your real data

cat("=====================================================\n")

# First, let's load and check what months are available
monthly_result <- load_and_aggregate_monthly_data()
monthly_data_list <- monthly_result$monthly_data

# Get best months for interpolation
best_months <- get_best_months_for_interpolation(monthly_data_list, min_stations = 3)

# Run IDW analysis for the target month
idw_result <- perform_monthly_idw_analysis(
  monthly_data_list = monthly_data_list,
  target_year_month = target_year_month,
  region = region,
  resolution = 0.1,        # Degrees (smaller = higher resolution, but slower)
  power = 10,               # IDW power parameter 
  nmax = Inf,              # Use all available stations
  nmin = 3                 # Minimum stations for interpolation
)

# Display results
if(!is.null(idw_result)) {
  cat("\n📊 MONTHLY IDW INTERPOLATION SUMMARY\n")
  cat("====================================\n")
  cat("Target month:", idw_result$summary_stats$target_year_month, "\n")
  cat("Region:", idw_result$summary_stats$region, "\n")
  cat("Total stations used:", idw_result$summary_stats$n_stations, "\n")
  cat("Original data stations:", idw_result$summary_stats$n_original_stations, "\n")
  cat("CHIRPS data stations:", idw_result$summary_stats$n_chirps_stations, "\n")
  cat("Average data completeness:", round(idw_result$summary_stats$avg_data_completeness*100, 1), "%\n")
  cat("Power parameter:", idw_result$summary_stats$power_parameter, "\n")
  cat("Interpolated monthly rainfall range:", 
      round(idw_result$summary_stats$min_precipitation, 1), "-", 
      round(idw_result$summary_stats$max_precipitation, 1), "mm\n")
  cat("Mean interpolated monthly rainfall:", round(idw_result$summary_stats$mean_precipitation, 1), "mm\n\n")
  
  # Display the maps
  cat("🗺️ Displaying monthly IDW interpolation map...\n")
  print(idw_result$interpolation_map)
  
  cat("\n📏 Displaying monthly distance analysis...\n")  
  print(idw_result$distance_analysis)
  
  # Save results
  save_monthly_idw_results(idw_result)
  
  cat("\n✅ Monthly IDW analysis completed and saved!\n")
  cat("Check the 'monthly_idw_interpolation_results' folder for output files.\n")
  cat("Files include: interpolation map, distance analysis, monthly spatial data, and coordinates.\n")
}
```

## VII.5. Monthly Spatial Interpolation using Real GPS Station Coordinates

```{r}
# Monthly Spatial Interpolation using Real GPS Station Coordinates

# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(gstat)        # For IDW
library(sp)           # Spatial data handling
library(sf)           # Modern spatial data
library(terra)        # Replaces deprecated raster package
library(viridis)      # Color palettes
library(gridExtra)    # Multiple plots
library(lubridate)    # Date handling
library(RColorBrewer) # Additional color palettes
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# Install and load required packages
install_and_load <- function(packages) {
  new_packages <- packages[!(packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
  if(length(new_packages)) {
    cat("Installing packages:", paste(new_packages, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    install.packages(new_packages, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
  sapply(packages, function(x) {
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(x, character.only = TRUE))
  })
}

required_packages <- c("gstat", "sp", "sf", "terra", "viridis", "gridExtra")
install_and_load(required_packages)

# Function to load GPS station coordinates from shapefile
load_gps_station_coordinates <- function(shapefile_path = "Pts_GPS_Station_English.shp") {
  cat("📍 Loading GPS station coordinates from shapefile...\n")
  
  if(!file.exists(shapefile_path)) {
    stop(paste("Shapefile not found:", shapefile_path, 
               "\nPlease make sure the shapefile and associated files (.shx, .dbf, .prj) are in the working directory."))
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    # Load the shapefile
    gps_stations <- st_read(shapefile_path, quiet = TRUE)
    
    # Check the structure
    cat("   📊 Shapefile loaded successfully\n")
    cat("   📋 Number of GPS stations:", nrow(gps_stations), "\n")
    cat("   📋 Columns available:", paste(colnames(gps_stations), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    
    # Check if required columns exist
    if(!"Sites" %in% colnames(gps_stations)) {
      stop("Column 'Sites' not found in shapefile. Available columns: ", paste(colnames(gps_stations), collapse = ", "))
    }
    
    # Get coordinates - handle different CRS
    coords <- st_coordinates(gps_stations)
    
    # Create coordinates dataframe
    coordinates_df <- data.frame(
      Station = as.character(gps_stations$Sites),  # Use Sites column as station names
      Longitude = coords[,1],
      Latitude = coords[,2],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    # Add additional information if available
    if("Station_ty" %in% colnames(gps_stations)) {
      coordinates_df$Station_Type <- as.character(gps_stations$Station_ty)
    }
    
    # Add elevation if available
    if("Elevation" %in% colnames(gps_stations)) {
      coordinates_df$Elevation_m <- as.numeric(gps_stations$Elevation)
    } else if("ELEV" %in% colnames(gps_stations)) {
      coordinates_df$Elevation_m <- as.numeric(gps_stations$ELEV)
    } else {
      coordinates_df$Elevation_m <- NA
    }
    
    # Remove any rows with missing coordinates or station names
    initial_count <- nrow(coordinates_df)
    coordinates_df <- coordinates_df %>%
      filter(!is.na(Station) & Station != "" & 
             !is.na(Longitude) & !is.na(Latitude) &
             is.finite(Longitude) & is.finite(Latitude))
    
    if(nrow(coordinates_df) < initial_count) {
      cat("   ⚠️ Removed", initial_count - nrow(coordinates_df), "rows with missing/invalid data\n")
    }
    
    # Check coordinate system and convert to WGS84 if needed
    crs_info <- st_crs(gps_stations)
    cat("   🗺️ Original CRS:", crs_info$input, "\n")
    
    if(!is.na(crs_info) && crs_info$epsg != 4326) {
      cat("   🔄 Converting coordinates to WGS84 (EPSG:4326)...\n")
      gps_stations_wgs84 <- st_transform(gps_stations, crs = 4326)
      coords_wgs84 <- st_coordinates(gps_stations_wgs84)
      coordinates_df$Longitude <- coords_wgs84[,1]
      coordinates_df$Latitude <- coords_wgs84[,2]
    }
    
    # Summary information
    cat("   📍 Coordinate ranges:\n")
    cat("      Longitude:", round(min(coordinates_df$Longitude, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "to", 
        round(max(coordinates_df$Longitude, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "°\n")
    cat("      Latitude:", round(min(coordinates_df$Latitude, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "to", 
        round(max(coordinates_df$Latitude, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "°\n")
    
    # Show unique station types if available
    if("Station_Type" %in% colnames(coordinates_df)) {
      station_types <- table(coordinates_df$Station_Type, useNA = "ifany")
      cat("   📋 Station types:\n")
      for(i in 1:length(station_types)) {
        cat("      ", names(station_types)[i], ":", station_types[i], "\n")
      }
    }
    
    # Show sample of station names
    cat("   📝 Sample station names (first 10):\n")
    sample_names <- head(coordinates_df$Station, 10)
    cat("      ", paste(sample_names, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    
    cat("   ✅ GPS coordinates loaded successfully!\n")
    
    return(coordinates_df)
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop(paste("Error loading GPS shapefile:", e$message))
  })
}

# Function to load and aggregate monthly rainfall data (same as before)
load_and_aggregate_monthly_data <- function(datasets_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets") {
  cat("📥 Loading and aggregating your real combined rainfall datasets to monthly...\n")
  
  if(!dir.exists(datasets_dir)) {
    stop(paste("Directory not found:", datasets_dir, 
               "\nPlease make sure you have run the enhanced time series script first."))
  }
  
  # Get all CSV files in the directory
  csv_files <- list.files(datasets_dir, pattern = "^combined_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  if(length(csv_files) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No combined CSV files found in:", datasets_dir))
  }
  
  monthly_data_list <- list()
  
  for(file in csv_files) {
    # Extract station name from filename
    filename <- basename(file)
    # Remove "combined_" prefix and "_2000_2025.csv" suffix
    station_name <- gsub("^combined_", "", filename)
    station_name <- gsub("_2000_2025\\.csv$", "", station_name)
    
    # Load the data
    tryCatch({
      daily_data <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
        mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))
      
      # Aggregate to monthly data
      monthly_data <- daily_data %>%
        mutate(
          Year = year(Date),
          Month = month(Date),
          YearMonth = floor_date(Date, "month")
        ) %>%
        group_by(Station = station_name, Year, Month, YearMonth) %>%
        summarise(
          # Monthly totals for rainfall
          monthly_rainfall = sum(combined_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
          monthly_original = sum(original_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
          monthly_chirps = sum(chirps_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
          
          # Count of valid days
          valid_days = sum(!is.na(combined_rainfall)),
          total_days = n(),
          data_completeness = valid_days / total_days,
          
          # Dominant data source for the month
          dominant_source = names(sort(table(data_source), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
          
          # First and last date of month
          month_start = min(Date, na.rm = TRUE),
          month_end = max(Date, na.rm = TRUE),
          
          .groups = 'drop'
        ) %>%
        # Only keep months with reasonable data completeness (at least 50% of days)
        filter(data_completeness >= 0.5 & valid_days >= 10) %>%
        # Convert 0 totals to NA if no valid data
        mutate(
          monthly_rainfall = ifelse(valid_days == 0, NA, monthly_rainfall),
          monthly_original = ifelse(monthly_original == 0 & valid_days > 0, NA, monthly_original),
          monthly_chirps = ifelse(monthly_chirps == 0 & valid_days > 0, NA, monthly_chirps)
        )
      
      monthly_data_list[[station_name]] <- monthly_data
      cat(paste("   ✅ Loaded and aggregated", station_name, ":", 
                nrow(daily_data), "daily →", nrow(monthly_data), "monthly records\n"))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(paste("   ❌ Failed to process", filename, ":", e$message, "\n"))
    })
  }
  
  if(length(monthly_data_list) == 0) {
    stop("No datasets were successfully processed")
  }
  
  cat("✅ Successfully processed", length(monthly_data_list), "station datasets to monthly\n")
  
  # Create summary of available months across all stations
  all_months <- map_dfr(monthly_data_list, ~select(.x, Station, YearMonth, valid_days, data_completeness)) %>%
    group_by(YearMonth) %>%
    summarise(
      stations_available = n(),
      avg_completeness = mean(data_completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_valid_days = min(valid_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(stations_available), desc(avg_completeness))
  
  cat("\n📊 Monthly data availability summary (top 10 months):\n")
  print(head(all_months, 10))
  
  return(list(
    monthly_data = monthly_data_list,
    availability_summary = all_months
  ))
}

# Function to match rainfall stations with GPS coordinates
match_rainfall_with_gps <- function(monthly_data_list, gps_coordinates, 
                                   similarity_threshold = 0.8, manual_matches = NULL) {
  cat("🔗 Matching rainfall station names with GPS station sites...\n")
  
  # Get rainfall station names
  rainfall_stations <- names(monthly_data_list)
  gps_sites <- gps_coordinates$Station
  
  cat("   📊 Rainfall stations:", length(rainfall_stations), "\n")
  cat("   📍 GPS stations:", length(gps_sites), "\n")
  
  # Initialize matching results
  matched_pairs <- data.frame(
    Rainfall_Station = character(),
    GPS_Station = character(),
    Match_Type = character(),
    Match_Score = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # 1. Exact matches (case-insensitive)
  cat("\n   🎯 Looking for exact matches...\n")
  exact_matches <- 0
  for(rainfall_station in rainfall_stations) {
    exact_match <- gps_sites[tolower(gps_sites) == tolower(rainfall_station)]
    if(length(exact_match) > 0) {
      matched_pairs <- rbind(matched_pairs, data.frame(
        Rainfall_Station = rainfall_station,
        GPS_Station = exact_match[1],
        Match_Type = "Exact",
        Match_Score = 1.0
      ))
      exact_matches <- exact_matches + 1
      cat(paste("      ✅", rainfall_station, "→", exact_match[1], "\n"))
    }
  }
  cat(paste("      Found", exact_matches, "exact matches\n"))
  
  # 2. Apply manual matches if provided
  if(!is.null(manual_matches)) {
    cat("\n   👥 Applying manual matches...\n")
    manual_count <- 0
    for(i in 1:nrow(manual_matches)) {
      rainfall_name <- manual_matches$rainfall_station[i]
      gps_name <- manual_matches$gps_station[i]
      
      # Check if both stations exist and aren't already matched
      if(rainfall_name %in% rainfall_stations && gps_name %in% gps_sites &&
         !rainfall_name %in% matched_pairs$Rainfall_Station) {
        matched_pairs <- rbind(matched_pairs, data.frame(
          Rainfall_Station = rainfall_name,
          GPS_Station = gps_name,
          Match_Type = "Manual",
          Match_Score = 1.0
        ))
        manual_count <- manual_count + 1
        cat(paste("      👤", rainfall_name, "→", gps_name, "\n"))
      }
    }
    cat(paste("      Applied", manual_count, "manual matches\n"))
  }
  
  # 3. Fuzzy matching for remaining stations
  library(stringdist)  # For string similarity
  cat(paste("\n   🔍 Looking for fuzzy matches (threshold:", similarity_threshold, ")...\n"))
  
  unmatched_rainfall <- rainfall_stations[!rainfall_stations %in% matched_pairs$Rainfall_Station]
  matched_gps <- matched_pairs$GPS_Station
  unmatched_gps <- gps_sites[!gps_sites %in% matched_gps]
  
  fuzzy_matches <- 0
  for(rainfall_station in unmatched_rainfall) {
    # Calculate string similarities
    similarities <- 1 - stringdist(tolower(rainfall_station), tolower(unmatched_gps), method = "jw")
    best_match_idx <- which.max(similarities)
    best_similarity <- similarities[best_match_idx]
    
    if(best_similarity >= similarity_threshold) {
      best_gps_station <- unmatched_gps[best_match_idx]
      matched_pairs <- rbind(matched_pairs, data.frame(
        Rainfall_Station = rainfall_station,
        GPS_Station = best_gps_station,
        Match_Type = "Fuzzy",
        Match_Score = round(best_similarity, 3)
      ))
      # Remove from unmatched
      unmatched_gps <- unmatched_gps[-best_match_idx]
      fuzzy_matches <- fuzzy_matches + 1
      cat(paste("      🔍", rainfall_station, "→", best_gps_station, 
                "(score:", round(best_similarity, 3), ")\n"))
    }
  }
  cat(paste("      Found", fuzzy_matches, "fuzzy matches\n"))
  
  # 4. Summary of matching results
  total_matches <- nrow(matched_pairs)
  unmatched_rainfall_final <- rainfall_stations[!rainfall_stations %in% matched_pairs$Rainfall_Station]
  unmatched_gps_final <- gps_sites[!gps_sites %in% matched_pairs$GPS_Station]
  
  cat("\n   📊 MATCHING SUMMARY:\n")
  cat(paste("      ✅ Successfully matched:", total_matches, "out of", length(rainfall_stations), "rainfall stations\n"))
  cat(paste("      📈 Matching rate:", round(total_matches/length(rainfall_stations)*100, 1), "%\n"))
  cat(paste("      🎯 Exact matches:", sum(matched_pairs$Match_Type == "Exact"), "\n"))
  if(!is.null(manual_matches)) {
    cat(paste("      👥 Manual matches:", sum(matched_pairs$Match_Type == "Manual"), "\n"))
  }
  cat(paste("      🔍 Fuzzy matches:", sum(matched_pairs$Match_Type == "Fuzzy"), "\n"))
  
  # Show unmatched stations
  if(length(unmatched_rainfall_final) > 0) {
    cat("\n   ⚠️ UNMATCHED RAINFALL STATIONS:\n")
    cat("      ", paste(unmatched_rainfall_final, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  
  if(length(unmatched_gps_final) > 0) {
    cat("\n   📍 UNMATCHED GPS STATIONS:\n")
    cat("      ", paste(head(unmatched_gps_final, 10), collapse = ", "))
    if(length(unmatched_gps_final) > 10) cat(", ...")
    cat("\n")
  }
  
  # Create final coordinates dataframe with only matched stations
  if(total_matches > 0) {
    final_coordinates <- matched_pairs %>%
      left_join(gps_coordinates, by = c("GPS_Station" = "Station")) %>%
      select(Station = Rainfall_Station, Longitude, Latitude, 
             GPS_Station, Match_Type, Match_Score, everything()) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Longitude) & !is.na(Latitude))
    
    cat(paste("\n   ✅ Final dataset:", nrow(final_coordinates), "stations with coordinates\n"))
    return(list(
      coordinates = final_coordinates,
      matching_summary = matched_pairs,
      unmatched_rainfall = unmatched_rainfall_final,
      unmatched_gps = unmatched_gps_final
    ))
  } else {
    stop("No stations could be matched between rainfall data and GPS coordinates")
  }
}

# Function to prepare monthly spatial data with GPS coordinates
prepare_monthly_spatial_data_with_gps <- function(monthly_data_list, matched_coordinates, target_year_month) {
  target_date <- as.Date(paste0(target_year_month, "-01"))
  target_ym <- floor_date(target_date, "month")
  
  cat(paste("📊 Preparing monthly spatial data with GPS coordinates for", format(target_ym, "%Y-%m"), "...\n"))
  
  # Only use stations that have coordinates
  available_stations <- matched_coordinates$coordinates$Station
  
  # Extract data for the target month from matched stations
  spatial_data <- map_dfr(available_stations, function(station_name) {
    station_data <- monthly_data_list[[station_name]]
    
    if(is.null(station_data) || nrow(station_data) == 0) {
      return(data.frame(Station = station_name, Monthly_Precipitation = NA, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
    
    # Find target month data
    target_row <- station_data %>% 
      filter(YearMonth == target_ym) %>%
      slice(1)
    
    if(nrow(target_row) > 0 && !is.na(target_row$monthly_rainfall)) {
      data.frame(
        Station = station_name,
        Monthly_Precipitation = as.numeric(target_row$monthly_rainfall),
        Monthly_Original = as.numeric(target_row$monthly_original %||% NA),
        Monthly_CHIRPS = as.numeric(target_row$monthly_chirps %||% NA),
        Data_Source = as.character(target_row$dominant_source %||% "Unknown"),
        Valid_Days = as.numeric(target_row$valid_days),
        Data_Completeness = as.numeric(target_row$data_completeness),
        Year = as.numeric(target_row$Year),
        Month = as.numeric(target_row$Month),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      data.frame(
        Station = station_name,
        Monthly_Precipitation = NA,
        Monthly_Original = NA,
        Monthly_CHIRPS = NA,
        Data_Source = "Missing",
        Valid_Days = 0,
        Data_Completeness = 0,
        Year = year(target_ym),
        Month = month(target_ym),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  })
  
  # Join with GPS coordinates
  spatial_data <- spatial_data %>%
    left_join(matched_coordinates$coordinates %>% select(Station, Longitude, Latitude, GPS_Station, Match_Type, Match_Score), 
              by = "Station") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Monthly_Precipitation) & !is.na(Longitude) & !is.na(Latitude) & 
           is.finite(Monthly_Precipitation) & is.finite(Longitude) & is.finite(Latitude) &
           Monthly_Precipitation >= 0)  # Remove negative rainfall values
  
  cat(paste("   📍 Stations with valid monthly data and GPS coordinates:", nrow(spatial_data), 
            "out of", length(monthly_data_list), "total rainfall stations\n"))
  
  if(nrow(spatial_data) < 3) {
    # Show available months
    available_months <- map(monthly_data_list, ~unique(.x$YearMonth)) %>% 
      unlist() %>% unique() %>% sort()
    
    cat("❌ Insufficient data points for IDW interpolation\n")
    cat("Available months in your dataset:\n")
    cat(paste(format(head(available_months, 10), "%Y-%m"), collapse = ", "))
    if(length(available_months) > 10) cat(", ...")
    cat("\n")
    
    stop(paste("Found only", nrow(spatial_data), "valid data points for", format(target_ym, "%Y-%m"), 
               ". Need at least 3 stations with data."))
  }
  
  # Summary of data sources and matching types
  source_summary <- spatial_data %>% 
    group_by(Data_Source) %>%
    summarise(
      n_stations = n(),
      avg_completeness = mean(Data_Completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_valid_days = mean(Valid_Days, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_stations))
  
  match_summary <- spatial_data %>%
    group_by(Match_Type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_stations = n(),
      avg_match_score = mean(Match_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_stations))
  
  cat("   📊 Monthly data sources summary:\n")
  for(i in 1:nrow(source_summary)) {
    cat(paste("      ", source_summary$Data_Source[i], ":", source_summary$n_stations[i], 
              "stations (", round(source_summary$avg_completeness[i]*100, 1), "% complete,",
              round(source_summary$avg_valid_days[i], 1), "valid days avg)\n"))
  }
  
  cat("   🔗 Station matching summary:\n")
  for(i in 1:nrow(match_summary)) {
    cat(paste("      ", match_summary$Match_Type[i], "matches:", match_summary$n_stations[i], 
              "stations (avg score:", round(match_summary$avg_match_score[i], 3), ")\n"))
  }
  
  # Rainfall statistics
  cat("   🌧️ Monthly rainfall statistics:\n")
  cat(paste("      Range:", round(min(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "-", 
            round(max(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "mm\n"))
  cat(paste("      Mean:", round(mean(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "mm\n"))
  cat(paste("      Median:", round(median(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "mm\n"))
  
  return(spatial_data)
}

# Function to create spatial points for IDW
create_spatial_points <- function(spatial_data) {
  sp_data <- spatial_data
  coordinates(sp_data) <- ~Longitude + Latitude
  proj4string(sp_data) <- CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs")
  return(sp_data)
}

# CORRECTED Function to create prediction grid with dynamic buffer based on GPS station extent
create_prediction_grid <- function(spatial_data, resolution = 0.01, buffer_percent = 0.05) {
  # Calculate bounds from your actual station locations
  lon_min <- min(spatial_data$Longitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  lon_max <- max(spatial_data$Longitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  lat_min <- min(spatial_data$Latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  lat_max <- max(spatial_data$Latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Calculate ranges
  lon_range <- lon_max - lon_min
  lat_range <- lat_max - lat_min
  
  # Calculate dynamic buffer based on the extent (default 5% of range on each side)
  buffer_lon <- lon_range * buffer_percent
  buffer_lat <- lat_range * buffer_percent
  
  # Apply buffer
  xmin <- lon_min - buffer_lon
  xmax <- lon_max + buffer_lon
  ymin <- lat_min - buffer_lat
  ymax <- lat_max + buffer_lat
  
  cat(paste("🗺️ Creating prediction grid with dynamic buffer:\n"))
  cat(paste("   📍 Original extent - Longitude:", round(lon_min, 4), "to", round(lon_max, 4), "°E\n"))
  cat(paste("   📍 Original extent - Latitude:", round(lat_min, 4), "to", round(lat_max, 4), "°N\n"))
  cat(paste("   📏 Longitude range:", round(lon_range, 4), "° | Buffer:", round(buffer_lon, 4), "°\n"))
  cat(paste("   📏 Latitude range:", round(lat_range, 4), "° | Buffer:", round(buffer_lat, 4), "°\n"))
  cat(paste("   📍 Final extent - Longitude:", round(xmin, 4), "to", round(xmax, 4), "°E\n"))
  cat(paste("   📍 Final extent - Latitude:", round(ymin, 4), "to", round(ymax, 4), "°N\n"))
  cat(paste("   📏 Grid resolution:", resolution, "degrees\n"))
  cat(paste("   📏 Buffer percentage:", buffer_percent * 100, "%\n"))
  
  # Create sequences
  x_seq <- seq(xmin, xmax, by = resolution)
  y_seq <- seq(ymin, ymax, by = resolution)
  
  # Create grid
  grid_df <- expand.grid(Longitude = x_seq, Latitude = y_seq)
  coordinates(grid_df) <- ~Longitude + Latitude
  gridded(grid_df) <- TRUE
  proj4string(grid_df) <- CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs")
  
  cat(paste("   ✅ Grid created:", length(x_seq), "x", length(y_seq), "=", length(x_seq) * length(y_seq), "points\n"))
  
  return(grid_df)
}

# Function to perform IDW interpolation
perform_idw <- function(spatial_points, prediction_grid, power = 2, nmax = Inf, nmin = 3) {
  tryCatch({
    cat("🎯 Performing monthly IDW interpolation...\n")
    cat("   Power parameter:", power, "\n")
    cat("   Max neighbors:", ifelse(is.finite(nmax), nmax, "All"), "\n")
    cat("   Min neighbors:", nmin, "\n")
    
    # Perform IDW interpolation using Monthly_Precipitation
    idw_result <- idw(Monthly_Precipitation ~ 1, 
                      spatial_points, 
                      prediction_grid, 
                      idp = power,
                      nmax = nmax,
                      nmin = nmin)
    
    cat("✅ Monthly IDW interpolation completed successfully!\n")
    
    return(list(
      idw_result = idw_result,
      power = power,
      nmax = nmax,
      nmin = nmin
    ))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ IDW failed:", e$message, "\n")
    stop(paste("IDW interpolation failed:", e$message))
  })
}

# Enhanced function to create monthly IDW interpolation map with GPS info
create_enhanced_monthly_idw_map_with_gps <- function(idw_result, spatial_points, target_year_month, 
                                                   title_prefix = "Monthly Rainfall Interpolation with GPS Coordinates") {
  # Convert IDW result to dataframe
  idw_df <- as.data.frame(idw_result$idw_result)
  
  # Convert spatial points to dataframe
  points_df <- as.data.frame(spatial_points)
  
  # Handle prediction values
  idw_df <- idw_df %>%
    filter(is.finite(var1.pred) & !is.na(var1.pred) & var1.pred >= 0)
  
  if(nrow(idw_df) == 0) {
    stop("No valid prediction values for mapping")
  }
  
  # Create the map
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Add interpolated surface
    geom_tile(data = idw_df, 
              aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = var1.pred),
              alpha = 0.8) +
    
    # Add contour lines
    {if(nrow(idw_df) > 50) {
      geom_contour(data = idw_df, 
                  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, z = var1.pred),
                  color = "white", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4, bins = 8)
    }} +
    
    # Add station points colored by data source and shaped by match type
    geom_point(data = points_df, 
               aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, 
                   size = Monthly_Precipitation,
                   shape = Match_Type,
                   color = Data_Source,
                   alpha = Data_Completeness),
               stroke = 1.2) +
    
    # Add station labels with GPS station names
    geom_text(data = points_df,
              aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, 
                  label = paste0(Station, "\n(", GPS_Station, ")")),
              color = "white", size = 2, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -2.2,
              fontface = "bold") +
    
    # Styling
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Interpolated\nMonthly Rainfall\n(mm)", 
                        option = "plasma",
                        na.value = "transparent",
                        trans = "sqrt") +
    
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Observed\nMonthly (mm)", 
                         range = c(2, 8),
                         trans = "sqrt") +
    
    scale_alpha_continuous(name = "Data\nCompleteness", 
                          range = c(0.5, 1.0),
                          labels = scales::percent) +
    
    scale_color_manual(name = "Data Source",
                      values = c("Original" = "#2E86AB", 
                                "CHIRPS" = "#E74C3C", 
                                "Unknown" = "#34495E"),
                      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1))) +
    
    scale_shape_manual(name = "Match Type",
                      values = c("Exact" = 16, "Fuzzy" = 17, "Manual" = 15)) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste(title_prefix, "- Monthly IDW Interpolation"),
      subtitle = paste("Month:", target_year_month, "| Power =", idw_result$power, 
                      "| GPS coordinates used | Labels show: Rainfall_Station (GPS_Station)"),
      x = "Longitude (°E)",
      y = "Latitude (°N)",
      caption = "Points show monthly observed values at GPS coordinates, surface shows IDW interpolated monthly rainfall"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
      legend.box = "vertical"
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to create monthly distance analysis plot with GPS info
create_monthly_distance_analysis_with_gps <- function(spatial_points, target_year_month) {
  points_df <- as.data.frame(spatial_points)
  
  # Calculate distance matrix (in degrees, approximate)
  coords <- points_df[, c("Longitude", "Latitude")]
  dist_matrix <- as.matrix(dist(coords))
  
  # Create distance vs monthly precipitation difference analysis
  distances <- c()
  precip_diffs <- c()
  source_pairs <- c()
  match_pairs <- c()
  completeness_pairs <- c()
  
  for(i in 1:(nrow(points_df)-1)) {
    for(j in (i+1):nrow(points_df)) {
      distances <- c(distances, dist_matrix[i,j])
      precip_diffs <- c(precip_diffs, abs(points_df$Monthly_Precipitation[i] - points_df$Monthly_Precipitation[j]))
      
      # Data source pairs
      pair_sources <- paste(sort(c(points_df$Data_Source[i], points_df$Data_Source[j])), collapse = "-")
      source_pairs <- c(source_pairs, pair_sources)
      
      # Match type pairs
      pair_matches <- paste(sort(c(points_df$Match_Type[i], points_df$Match_Type[j])), collapse = "-")
      match_pairs <- c(match_pairs, pair_matches)
      
      completeness_pairs <- c(completeness_pairs, 
                            min(points_df$Data_Completeness[i], points_df$Data_Completeness[j]))
    }
  }
  
  analysis_df <- data.frame(
    Distance = distances,
    Monthly_Precipitation_Difference = precip_diffs,
    Source_Pair = source_pairs,
    Match_Pair = match_pairs,
    Min_Completeness = completeness_pairs
  )
  
  # Create scatter plot with trend line
  p <- ggplot(analysis_df, aes(x = Distance, y = Monthly_Precipitation_Difference, 
                              color = Match_Pair, size = Min_Completeness)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "#34495E", fill = "#34495E", alpha = 0.2) +
    scale_color_brewer(name = "Station Pair\nMatch Types", type = "qual", palette = "Set2") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Min Data\nCompleteness", 
                         range = c(1, 4),
                         labels = scales::percent) +
    labs(
      title = "Distance vs Monthly Rainfall Difference Analysis (GPS Coordinates)",
      subtitle = paste("Month:", target_year_month, "| Spatial autocorrelation with GPS matching info"),
      x = "Distance between GPS stations (degrees)",
      y = "Monthly rainfall difference (mm)",
      caption = "Closer GPS stations should have more similar monthly rainfall values"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "gray50"),
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Main function to perform complete monthly IDW analysis with GPS coordinates
perform_monthly_idw_analysis_with_gps <- function(monthly_data_list = NULL, target_year_month, 
                                                gps_coordinates = NULL, shapefile_path = "Pts_GPS_Station_English.shp",
                                                manual_matches = NULL, similarity_threshold = 0.8,
                                                resolution = 0.01, power = 2, nmax = Inf, nmin = 3,
                                                buffer_percent = 0.05,
                                                datasets_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets") {
  
  cat("🚀 Starting MONTHLY IDW interpolation analysis with real GPS coordinates...\n")
  cat("   Target month:", target_year_month, "\n")
  cat("   Buffer percentage:", buffer_percent * 100, "%\n")
  
  # Load and aggregate your real data to monthly if not provided
  if(is.null(monthly_data_list)) {
    monthly_result <- load_and_aggregate_monthly_data(datasets_dir)
    monthly_data_list <- monthly_result$monthly_data
  }
  
  # Load GPS coordinates if not provided
  if(is.null(gps_coordinates)) {
    cat("📍 Loading GPS coordinates from shapefile...\n")
    gps_coordinates <- load_gps_station_coordinates(shapefile_path)
  }
  
  # Match rainfall stations with GPS coordinates
  matched_coordinates <- match_rainfall_with_gps(monthly_data_list, gps_coordinates, 
                                               similarity_threshold, manual_matches)
  
  cat("   Number of matched stations:", nrow(matched_coordinates$coordinates), "\n")
  
  # Prepare monthly spatial data with GPS coordinates
  spatial_data <- prepare_monthly_spatial_data_with_gps(monthly_data_list, matched_coordinates, target_year_month)
  
  cat("   Stations with valid monthly data and coordinates:", nrow(spatial_data), "\n")
  cat("   Monthly rainfall range:", 
      round(min(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "-", 
      round(max(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "mm\n")
  
  # Create spatial points
  spatial_points <- create_spatial_points(spatial_data)
  
  # Create prediction grid based on GPS coordinates extent with dynamic buffer
  cat("🗺️ Creating prediction grid based on GPS station locations with dynamic buffer...\n")
  prediction_grid <- create_prediction_grid(spatial_data, resolution, buffer_percent)
  
  # Perform IDW
  idw_results <- perform_idw(spatial_points, prediction_grid, power, nmax, nmin)
  
  # Create enhanced maps with GPS information
  cat("🎨 Creating enhanced monthly visualization maps with GPS info...\n")
  interpolation_map <- create_enhanced_monthly_idw_map_with_gps(idw_results, spatial_points, target_year_month, 
                                                              "Real Monthly Rainfall Data with GPS Coordinates")
  
  # Create distance analysis
  distance_analysis <- create_monthly_distance_analysis_with_gps(spatial_points, target_year_month)
  
  # Summary statistics with GPS matching info
  idw_df <- as.data.frame(idw_results$idw_result)
  summary_stats <- list(
    target_year_month = target_year_month,
    n_stations = nrow(spatial_data),
    n_matched_stations = nrow(matched_coordinates$coordinates),
    n_original_stations = sum(spatial_data$Data_Source == "Original", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_chirps_stations = sum(spatial_data$Data_Source == "CHIRPS", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_exact_matches = sum(spatial_data$Match_Type == "Exact", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_fuzzy_matches = sum(spatial_data$Match_Type == "Fuzzy", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_manual_matches = sum(spatial_data$Match_Type == "Manual", na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_data_completeness = mean(spatial_data$Data_Completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_match_score = mean(spatial_data$Match_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_precipitation = min(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_precipitation = max(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_precipitation = mean(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    power_parameter = power,
    max_neighbors = nmax,
    min_neighbors = nmin,
    shapefile_used = shapefile_path,
    similarity_threshold = similarity_threshold,
    buffer_percent = buffer_percent,
    grid_resolution = resolution
  )
  
  cat("✅ Monthly IDW analysis with GPS coordinates completed successfully!\n")
  
  return(list(
    interpolation_map = interpolation_map,
    distance_analysis = distance_analysis,
    idw_results = idw_results,
    spatial_data = spatial_data,
    matched_coordinates = matched_coordinates,
    summary_stats = summary_stats,
    monthly_data_list = monthly_data_list
  ))
}

# Function to save GPS-based IDW results
save_monthly_idw_results_with_gps <- function(idw_result, output_dir = "monthly_idw_interpolation_results_gps") {
  if(is.null(idw_result)) {
    cat("❌ No results to save\n")
    return()
  }
  
  if(!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    cat("📁 Created output directory:", output_dir, "\n")
  }
  
  target_month_str <- gsub("-", "_", idw_result$summary_stats$target_year_month)
  
  tryCatch({
    # Save maps
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_idw_interpolation_gps_", target_month_str, ".png")),
           idw_result$interpolation_map, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_distance_analysis_gps_", target_month_str, ".png")),
           idw_result$distance_analysis, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    # Save monthly spatial data with GPS matching information
    write.csv(idw_result$spatial_data, 
              file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_spatial_data_gps_", target_month_str, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save GPS coordinates and matching information
    write.csv(idw_result$matched_coordinates$coordinates,
              file.path(output_dir, "gps_station_coordinates_matched.csv"),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save matching summary
    write.csv(idw_result$matched_coordinates$matching_summary,
              file.path(output_dir, "station_matching_summary.csv"),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save unmatched stations info
    if(length(idw_result$matched_coordinates$unmatched_rainfall) > 0) {
      write.csv(data.frame(Unmatched_Rainfall_Stations = idw_result$matched_coordinates$unmatched_rainfall),
                file.path(output_dir, "unmatched_rainfall_stations.csv"),
                row.names = FALSE)
    }
    
    if(length(idw_result$matched_coordinates$unmatched_gps) > 0) {
      write.csv(data.frame(Unmatched_GPS_Stations = idw_result$matched_coordinates$unmatched_gps),
                file.path(output_dir, "unmatched_gps_stations.csv"),
                row.names = FALSE)
    }
    
    # Save IDW results as raster
    idw_raster <- rast(idw_result$idw_results$idw_result)
    writeRaster(idw_raster, 
                file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_idw_raster_gps_", target_month_str, ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
    
    # Save GPS-based summary statistics
    summary_df <- data.frame(
      Parameter = names(idw_result$summary_stats),
      Value = as.character(idw_result$summary_stats),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    write.csv(summary_df,
              file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_idw_summary_gps_", target_month_str, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save aggregated monthly data for all stations
    if(!is.null(idw_result$monthly_data_list)) {
      all_monthly_data <- map_dfr(idw_result$monthly_data_list, ~.x)
      write.csv(all_monthly_data,
                file.path(output_dir, "all_stations_monthly_data.csv"),
                row.names = FALSE)
    }
    
    cat("💾 Monthly IDW results with GPS coordinates saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ Error saving results:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

# Function to create manual matching template
create_manual_matching_template <- function(monthly_data_list, gps_coordinates, 
                                          output_file = "manual_station_matching_template.csv") {
  cat("📝 Creating manual matching template...\n")
  
  rainfall_stations <- names(monthly_data_list)
  gps_sites <- gps_coordinates$Station
  
  # Create template with all rainfall stations
  template <- data.frame(
    rainfall_station = rainfall_stations,
    gps_station = "",  # To be filled manually
    notes = "",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Add available GPS stations as reference
  gps_reference <- data.frame(
    rainfall_station = paste("# Available GPS stations:", paste(head(gps_sites, 50), collapse = ", ")),
    gps_station = ifelse(length(gps_sites) > 50, paste("... and", length(gps_sites) - 50, "more"), ""),
    notes = "Reference only - delete these rows",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  final_template <- rbind(gps_reference, 
                         data.frame(rainfall_station = "# Instructions:", 
                                   gps_station = "Fill gps_station column with matching GPS station names", 
                                   notes = "Leave empty if no match exists", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
                         template)
  
  write.csv(final_template, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("   📄 Template saved to:", output_file, "\n")
  cat("   📝 Edit this file to manually specify station matches\n")
  cat("   📝 Then read it back with: manual_matches <- read.csv('", output_file, "')\n")
  
  return(final_template)
}

} else {
```

```{r}
# Monthly Spatial Interpolation for ALL AVAILABLE MONTHS

# Load required libraries (same as before)
library(tidyverse)
library(gstat)        # For IDW
library(sp)           # Spatial data handling
library(sf)           # Modern spatial data
library(terra)        # Replaces deprecated raster package
library(viridis)      # Color palettes
library(gridExtra)    # Multiple plots

# Install and load required packages
install_and_load <- function(packages) {
  new_packages <- packages[!(packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
  if(length(new_packages)) {
    cat("Installing packages:", paste(new_packages, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    install.packages(new_packages, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
  sapply(packages, function(x) {
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(x, character.only = TRUE))
  })
}

required_packages <- c("gstat", "sp", "sf", "terra", "viridis", "gridExtra", "stringdist")
install_and_load(required_packages)

# All previous functions remain the same - just copying them here for completeness
  # Or include all previous functions

# NEW FUNCTION: Get all available months from the dataset
get_available_months <- function(monthly_data_list, min_stations = 3, min_completeness = 0.5) {
  cat("🗓️ Analyzing available months across all stations...\n")
  
  # Extract all month-year combinations from all stations
  all_months <- map_dfr(monthly_data_list, function(station_data) {
    station_data %>%
      select(YearMonth, valid_days, data_completeness) %>%
      mutate(Station = station_data$Station[1])
  })
  
  # Summarize by month-year
  month_summary <- all_months %>%
    group_by(YearMonth) %>%
    summarise(
      n_stations = n(),
      avg_completeness = mean(data_completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_completeness = min(data_completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_completeness = max(data_completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_valid_days = mean(valid_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    # Filter months with sufficient data
    filter(n_stations >= min_stations, 
           avg_completeness >= min_completeness) %>%
    arrange(YearMonth)
  
  cat(paste("   📊 Total unique months in dataset:", nrow(all_months %>% distinct(YearMonth)), "\n"))
  cat(paste("   ✅ Months meeting criteria (≥", min_stations, "stations, ≥", 
            round(min_completeness*100, 1), "% completeness):", nrow(month_summary), "\n"))
  
  if(nrow(month_summary) > 0) {
    cat("   📅 Date range:", format(min(month_summary$YearMonth), "%Y-%m"), "to", 
        format(max(month_summary$YearMonth), "%Y-%m"), "\n")
    
    # Show distribution by year
    year_dist <- month_summary %>%
      mutate(Year = year(YearMonth)) %>%
      count(Year) %>%
      arrange(Year)
    
    cat("   📈 Distribution by year:\n")
    for(i in 1:min(10, nrow(year_dist))) {
      cat(paste("      ", year_dist$Year[i], ":", year_dist$n[i], "months\n"))
    }
    if(nrow(year_dist) > 10) cat("      ... and", nrow(year_dist) - 10, "more years\n")
    
    # Show months with most stations
    cat("   🏆 Top months by station count:\n")
    top_months <- month_summary %>% 
      arrange(desc(n_stations), desc(avg_completeness)) %>%
      head(5)
    
    for(i in 1:nrow(top_months)) {
      cat(paste("      ", format(top_months$YearMonth[i], "%Y-%m"), ":", 
                top_months$n_stations[i], "stations (", 
                round(top_months$avg_completeness[i]*100, 1), "% avg completeness)\n"))
    }
  }
  
  return(month_summary)
}

# NEW FUNCTION: Enhanced multi-year IDW analysis
perform_multi_year_monthly_idw_analysis <- function(
  monthly_data_list = NULL,
  gps_coordinates = NULL, 
  shapefile_path = "Pts_GPS_Station_English.shp",
  manual_matches = NULL, 
  similarity_threshold = 0.8,
  min_stations = 3,
  min_completeness = 0.5,
  resolution = 0.001, 
  power = 5, 
  nmax = Inf, 
  nmin = 3,
  buffer_percent = 0.05,
  datasets_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets",
  output_base_dir = "multi_year_monthly_idw_results",
  max_months = NULL,  # Limit number of months to process (NULL = all)
  start_date = NULL,  # Optional start date filter
  end_date = NULL,    # Optional end date filter
  parallel = FALSE    # Option for parallel processing
) {
  
  cat("🚀 Starting MULTI-YEAR MONTHLY IDW interpolation analysis...\n")
  cat("===============================================================\n")
  
  # Load and aggregate data if not provided
  if(is.null(monthly_data_list)) {
    monthly_result <- load_and_aggregate_monthly_data(datasets_dir)
    monthly_data_list <- monthly_result$monthly_data
  }
  
  # Load GPS coordinates if not provided
  if(is.null(gps_coordinates)) {
    gps_coordinates <- load_gps_station_coordinates(shapefile_path)
  }
  
  # Match rainfall stations with GPS coordinates (do this once)
  cat("🔗 Matching rainfall stations with GPS coordinates...\n")
  matched_coordinates <- match_rainfall_with_gps(monthly_data_list, gps_coordinates, 
                                                similarity_threshold, manual_matches)
  
  # Get all available months
  available_months <- get_available_months(monthly_data_list, min_stations, min_completeness)
  
  if(nrow(available_months) == 0) {
    stop("No months meet the minimum criteria for interpolation")
  }
  
  # Apply date filters if specified
  if(!is.null(start_date)) {
    start_date <- as.Date(paste0(start_date, "-01"))
    available_months <- available_months %>% filter(YearMonth >= start_date)
    cat("   📅 Applied start date filter:", format(start_date, "%Y-%m"), "\n")
  }
  
  if(!is.null(end_date)) {
    end_date <- as.Date(paste0(end_date, "-01"))
    available_months <- available_months %>% filter(YearMonth <= end_date)
    cat("   📅 Applied end date filter:", format(end_date, "%Y-%m"), "\n")
  }
  
  # Limit number of months if specified
  if(!is.null(max_months) && nrow(available_months) > max_months) {
    cat(paste("   📊 Limiting to first", max_months, "months out of", nrow(available_months), "available\n"))
    available_months <- head(available_months, max_months)
  }
  
  cat(paste("   🎯 Will process", nrow(available_months), "months\n"))
  
  # Create output directory structure
  if(!dir.exists(output_base_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_base_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Initialize results tracking
  results_summary <- data.frame(
    YearMonth = character(),
    Status = character(),
    n_stations = numeric(),
    n_matched = numeric(),
    min_precip = numeric(),
    max_precip = numeric(),
    mean_precip = numeric(),
    processing_time = numeric(),
    error_message = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  successful_results <- list()
  failed_months <- character()
  
  # Process each month
  cat("\n🔄 Starting monthly interpolation processing...\n")
  cat("==================================================\n")
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(available_months)) {
    target_month <- available_months$YearMonth[i]
    target_month_str <- format(target_month, "%Y-%m")
    
    cat(paste("\n📅 Processing month", i, "of", nrow(available_months), ":", target_month_str, "\n"))
    cat(paste("   Expected stations:", available_months$n_stations[i], 
              "| Avg completeness:", round(available_months$avg_completeness[i]*100, 1), "%\n"))
    
    # Record start time
    start_time <- Sys.time()
    
    tryCatch({
      # Prepare spatial data for this month
      spatial_data <- prepare_monthly_spatial_data_with_gps(monthly_data_list, matched_coordinates, target_month_str)
      
      if(nrow(spatial_data) < min_stations) {
        stop(paste("Only", nrow(spatial_data), "stations available, need at least", min_stations))
      }
      
      # Create spatial points
      spatial_points <- create_spatial_points(spatial_data)
      
      # Create prediction grid (using consistent extent for all months)
      prediction_grid <- create_prediction_grid(spatial_data, resolution, buffer_percent)
      
      # Perform IDW
      idw_results <- perform_idw(spatial_points, prediction_grid, power, nmax, nmin)
      
      # Create maps
      interpolation_map <- create_enhanced_monthly_idw_map_with_gps(
        idw_results, spatial_points, target_month_str,
        paste("Multi-Year Monthly Rainfall Analysis -", target_month_str)
      )
      
      distance_analysis <- create_monthly_distance_analysis_with_gps(spatial_points, target_month_str)
      
      # Calculate processing time
      end_time <- Sys.time()
      processing_time <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "secs"))
      
      # Compile results
      idw_df <- as.data.frame(idw_results$idw_result)
      month_result <- list(
        interpolation_map = interpolation_map,
        distance_analysis = distance_analysis,
        idw_results = idw_results,
        spatial_data = spatial_data,
        matched_coordinates = matched_coordinates,
        summary_stats = list(
          target_year_month = target_month_str,
          n_stations = nrow(spatial_data),
          n_matched_stations = nrow(matched_coordinates$coordinates),
          n_original_stations = sum(spatial_data$Data_Source == "Original", na.rm = TRUE),
          n_chirps_stations = sum(spatial_data$Data_Source == "CHIRPS", na.rm = TRUE),
          n_exact_matches = sum(spatial_data$Match_Type == "Exact", na.rm = TRUE),
          n_fuzzy_matches = sum(spatial_data$Match_Type == "Fuzzy", na.rm = TRUE),
          n_manual_matches = sum(spatial_data$Match_Type == "Manual", na.rm = TRUE),
          avg_data_completeness = mean(spatial_data$Data_Completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
          avg_match_score = mean(spatial_data$Match_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
          min_precipitation = min(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
          max_precipitation = max(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
          mean_precipitation = mean(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
          power_parameter = power,
          max_neighbors = nmax,
          min_neighbors = nmin,
          shapefile_used = shapefile_path,
          similarity_threshold = similarity_threshold,
          buffer_percent = buffer_percent,
          grid_resolution = resolution,
          processing_time_seconds = processing_time
        )
      )
      
      # Save individual month results
      save_individual_month_results(month_result, output_base_dir, target_month_str)
      
      # Store in successful results
      successful_results[[target_month_str]] <- month_result
      
      # Update summary
      results_summary <- rbind(results_summary, data.frame(
        YearMonth = target_month_str,
        Status = "Success",
        n_stations = nrow(spatial_data),
        n_matched = nrow(matched_coordinates$coordinates),
        min_precip = round(min(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        max_precip = round(max(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        mean_precip = round(mean(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        processing_time = round(processing_time, 2),
        error_message = "",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
      
      cat(paste("   ✅ Success! Processed in", round(processing_time, 1), "seconds\n"))
      cat(paste("   📊 Stations used:", nrow(spatial_data), 
                "| Rainfall range:", round(min(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "-", 
                round(max(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "mm\n"))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      end_time <- Sys.time()
      processing_time <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "secs"))
      
      error_msg <- as.character(e$message)
      cat(paste("   ❌ Failed:", error_msg, "\n"))
      
      failed_months <- c(failed_months, target_month_str)
      
      # Update summary with error
      results_summary <- rbind(results_summary, data.frame(
        YearMonth = target_month_str,
        Status = "Failed",
        n_stations = NA,
        n_matched = NA,
        min_precip = NA,
        max_precip = NA,
        mean_precip = NA,
        processing_time = round(processing_time, 2),
        error_message = substr(error_msg, 1, 200),  # Truncate long error messages
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    })
    
    # Progress update
    if(i %% 10 == 0 || i == nrow(available_months)) {
      successful_count <- sum(results_summary$Status == "Success", na.rm = TRUE)
      failed_count <- sum(results_summary$Status == "Failed", na.rm = TRUE)
      cat(paste("\n📊 Progress Update:", i, "/", nrow(available_months), "months processed\n"))
      cat(paste("   ✅ Successful:", successful_count, "| ❌ Failed:", failed_count, "\n"))
      if(successful_count > 0) {
        avg_time <- mean(results_summary$processing_time[results_summary$Status == "Success"], na.rm = TRUE)
        remaining_months <- nrow(available_months) - i
        estimated_time <- remaining_months * avg_time / 60
        cat(paste("   ⏱️ Avg processing time:", round(avg_time, 1), "sec | Est. remaining:", 
                  round(estimated_time, 1), "minutes\n"))
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Final summary and master results
  cat("\n🎉 MULTI-YEAR MONTHLY IDW ANALYSIS COMPLETE!\n")
  cat("=============================================\n")
  
  successful_count <- length(successful_results)
  failed_count <- length(failed_months)
  total_count <- successful_count + failed_count
  
  cat(paste("📊 FINAL SUMMARY:\n"))
  cat(paste("   ✅ Successfully processed:", successful_count, "months\n"))
  cat(paste("   ❌ Failed:", failed_count, "months\n"))
  cat(paste("   📈 Success rate:", round(successful_count/total_count*100, 1), "%\n"))
  
  if(successful_count > 0) {
    # Calculate overall statistics
    all_precip_values <- map_dbl(successful_results, ~.x$summary_stats$mean_precipitation)
    total_processing_time <- sum(results_summary$processing_time, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat(paste("   🌧️ Overall rainfall range:", 
              round(min(results_summary$min_precip, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "-", 
              round(max(results_summary$max_precip, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "mm\n"))
    cat(paste("   ⏱️ Total processing time:", round(total_processing_time/60, 1), "minutes\n"))
    cat(paste("   📅 Date range processed:", 
              min(results_summary$YearMonth[results_summary$Status == "Success"]), "to",
              max(results_summary$YearMonth[results_summary$Status == "Success"]), "\n"))
  }
  
  # Save master summary files
  save_master_summary_results(results_summary, successful_results, failed_months, 
                             matched_coordinates, output_base_dir)
  
  if(failed_count > 0) {
    cat(paste("\n⚠️ Failed months:", paste(failed_months, collapse = ", "), "\n"))
  }
  
  cat(paste("\n📁 All results saved to:", output_base_dir, "\n"))
  cat("📊 Check the summary files and individual month folders for detailed results.\n")
  
  return(list(
    results_summary = results_summary,
    successful_results = successful_results,
    failed_months = failed_months,
    matched_coordinates = matched_coordinates,
    processing_stats = list(
      total_months_processed = total_count,
      successful_months = successful_count,
      failed_months = failed_count,
      success_rate = successful_count/total_count,
      total_processing_time_minutes = total_processing_time/60,
      average_processing_time_seconds = mean(results_summary$processing_time, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ))
}

# NEW FUNCTION: Save individual month results
save_individual_month_results <- function(month_result, output_base_dir, target_month_str) {
  # Create month-specific directory
  month_dir <- file.path(output_base_dir, paste0("month_", gsub("-", "_", target_month_str)))
  if(!dir.exists(month_dir)) {
    dir.create(month_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    # Save maps with unique names
    ggsave(file.path(month_dir, paste0("interpolation_map_", gsub("-", "_", target_month_str), ".png")),
           month_result$interpolation_map, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    ggsave(file.path(month_dir, paste0("distance_analysis_", gsub("-", "_", target_month_str), ".png")),
           month_result$distance_analysis, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    # Save spatial data
    write.csv(month_result$spatial_data, 
              file.path(month_dir, paste0("spatial_data_", gsub("-", "_", target_month_str), ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save IDW results as raster
    idw_raster <- rast(month_result$idw_results$idw_result)
    writeRaster(idw_raster, 
                file.path(month_dir, paste0("idw_raster_", gsub("-", "_", target_month_str), ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
    
    # Save month-specific summary
    summary_df <- data.frame(
      Parameter = names(month_result$summary_stats),
      Value = as.character(month_result$summary_stats),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    write.csv(summary_df,
              file.path(month_dir, paste0("summary_", gsub("-", "_", target_month_str), ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(paste("   ⚠️ Warning: Could not save some files for", target_month_str, ":", e$message, "\n"))
  })
}

# NEW FUNCTION: Save master summary results
save_master_summary_results <- function(results_summary, successful_results, failed_months, 
                                       matched_coordinates, output_base_dir) {
  
  # Save overall results summary
  write.csv(results_summary, file.path(output_base_dir, "master_results_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  # Save GPS matching information (same for all months)
  write.csv(matched_coordinates$coordinates,
            file.path(output_base_dir, "gps_station_coordinates_matched.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  write.csv(matched_coordinates$matching_summary,
            file.path(output_base_dir, "station_matching_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  # Save failed months list
  if(length(failed_months) > 0) {
    write.csv(data.frame(Failed_Months = failed_months),
              file.path(output_base_dir, "failed_months.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  }
  
  # Create aggregated statistics across all successful months
  if(length(successful_results) > 0) {
    monthly_stats <- map_dfr(successful_results, function(result) {
      data.frame(
        YearMonth = result$summary_stats$target_year_month,
        n_stations = result$summary_stats$n_stations,
        mean_precipitation = result$summary_stats$mean_precipitation,
        min_precipitation = result$summary_stats$min_precipitation,
        max_precipitation = result$summary_stats$max_precipitation,
        avg_data_completeness = result$summary_stats$avg_data_completeness,
        processing_time = result$summary_stats$processing_time_seconds,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    })
    
    write.csv(monthly_stats, file.path(output_base_dir, "monthly_statistics_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Create time series of monthly rainfall statistics
    monthly_stats$Date <- as.Date(paste0(monthly_stats$YearMonth, "-01"))
    monthly_stats$Year <- year(monthly_stats$Date)
    monthly_stats$Month <- month(monthly_stats$Date)
    
    # Annual summary
    annual_stats <- monthly_stats %>%
      group_by(Year) %>%
      summarise(
        months_available = n(),
        avg_stations = mean(n_stations),
        avg_mean_precipitation = mean(mean_precipitation, na.rm = TRUE),
        total_mean_precipitation = sum(mean_precipitation, na.rm = TRUE),
        avg_completeness = mean(avg_data_completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = 'drop'
      )
    
    write.csv(annual_stats, file.path(output_base_dir, "annual_summary_statistics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  }
  
  # Create processing log
  processing_log <- data.frame(
    Analysis_Date = Sys.time(),
    Total_Months_Processed = nrow(results_summary),
    Successful_Months = sum(results_summary$Status == "Success", na.rm = TRUE),
    Failed_Months = sum(results_summary$Status == "Failed", na.rm = TRUE),
    Success_Rate_Percent = round(sum(results_summary$Status == "Success", na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(results_summary) * 100, 1),
    Total_Processing_Time_Minutes = round(sum(results_summary$processing_time, na.rm = TRUE) / 60, 1),
    Average_Processing_Time_Seconds = round(mean(results_summary$processing_time, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Output_Directory = output_base_dir,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  write.csv(processing_log, file.path(output_base_dir, "processing_log.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

# ====================================================================
# MAIN EXECUTION - Run this for all months in your dataset
# ====================================================================

# Configuration parameters
shapefile_path <- "Pts_GPS_Station_English.shp"
similarity_threshold <- 0.8
min_stations <- 3           # Minimum stations required per month
min_completeness <- 0.5     # Minimum data completeness (50%)
resolution <- 0.001         # Grid resolution (smaller = higher detail)
power <- 5                  # IDW power parameter
buffer_percent <- 0.05      # Dynamic buffer (5% of extent)

# Optional date range filtering (set to NULL to process all available)
start_date <- NULL          # e.g., "2015-01" to start from January 2015
end_date <- NULL            # e.g., "2023-12" to end at December 2023
max_months <- NULL          # e.g., 24 to limit to first 24 months (NULL = all)

cat("🚀 STARTING MULTI-YEAR MONTHLY IDW ANALYSIS...\n")
cat("==============================================\n")
cat("Configuration:\n")
cat(paste("   Minimum stations per month:", min_stations, "\n"))
cat(paste("   Minimum data completeness:", min_completeness*100, "%\n"))
cat(paste("   Grid resolution:", resolution, "degrees\n"))
cat(paste("   IDW power parameter:", power, "\n"))
cat(paste("   Dynamic buffer:", buffer_percent*100, "%\n"))
if(!is.null(start_date)) cat(paste("   Start date filter:", start_date, "\n"))
if(!is.null(end_date)) cat(paste("   End date filter:", end_date, "\n"))
if(!is.null(max_months)) cat(paste("   Maximum months to process:", max_months, "\n"))

# Optional: Load manual matches if available
# manual_matches <- read.csv("manual_station_matching_template.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
#   filter(!startsWith(rainfall_station, "#") & gps_station != "") %>%
#   select(rainfall_station, gps_station)

# Run the enhanced multi-year analysis
multi_year_results <- perform_multi_year_monthly_idw_analysis(
  shapefile_path = shapefile_path,
  similarity_threshold = similarity_threshold,
  min_stations = min_stations,
  min_completeness = min_completeness,
  resolution = resolution,
  power = power,
  nmax = Inf,
  nmin = 3,
  buffer_percent = buffer_percent,
  output_base_dir = "multi_year_monthly_idw_results",
  max_months = max_months,
  start_date = start_date,
  end_date = end_date
  # manual_matches = manual_matches  # Uncomment if you have manual matches
)

# Display final results
if(!is.null(multi_year_results)) {
  cat("\n🎉 MULTI-YEAR ANALYSIS COMPLETE!\n")
  cat("================================\n")
  print(multi_year_results$processing_stats)
  
  if(nrow(multi_year_results$results_summary) > 0) {
    # Show some successful examples
    successful_months <- multi_year_results$results_summary %>%
      filter(Status == "Success") %>%
      arrange(desc(mean_precip)) %>%
      head(5)
    
    if(nrow(successful_months) > 0) {
      cat("\n🏆 Top 5 months by mean interpolated rainfall:\n")
      for(i in 1:nrow(successful_months)) {
        cat(paste("   ", successful_months$YearMonth[i], ":", 
                  round(successful_months$mean_precip[i], 1), "mm", 
                  "(", successful_months$n_stations[i], "stations )\n"))
      }
    }
    
    # Show processing efficiency
    total_time <- sum(multi_year_results$results_summary$processing_time, na.rm = TRUE)
    cat(paste("\n⏱️ Total processing time:", round(total_time/60, 1), "minutes for", 
              sum(multi_year_results$results_summary$Status == "Success"), "successful months\n"))
    
    cat("\n📁 Results saved in organized folder structure:\n")
    cat("   📊 multi_year_monthly_idw_results/master_results_summary.csv\n")
    cat("   📅 multi_year_monthly_idw_results/month_YYYY_MM/ (individual month folders)\n")
    cat("   📈 multi_year_monthly_idw_results/monthly_statistics_summary.csv\n")
    cat("   📋 multi_year_monthly_idw_results/processing_log.csv\n")
  }
  
} else {
  cat("❌ Multi-year analysis failed. Check error messages above.\n")
}
```

## GIF making

```{r}
# Lightweight Rainfall GIF Creator
# Optimized for low-power PCs with limited resources
# Creates simple but effective animated GIFs from your monthly maps

# Load only essential libraries
library(magick)      # For image processing and GIF creation
library(lubridate)   # Date handling

# Install magick if not available
if(!require(magick, quietly = TRUE)) {
  cat("Installing magick package...\n")
  install.packages("magick")
  library(magick)
}

# Simple function to find interpolation maps
find_maps_simple <- function(results_dir = "multi_year_monthly_idw_results") {
  
  cat("🔍 Finding interpolation maps...\n")
  
  # Find all PNG files in all subdirectories
  all_files <- list.files(results_dir, 
                         pattern = "interpolation_map.*\\.png$", 
                         recursive = TRUE, 
                         full.names = TRUE)
  
  if(length(all_files) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No interpolation maps found in:", results_dir))
  }
  
  cat(paste("   Found", length(all_files), "maps\n"))
  
  # Extract dates and sort
  filenames <- basename(all_files)
  date_strings <- gsub(".*interpolation_map_([0-9]{4}_[0-9]{2}).*", "\\1", filenames)
  dates <- as.Date(paste0(gsub("_", "-", date_strings), "-01"))
  
  # Create simple data frame and sort by date
  map_data <- data.frame(
    file = all_files,
    date = dates,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Remove invalid dates and sort
  map_data <- map_data[!is.na(map_data$date), ]
  map_data <- map_data[order(map_data$date), ]
  
  cat(paste("   Date range:", format(min(map_data$date), "%Y-%m"), 
            "to", format(max(map_data$date), "%Y-%m"), "\n"))
  
  return(map_data)
}

# Memory-efficient GIF creator
create_simple_gif <- function(results_dir = "multi_year_monthly_idw_results",
                             output_file = "rainfall_simple.gif",
                             max_width = 800,      # Better quality size
                             frame_delay = 200,    # Much slower (200ms between frames)
                             max_frames = 80,      # More frames allowed
                             quality = 85,         # Higher quality
                             add_labels = TRUE,
                             optimize_colors = TRUE) {   # Color optimization option
  
  cat("🎬 Creating simple rainfall GIF (low resource mode)...\n")
  
  # Find maps
  map_data <- find_maps_simple(results_dir)
  
  # Limit frames if too many (sample evenly)
  if(nrow(map_data) > max_frames) {
    cat(paste("   Reducing from", nrow(map_data), "to", max_frames, "frames\n"))
    indices <- round(seq(1, nrow(map_data), length.out = max_frames))
    map_data <- map_data[indices, ]
  }
  
  cat(paste("   Processing", nrow(map_data), "frames...\n"))
  
  # Process images one by one (memory efficient)
  images <- c()
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(map_data)) {
    cat(paste("\r   Frame", i, "of", nrow(map_data)), sep = "")
    
    # Read and resize image
    img <- image_read(map_data$file[i])
    img <- image_scale(img, paste0(max_width, "x"))  # Resize to save memory
    
    # Add simple date label with better formatting
    if(add_labels) {
      date_label <- format(map_data$date[i], "%B %Y")  # Full month name
      img <- image_annotate(img, 
                           text = date_label,
                           size = 50,              # Larger text
                           color = "white",
                           gravity = "northeast",
                           location = "+15+15",    # Better positioning
                           strokecolor = "black",  # Text outline for readability
                           strokewidth = 1,
                           boxcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)")  # Semi-transparent background
    }
    
    # Add to list
    images <- c(images, img)
  }
  
  cat("\n   Creating GIF...\n")
  
  # Create animation (all at once to save memory operations)
  animation <- image_join(images)
  
  # Fix fps to be a factor of 100 (magick requirement)
  target_fps <- 1000/frame_delay
  valid_fps <- c(1, 2, 4, 5, 10, 20, 25, 50, 100)  # factors of 100
  actual_fps <- valid_fps[which.min(abs(valid_fps - target_fps))]
  
  animation <- image_animate(animation, fps = actual_fps, loop = 0)
  
  # Simple optimization (reduce colors for smaller file size)
  cat("   Optimizing...\n")
  animation <- image_quantize(animation, max = 256)  # Reduce to 256 colors
  
  # Save
  cat("   Saving...\n")
  image_write(animation, output_file, quality = quality)
  
  # Show results
  file_size <- round(file.info(output_file)$size / 1024 / 1024, 2)
  cat("✅ Simple GIF created!\n")
  cat(paste("   File:", output_file, "\n"))
  cat(paste("   Size:", file_size, "MB\n"))
  cat(paste("   Frames:", length(images), "\n"))
  
  return(animation)
}
```
