```{r}
# Month-by-month progression GIF (shows each month clearly)
create_monthly_progression_gif <- function(results_dir = "multi_year_monthly_idw_results",
                                          output_file = "rainfall_monthly_progression.gif",
                                          max_width = 900,        # Large for clear viewing
                                          frame_delay = 800,      # Very slow - 0.8 seconds per month
                                          quality = 90,           # High quality
                                          add_month_counter = TRUE,
                                          add_progress_bar = TRUE,
                                          pause_at_years = TRUE,  # Pause between years
                                          year_pause = 1500) {    # 1.5 second pause at new year
  
  cat("📅 Creating MONTH-BY-MONTH progression GIF...\n")
  cat("   Each month will be clearly visible as it passes by!\n")
  
  # Find all maps in chronological order
  map_data <- find_maps_simple(results_dir)
  total_months <- nrow(map_data)
  
  cat(paste("   📊 Total months to show:", total_months, "\n"))
  cat(paste("   📅 From", format(min(map_data$date), "%B %Y"), 
            "to", format(max(map_data$date), "%B %Y"), "\n"))
  cat(paste("   ⏱️ Each month displays for", frame_delay/1000, "seconds\n"))
  
  images <- c()
  current_year <- NULL
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(map_data)) {
    cat(paste("\r   📅 Processing", format(map_data$date[i], "%B %Y"), 
              "(", i, "of", total_months, ")..."), sep = "")
    
    # Read and resize image for clear viewing
    img <- image_read(map_data$file[i])
    img <- image_scale(img, paste0(max_width, "x"))
    
    # Add prominent month/year label
    month_year <- format(map_data$date[i], "%B %Y")
    img <- image_annotate(img, 
                         text = month_year,
                         size = 70,                    # Large text
                         color = "white",
                         gravity = "north",            # Top center
                         location = "+0+20",
                         strokecolor = "black",
                         strokewidth = 2,
                         boxcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.8)")
    
    # Add month counter if requested
    if(add_month_counter) {
      counter_text <- paste("Month", i, "of", total_months)
      img <- image_annotate(img,
                           text = counter_text,
                           size = 40,
                           color = "lightblue",
                           gravity = "northeast",
                           location = "+20+20",
                           strokecolor = "navy",
                           strokewidth = 1)
    }
    
    # Add progress indicator
    if(add_progress_bar) {
      progress_pct <- round((i/total_months) * 100, 1)
      progress_text <- paste("Progress:", progress_pct, "%")
      img <- image_annotate(img,
                           text = progress_text,
                           size = 35,
                           color = "yellow",
                           gravity = "northwest",
                           location = "+20+80",
                           strokecolor = "black",
                           strokewidth = 1)
    }
    
    # Add season indicator
    month_num <- month(map_data$date[i])
    season <- case_when(
      month_num %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "❄️ Winter",
      month_num %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "🌸 Spring", 
      month_num %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "☀️ Summer",
      month_num %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "🍂 Autumn"
    )
    
    img <- image_annotate(img,
                         text = season,
                         size = 45,
                         color = "lightgreen",
                         gravity = "southeast",
                         location = "+20+20",
                         strokecolor = "darkgreen",
                         strokewidth = 1)
    
    images <- c(images, img)
    
    # Add year transition pause
    if(pause_at_years) {
      year <- year(map_data$date[i])
      next_year <- if(i < nrow(map_data)) year(map_data$date[i+1]) else NULL
      
      if(!is.null(next_year) && next_year != year) {
        # Add pause frames for year transition
        pause_frames <- ceiling(year_pause / frame_delay)
        
        # Create year transition frame
        transition_img <- img
        transition_text <- paste("Year", year, "Complete →", next_year)
        transition_img <- image_annotate(transition_img,
                                       text = transition_text,
                                       size = 60,
                                       color = "orange",
                                       gravity = "center",
                                       strokecolor = "red",
                                       strokewidth = 2,
                                       boxcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.9)")
        
        for(p in 1:pause_frames) {
          images <- c(images, transition_img)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  cat("\n   🎬 Creating smooth month-by-month animation...\n")
  
  # Create animation with appropriate fps
  target_fps <- 1000/frame_delay
  valid_fps <- c(1, 2, 4, 5, 10, 20, 25, 50, 100)
  actual_fps <- valid_fps[which.min(abs(valid_fps - target_fps))]
  
  animation <- image_join(images)
  animation <- image_animate(animation, fps = actual_fps, loop = 0)
  animation <- image_quantize(animation, max = 256)
  
  # Save the GIF
  image_write(animation, output_file, quality = quality)
  
  # Calculate total duration
  total_duration <- length(images) * frame_delay / 1000
  file_size <- round(file.info(output_file)$size / 1024 / 1024, 2)
  
  cat("✅ Monthly progression GIF created!\n")
  cat(paste("   📁 File:", output_file, "\n"))
  cat(paste("   📊 Size:", file_size, "MB\n"))
  cat(paste("   🎞️ Total frames:", length(images), "\n"))
  cat(paste("   ⏱️ Duration:", round(total_duration, 1), "seconds\n"))
  cat(paste("   📅 Shows", total_months, "months passing by clearly!\n"))
  
  return(animation)
}
  
# Smart batch processor (slower, better quality)
create_batch_gif <- function(results_dir = "multi_year_monthly_idw_results",
                            output_file = "rainfall_batch.gif",
                            batch_size = 8,        # Smaller batches for smoother processing
                            max_width = 700,       # Better size
                            frame_delay = 180,     # Slower speed
                            quality = 80) {        # Better quality
  
  cat("📦 Creating GIF with batch processing...\n")
  
  map_data <- find_maps_simple(results_dir)
  total_frames <- nrow(map_data)
  
  # Process in batches
  all_images <- list()
  num_batches <- ceiling(total_frames / batch_size)
  
  for(batch in 1:num_batches) {
    start_idx <- (batch - 1) * batch_size + 1
    end_idx <- min(batch * batch_size, total_frames)
    
    cat(paste("   Batch", batch, "of", num_batches, 
              "(frames", start_idx, "to", end_idx, ")\n"))
    
    batch_images <- c()
    for(i in start_idx:end_idx) {
      img <- image_read(map_data$file[i])
      img <- image_scale(img, paste0(max_width, "x"))
      
      # Better labels
      date_label <- format(map_data$date[i], "%B %Y")  # Full month name
      img <- image_annotate(img, 
                           text = date_label, 
                           size = 40, 
                           color = "white",
                           strokecolor = "black",
                           strokewidth = 1,
                           gravity = "northeast",
                           location = "+10+10")
      
      batch_images <- c(batch_images, img)
    }
    
    all_images <- c(all_images, batch_images)
    
    # Clean up batch (force garbage collection)
    rm(batch_images)
    gc()
  }
  
  cat("   Combining all batches...\n")
  animation <- image_join(all_images)
  
  # Use slower fps for better viewing
  target_fps <- 1000/frame_delay
  valid_fps <- c(1, 2, 4, 5, 10, 20, 25, 50, 100)
  actual_fps <- valid_fps[which.min(abs(valid_fps - target_fps))]
  
  animation <- image_animate(animation, fps = actual_fps, loop = 0)
  animation <- image_quantize(animation, max = 240)  # More colors for better quality
  
  image_write(animation, output_file, quality = quality)
  
  file_size <- round(file.info(output_file)$size / 1024 / 1024, 2)
  cat("✅ Batch-processed GIF ready!\n")
  cat(paste("   Size:", file_size, "MB\n"))
  
  return(animation)
}
```

## VII.7. Multi-Power IDW Spatial Interpolation Comparison

```{r}
# Multi-Power IDW Spatial Interpolation Comparison
# This script allows you to test and compare different IDW power parameters
# to find the optimal setting for your rainfall data

# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(gstat)        # For IDW
library(sp)           # Spatial data handling
library(sf)           # Modern spatial data
library(terra)        # Replaces deprecated raster package
library(viridis)      # Color palettes
library(gridExtra)    # Multiple plots
library(lubridate)    # Date handling
library(RColorBrewer) # Additional color palettes
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(cowplot)      # For plot arrangements

# Install and load required packages
install_and_load <- function(packages) {
  new_packages <- packages[!(packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
  if(length(new_packages)) {
    cat("Installing packages:", paste(new_packages, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    install.packages(new_packages, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
  sapply(packages, function(x) {
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(x, character.only = TRUE))
  })
}

required_packages <- c("gstat", "sp", "sf", "terra", "viridis", "gridExtra", "cowplot")
install_and_load(required_packages)

# Load the monthly aggregation functions from previous script
source_monthly_functions <- function() {
  # Function to load and aggregate your real combined datasets to monthly data
  load_and_aggregate_monthly_data <<- function(datasets_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets") {
    cat("📥 Loading and aggregating your real combined rainfall datasets to monthly...\n")
    
    if(!dir.exists(datasets_dir)) {
      stop(paste("Directory not found:", datasets_dir, 
                 "\nPlease make sure you have run the enhanced time series script first."))
    }
    
    # Get all CSV files in the directory
    csv_files <- list.files(datasets_dir, pattern = "^combined_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
    
    if(length(csv_files) == 0) {
      stop(paste("No combined CSV files found in:", datasets_dir))
    }
    
    monthly_data_list <- list()
    
    for(file in csv_files) {
      # Extract station name from filename
      filename <- basename(file)
      # Remove "combined_" prefix and "_2000_2025.csv" suffix
      station_name <- gsub("^combined_", "", filename)
      station_name <- gsub("_2000_2025\\.csv$", "", station_name)
      
      # Load the data
      tryCatch({
        daily_data <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
          mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))
        
        # Aggregate to monthly data
        monthly_data <- daily_data %>%
          mutate(
            Year = year(Date),
            Month = month(Date),
            YearMonth = floor_date(Date, "month")
          ) %>%
          group_by(Station = station_name, Year, Month, YearMonth) %>%
          summarise(
            # Monthly totals for rainfall
            monthly_rainfall = sum(combined_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
            monthly_original = sum(original_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
            monthly_chirps = sum(chirps_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
            
            # Count of valid days
            valid_days = sum(!is.na(combined_rainfall)),
            total_days = n(),
            data_completeness = valid_days / total_days,
            
            # Dominant data source for the month
            dominant_source = names(sort(table(data_source), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
            
            # First and last date of month
            month_start = min(Date, na.rm = TRUE),
            month_end = max(Date, na.rm = TRUE),
            
            .groups = 'drop'
          ) %>%
          # Only keep months with reasonable data completeness (at least 50% of days)
          filter(data_completeness >= 0.5 & valid_days >= 10) %>%
          # Convert 0 totals to NA if no valid data
          mutate(
            monthly_rainfall = ifelse(valid_days == 0, NA, monthly_rainfall),
            monthly_original = ifelse(monthly_original == 0 & valid_days > 0, NA, monthly_original),
            monthly_chirps = ifelse(monthly_chirps == 0 & valid_days > 0, NA, monthly_chirps)
          )
        
        monthly_data_list[[station_name]] <- monthly_data
        cat(paste("   ✅ Loaded and aggregated", station_name, ":", 
                  nrow(daily_data), "daily →", nrow(monthly_data), "monthly records\n"))
        
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat(paste("   ❌ Failed to process", filename, ":", e$message, "\n"))
      })
    }
    
    if(length(monthly_data_list) == 0) {
      stop("No datasets were successfully processed")
    }
    
    cat("✅ Successfully processed", length(monthly_data_list), "station datasets to monthly\n")
    return(list(monthly_data = monthly_data_list))
  }
  
  # Generate station coordinates function
  generate_station_coordinates <<- function(station_names, region = "morocco", seed = 123) {
    set.seed(seed)
    n_stations <- length(station_names)
    
    if(n_stations < 3) {
      stop("Need at least 3 stations for spatial interpolation")
    }
    
    # Define realistic bounding boxes for different regions
    region_bounds <- list(
      morocco = list(xmin = -17, xmax = -1, ymin = 21, ymax = 36, name = "Morocco"),
      france = list(xmin = -5, xmax = 10, ymin = 42, ymax = 51, name = "France"),
      spain = list(xmin = -10, xmax = 5, ymin = 36, ymax = 44, name = "Spain"),
      algeria = list(xmin = -8, xmax = 12, ymin = 19, ymax = 37, name = "Algeria"),
      mediterranean = list(xmin = -6, xmax = 10, ymin = 30, ymax = 45, name = "Western Mediterranean"),
      custom = list(xmin = -10, xmax = 10, ymin = 30, ymax = 45, name = "Custom Region")
    )
    
    if(!region %in% names(region_bounds)) {
      cat("⚠️ Unknown region, using mediterranean bounds\n")
      region <- "mediterranean"
    }
    
    bbox <- region_bounds[[region]]
    
    # Generate coordinates with clustering
    coordinates_df <- data.frame(
      Station = station_names,
      Longitude = runif(n_stations, bbox$xmin, bbox$xmax),
      Latitude = runif(n_stations, bbox$ymin, bbox$ymax),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    # Add spatial clustering
    n_clusters <- min(3, max(2, floor(n_stations / 4)))
    cluster_centers <- data.frame(
      lon = runif(n_clusters, bbox$xmin + 1, bbox$xmax - 1),
      lat = runif(n_clusters, bbox$ymin + 1, bbox$ymax - 1)
    )
    
    station_clusters <- sample(1:n_clusters, n_stations, replace = TRUE)
    
    for(i in 1:n_stations) {
      cluster_id <- station_clusters[i]
      center <- cluster_centers[cluster_id, ]
      
      noise_lon <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.5)
      noise_lat <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.0)
      
      coordinates_df$Longitude[i] <- center$lon + noise_lon
      coordinates_df$Latitude[i] <- center$lat + noise_lat
    }
    
    # Ensure coordinates stay within bounds
    coordinates_df$Longitude <- pmax(bbox$xmin, pmin(bbox$xmax, coordinates_df$Longitude))
    coordinates_df$Latitude <- pmax(bbox$ymin, pmin(bbox$ymax, coordinates_df$Latitude))
    
    # Add elevation
    coordinates_df$Elevation_m <- round(runif(n_stations, 50, 2000), 0)
    
    return(coordinates_df)
  }
  
  # Prepare monthly spatial data function
  prepare_monthly_spatial_data <<- function(monthly_data_list, coordinates_df, target_year_month) {
    target_date <- as.Date(paste0(target_year_month, "-01"))
    target_ym <- floor_date(target_date, "month")
    
    # Extract data for the target month from all stations
    spatial_data <- map_dfr(names(monthly_data_list), function(station_name) {
      station_data <- monthly_data_list[[station_name]]
      
      if(is.null(station_data) || nrow(station_data) == 0) {
        return(data.frame(Station = station_name, Monthly_Precipitation = NA, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
      }
      
      # Find target month data
      target_row <- station_data %>% 
        filter(YearMonth == target_ym) %>%
        slice(1)
      
      if(nrow(target_row) > 0 && !is.na(target_row$monthly_rainfall)) {
        data.frame(
          Station = station_name,
          Monthly_Precipitation = as.numeric(target_row$monthly_rainfall),
          Data_Source = as.character(target_row$dominant_source %||% "Unknown"),
          Valid_Days = as.numeric(target_row$valid_days),
          Data_Completeness = as.numeric(target_row$data_completeness),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      } else {
        data.frame(
          Station = station_name,
          Monthly_Precipitation = NA,
          Data_Source = "Missing",
          Valid_Days = 0,
          Data_Completeness = 0,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    })
    
    # Join with coordinates and filter
    spatial_data <- spatial_data %>%
      left_join(coordinates_df, by = "Station") %>%
      filter(!is.na(Monthly_Precipitation) & !is.na(Longitude) & !is.na(Latitude) & 
             is.finite(Monthly_Precipitation) & is.finite(Longitude) & is.finite(Latitude) &
             Monthly_Precipitation >= 0)
    
    if(nrow(spatial_data) < 3) {
      stop(paste("Found only", nrow(spatial_data), "valid data points for", target_year_month, 
                 ". Need at least 3 stations with data."))
    }
    
    return(spatial_data)
  }
}

# Function to perform IDW with multiple power parameters
perform_multi_power_idw <- function(spatial_data, target_year_month, 
                                   power_values = c(0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3),
                                   resolution = 0.1, nmax = Inf, nmin = 3) {
  
  cat("🎯 Performing multi-power IDW analysis...\n")
  cat("   Power values to test:", paste(power_values, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("   Target month:", target_year_month, "\n")
  
  # Create spatial points
  sp_data <- spatial_data
  coordinates(sp_data) <- ~Longitude + Latitude
  proj4string(sp_data) <- CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs")
  
  # Create prediction grid
  xmin <- min(spatial_data$Longitude) - 0.5
  xmax <- max(spatial_data$Longitude) + 0.5
  ymin <- min(spatial_data$Latitude) - 0.5
  ymax <- max(spatial_data$Latitude) + 0.5
  
  x_seq <- seq(xmin, xmax, by = resolution)
  y_seq <- seq(ymin, ymax, by = resolution)
  
  grid_df <- expand.grid(Longitude = x_seq, Latitude = y_seq)
  coordinates(grid_df) <- ~Longitude + Latitude
  gridded(grid_df) <- TRUE
  proj4string(grid_df) <- CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs")
  
  # Store results for each power value
  power_results <- list()
  
  for(power in power_values) {
    cat(paste("   Processing power =", power, "...\n"))
    
    tryCatch({
      # Perform IDW interpolation
      idw_result <- idw(Monthly_Precipitation ~ 1, 
                       sp_data, 
                       grid_df, 
                       idp = power,
                       nmax = nmax,
                       nmin = nmin)
      
      # Convert to dataframe
      idw_df <- as.data.frame(idw_result)
      idw_df <- idw_df %>%
        filter(is.finite(var1.pred) & !is.na(var1.pred) & var1.pred >= 0) %>%
        mutate(Power = power)
      
      # Calculate statistics
      stats <- list(
        power = power,
        min_value = min(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
        max_value = max(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_value = mean(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_value = median(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
        std_dev = sd(idw_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_points = nrow(idw_df)
      )
      
      power_results[[as.character(power)]] <- list(
        idw_result = idw_result,
        idw_df = idw_df,
        stats = stats,
        power = power
      )
      
      cat(paste("      ✅ Power", power, "completed - Mean:", round(stats$mean_value, 1), 
                "mm, Range:", round(stats$min_value, 1), "-", round(stats$max_value, 1), "mm\n"))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(paste("      ❌ Power", power, "failed:", e$message, "\n"))
    })
  }
  
  cat("✅ Multi-power IDW analysis completed!\n")
  
  return(list(
    power_results = power_results,
    spatial_data = spatial_data,
    target_year_month = target_year_month,
    tested_powers = power_values[power_values %in% as.numeric(names(power_results))]
  ))
}

# Function to create comparison maps for different power values
create_power_comparison_maps <- function(multi_power_result, max_plots = 6) {
  
  cat("🎨 Creating power comparison maps...\n")
  
  power_results <- multi_power_result$power_results
  spatial_data <- multi_power_result$spatial_data
  target_month <- multi_power_result$target_year_month
  
  # Limit number of plots
  powers_to_plot <- head(multi_power_result$tested_powers, max_plots)
  
  # Calculate global scale for consistent comparison
  all_values <- map(power_results[as.character(powers_to_plot)], ~.x$idw_df$var1.pred) %>%
    unlist()
  
  global_min <- min(all_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  global_max <- max(all_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Create individual maps
  map_list <- list()
  
  for(power in powers_to_plot) {
    power_key <- as.character(power)
    
    if(power_key %in% names(power_results)) {
      idw_df <- power_results[[power_key]]$idw_df
      stats <- power_results[[power_key]]$stats
      
      p <- ggplot() +
        # Interpolated surface
        geom_tile(data = idw_df, 
                  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = var1.pred),
                  alpha = 0.8) +
        
        # Station points
        geom_point(data = spatial_data, 
                   aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, size = Monthly_Precipitation),
                   color = "white", stroke = 1.5, alpha = 0.9) +
        
        # Styling with consistent scale
        scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Rainfall\n(mm)", 
                            option = "plasma",
                            limits = c(global_min, global_max),
                            na.value = "transparent",
                            trans = "sqrt") +
        
        scale_size_continuous(name = "Observed\n(mm)", 
                             range = c(1.5, 4),
                             trans = "sqrt",
                             guide = "none") +
        
        labs(
          title = paste("Power =", power),
          subtitle = paste("Mean:", round(stats$mean_value, 1), "mm | Range:", 
                          round(stats$min_value, 1), "-", round(stats$max_value, 1), "mm"),
          x = NULL, y = NULL
        ) +
        
        theme_void() +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray60", hjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "none",
          plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
        ) +
        coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
      
      map_list[[power_key]] <- p
    }
  }
  
  # Create combined plot
  n_plots <- length(map_list)
  ncols <- min(3, n_plots)
  nrows <- ceiling(n_plots / ncols)
  
  # Add a common legend
  legend_plot <- map_list[[1]] + 
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 15, barheight = 0.5, title.position = "top"))
  
  legend <- get_legend(legend_plot)
  
  # Remove legends from individual plots
  map_list <- map(map_list, ~.x + theme(legend.position = "none"))
  
  # Combine plots
  combined_maps <- plot_grid(plotlist = map_list, 
                            ncol = ncols, 
                            nrow = nrows,
                            align = "hv")
  
  # Add title and legend
  title <- ggdraw() + 
    draw_label(paste("IDW Power Parameter Comparison -", target_month),
               fontface = 'bold', size = 14, hjust = 0.5)
  
  final_plot <- plot_grid(
    title,
    combined_maps,
    legend,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.08, 0.84, 0.08)
  )
  
  return(final_plot)
}

# Function to create power statistics comparison
create_power_statistics_comparison <- function(multi_power_result) {
  
  cat("📊 Creating power statistics comparison...\n")
  
  power_results <- multi_power_result$power_results
  target_month <- multi_power_result$target_year_month
  
  # Extract statistics
  stats_df <- map_dfr(power_results, function(result) {
    stats <- result$stats
    data.frame(
      Power = stats$power,
      Min_Value = stats$min_value,
      Max_Value = stats$max_value,
      Mean_Value = stats$mean_value,
      Median_Value = stats$median_value,
      Std_Dev = stats$std_dev,
      Range = stats$max_value - stats$min_value,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }) %>%
    arrange(Power)
  
  # Create multiple comparison plots
  
  # 1. Mean and Range comparison
  p1 <- ggplot(stats_df, aes(x = factor(Power))) +
    geom_col(aes(y = Mean_Value), fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Mean_Value), color = "darkblue", size = 3) +
    geom_text(aes(y = Mean_Value, label = round(Mean_Value, 1)), 
              vjust = -0.5, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
    labs(
      title = "Mean Interpolated Rainfall by Power",
      subtitle = paste("Month:", target_month),
      x = "IDW Power Parameter",
      y = "Mean Rainfall (mm)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # 2. Variability comparison (Range and Std Dev)
  p2_data <- stats_df %>%
    select(Power, Range, Std_Dev) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(Range, Std_Dev), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value")
  
  p2 <- ggplot(p2_data, aes(x = factor(Power), y = Value, fill = Metric)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Range" = "#E74C3C", "Std_Dev" = "#3498DB"),
                      labels = c("Range" = "Range (Max - Min)", "Std_Dev" = "Standard Deviation")) +
    labs(
      title = "Interpolation Variability by Power",
      subtitle = "Higher power = smoother interpolation (lower variability)",
      x = "IDW Power Parameter",
      y = "Rainfall (mm)",
      fill = "Variability Metric"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # 3. Min/Max comparison
  p3_data <- stats_df %>%
    select(Power, Min_Value, Max_Value) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(Min_Value, Max_Value), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value")
  
  p3 <- ggplot(p3_data, aes(x = factor(Power), y = Value, color = Metric)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = Metric), linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Min_Value" = "#2ECC71", "Max_Value" = "#E67E22"),
                       labels = c("Min_Value" = "Minimum", "Max_Value" = "Maximum")) +
    labs(
      title = "Min/Max Values by Power",
      subtitle = "Shows how power affects interpolation extremes",
      x = "IDW Power Parameter",
      y = "Rainfall (mm)",
      color = "Value Type"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # 4. Summary table
  summary_table <- stats_df %>%
    mutate(
      Mean_Value = round(Mean_Value, 1),
      Range = round(Range, 1),
      Std_Dev = round(Std_Dev, 1)
    ) %>%
    select(Power, Mean_Value, Range, Std_Dev)
  
  # Combine plots
  combined_stats <- plot_grid(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 2, nrow = 2, 
                             labels = c("A", "B", "C"), label_size = 12)
  
  return(list(
    combined_plot = combined_stats,
    individual_plots = list(mean_plot = p1, variability_plot = p2, minmax_plot = p3),
    summary_table = summary_table,
    stats_df = stats_df
  ))
}

# Function to recommend optimal power based on analysis
recommend_optimal_power <- function(multi_power_result, spatial_data) {
  
  cat("🎯 Analyzing power parameters to recommend optimal value...\n")
  
  power_results <- multi_power_result$power_results
  
  # Extract statistics
  stats_df <- map_dfr(power_results, function(result) {
    stats <- result$stats
    data.frame(
      Power = stats$power,
      Mean_Value = stats$mean_value,
      Std_Dev = stats$std_dev,
      Range = stats$max_value - stats$min_value,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }) %>%
    arrange(Power)
  
  # Calculate observed statistics for comparison
  observed_mean <- mean(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE)
  observed_std <- sd(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE)
  observed_range <- max(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE) - 
                   min(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Score each power based on how well it preserves observed statistics
  stats_df <- stats_df %>%
    mutate(
      # Normalized differences from observed values (0 = perfect match, 1 = maximum difference)
      mean_score = abs(Mean_Value - observed_mean) / observed_mean,
      std_score = abs(Std_Dev - observed_std) / observed_std,
      range_score = abs(Range - observed_range) / observed_range,
      
      # Combined score (lower is better)
      total_score = mean_score + std_score + range_score,
      
      # Rank by total score
      rank = rank(total_score)
    )
  
  # Find optimal power
  optimal_power <- stats_df$Power[which.min(stats_df$total_score)]
  
  # Create recommendation summary
  cat("\n📋 POWER PARAMETER ANALYSIS RESULTS\n")
  cat("==================================\n")
  cat("Observed data statistics:\n")
  cat(paste("  Mean rainfall:", round(observed_mean, 1), "mm\n"))
  cat(paste("  Std deviation:", round(observed_std, 1), "mm\n"))
  cat(paste("  Range:", round(observed_range, 1), "mm\n\n"))
  
  cat("Power parameter comparison (top 3):\n")
  top_3 <- head(stats_df %>% arrange(rank), 3)
  for(i in 1:nrow(top_3)) {
    cat(paste("  ", i, ". Power =", top_3$Power[i], 
              "- Score:", round(top_3$total_score[i], 3),
              "- Mean:", round(top_3$Mean_Value[i], 1), "mm\n"))
  }
  
  cat(paste("\n🎯 RECOMMENDED OPTIMAL POWER:", optimal_power, "\n"))
  cat("   This power best preserves your observed data characteristics.\n\n")
  
  # Additional guidance
  power_guidance <- data.frame(
    Power_Range = c("0.5-1.0", "1.5-2.0", "2.5-3.0+"),
    Effect = c("Sharp transitions, honors local values", 
               "Balanced smoothing (recommended)", 
               "Very smooth, global averaging"),
    Use_Case = c("Sparse data, preserve extremes",
                "Most rainfall applications",
                "Dense data, regional patterns"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  cat("💡 GENERAL POWER PARAMETER GUIDANCE:\n")
  for(i in 1:nrow(power_guidance)) {
    cat(paste("   ", power_guidance$Power_Range[i], ":", power_guidance$Effect[i], "\n"))
    cat(paste("      Best for:", power_guidance$Use_Case[i], "\n"))
  }
  
  return(list(
    optimal_power = optimal_power,
    stats_comparison = stats_df,
    observed_stats = list(
      mean = observed_mean,
      std = observed_std,
      range = observed_range
    ),
    recommendation_summary = top_3
  ))
}

# Function to save multi-power results
save_multi_power_results <- function(multi_power_result, power_maps, power_stats, power_recommendation,
                                    output_dir = "multi_power_idw_results") {
  
  if(!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    cat("📁 Created output directory:", output_dir, "\n")
  }
  
  target_month_str <- gsub("-", "_", multi_power_result$target_year_month)
  
  tryCatch({
    # Save comparison maps
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("power_comparison_maps_", target_month_str, ".png")),
           power_maps, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    # Save statistics plots
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("power_statistics_", target_month_str, ".png")),
           power_stats$combined_plot, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    # Save individual statistics plots
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("power_mean_comparison_", target_month_str, ".png")),
           power_stats$individual_plots$mean_plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    # Save statistics table
    write.csv(power_stats$stats_df, 
              file.path(output_dir, paste0("power_statistics_table_", target_month_str, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save recommendation results
    write.csv(power_recommendation$stats_comparison,
              file.path(output_dir, paste0("power_recommendation_analysis_", target_month_str, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save spatial data
    write.csv(multi_power_result$spatial_data,
              file.path(output_dir, paste0("spatial_data_", target_month_str, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save recommendation summary as text file
    recommendation_text <- paste(
      "MULTI-POWER IDW ANALYSIS SUMMARY",
      "================================",
      paste("Analysis Date:", Sys.Date()),
      paste("Target Month:", multi_power_result$target_year_month),
      paste("Number of Stations:", nrow(multi_power_result$spatial_data)),
      paste("Powers Tested:", paste(multi_power_result$tested_powers, collapse = ", ")),
      "",
      "RECOMMENDED OPTIMAL POWER:",
      paste("  Optimal Power:", power_recommendation$optimal_power),
      "",
      "OBSERVED DATA STATISTICS:",
      paste("  Mean Rainfall:", round(power_recommendation$observed_stats$mean, 1), "mm"),
      paste("  Std Deviation:", round(power_recommendation$observed_stats$std, 1), "mm"),
      paste("  Range:", round(power_recommendation$observed_stats$range, 1), "mm"),
      "",
      "TOP 3 POWER RECOMMENDATIONS:",
      sep = "\n"
    )
    
    # Add top 3 recommendations
    top_3 <- head(power_recommendation$stats_comparison %>% arrange(rank), 3)
    for(i in 1:nrow(top_3)) {
      recommendation_text <- paste(recommendation_text,
        paste("  ", i, ". Power =", top_3$Power[i], 
              "- Score:", round(top_3$total_score[i], 3),
              "- Mean:", round(top_3$Mean_Value[i], 1), "mm"),
        sep = "\n")
    }
    
    writeLines(recommendation_text, 
               file.path(output_dir, paste0("power_recommendation_summary_", target_month_str, ".txt")))
    
    cat("💾 Multi-power IDW results saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
    cat("Files saved:\n")
    cat("  - Power comparison maps\n")
    cat("  - Statistical analysis plots\n")
    cat("  - Statistics tables (CSV)\n")
    cat("  - Recommendation summary (TXT)\n")
    cat("  - Spatial data (CSV)\n")
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ Error saving results:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

# Main function to perform complete multi-power IDW analysis
perform_complete_multi_power_analysis <- function(target_year_month, 
                                                power_values = c(0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3),
                                                region = "morocco",
                                                resolution = 0.1,
                                                datasets_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets") {
  
  cat("🚀 STARTING COMPLETE MULTI-POWER IDW ANALYSIS\n")
  cat("=============================================\n")
  cat("Target month:", target_year_month, "\n")
  cat("Power values to test:", paste(power_values, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Region:", region, "\n")
  cat("Resolution:", resolution, "degrees\n\n")
  
  # 1. Load and prepare data
  cat("📥 Step 1: Loading and preparing monthly data...\n")
  monthly_result <- load_and_aggregate_monthly_data(datasets_dir)
  monthly_data_list <- monthly_result$monthly_data
  
  # Generate coordinates
  station_coords <- generate_station_coordinates(names(monthly_data_list), region)
  
  # Prepare spatial data for target month
  spatial_data <- prepare_monthly_spatial_data(monthly_data_list, station_coords, target_year_month)
  
  cat("✅ Data preparation completed\n")
  cat("  Stations with data:", nrow(spatial_data), "\n")
  cat("  Rainfall range:", round(min(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation), 1), "-", 
      round(max(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation), 1), "mm\n\n")
  
  # 2. Perform multi-power IDW
  cat("🎯 Step 2: Performing multi-power IDW interpolation...\n")
  multi_power_result <- perform_multi_power_idw(
    spatial_data = spatial_data,
    target_year_month = target_year_month,
    power_values = power_values,
    resolution = resolution
  )
  
  if(length(multi_power_result$power_results) == 0) {
    stop("❌ No successful IDW interpolations. Check your data and parameters.")
  }
  
  cat("✅ Multi-power IDW completed\n")
  cat("  Successful powers:", length(multi_power_result$power_results), "out of", length(power_values), "\n\n")
  
  # 3. Create comparison maps
  cat("🎨 Step 3: Creating power comparison maps...\n")
  power_maps <- create_power_comparison_maps(multi_power_result, max_plots = 6)
  cat("✅ Comparison maps created\n\n")
  
  # 4. Create statistical analysis
  cat("📊 Step 4: Creating statistical analysis...\n")
  power_stats <- create_power_statistics_comparison(multi_power_result)
  cat("✅ Statistical analysis completed\n\n")
  
  # 5. Recommend optimal power
  cat("🎯 Step 5: Analyzing and recommending optimal power...\n")
  power_recommendation <- recommend_optimal_power(multi_power_result, spatial_data)
  cat("✅ Power recommendation completed\n\n")
  
  # 6. Save all results
  cat("💾 Step 6: Saving all results...\n")
  save_multi_power_results(multi_power_result, power_maps, power_stats, power_recommendation)
  cat("✅ All results saved\n\n")
  
  # Return comprehensive results
  return(list(
    multi_power_result = multi_power_result,
    power_maps = power_maps,
    power_stats = power_stats,
    power_recommendation = power_recommendation,
    spatial_data = spatial_data,
    station_coords = station_coords
  ))
}

# Function to create interactive power comparison
create_interactive_power_explorer <- function(complete_analysis_result) {
  
  cat("🔍 Creating interactive power parameter explorer...\n")
  
  multi_power_result <- complete_analysis_result$multi_power_result
  power_recommendation <- complete_analysis_result$power_recommendation
  
  # Create a function that users can call to explore specific power values
  explore_power <- function(power_value) {
    power_key <- as.character(power_value)
    
    if(!power_key %in% names(multi_power_result$power_results)) {
      cat("❌ Power value", power_value, "not found in analysis results.\n")
      cat("Available powers:", paste(names(multi_power_result$power_results), collapse = ", "), "\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    result <- multi_power_result$power_results[[power_key]]
    stats <- result$stats
    
    cat("\n🔍 POWER", power_value, "DETAILED ANALYSIS\n")
    cat("================================\n")
    cat("Interpolation Statistics:\n")
    cat(paste("  Mean rainfall:", round(stats$mean_value, 2), "mm\n"))
    cat(paste("  Median rainfall:", round(stats$median_value, 2), "mm\n"))
    cat(paste("  Standard deviation:", round(stats$std_dev, 2), "mm\n"))
    cat(paste("  Range:", round(stats$min_value, 2), "-", round(stats$max_value, 2), "mm\n"))
    cat(paste("  Total grid points:", stats$n_points, "\n"))
    
    # Compare with optimal recommendation
    if(power_value == power_recommendation$optimal_power) {
      cat("✅ This is the RECOMMENDED optimal power!\n")
    } else {
      optimal_stats <- power_recommendation$stats_comparison[
        power_recommendation$stats_comparison$Power == power_value, ]
      if(nrow(optimal_stats) > 0) {
        cat(paste("📊 Optimization score:", round(optimal_stats$total_score, 3), 
                  "(lower is better)\n"))
        cat(paste("📈 Ranking:", optimal_stats$rank, "out of", 
                  nrow(power_recommendation$stats_comparison), "\n"))
      }
    }
    
    return(result)
  }
  
  # Create power comparison function
  compare_powers <- function(power1, power2) {
    result1 <- explore_power(power1)
    result2 <- explore_power(power2)
    
    if(is.null(result1) || is.null(result2)) return(NULL)
    
    cat("\n⚖️ POWER COMPARISON:", power1, "vs", power2, "\n")
    cat("=====================================\n")
    
    stats1 <- result1$stats
    stats2 <- result2$stats
    
    comparisons <- data.frame(
      Metric = c("Mean", "Std Dev", "Range", "Min", "Max"),
      Power1 = c(stats1$mean_value, stats1$std_dev, 
                stats1$max_value - stats1$min_value, stats1$min_value, stats1$max_value),
      Power2 = c(stats2$mean_value, stats2$std_dev,
                stats2$max_value - stats2$min_value, stats2$min_value, stats2$max_value),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    comparisons$Difference <- comparisons$Power2 - comparisons$Power1
    comparisons$Percent_Change <- (comparisons$Difference / comparisons$Power1) * 100
    
    names(comparisons)[2:3] <- paste0("Power_", c(power1, power2))
    
    print(round(comparisons, 2))
    
    cat("\nInterpretation:\n")
    if(power1 < power2) {
      cat(paste("  Power", power2, "(higher) will produce smoother interpolation\n"))
      cat(paste("  Power", power1, "(lower) will have sharper transitions\n"))
    } else {
      cat(paste("  Power", power1, "(higher) will produce smoother interpolation\n"))
      cat(paste("  Power", power2, "(lower) will have sharper transitions\n"))
    }
    
    return(comparisons)
  }
  
  return(list(
    explore_power = explore_power,
    compare_powers = compare_powers,
    optimal_power = power_recommendation$optimal_power,
    available_powers = as.numeric(names(multi_power_result$power_results))
  ))
}

# Function to create power sensitivity analysis
create_power_sensitivity_report <- function(complete_analysis_result) {
  
  cat("📈 Creating power sensitivity analysis report...\n")
  
  power_stats <- complete_analysis_result$power_stats$stats_df
  power_recommendation <- complete_analysis_result$power_recommendation
  target_month <- complete_analysis_result$multi_power_result$target_year_month
  
  # Calculate sensitivity metrics
  sensitivity_analysis <- power_stats %>%
    arrange(Power) %>%
    mutate(
      # Calculate rate of change between consecutive power values
      mean_change_rate = c(NA, diff(Mean_Value) / diff(Power)),
      range_change_rate = c(NA, diff(Range) / diff(Power)),
      std_change_rate = c(NA, diff(Std_Dev) / diff(Power)),
      
      # Classify sensitivity
      sensitivity_level = case_when(
        abs(mean_change_rate) < 1 ~ "Low",
        abs(mean_change_rate) < 5 ~ "Moderate", 
        TRUE ~ "High"
      )
    )
  
  # Find power ranges with different sensitivity levels
  low_sensitivity <- sensitivity_analysis %>% 
    filter(sensitivity_level == "Low" | is.na(sensitivity_level))
  moderate_sensitivity <- sensitivity_analysis %>% 
    filter(sensitivity_level == "Moderate")
  high_sensitivity <- sensitivity_analysis %>% 
    filter(sensitivity_level == "High")
  
  # Generate report
  report_text <- paste(
    "POWER SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS REPORT",
    "=================================",
    paste("Analysis Date:", Sys.Date()),
    paste("Target Month:", target_month),
    paste("Number of Power Values Tested:", nrow(power_stats)),
    "",
    "SENSITIVITY SUMMARY:",
    paste("  Recommended Optimal Power:", power_recommendation$optimal_power),
    paste("  Power Range Tested:", min(power_stats$Power), "-", max(power_stats$Power)),
    "",
    "SENSITIVITY LEVELS:",
    paste("  Low Sensitivity Powers:", 
          ifelse(nrow(low_sensitivity) > 0, 
                 paste(low_sensitivity$Power, collapse = ", "), 
                 "None")),
    paste("  Moderate Sensitivity Powers:", 
          ifelse(nrow(moderate_sensitivity) > 0, 
                 paste(moderate_sensitivity$Power, collapse = ", "), 
                 "None")),
    paste("  High Sensitivity Powers:", 
          ifelse(nrow(high_sensitivity) > 0, 
                 paste(high_sensitivity$Power, collapse = ", "), 
                 "None")),
    "",
    "RECOMMENDATIONS:",
    sep = "\n"
  )
  
  # Add specific recommendations based on sensitivity
  if(nrow(low_sensitivity) > 0) {
    stable_range <- paste(round(min(low_sensitivity$Power, na.rm = TRUE), 1), 
                         "-", round(max(low_sensitivity$Power, na.rm = TRUE), 1))
    report_text <- paste(report_text,
      paste("  ✅ Stable Range:", stable_range, "- Results are less sensitive to power changes"),
      sep = "\n")
  }
  
  if(power_recommendation$optimal_power %in% moderate_sensitivity$Power) {
    report_text <- paste(report_text,
      "  ⚠️  Optimal power is in moderate sensitivity range - small changes may affect results",
      sep = "\n")
  }
  
  if(power_recommendation$optimal_power %in% high_sensitivity$Power) {
    report_text <- paste(report_text,
      "  ⚠️  Optimal power is in high sensitivity range - consider nearby stable values",
      sep = "\n")
  }
  
  # Add interpretation guidelines
  report_text <- paste(report_text, 
    "",
    "INTERPRETATION GUIDELINES:",
    "  • Low sensitivity: Safe to use, robust results",
    "  • Moderate sensitivity: Good choice, monitor parameter selection", 
    "  • High sensitivity: Use with caution, validate results",
    "",
    "TECHNICAL DETAILS:",
    paste("  • Mean rainfall varies by", 
          round(max(power_stats$Mean_Value) - min(power_stats$Mean_Value), 1), 
          "mm across all powers"),
    paste("  • Range varies by", 
          round(max(power_stats$Range) - min(power_stats$Range), 1), 
          "mm across all powers"),
    paste("  • Most stable metric:", 
          names(power_stats)[which.min(apply(power_stats[,c("Mean_Value", "Range", "Std_Dev")], 2, sd))]),
    sep = "\n"
  )
  
  cat("✅ Sensitivity analysis completed\n")
  
  return(list(
    report_text = report_text,
    sensitivity_data = sensitivity_analysis,
    stable_powers = low_sensitivity$Power,
    sensitive_powers = high_sensitivity$Power,
    optimal_power_sensitivity = power_recommendation$optimal_power %in% 
      c(low_sensitivity$Power, moderate_sensitivity$Power, high_sensitivity$Power)
  ))
}
```
