## VII.8. Monthly Spatial Interpolation using Real GPS Station Coordinates - Matérn Kriging

```{r}
# Monthly Spatial Interpolation using Real GPS Station Coordinates
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(gstat)        # For Kriging
library(sp)           # Spatial data handling
library(sf)           # Modern spatial data
library(terra)        # Replaces deprecated raster package
library(viridis)      # Color palettes
library(gridExtra)    # Multiple plots
library(lubridate)    # Date handling
library(RColorBrewer) # Additional color palettes
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# Install and load required packages
install_and_load <- function(packages) {
  new_packages <- packages[!(packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
  if(length(new_packages)) {
    cat("Installing packages:", paste(new_packages, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    install.packages(new_packages, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
  sapply(packages, function(x) {
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(x, character.only = TRUE))
  })
}

required_packages <- c("gstat", "sp", "sf", "terra", "viridis", "gridExtra", "stringdist")
install_and_load(required_packages)

# Function to load GPS station coordinates from shapefile
load_gps_station_coordinates <- function(shapefile_path = "Pts_GPS_Station_English.shp") {
  cat("📍 Loading GPS station coordinates from shapefile...\n")
  
  if(!file.exists(shapefile_path)) {
    stop(paste("Shapefile not found:", shapefile_path, 
               "\nPlease make sure the shapefile and associated files (.shx, .dbf, .prj) are in the working directory."))
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    # Load the shapefile
    gps_stations <- st_read(shapefile_path, quiet = TRUE)
    
    # Check the structure
    cat("   📊 Shapefile loaded successfully\n")
    cat("   📋 Number of GPS stations:", nrow(gps_stations), "\n")
    cat("   📋 Columns available:", paste(colnames(gps_stations), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    
    # Check if required columns exist
    if(!"Sites" %in% colnames(gps_stations)) {
      stop("Column 'Sites' not found in shapefile. Available columns: ", paste(colnames(gps_stations), collapse = ", "))
    }
    
    # Transform to UTM 28N for kriging
    cat("   🔄 Transforming to UTM 28N (EPSG:32628) for kriging...\n")
    gps_stations_utm <- st_transform(gps_stations, crs = 32628)
    coords <- st_coordinates(gps_stations_utm)
    
    # Create coordinates dataframe
    coordinates_df <- data.frame(
      Station = as.character(gps_stations$Sites),  # Use Sites column as station names
      X_UTM = coords[,1],  # UTM X coordinate
      Y_UTM = coords[,2],  # UTM Y coordinate
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    # Add WGS84 coordinates for display purposes
    coords_wgs84 <- st_coordinates(st_transform(gps_stations_utm, 4326))
    coordinates_df$Longitude <- coords_wgs84[,1]
    coordinates_df$Latitude <- coords_wgs84[,2]
    
    # Add additional information if available
    if("Station_ty" %in% colnames(gps_stations)) {
      coordinates_df$Station_Type <- as.character(gps_stations$Station_ty)
    }
    
    # Add elevation if available
    if("Elevation" %in% colnames(gps_stations)) {
      coordinates_df$Elevation_m <- as.numeric(gps_stations$Elevation)
    } else if("ELEV" %in% colnames(gps_stations)) {
      coordinates_df$Elevation_m <- as.numeric(gps_stations$ELEV)
    } else {
      coordinates_df$Elevation_m <- NA
    }
    
    # Remove any rows with missing coordinates or station names
    initial_count <- nrow(coordinates_df)
    coordinates_df <- coordinates_df %>%
      filter(!is.na(Station) & Station != "" & 
             !is.na(X_UTM) & !is.na(Y_UTM) &
             is.finite(X_UTM) & is.finite(Y_UTM))
    
    if(nrow(coordinates_df) < initial_count) {
      cat("   ⚠️ Removed", initial_count - nrow(coordinates_df), "rows with missing/invalid data\n")
    }
    
    # Summary information
    cat("   📍 UTM 28N coordinate ranges:\n")
    cat("      X (Easting):", round(min(coordinates_df$X_UTM, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "to", 
        round(max(coordinates_df$X_UTM, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "m\n")
    cat("      Y (Northing):", round(min(coordinates_df$Y_UTM, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "to", 
        round(max(coordinates_df$Y_UTM, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "m\n")
    
    # Show unique station types if available
    if("Station_Type" %in% colnames(coordinates_df)) {
      station_types <- table(coordinates_df$Station_Type, useNA = "ifany")
      cat("   📋 Station types:\n")
      for(i in 1:length(station_types)) {
        cat("      ", names(station_types)[i], ":", station_types[i], "\n")
      }
    }
    
    # Show sample of station names
    cat("   📝 Sample station names (first 10):\n")
    sample_names <- head(coordinates_df$Station, 10)
    cat("      ", paste(sample_names, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    
    cat("   ✅ GPS coordinates loaded and transformed to UTM 28N successfully!\n")
    
    return(coordinates_df)
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop(paste("Error loading GPS shapefile:", e$message))
  })
}

# Function to load and aggregate monthly rainfall data
load_and_aggregate_monthly_data <- function(datasets_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets") {
  cat("📥 Loading and aggregating your real combined rainfall datasets to monthly...\n")
  
  if(!dir.exists(datasets_dir)) {
    stop(paste("Directory not found:", datasets_dir, 
               "\nPlease make sure you have run the enhanced time series script first."))
  }
  
  # Get all CSV files in the directory
  csv_files <- list.files(datasets_dir, pattern = "^combined_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  if(length(csv_files) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No combined CSV files found in:", datasets_dir))
  }
  
  monthly_data_list <- list()
  
  for(file in csv_files) {
    # Extract station name from filename
    filename <- basename(file)
    # Remove "combined_" prefix and "_2000_2025.csv" suffix
    station_name <- gsub("^combined_", "", filename)
    station_name <- gsub("_2000_2025\\.csv$", "", station_name)
    
    # Load the data
    tryCatch({
      daily_data <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
        mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))
      
      # Aggregate to monthly data
      monthly_data <- daily_data %>%
        mutate(
          Year = year(Date),
          Month = month(Date),
          YearMonth = floor_date(Date, "month")
        ) %>%
        group_by(Station = station_name, Year, Month, YearMonth) %>%
        summarise(
          # Monthly totals for rainfall
          monthly_rainfall = sum(combined_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
          monthly_original = sum(original_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
          monthly_chirps = sum(chirps_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
          
          # Count of valid days
          valid_days = sum(!is.na(combined_rainfall)),
          total_days = n(),
          data_completeness = valid_days / total_days,
          
          # Dominant data source for the month
          dominant_source = names(sort(table(data_source), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
          
          # First and last date of month
          month_start = min(Date, na.rm = TRUE),
          month_end = max(Date, na.rm = TRUE),
          
          .groups = 'drop'
        ) %>%
        # Only keep months with reasonable data completeness (at least 50% of days)
        filter(data_completeness >= 0.5 & valid_days >= 10) %>%
        # Convert 0 totals to NA if no valid data
        mutate(
          monthly_rainfall = ifelse(valid_days == 0, NA, monthly_rainfall),
          monthly_original = ifelse(monthly_original == 0 & valid_days > 0, NA, monthly_original),
          monthly_chirps = ifelse(monthly_chirps == 0 & valid_days > 0, NA, monthly_chirps)
        )
      
      monthly_data_list[[station_name]] <- monthly_data
      cat(paste("   ✅ Loaded and aggregated", station_name, ":", 
                nrow(daily_data), "daily →", nrow(monthly_data), "monthly records\n"))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(paste("   ❌ Failed to process", filename, ":", e$message, "\n"))
    })
  }
  
  if(length(monthly_data_list) == 0) {
    stop("No datasets were successfully processed")
  }
  
  cat("✅ Successfully processed", length(monthly_data_list), "station datasets to monthly\n")
  
  # Create summary of available months across all stations
  all_months <- map_dfr(monthly_data_list, ~select(.x, Station, YearMonth, valid_days, data_completeness)) %>%
    group_by(YearMonth) %>%
    summarise(
      stations_available = n(),
      avg_completeness = mean(data_completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_valid_days = min(valid_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(stations_available), desc(avg_completeness))
  
  cat("\n📊 Monthly data availability summary (top 10 months):\n")
  print(head(all_months, 10))
  
  return(list(
    monthly_data = monthly_data_list,
    availability_summary = all_months
  ))
}

# Function to match rainfall stations with GPS coordinates
match_rainfall_with_gps <- function(monthly_data_list, gps_coordinates, 
                                   similarity_threshold = 0.8, manual_matches = NULL) {
  cat("🔗 Matching rainfall station names with GPS station sites...\n")
  
  # Get rainfall station names
  rainfall_stations <- names(monthly_data_list)
  gps_sites <- gps_coordinates$Station
  
  cat("   📊 Rainfall stations:", length(rainfall_stations), "\n")
  cat("   📍 GPS stations:", length(gps_sites), "\n")
  
  # Initialize matching results
  matched_pairs <- data.frame(
    Rainfall_Station = character(),
    GPS_Station = character(),
    Match_Type = character(),
    Match_Score = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # 1. Exact matches (case-insensitive)
  cat("\n   🎯 Looking for exact matches...\n")
  exact_matches <- 0
  for(rainfall_station in rainfall_stations) {
    exact_match <- gps_sites[tolower(gps_sites) == tolower(rainfall_station)]
    if(length(exact_match) > 0) {
      matched_pairs <- rbind(matched_pairs, data.frame(
        Rainfall_Station = rainfall_station,
        GPS_Station = exact_match[1],
        Match_Type = "Exact",
        Match_Score = 1.0
      ))
      exact_matches <- exact_matches + 1
      cat(paste("      ✅", rainfall_station, "→", exact_match[1], "\n"))
    }
  }
  cat(paste("      Found", exact_matches, "exact matches\n"))
  
  # 2. Apply manual matches if provided
  if(!is.null(manual_matches)) {
    cat("\n   👥 Applying manual matches...\n")
    manual_count <- 0
    for(i in 1:nrow(manual_matches)) {
      rainfall_name <- manual_matches$rainfall_station[i]
      gps_name <- manual_matches$gps_station[i]
      
      # Check if both stations exist and aren't already matched
      if(rainfall_name %in% rainfall_stations && gps_name %in% gps_sites &&
         !rainfall_name %in% matched_pairs$Rainfall_Station) {
        matched_pairs <- rbind(matched_pairs, data.frame(
          Rainfall_Station = rainfall_name,
          GPS_Station = gps_name,
          Match_Type = "Manual",
          Match_Score = 1.0
        ))
        manual_count <- manual_count + 1
        cat(paste("      👤", rainfall_name, "→", gps_name, "\n"))
      }
    }
    cat(paste("      Applied", manual_count, "manual matches\n"))
  }
  
  # 3. Fuzzy matching for remaining stations
  cat(paste("\n   🔍 Looking for fuzzy matches (threshold:", similarity_threshold, ")...\n"))
  
  unmatched_rainfall <- rainfall_stations[!rainfall_stations %in% matched_pairs$Rainfall_Station]
  matched_gps <- matched_pairs$GPS_Station
  unmatched_gps <- gps_sites[!gps_sites %in% matched_gps]
  
  fuzzy_matches <- 0
  for(rainfall_station in unmatched_rainfall) {
    # Calculate string similarities
    similarities <- 1 - stringdist(tolower(rainfall_station), tolower(unmatched_gps), method = "jw")
    best_match_idx <- which.max(similarities)
    best_similarity <- similarities[best_match_idx]
    
    if(best_similarity >= similarity_threshold) {
      best_gps_station <- unmatched_gps[best_match_idx]
      matched_pairs <- rbind(matched_pairs, data.frame(
        Rainfall_Station = rainfall_station,
        GPS_Station = best_gps_station,
        Match_Type = "Fuzzy",
        Match_Score = round(best_similarity, 3)
      ))
      # Remove from unmatched
      unmatched_gps <- unmatched_gps[-best_match_idx]
      fuzzy_matches <- fuzzy_matches + 1
      cat(paste("      🔍", rainfall_station, "→", best_gps_station, 
                "(score:", round(best_similarity, 3), ")\n"))
    }
  }
  cat(paste("      Found", fuzzy_matches, "fuzzy matches\n"))
  
  # 4. Summary of matching results
  total_matches <- nrow(matched_pairs)
  unmatched_rainfall_final <- rainfall_stations[!rainfall_stations %in% matched_pairs$Rainfall_Station]
  unmatched_gps_final <- gps_sites[!gps_sites %in% matched_pairs$GPS_Station]
  
  cat("\n   📊 MATCHING SUMMARY:\n")
  cat(paste("      ✅ Successfully matched:", total_matches, "out of", length(rainfall_stations), "rainfall stations\n"))
  cat(paste("      📈 Matching rate:", round(total_matches/length(rainfall_stations)*100, 1), "%\n"))
  cat(paste("      🎯 Exact matches:", sum(matched_pairs$Match_Type == "Exact"), "\n"))
  if(!is.null(manual_matches)) {
    cat(paste("      👥 Manual matches:", sum(matched_pairs$Match_Type == "Manual"), "\n"))
  }
  cat(paste("      🔍 Fuzzy matches:", sum(matched_pairs$Match_Type == "Fuzzy"), "\n"))
  
  # Show unmatched stations
  if(length(unmatched_rainfall_final) > 0) {
    cat("\n   ⚠️ UNMATCHED RAINFALL STATIONS:\n")
    cat("      ", paste(unmatched_rainfall_final, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  
  if(length(unmatched_gps_final) > 0) {
    cat("\n   📍 UNMATCHED GPS STATIONS:\n")
    cat("      ", paste(head(unmatched_gps_final, 10), collapse = ", "))
    if(length(unmatched_gps_final) > 10) cat(", ...")
    cat("\n")
  }
  
  # Create final coordinates dataframe with only matched stations
  if(total_matches > 0) {
    final_coordinates <- matched_pairs %>%
      left_join(gps_coordinates, by = c("GPS_Station" = "Station")) %>%
      select(Station = Rainfall_Station, X_UTM, Y_UTM, Longitude, Latitude,
             GPS_Station, Match_Type, Match_Score, everything()) %>%
      filter(!is.na(X_UTM) & !is.na(Y_UTM))
    
    cat(paste("\n   ✅ Final dataset:", nrow(final_coordinates), "stations with UTM coordinates\n"))
    return(list(
      coordinates = final_coordinates,
      matching_summary = matched_pairs,
      unmatched_rainfall = unmatched_rainfall_final,
      unmatched_gps = unmatched_gps_final
    ))
  } else {
    stop("No stations could be matched between rainfall data and GPS coordinates")
  }
}

# Function to prepare monthly spatial data with GPS coordinates
prepare_monthly_spatial_data_with_gps <- function(monthly_data_list, matched_coordinates, target_year_month) {
  target_date <- as.Date(paste0(target_year_month, "-01"))
  target_ym <- floor_date(target_date, "month")
  
  cat(paste("📊 Preparing monthly spatial data with GPS UTM coordinates for", format(target_ym, "%Y-%m"), "...\n"))
  
  # Only use stations that have coordinates
  available_stations <- matched_coordinates$coordinates$Station
  
  # Extract data for the target month from matched stations
  spatial_data <- map_dfr(available_stations, function(station_name) {
    station_data <- monthly_data_list[[station_name]]
    
    if(is.null(station_data) || nrow(station_data) == 0) {
      return(data.frame(Station = station_name, Monthly_Precipitation = NA, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
    
    # Find target month data
    target_row <- station_data %>% 
      filter(YearMonth == target_ym) %>%
      slice(1)
    
    if(nrow(target_row) > 0 && !is.na(target_row$monthly_rainfall)) {
      data.frame(
        Station = station_name,
        Monthly_Precipitation = as.numeric(target_row$monthly_rainfall),
        Monthly_Original = as.numeric(target_row$monthly_original %||% NA),
        Monthly_CHIRPS = as.numeric(target_row$monthly_chirps %||% NA),
        Data_Source = as.character(target_row$dominant_source %||% "Unknown"),
        Valid_Days = as.numeric(target_row$valid_days),
        Data_Completeness = as.numeric(target_row$data_completeness),
        Year = as.numeric(target_row$Year),
        Month = as.numeric(target_row$Month),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      data.frame(
        Station = station_name,
        Monthly_Precipitation = NA,
        Monthly_Original = NA,
        Monthly_CHIRPS = NA,
        Data_Source = "Missing",
        Valid_Days = 0,
        Data_Completeness = 0,
        Year = year(target_ym),
        Month = month(target_ym),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  })
  
  # Join with GPS coordinates (UTM)
  spatial_data <- spatial_data %>%
    left_join(matched_coordinates$coordinates %>% select(Station, X_UTM, Y_UTM, Longitude, Latitude, GPS_Station, Match_Type, Match_Score), 
              by = "Station") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Monthly_Precipitation) & !is.na(X_UTM) & !is.na(Y_UTM) & 
           is.finite(Monthly_Precipitation) & is.finite(X_UTM) & is.finite(Y_UTM) &
           Monthly_Precipitation >= 0)  # Remove negative rainfall values
  
  cat(paste("   📍 Stations with valid monthly data and GPS UTM coordinates:", nrow(spatial_data), 
            "out of", length(monthly_data_list), "total rainfall stations\n"))
  
  if(nrow(spatial_data) < 3) {
    # Show available months
    available_months <- map(monthly_data_list, ~unique(.x$YearMonth)) %>% 
      unlist() %>% unique() %>% sort()
    
    cat("❌ Insufficient data points for Kriging interpolation\n")
    cat("Available months in your dataset:\n")
    cat(paste(format(head(available_months, 10), "%Y-%m"), collapse = ", "))
    if(length(available_months) > 10) cat(", ...")
    cat("\n")
    
    stop(paste("Found only", nrow(spatial_data), "valid data points for", format(target_ym, "%Y-%m"), 
               ". Need at least 3 stations with data."))
  }
  
  # Summary of data sources and matching types
  source_summary <- spatial_data %>% 
    group_by(Data_Source) %>%
    summarise(
      n_stations = n(),
      avg_completeness = mean(Data_Completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_valid_days = mean(Valid_Days, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_stations))
  
  match_summary <- spatial_data %>%
    group_by(Match_Type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_stations = n(),
      avg_match_score = mean(Match_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_stations))
  
  cat("   📊 Monthly data sources summary:\n")
  for(i in 1:nrow(source_summary)) {
    cat(paste("      ", source_summary$Data_Source[i], ":", source_summary$n_stations[i], 
              "stations (", round(source_summary$avg_completeness[i]*100, 1), "% complete,",
              round(source_summary$avg_valid_days[i], 1), "valid days avg)\n"))
  }
  
  cat("   🔗 Station matching summary:\n")
  for(i in 1:nrow(match_summary)) {
    cat(paste("      ", match_summary$Match_Type[i], "matches:", match_summary$n_stations[i], 
              "stations (avg score:", round(match_summary$avg_match_score[i], 3), ")\n"))
  }
  
  # Rainfall statistics
  cat("   🌧️ Monthly rainfall statistics:\n")
  cat(paste("      Range:", round(min(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "-", 
            round(max(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "mm\n"))
  cat(paste("      Mean:", round(mean(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "mm\n"))
  cat(paste("      Median:", round(median(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "mm\n"))
  
  return(spatial_data)
}

# Function to create spatial points for Kriging (UTM projected)
create_spatial_points_utm <- function(spatial_data) {
  sp_data <- spatial_data
  coordinates(sp_data) <- ~X_UTM + Y_UTM
  proj4string(sp_data) <- CRS("+proj=utm +zone=28 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")
  return(sp_data)
}

# Function to create prediction grid in UTM coordinates
create_prediction_grid_utm <- function(spatial_data, resolution = 1000, buffer_percent = 0.05) {
  # Calculate bounds from UTM coordinates
  x_min <- min(spatial_data$X_UTM, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_max <- max(spatial_data$X_UTM, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(spatial_data$Y_UTM, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(spatial_data$Y_UTM, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Calculate ranges
  x_range <- x_max - x_min
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  
  # Calculate dynamic buffer
  buffer_x <- x_range * buffer_percent
  buffer_y <- y_range * buffer_percent
  
  # Apply buffer
  xmin <- x_min - buffer_x
  xmax <- x_max + buffer_x
  ymin <- y_min - buffer_y
  ymax <- y_max + buffer_y
  
  cat(paste("🗺️ Creating UTM prediction grid with dynamic buffer:\n"))
  cat(paste("   📍 Original extent - X:", round(x_min, 0), "to", round(x_max, 0), "m\n"))
  cat(paste("   📍 Original extent - Y:", round(y_min, 0), "to", round(y_max, 0), "m\n"))
  cat(paste("   📏 X range:", round(x_range, 0), "m | Buffer:", round(buffer_x, 0), "m\n"))
  cat(paste("   📏 Y range:", round(y_range, 0), "m | Buffer:", round(buffer_y, 0), "m\n"))
  cat(paste("   📍 Final extent - X:", round(xmin, 0), "to", round(xmax, 0), "m\n"))
  cat(paste("   📍 Final extent - Y:", round(ymin, 0), "to", round(ymax, 0), "m\n"))
  cat(paste("   📏 Grid resolution:", resolution, "meters\n"))
  
  # Create sequences
  x_seq <- seq(xmin, xmax, by = resolution)
  y_seq <- seq(ymin, ymax, by = resolution)
  
  # Create grid
  grid_df <- expand.grid(X_UTM = x_seq, Y_UTM = y_seq)
  coordinates(grid_df) <- ~X_UTM + Y_UTM
  gridded(grid_df) <- TRUE
  proj4string(grid_df) <- CRS("+proj=utm +zone=28 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")
  
  cat(paste("   ✅ UTM grid created:", length(x_seq), "x", length(y_seq), "=", length(x_seq) * length(y_seq), "points\n"))
  
  return(grid_df)
}

# Function to perform Matérn Kriging
perform_matern_kriging <- function(spatial_points, prediction_grid, model = "Mat") {
  tryCatch({
    cat("🎯 Performing monthly Matérn Kriging interpolation...\n")
    cat("   Model:", model, "\n")
    
    # Fit variogram
    cat("   📊 Fitting experimental variogram...\n")
    vgm_emp <- variogram(Monthly_Precipitation ~ 1, spatial_points)
    
    # Fit Matérn model
    cat("   🔧 Fitting Matérn variogram model...\n")
    vgm_fit <- fit.variogram(vgm_emp, vgm(model = model))
    
    # Display variogram parameters
    cat("   📈 Variogram parameters:\n")
    cat(paste("      Nugget:", round(vgm_fit$psill[1], 2), "\n"))
    if(nrow(vgm_fit) > 1) {
      cat(paste("      Partial Sill:", round(vgm_fit$psill[2], 2), "\n"))
      cat(paste("      Range:", round(vgm_fit$range[2], 0), "m\n"))
    }
    
    # Perform kriging
    cat("   🎯 Performing Matérn Kriging...\n")
    kriging_result <- krige(Monthly_Precipitation ~ 1, 
                           spatial_points, 
                           prediction_grid, 
                           model = vgm_fit)
    
    cat("✅ Matérn Kriging completed successfully!\n")
    
    return(list(
      kriging_result = kriging_result,
      variogram_emp = vgm_emp,
      variogram_fit = vgm_fit,
      model = model
    ))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ Kriging failed:", e$message, "\n")
    stop(paste("Kriging interpolation failed:", e$message))
  })
}

# FIXED: Enhanced function to create monthly Kriging interpolation map
create_enhanced_monthly_kriging_map_with_gps <- function(kriging_result, spatial_points, target_year_month, 
                                                        title_prefix = "Monthly Rainfall Interpolation with GPS Coordinates") {
  # Convert Kriging result to dataframe and transform back to WGS84 for visualization
  kriging_sp <- kriging_result$kriging_result
  kriging_wgs84 <- spTransform(kriging_sp, CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"))
  kriging_df <- as.data.frame(kriging_wgs84)
  
  # Transform spatial points to WGS84 for visualization
  points_wgs84 <- spTransform(spatial_points, CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"))
  points_df <- as.data.frame(points_wgs84)
  
  # Debug: check column names and data
  cat("   📊 Kriging dataframe columns:", paste(names(kriging_df), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("   📊 Kriging dataframe rows before filtering:", nrow(kriging_df), "\n")
  
  # FIXED: Properly handle column names without renaming coordinate columns
  # The issue was that we were renaming coordinate columns before checking for prediction columns
  
  # First, identify and verify the prediction column exists
  pred_col <- if("var1.pred" %in% names(kriging_df)) {
    "var1.pred"
  } else if(any(grepl("pred", names(kriging_df)))) {
    names(kriging_df)[grepl("pred", names(kriging_df))][1]
  } else {
    stop("No prediction column found in kriging results")
  }
  
  # Identify variance column
  var_col <- if("var1.var" %in% names(kriging_df)) {
    "var1.var"
  } else if(any(grepl("var", names(kriging_df)))) {
    names(kriging_df)[grepl("var", names(kriging_df))][1]
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  
  cat("   📊 Using prediction column:", pred_col, "\n")
  if(!is.null(var_col)) {
    cat("   📊 Using variance column:", var_col, "\n")
  }
  cat("   📊 Sample prediction values:", paste(head(kriging_df[[pred_col]], 3), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Filter valid predictions BEFORE renaming columns
  kriging_df <- kriging_df %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[pred_col]]) & !is.na(.data[[pred_col]]) & .data[[pred_col]] >= 0)
  
  cat("   📊 Kriging dataframe rows after filtering:", nrow(kriging_df), "\n")
  
  if(nrow(kriging_df) == 0) {
    stop("No valid prediction values for mapping")
  }
  
  # Now safely rename coordinate columns to standard names
  # Find coordinate columns (should be first two columns or coords.x1, coords.x2)
  coord_cols <- names(kriging_df)[1:2]
  if(any(grepl("coords", names(kriging_df)))) {
    coord_cols <- names(kriging_df)[grepl("coords", names(kriging_df))]
  }
  
  # Rename coordinate columns to Longitude and Latitude
  names(kriging_df)[names(kriging_df) == coord_cols[1]] <- "Longitude"
  names(kriging_df)[names(kriging_df) == coord_cols[2]] <- "Latitude"
  
  # Standardize prediction and variance column names
  if(pred_col != "var1.pred") {
    names(kriging_df)[names(kriging_df) == pred_col] <- "var1.pred"
  }
  
  if(!is.null(var_col) && var_col != "var1.var") {
    names(kriging_df)[names(kriging_df) == var_col] <- "var1.var"
  }
  
  # Final verification
  if(!"var1.pred" %in% names(kriging_df)) {
    stop(paste("Prediction column lost during processing. Current columns:", paste(names(kriging_df), collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  cat("   ✅ Ready for plotting with", nrow(kriging_df), "valid prediction points\n")
  cat("   📊 Final column names:", paste(names(kriging_df), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Create the map
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Add interpolated surface
    geom_tile(data = kriging_df, 
              aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = var1.pred),
              alpha = 0.8) +
    
    # Add contour lines
    {if(nrow(kriging_df) > 50) {
      geom_contour(data = kriging_df, 
                  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, z = var1.pred),
                  color = "white", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4, bins = 8)
    }} +
    
    # Add station points colored by data source and shaped by match type
    geom_point(data = points_df, 
               aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, 
                   size = Monthly_Precipitation,
                   shape = Match_Type,
                   color = Data_Source,
                   alpha = Data_Completeness),
               stroke = 1.2) +
    
    # Add station labels with GPS station names
    geom_text(data = points_df,
              aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, 
                  label = paste0(Station, "\n(", GPS_Station, ")")),
              color = "white", size = 2, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -2.2,
              fontface = "bold") +
    
    # Styling
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Kriged\nMonthly Rainfall\n(mm)", 
                        option = "plasma",
                        na.value = "transparent",
                        trans = "sqrt") +
    
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Observed\nMonthly (mm)", 
                         range = c(2, 8),
                         trans = "sqrt") +
    
    scale_alpha_continuous(name = "Data\nCompleteness", 
                          range = c(0.5, 1.0),
                          labels = scales::percent) +
    
    scale_color_manual(name = "Data Source",
                      values = c("Original" = "#2E86AB", 
                                "CHIRPS" = "#E74C3C", 
                                "Unknown" = "#34495E"),
                      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1))) +
    
    scale_shape_manual(name = "Match Type",
                      values = c("Exact" = 16, "Fuzzy" = 17, "Manual" = 15)) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste(title_prefix, "- Monthly Matérn Kriging"),
      subtitle = paste("Month:", target_year_month, "| Matérn Model | UTM 28N projection used | Labels show: Rainfall_Station (GPS_Station)"),
      x = "Longitude (°E)",
      y = "Latitude (°N)",
      caption = "Points show monthly observed values at GPS coordinates, surface shows Matérn Kriging interpolated monthly rainfall"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
      legend.box = "vertical"
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to create variogram plot
create_variogram_plot <- function(kriging_results, target_year_month) {
  vgm_emp <- kriging_results$variogram_emp
  vgm_fit <- kriging_results$variogram_fit
  
  # Create fitted variogram values for plotting
  max_dist <- max(vgm_emp$dist)
  dist_seq <- seq(0, max_dist, length.out = 100)
  
  # Calculate fitted values
  fitted_values <- variogramLine(vgm_fit, dist_vector = dist_seq)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Empirical variogram
    geom_point(data = vgm_emp, aes(x = dist, y = gamma, size = np), 
               color = "#E74C3C", alpha = 0.7) +
    
    # Fitted variogram
    geom_line(data = fitted_values, aes(x = dist, y = gamma), 
              color = "#2E86AB", linewidth = 1.2) +
    
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Number of\nPairs", range = c(1, 5)) +
    
    labs(
      title = "Empirical and Fitted Matérn Variogram",
      subtitle = paste("Month:", target_year_month, "| Model:", kriging_results$model),
      x = "Distance (m)",
      y = "Semivariance",
      caption = "Red points: empirical variogram, Blue line: fitted Matérn model"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "gray50"),
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to create monthly distance analysis plot with GPS info
create_monthly_distance_analysis_with_gps <- function(spatial_points, target_year_month) {
  points_df <- as.data.frame(spatial_points)
  
  # Calculate distance matrix in UTM (meters)
  coords <- points_df[, c("X_UTM", "Y_UTM")]
  dist_matrix <- as.matrix(dist(coords))
  
  # Create distance vs monthly precipitation difference analysis
  distances <- c()
  precip_diffs <- c()
  source_pairs <- c()
  match_pairs <- c()
  completeness_pairs <- c()
  
  for(i in 1:(nrow(points_df)-1)) {
    for(j in (i+1):nrow(points_df)) {
      distances <- c(distances, dist_matrix[i,j])
      precip_diffs <- c(precip_diffs, abs(points_df$Monthly_Precipitation[i] - points_df$Monthly_Precipitation[j]))
      
      # Data source pairs
      pair_sources <- paste(sort(c(points_df$Data_Source[i], points_df$Data_Source[j])), collapse = "-")
      source_pairs <- c(source_pairs, pair_sources)
      
      # Match type pairs
      pair_matches <- paste(sort(c(points_df$Match_Type[i], points_df$Match_Type[j])), collapse = "-")
      match_pairs <- c(match_pairs, pair_matches)
      
      completeness_pairs <- c(completeness_pairs, 
                            min(points_df$Data_Completeness[i], points_df$Data_Completeness[j]))
    }
  }
  
  analysis_df <- data.frame(
    Distance = distances,
    Monthly_Precipitation_Difference = precip_diffs,
    Source_Pair = source_pairs,
    Match_Pair = match_pairs,
    Min_Completeness = completeness_pairs
  )
  
  # Create scatter plot with trend line
  p <- ggplot(analysis_df, aes(x = Distance, y = Monthly_Precipitation_Difference, 
                              color = Match_Pair, size = Min_Completeness)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "#34495E", fill = "#34495E", alpha = 0.2) +
    scale_color_brewer(name = "Station Pair\nMatch Types", type = "qual", palette = "Set2") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Min Data\nCompleteness", 
                         range = c(1, 4),
                         labels = scales::percent) +
    labs(
      title = "Distance vs Monthly Rainfall Difference Analysis (UTM 28N)",
      subtitle = paste("Month:", target_year_month, "| Spatial autocorrelation with GPS matching info"),
      x = "Distance between GPS stations (meters)",
      y = "Monthly rainfall difference (mm)",
      caption = "Closer GPS stations should have more similar monthly rainfall values"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "gray50"),
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Main function to perform complete monthly Kriging analysis with GPS coordinates
perform_monthly_kriging_analysis_with_gps <- function(monthly_data_list = NULL, target_year_month, 
                                                     gps_coordinates = NULL, shapefile_path = "Pts_GPS_Station_English.shp",
                                                     manual_matches = NULL, similarity_threshold = 0.8,
                                                     resolution = 100, model = "Mat",
                                                     buffer_percent = 0.05,
                                                     datasets_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets") {
  
  cat("🚀 Starting MONTHLY Matérn Kriging interpolation analysis with real GPS coordinates...\n")
  cat("   Target month:", target_year_month, "\n")
  cat("   UTM Zone: 28N (EPSG:32628)\n")
  cat("   Variogram model:", model, "\n")
  cat("   Buffer percentage:", buffer_percent * 100, "%\n")
  
  # Load and aggregate your real data to monthly if not provided
  if(is.null(monthly_data_list)) {
    monthly_result <- load_and_aggregate_monthly_data(datasets_dir)
    monthly_data_list <- monthly_result$monthly_data
  }
  
  # Load GPS coordinates if not provided
  if(is.null(gps_coordinates)) {
    cat("📍 Loading GPS coordinates from shapefile...\n")
    gps_coordinates <- load_gps_station_coordinates(shapefile_path)
  }
  
  # Match rainfall stations with GPS coordinates
  matched_coordinates <- match_rainfall_with_gps(monthly_data_list, gps_coordinates, 
                                               similarity_threshold, manual_matches)
  
  cat("   Number of matched stations:", nrow(matched_coordinates$coordinates), "\n")
  
  # Prepare monthly spatial data with GPS coordinates
  spatial_data <- prepare_monthly_spatial_data_with_gps(monthly_data_list, matched_coordinates, target_year_month)
  
  cat("   Stations with valid monthly data and UTM coordinates:", nrow(spatial_data), "\n")
  cat("   Monthly rainfall range:", 
      round(min(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "-", 
      round(max(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "mm\n")
  
  # Create spatial points in UTM
  spatial_points <- create_spatial_points_utm(spatial_data)
  
  # Create prediction grid in UTM with dynamic buffer
  cat("🗺️ Creating UTM prediction grid based on GPS station locations...\n")
  prediction_grid <- create_prediction_grid_utm(spatial_data, resolution, buffer_percent)
  
  # Perform Matérn Kriging
  kriging_results <- perform_matern_kriging(spatial_points, prediction_grid, model)
  
  # Create enhanced maps with GPS information
  cat("🎨 Creating enhanced monthly visualization maps with GPS info...\n")
  interpolation_map <- create_enhanced_monthly_kriging_map_with_gps(kriging_results, spatial_points, target_year_month, 
                                                                   "Real Monthly Rainfall Data with GPS Coordinates")
  
  # Create variogram plot
  variogram_plot <- create_variogram_plot(kriging_results, target_year_month)
  
  # Create distance analysis
  distance_analysis <- create_monthly_distance_analysis_with_gps(spatial_points, target_year_month)
  
  # Summary statistics with GPS matching info
  kriging_df <- as.data.frame(kriging_results$kriging_result)
  summary_stats <- list(
    target_year_month = target_year_month,
    n_stations = nrow(spatial_data),
    n_matched_stations = nrow(matched_coordinates$coordinates),
    n_original_stations = sum(spatial_data$Data_Source == "Original", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_chirps_stations = sum(spatial_data$Data_Source == "CHIRPS", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_exact_matches = sum(spatial_data$Match_Type == "Exact", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_fuzzy_matches = sum(spatial_data$Match_Type == "Fuzzy", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_manual_matches = sum(spatial_data$Match_Type == "Manual", na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_data_completeness = mean(spatial_data$Data_Completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_match_score = mean(spatial_data$Match_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_precipitation = min(kriging_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_precipitation = max(kriging_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_precipitation = mean(kriging_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    kriging_variance_min = min(kriging_df$var1.var, na.rm = TRUE),
    kriging_variance_max = max(kriging_df$var1.var, na.rm = TRUE),
    kriging_variance_mean = mean(kriging_df$var1.var, na.rm = TRUE),
    variogram_model = model,
    variogram_nugget = kriging_results$variogram_fit$psill[1],
    variogram_sill = ifelse(nrow(kriging_results$variogram_fit) > 1, 
                           sum(kriging_results$variogram_fit$psill), 
                           kriging_results$variogram_fit$psill[1]),
    variogram_range = ifelse(nrow(kriging_results$variogram_fit) > 1, 
                            kriging_results$variogram_fit$range[2], 
                            kriging_results$variogram_fit$range[1]),
    utm_zone = "28N",
    shapefile_used = shapefile_path,
    similarity_threshold = similarity_threshold,
    buffer_percent = buffer_percent,
    grid_resolution = resolution
  )
  
  cat("✅ Monthly Matérn Kriging analysis with GPS coordinates completed successfully!\n")
  
  return(list(
    interpolation_map = interpolation_map,
    variogram_plot = variogram_plot,
    distance_analysis = distance_analysis,
    kriging_results = kriging_results,
    spatial_data = spatial_data,
    matched_coordinates = matched_coordinates,
    summary_stats = summary_stats,
    monthly_data_list = monthly_data_list
  ))
}

# Function to save GPS-based Kriging results
save_monthly_kriging_results_with_gps <- function(kriging_result, output_dir = "monthly_kriging_interpolation_results_gps") {
  if(is.null(kriging_result)) {
    cat("❌ No results to save\n")
    return()
  }
  
  if(!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    cat("📁 Created output directory:", output_dir, "\n")
  }
  
  target_month_str <- gsub("-", "_", kriging_result$summary_stats$target_year_month)
  
  tryCatch({
    # Save maps
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_kriging_interpolation_gps_", target_month_str, ".png")),
           kriging_result$interpolation_map, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_variogram_gps_", target_month_str, ".png")),
           kriging_result$variogram_plot, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_distance_analysis_gps_", target_month_str, ".png")),
           kriging_result$distance_analysis, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    # Save monthly spatial data with GPS matching information
    write.csv(kriging_result$spatial_data, 
              file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_spatial_data_gps_", target_month_str, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save GPS coordinates and matching information
    write.csv(kriging_result$matched_coordinates$coordinates,
              file.path(output_dir, "gps_station_coordinates_matched.csv"),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save matching summary
    write.csv(kriging_result$matched_coordinates$matching_summary,
              file.path(output_dir, "station_matching_summary.csv"),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save unmatched stations info
    if(length(kriging_result$matched_coordinates$unmatched_rainfall) > 0) {
      write.csv(data.frame(Unmatched_Rainfall_Stations = kriging_result$matched_coordinates$unmatched_rainfall),
                file.path(output_dir, "unmatched_rainfall_stations.csv"),
                row.names = FALSE)
    }
    
    if(length(kriging_result$matched_coordinates$unmatched_gps) > 0) {
      write.csv(data.frame(Unmatched_GPS_Stations = kriging_result$matched_coordinates$unmatched_gps),
                file.path(output_dir, "unmatched_gps_stations.csv"),
                row.names = FALSE)
    }
    
    # Save Kriging results as raster (transform back to WGS84)
    kriging_raster <- rast(kriging_result$kriging_results$kriging_result)
    # Transform to WGS84 for standard output
    kriging_wgs84 <- project(kriging_raster, "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs")
    writeRaster(kriging_wgs84, 
                file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_kriging_raster_gps_", target_month_str, ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
    
    # Save UTM version as well
    writeRaster(kriging_raster, 
                file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_kriging_raster_utm28n_gps_", target_month_str, ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
    
    # Save variogram information
    vgm_info <- data.frame(
      Parameter = c("Model", "Nugget", "Partial_Sill", "Range_m", "Total_Sill"),
      Value = c(
        kriging_result$kriging_results$variogram_fit$model[1],
        kriging_result$kriging_results$variogram_fit$psill[1],
        ifelse(nrow(kriging_result$kriging_results$variogram_fit) > 1, 
               kriging_result$kriging_results$variogram_fit$psill[2], 0),
        ifelse(nrow(kriging_result$kriging_results$variogram_fit) > 1, 
               kriging_result$kriging_results$variogram_fit$range[2], 
               kriging_result$kriging_results$variogram_fit$range[1]),
        sum(kriging_result$kriging_results$variogram_fit$psill)
      )
    )
    write.csv(vgm_info,
              file.path(output_dir, paste0("variogram_parameters_", target_month_str, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save GPS-based summary statistics
    summary_df <- data.frame(
      Parameter = names(kriging_result$summary_stats),
      Value = as.character(kriging_result$summary_stats),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    write.csv(summary_df,
              file.path(output_dir, paste0("monthly_kriging_summary_gps_", target_month_str, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save aggregated monthly data for all stations
    if(!is.null(kriging_result$monthly_data_list)) {
      all_monthly_data <- map_dfr(kriging_result$monthly_data_list, ~.x)
      write.csv(all_monthly_data,
                file.path(output_dir, "all_stations_monthly_data.csv"),
                row.names = FALSE)
    }
    
    cat("💾 Monthly Matérn Kriging results with GPS coordinates saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ Error saving results:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

# Function to create manual matching template
create_manual_matching_template <- function(monthly_data_list, gps_coordinates, 
                                          output_file = "manual_station_matching_template.csv") {
  cat("📝 Creating manual matching template...\n")
  
  rainfall_stations <- names(monthly_data_list)
  gps_sites <- gps_coordinates$Station
  
  # Create template with all rainfall stations
  template <- data.frame(
    rainfall_station = rainfall_stations,
    gps_station = "",  # To be filled manually
    notes = "",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Add available GPS stations as reference
  gps_reference <- data.frame(
    rainfall_station = paste("# Available GPS stations:", paste(head(gps_sites, 50), collapse = ", ")),
    gps_station = ifelse(length(gps_sites) > 50, paste("... and", length(gps_sites) - 50, "more"), ""),
    notes = "Reference only - delete these rows",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  final_template <- rbind(gps_reference, 
                         data.frame(rainfall_station = "# Instructions:", 
                                   gps_station = "Fill gps_station column with matching GPS station names", 
                                   notes = "Leave empty if no match exists", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
                         template)
  
  write.csv(final_template, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("   📄 Template saved to:", output_file, "\n")
  cat("   📝 Edit this file to manually specify station matches\n")
  cat("   📝 Then read it back with: manual_matches <- read.csv('", output_file, "')\n")
  
  return(final_template)
}

  cat("Average match score:", round(kriging_result_gps$summary_stats$avg_match_score, 3), "\n")
  cat("Average data completeness:", round(kriging_result_gps$summary_stats$avg_data_completeness * 100, 1), "%\n")
  cat("Interpolated rainfall range:", round(kriging_result_gps$summary_stats$min_precipitation, 1), "-", 
      round(kriging_result_gps$summary_stats$max_precipitation, 1), "mm\n")
  cat("Variogram nugget:", round(kriging_result_gps$summary_stats$variogram_nugget, 2), "\n")
  cat("Variogram range:", round(kriging_result_gps$summary_stats$variogram_range, 0), "m\n")
  cat("Mean kriging variance:", round(kriging_result_gps$summary_stats$kriging_variance_mean, 2), "\n")
  
  # Display the maps

} else {

}

# Function to debug kriging results structure
debug_kriging_results <- function(kriging_result) {
  if(is.null(kriging_result)) {
    cat("❌ Kriging result is NULL\n")
    return()
  }
  
  cat("🔍 DEBUGGING KRIGING RESULTS STRUCTURE\n")
  cat("=====================================\n")
  
  kriging_sp <- kriging_result$kriging_result
  cat("📊 Kriging object class:", class(kriging_sp), "\n")
  cat("📊 Kriging object structure:\n")
  print(str(kriging_sp))
  
  # Convert to dataframe and check
  kriging_df <- as.data.frame(kriging_sp)
  cat("\n📊 Dataframe columns:", paste(names(kriging_df), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("📊 Dataframe dimensions:", nrow(kriging_df), "x", ncol(kriging_df), "\n")
  cat("📊 First few rows:\n")
  print(head(kriging_df, 3))
  
  # Check coordinate system
  cat("\n📍 Coordinate system:", proj4string(kriging_sp), "\n")
  
  # Check for prediction and variance columns
  pred_cols <- names(kriging_df)[grepl("pred", names(kriging_df))]
  var_cols <- names(kriging_df)[grepl("var", names(kriging_df))]
  coord_cols <- names(kriging_df)[grepl("coords", names(kriging_df))]
  
  cat("📊 Prediction columns:", paste(pred_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("📊 Variance columns:", paste(var_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("📊 Coordinate columns:", paste(coord_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  return(kriging_df)
}

# Function to test coordinate transformation
test_coordinate_transformation <- function(spatial_points) {
  cat("🔍 TESTING COORDINATE TRANSFORMATION\n")
  cat("===================================\n")
  
  cat("📍 Original spatial points (UTM):\n")
  cat("   Class:", class(spatial_points), "\n")
  cat("   CRS:", proj4string(spatial_points), "\n")
  
  # Convert to dataframe to see coordinates
  points_df_utm <- as.data.frame(spatial_points)
  cat("   Sample UTM coordinates:\n")
  print(head(points_df_utm[, c("X_UTM", "Y_UTM", "Monthly_Precipitation")], 3))
  
  # Transform to WGS84
  cat("\n🔄 Transforming to WGS84...\n")
  points_wgs84 <- spTransform(spatial_points, CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"))
  cat("   New CRS:", proj4string(points_wgs84), "\n")
  
  # Convert to dataframe to see coordinates
  points_df_wgs84 <- as.data.frame(points_wgs84)
  cat("   Sample WGS84 coordinates:\n")
  print(head(points_df_wgs84[, c("Longitude", "Latitude", "Monthly_Precipitation")], 3))
  
  return(points_wgs84)
}

# Function to create a simple test kriging map without GPS info
create_simple_kriging_map <- function(kriging_result, spatial_points, target_year_month) {
  cat("🗺️ Creating SIMPLE kriging map for testing...\n")
  
  # Convert results
  kriging_sp <- kriging_result$kriging_result
  kriging_wgs84 <- spTransform(kriging_sp, CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"))
  kriging_df <- as.data.frame(kriging_wgs84)
  
  points_wgs84 <- spTransform(spatial_points, CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"))
  points_df <- as.data.frame(points_wgs84)
  
  cat("   📊 Kriging columns:", paste(names(kriging_df), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Simple column handling
  if("var1.pred" %in% names(kriging_df)) {
    pred_col <- "var1.pred"
  } else {
    pred_col <- names(kriging_df)[3]  # Assume 3rd column
  }
  
  # Get coordinate columns (first two)
  coord_names <- names(kriging_df)[1:2]
  
  # Create basic map
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_tile(data = kriging_df, 
              aes_string(x = coord_names[1], y = coord_names[2], fill = pred_col),
              alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = points_df, 
               aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, size = Monthly_Precipitation),
               color = "white", stroke = 1) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Rainfall\n(mm)", option = "plasma") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Observed\n(mm)", range = c(2, 6)) +
    labs(title = paste("Simple Kriging Test Map -", target_year_month),
         x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
    theme_minimal() +
    coord_fixed()
  
  return(p)
}
```

## Kriging Results Visualization

```{r}
# Import TIF and Recreate Enhanced Kriging Visualization
# This script imports saved Kriging TIF files and recreates the same enhanced visualization
# as the original monthly Kriging analysis with GPS coordinates

# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)        # For raster handling
library(sf)           # Modern spatial data
library(viridis)      # Color palettes
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(lubridate)

# Install and load required packages
install_and_load <- function(packages) {
  new_packages <- packages[!(packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
  if(length(new_packages)) {
    cat("Installing packages:", paste(new_packages, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    install.packages(new_packages, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
  sapply(packages, function(x) {
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(x, character.only = TRUE))
  })
}

required_packages <- c("terra", "sf", "viridis", "scales")
install_and_load(required_packages)

# Function to import Kriging TIF file and associated data
import_kriging_results_from_tif <- function(results_dir = "monthly_kriging_interpolation_results_gps", 
                                           target_year_month = "2021_08") {
  
  cat("📥 Importing Kriging results from TIF files...\n")
  cat("   Directory:", results_dir, "\n")
  cat("   Target month:", target_year_month, "\n")
  
  if(!dir.exists(results_dir)) {
    stop(paste("Results directory not found:", results_dir))
  }
  
  # File paths
  tif_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("monthly_kriging_raster_gps_", target_year_month, ".tif"))
  spatial_data_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("monthly_spatial_data_gps_", target_year_month, ".csv"))
  gps_coords_file <- file.path(results_dir, "gps_station_coordinates_matched.csv")
  summary_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("monthly_kriging_summary_gps_", target_year_month, ".csv"))
  variogram_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("variogram_parameters_", target_year_month, ".csv"))
  
  # Check if required files exist
  required_files <- c(tif_file, spatial_data_file, gps_coords_file)
  missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]
  
  if(length(missing_files) > 0) {
    cat("❌ Missing required files:\n")
    for(file in missing_files) {
      cat("   ", file, "\n")
    }
    stop("Cannot proceed without required files")
  }
  
  # Load TIF file
  cat("   📍 Loading Kriging raster from TIF...\n")
  kriging_raster <- rast(tif_file)
  cat("      Raster dimensions:", nrow(kriging_raster), "x", ncol(kriging_raster), "\n")
  cat("      Raster extent:", paste(round(as.vector(ext(kriging_raster)), 4), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("      Raster CRS:", crs(kriging_raster), "\n")
  
  # Convert raster to dataframe for ggplot
  kriging_df <- as.data.frame(kriging_raster, xy = TRUE)
  
  # Handle different possible layer names
  prediction_col <- names(kriging_df)[!names(kriging_df) %in% c("x", "y")]
  if(length(prediction_col) > 1) {
    # If multiple layers, assume first is prediction
    prediction_col <- prediction_col[1]
    cat("      Multiple layers found, using:", prediction_col, "\n")
  }
  
  # Rename columns for consistency
  names(kriging_df)[names(kriging_df) == "x"] <- "Longitude"
  names(kriging_df)[names(kriging_df) == "y"] <- "Latitude"
  names(kriging_df)[names(kriging_df) == prediction_col] <- "var1.pred"
  
  # Filter out NA values
  kriging_df <- kriging_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(var1.pred) & is.finite(var1.pred) & var1.pred >= 0)
  
  cat("      Valid prediction points:", nrow(kriging_df), "\n")
  cat("      Rainfall range:", round(min(kriging_df$var1.pred), 1), "-", 
      round(max(kriging_df$var1.pred), 1), "mm\n")
  
  # Load spatial station data
  cat("   📊 Loading station spatial data...\n")
  spatial_data <- read_csv(spatial_data_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cat("      Stations loaded:", nrow(spatial_data), "\n")
  
  # Load GPS coordinates
  cat("   📍 Loading GPS coordinates...\n")
  gps_coordinates <- read_csv(gps_coords_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cat("      GPS stations loaded:", nrow(gps_coordinates), "\n")
  
  # Load summary if available
  summary_stats <- NULL
  if(file.exists(summary_file)) {
    cat("   📋 Loading summary statistics...\n")
    summary_raw <- read_csv(summary_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
    summary_stats <- setNames(summary_raw$Value, summary_raw$Parameter)
  }
  
  # Load variogram parameters if available
  variogram_params <- NULL
  if(file.exists(variogram_file)) {
    cat("   📈 Loading variogram parameters...\n")
    variogram_params <- read_csv(variogram_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  }
  
  cat("✅ Successfully imported Kriging results from TIF!\n")
  
  return(list(
    kriging_df = kriging_df,
    spatial_data = spatial_data,
    gps_coordinates = gps_coordinates,
    summary_stats = summary_stats,
    variogram_params = variogram_params,
    target_year_month = gsub("_", "-", target_year_month)
  ))
}

# Function to recreate the enhanced Kriging visualization from imported TIF
recreate_enhanced_kriging_map_from_tif <- function(imported_data, 
                                                  title_prefix = "Monthly Rainfall Interpolation from TIF") {
  
  cat("🎨 Recreating enhanced Kriging visualization from imported TIF data...\n")
  
  # Extract data components
  kriging_df <- imported_data$kriging_df
  spatial_data <- imported_data$spatial_data
  target_year_month <- imported_data$target_year_month
  
  cat("   📊 Kriging points for plotting:", nrow(kriging_df), "\n")
  cat("   📍 Station points for plotting:", nrow(spatial_data), "\n")
  
  # Ensure required columns exist in spatial_data
  required_cols <- c("Longitude", "Latitude", "Monthly_Precipitation", "Data_Source", "Match_Type", "Data_Completeness")
  missing_cols <- required_cols[!required_cols %in% names(spatial_data)]
  
  if(length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    cat("   ⚠️ Missing columns in spatial data:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    # Add default values for missing columns
    if(!"Data_Source" %in% names(spatial_data)) spatial_data$Data_Source <- "Unknown"
    if(!"Match_Type" %in% names(spatial_data)) spatial_data$Match_Type <- "Unknown"
    if(!"Data_Completeness" %in% names(spatial_data)) spatial_data$Data_Completeness <- 1.0
  }
  
  # Ensure GPS_Station column exists for labels
  if(!"GPS_Station" %in% names(spatial_data)) {
    spatial_data$GPS_Station <- spatial_data$Station  # Fallback
  }
  
  # Create the enhanced map
  cat("   🗺️ Building enhanced visualization...\n")
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Add interpolated surface
    geom_tile(data = kriging_df, 
              aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = var1.pred),
              alpha = 0.8) +
    
    # Add contour lines if enough data points
    {if(nrow(kriging_df) > 50) {
      geom_contour(data = kriging_df, 
                  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, z = var1.pred),
                  color = "white", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4, bins = 8)
    }} +
    
    # Add station points colored by data source and shaped by match type
    geom_point(data = spatial_data, 
               aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, 
                   size = Monthly_Precipitation,
                   shape = Match_Type,
                   color = Data_Source,
                   alpha = Data_Completeness),
               stroke = 1.2) +
    
    # Add station labels with GPS station names
    geom_text(data = spatial_data,
              aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, 
                  label = paste0(Station, "\n(", GPS_Station, ")")),
              color = "white", size = 2, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -2.2,
              fontface = "bold") +
    
    # Styling - exactly as in original
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Kriged\nMonthly Rainfall\n(mm)", 
                        option = "plasma",
                        na.value = "transparent",
                        trans = "sqrt") +
    
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Observed\nMonthly (mm)", 
                         range = c(2, 8),
                         trans = "sqrt") +
    
    scale_alpha_continuous(name = "Data\nCompleteness", 
                          range = c(0.5, 1.0),
                          labels = scales::percent) +
    
    scale_color_manual(name = "Data Source",
                      values = c("Original" = "#2E86AB", 
                                "CHIRPS" = "#E74C3C", 
                                "Unknown" = "#34495E"),
                      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1))) +
    
    scale_shape_manual(name = "Match Type",
                      values = c("Exact" = 16, "Fuzzy" = 17, "Manual" = 15, "Unknown" = 18)) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste(title_prefix, "- Monthly Matérn Kriging (from TIF)"),
      subtitle = paste("Month:", target_year_month, "| Imported from saved TIF raster | Labels show: Rainfall_Station (GPS_Station)"),
      x = "Longitude (°E)",
      y = "Latitude (°N)",
      caption = "Points show monthly observed values at GPS coordinates, surface shows imported Matérn Kriging interpolation"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
      legend.box = "vertical"
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
  
  cat("✅ Enhanced Kriging map recreated from TIF!\n")
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to create summary information display from imported data
create_summary_display_from_tif <- function(imported_data) {
  cat("📊 Creating summary display from imported TIF data...\n")
  
  summary_stats <- imported_data$summary_stats
  variogram_params <- imported_data$variogram_params
  target_year_month <- imported_data$target_year_month
  
  if(is.null(summary_stats)) {
    cat("   ⚠️ No summary statistics available\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cat("\n📊 IMPORTED KRIGING RESULTS SUMMARY\n")
  cat("==================================\n")
  cat("Target month:", target_year_month, "\n")
  
  # Display key statistics
  key_stats <- c("n_stations", "n_matched_stations", "n_exact_matches", "n_fuzzy_matches", 
                  "avg_data_completeness", "avg_match_score", "min_precipitation", 
                  "max_precipitation", "mean_precipitation", "variogram_model", 
                  "variogram_range", "utm_zone", "similarity_threshold")
  
  for(stat in key_stats) {
    if(stat %in% names(summary_stats)) {
      value <- summary_stats[[stat]]
      # Format specific statistics
      formatted_value <- switch(stat,
        "avg_data_completeness" = paste0(round(as.numeric(value) * 100, 1), "%"),
        "avg_match_score" = round(as.numeric(value), 3),
        "min_precipitation" = paste0(round(as.numeric(value), 1), " mm"),
        "max_precipitation" = paste0(round(as.numeric(value), 1), " mm"),
        "mean_precipitation" = paste0(round(as.numeric(value), 1), " mm"),
        "variogram_range" = paste0(round(as.numeric(value), 0), " m"),
        "similarity_threshold" = as.numeric(value),
        value
      )
      
      # Clean up stat name for display
      display_name <- switch(stat,
        "n_stations" = "Stations used for Kriging",
        "n_matched_stations" = "Total matched stations",
        "n_exact_matches" = "Exact matches",
        "n_fuzzy_matches" = "Fuzzy matches",
        "avg_data_completeness" = "Average data completeness",
        "avg_match_score" = "Average match score",
        "min_precipitation" = "Minimum interpolated rainfall",
        "max_precipitation" = "Maximum interpolated rainfall",
        "mean_precipitation" = "Mean interpolated rainfall",
        "variogram_model" = "Variogram model",
        "variogram_range" = "Variogram range",
        "utm_zone" = "UTM Zone",
        "similarity_threshold" = "Similarity threshold",
        stat
      )
      
      cat(paste0(display_name, ": ", formatted_value, "\n"))
    }
  }
  
  # Display variogram parameters if available
  if(!is.null(variogram_params)) {
    cat("\n📈 VARIOGRAM PARAMETERS:\n")
    for(i in 1:nrow(variogram_params)) {
      cat(paste0(variogram_params$Parameter[i], ": ", variogram_params$Value[i], "\n"))
    }
  }
  
  return(invisible(summary_stats))
}

# Function to save recreated visualization
save_recreated_visualization <- function(map_plot, target_year_month, 
                                       output_dir = "recreated_kriging_visualizations") {
  
  if(!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    cat("📁 Created output directory:", output_dir, "\n")
  }
  
  target_month_str <- gsub("-", "_", target_year_month)
  output_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("recreated_kriging_map_", target_month_str, ".png"))
  
  tryCatch({
    ggsave(output_file, map_plot, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    cat("💾 Recreated visualization saved to:", output_file, "\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ Error saving visualization:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

# Function to compare TIF data with original data (if available)
compare_tif_with_original <- function(imported_data, original_results = NULL) {
  if(is.null(original_results)) {
    cat("⚠️ No original results provided for comparison\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  cat("🔍 Comparing imported TIF data with original results...\n")
  
  # Compare basic statistics
  tif_stats <- list(
    n_predictions = nrow(imported_data$kriging_df),
    min_pred = min(imported_data$kriging_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_pred = max(imported_data$kriging_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pred = mean(imported_data$kriging_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  if(!is.null(original_results$kriging_results)) {
    orig_df <- as.data.frame(original_results$kriging_results$kriging_result)
    orig_stats <- list(
      n_predictions = nrow(orig_df),
      min_pred = min(orig_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_pred = max(orig_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_pred = mean(orig_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    
    cat("📊 COMPARISON RESULTS:\n")
    cat("   Prediction points - TIF:", tif_stats$n_predictions, "| Original:", orig_stats$n_predictions, "\n")
    cat("   Min rainfall - TIF:", round(tif_stats$min_pred, 1), "| Original:", round(orig_stats$min_pred, 1), "\n")
    cat("   Max rainfall - TIF:", round(tif_stats$max_pred, 1), "| Original:", round(orig_stats$max_pred, 1), "\n")
    cat("   Mean rainfall - TIF:", round(tif_stats$mean_pred, 1), "| Original:", round(orig_stats$mean_pred, 1), "\n")
    
    # Calculate differences
    min_diff <- abs(tif_stats$min_pred - orig_stats$min_pred)
    max_diff <- abs(tif_stats$max_pred - orig_stats$max_pred)
    mean_diff <- abs(tif_stats$mean_pred - orig_stats$mean_pred)
    
    cat("   Differences - Min:", round(min_diff, 3), "| Max:", round(max_diff, 3), "| Mean:", round(mean_diff, 3), "\n")
    
    if(min_diff < 0.01 && max_diff < 0.01 && mean_diff < 0.01) {
      cat("✅ TIF data matches original results very closely!\n")
    } else {
      cat("⚠️ Some differences found between TIF and original data\n")
    }
  }
  
  return(invisible(list(tif_stats = tif_stats, orig_stats = if(exists("orig_stats")) orig_stats else NULL)))
}
```
