## VII.9. Optimized Monthly Spatial Interpolation using Matérn Kriging with automap

```{r}
# Optimized Monthly Spatial Interpolation using Matérn Kriging with automap
# This script uses automap for optimized Matérn model parameter estimation
# Includes performance optimizations and robust error handling

# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(gstat)        # For Kriging
library(automap)      # For automatic parameter optimization
library(sp)           # Spatial data handling
library(sf)           # Modern spatial data
library(terra)        # Replaces deprecated raster package
library(viridis)      # Color palettes
library(gridExtra)    # Multiple plots
library(lubridate)    # Date handling
library(RColorBrewer) # Additional color palettes
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(parallel)     # For parallel processing
library(data.table)   # For fast data operations

# Enhanced package installation and loading
install_and_load <- function(packages) {
  new_packages <- packages[!(packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
  if(length(new_packages)) {
    cat("Installing packages:", paste(new_packages, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    install.packages(new_packages, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Load packages with better error handling
  failed_packages <- c()
  for(pkg in packages) {
    if(!suppressPackageStartupMessages(require(pkg, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE))) {
      failed_packages <- c(failed_packages, pkg)
    }
  }
  
  if(length(failed_packages) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Failed to load packages:", paste(failed_packages, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  cat("✅ All required packages loaded successfully\n")
}

required_packages <- c("gstat", "automap", "sp", "sf", "terra", "viridis", 
                      "gridExtra", "stringdist", "parallel", "data.table")
install_and_load(required_packages)

# Optimized function to load GPS station coordinates from shapefile
load_gps_station_coordinates_optimized <- function(shapefile_path = "Pts_GPS_Station_English.shp") {
  cat("📍 Loading GPS station coordinates from shapefile (optimized)...\n")
  
  if(!file.exists(shapefile_path)) {
    stop(paste("Shapefile not found:", shapefile_path, 
               "\nPlease ensure the shapefile and associated files (.shx, .dbf, .prj) are present."))
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    # Load shapefile with better error handling
    gps_stations <- st_read(shapefile_path, quiet = TRUE)
    
    # Validate required columns
    required_cols <- "Sites"
    missing_cols <- required_cols[!required_cols %in% colnames(gps_stations)]
    if(length(missing_cols) > 0) {
      stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
                 "\nAvailable columns:", paste(colnames(gps_stations), collapse = ", ")))
    }
    
    cat("   📊 Shapefile loaded successfully with", nrow(gps_stations), "GPS stations\n")
    
    # Transform to UTM 28N efficiently
    cat("   🔄 Transforming to UTM 28N (EPSG:32628)...\n")
    gps_stations_utm <- st_transform(gps_stations, crs = 32628)
    
    # Extract coordinates efficiently
    coords <- st_coordinates(gps_stations_utm)
    coords_wgs84 <- st_coordinates(st_transform(gps_stations_utm, 4326))
    
    # Create optimized coordinates dataframe
    coordinates_df <- data.table(
      Station = as.character(gps_stations$Sites),
      X_UTM = coords[,1],
      Y_UTM = coords[,2],
      Longitude = coords_wgs84[,1],
      Latitude = coords_wgs84[,2]
    )
    
    # Add optional columns if available
    optional_cols <- c("Station_ty", "Elevation", "ELEV")
    for(col in optional_cols) {
      if(col %in% colnames(gps_stations)) {
        if(col == "Station_ty") {
          coordinates_df[, Station_Type := as.character(gps_stations[[col]])]
        } else if(col %in% c("Elevation", "ELEV")) {
          coordinates_df[, Elevation_m := as.numeric(gps_stations[[col]])]
          break  # Use first available elevation column
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Remove invalid records efficiently
    initial_count <- nrow(coordinates_df)
    coordinates_df <- coordinates_df[
      !is.na(Station) & Station != "" & 
      !is.na(X_UTM) & !is.na(Y_UTM) &
      is.finite(X_UTM) & is.finite(Y_UTM)
    ]
    
    if(nrow(coordinates_df) < initial_count) {
      cat("   ⚠️ Removed", initial_count - nrow(coordinates_df), "invalid records\n")
    }
    
    # Convert back to data.frame for compatibility
    coordinates_df <- as.data.frame(coordinates_df)
    
    cat("   ✅ GPS coordinates processed:", nrow(coordinates_df), "valid stations\n")
    cat("   📍 UTM extent: X[", round(min(coordinates_df$X_UTM)), "-", 
        round(max(coordinates_df$X_UTM)), "] Y[", round(min(coordinates_df$Y_UTM)), 
        "-", round(max(coordinates_df$Y_UTM)), "]\n")
    
    return(coordinates_df)
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop(paste("Error loading GPS shapefile:", e$message))
  })
}

# Optimized function to load and aggregate monthly rainfall data
load_and_aggregate_monthly_data_optimized <- function(datasets_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets") {
  cat("📥 Loading and aggregating rainfall data to monthly (optimized)...\n")
  
  if(!dir.exists(datasets_dir)) {
    stop(paste("Directory not found:", datasets_dir))
  }
  
  # Get all CSV files
  csv_files <- list.files(datasets_dir, pattern = "^combined_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  if(length(csv_files) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No combined CSV files found in:", datasets_dir))
  }
  
  cat("   📂 Found", length(csv_files), "data files\n")
  
  # Function to process single file efficiently
  process_file <- function(file) {
    # Extract station name
    filename <- basename(file)
    station_name <- gsub("^combined_", "", filename)
    station_name <- gsub("_2000_2025\\.csv$", "", station_name)
    
    tryCatch({
      # Use data.table for faster reading
      daily_data <- fread(file, select = c("Date", "combined_rainfall", "original_rainfall", 
                                          "chirps_rainfall", "data_source"))
      daily_data[, Date := as.Date(Date)]
      
      # Fast monthly aggregation
      monthly_data <- daily_data[
        , .(
          monthly_rainfall = sum(combined_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
          monthly_original = sum(original_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
          monthly_chirps = sum(chirps_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
          valid_days = sum(!is.na(combined_rainfall)),
          total_days = .N,
          dominant_source = names(sort(table(data_source), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
        ), 
        by = .(Year = year(Date), Month = month(Date))
      ][
        , `:=`(
          Station = station_name,
          YearMonth = as.Date(paste(Year, Month, "01", sep = "-")),
          data_completeness = valid_days / total_days
        )
      ][
        data_completeness >= 0.5 & valid_days >= 10  # Filter incomplete months
      ]
      
      # Convert back to data.frame
      as.data.frame(monthly_data)
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("   ❌ Failed to process", filename, ":", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
  }
  
  # Process files (with option for parallel processing)
  use_parallel <- length(csv_files) > 10 && detectCores() > 2
  
  if(use_parallel) {
    cat("   🚀 Using parallel processing with", detectCores() - 1, "cores\n")
    cl <- makeCluster(detectCores() - 1)
    clusterEvalQ(cl, {library(data.table); library(lubridate)})
    monthly_data_list <- parLapply(cl, csv_files, process_file)
    stopCluster(cl)
  } else {
    monthly_data_list <- lapply(csv_files, process_file)
  }
  
  # Remove NULL results and create named list
  valid_results <- monthly_data_list[!sapply(monthly_data_list, is.null)]
  names(valid_results) <- sapply(valid_results, function(x) x$Station[1])
  
  cat("   ✅ Successfully processed", length(valid_results), "stations\n")
  
  return(list(
    monthly_data = valid_results,
    processing_summary = data.frame(
      total_files = length(csv_files),
      successful = length(valid_results),
      failed = length(csv_files) - length(valid_results)
    )
  ))
}

# Optimized station matching with pre-allocated vectors
match_rainfall_with_gps_optimized <- function(monthly_data_list, gps_coordinates, 
                                            similarity_threshold = 0.8, manual_matches = NULL) {
  cat("🔗 Matching rainfall stations with GPS coordinates (optimized)...\n")
  
  rainfall_stations <- names(monthly_data_list)
  gps_sites <- gps_coordinates$Station
  
  cat("   📊 Rainfall stations:", length(rainfall_stations), "| GPS stations:", length(gps_sites), "\n")
  
  # Pre-allocate matching results
  max_matches <- length(rainfall_stations)
  matched_pairs <- data.frame(
    Rainfall_Station = character(max_matches),
    GPS_Station = character(max_matches),
    Match_Type = character(max_matches),
    Match_Score = numeric(max_matches),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  match_count <- 0
  
  # 1. Exact matches (vectorized)
  cat("   🎯 Finding exact matches...\n")
  rainfall_lower <- tolower(rainfall_stations)
  gps_lower <- tolower(gps_sites)
  
  for(i in seq_along(rainfall_stations)) {
    exact_idx <- which(gps_lower == rainfall_lower[i])
    if(length(exact_idx) > 0) {
      match_count <- match_count + 1
      matched_pairs[match_count, ] <- list(
        rainfall_stations[i], gps_sites[exact_idx[1]], "Exact", 1.0
      )
    }
  }
  
  exact_matches <- match_count
  cat("      ✅ Found", exact_matches, "exact matches\n")
  
  # 2. Manual matches
  if(!is.null(manual_matches)) {
    cat("   👥 Applying manual matches...\n")
    manual_count <- 0
    
    for(i in 1:nrow(manual_matches)) {
      rainfall_name <- manual_matches$rainfall_station[i]
      gps_name <- manual_matches$gps_station[i]
      
      if(rainfall_name %in% rainfall_stations && 
         gps_name %in% gps_sites &&
         !rainfall_name %in% matched_pairs$Rainfall_Station[1:match_count]) {
        
        match_count <- match_count + 1
        matched_pairs[match_count, ] <- list(rainfall_name, gps_name, "Manual", 1.0)
        manual_count <- manual_count + 1
      }
    }
    cat("      👤 Applied", manual_count, "manual matches\n")
  }
  
  # 3. Optimized fuzzy matching
  cat("   🔍 Fuzzy matching (threshold:", similarity_threshold, ")...\n")
  
  unmatched_rainfall <- rainfall_stations[!rainfall_stations %in% matched_pairs$Rainfall_Station[1:match_count]]
  matched_gps <- matched_pairs$GPS_Station[1:match_count]
  unmatched_gps <- gps_sites[!gps_sites %in% matched_gps]
  
  if(length(unmatched_rainfall) > 0 && length(unmatched_gps) > 0) {
    # Vectorized string distance calculation
    fuzzy_matches <- 0
    
    for(rainfall_station in unmatched_rainfall) {
      # Calculate all similarities at once
      similarities <- 1 - stringdist(tolower(rainfall_station), tolower(unmatched_gps), method = "jw")
      
      if(length(similarities) > 0) {
        best_idx <- which.max(similarities)
        best_similarity <- similarities[best_idx]
        
        if(best_similarity >= similarity_threshold) {
          match_count <- match_count + 1
          matched_pairs[match_count, ] <- list(
            rainfall_station, unmatched_gps[best_idx], "Fuzzy", best_similarity
          )
          
          # Remove from unmatched
          unmatched_gps <- unmatched_gps[-best_idx]
          fuzzy_matches <- fuzzy_matches + 1
        }
      }
    }
    cat("      🔍 Found", fuzzy_matches, "fuzzy matches\n")
  }
  
  # Trim results to actual matches
  if(match_count > 0) {
    matched_pairs <- matched_pairs[1:match_count, ]
  } else {
    matched_pairs <- matched_pairs[0, ]
  }
  
  cat("   📊 MATCHING SUMMARY: ", match_count, "/", length(rainfall_stations), 
      " (", round(match_count/length(rainfall_stations)*100, 1), "%)\n")
  
  if(match_count == 0) {
    stop("No stations could be matched between rainfall data and GPS coordinates")
  }
  
  # Create final coordinates with matched stations
  final_coordinates <- merge(matched_pairs, gps_coordinates, 
                           by.x = "GPS_Station", by.y = "Station", all.x = TRUE)
  names(final_coordinates)[names(final_coordinates) == "Rainfall_Station"] <- "Station"
  
  return(list(
    coordinates = final_coordinates,
    matching_summary = matched_pairs,
    match_count = match_count
  ))
}

# Optimized spatial data preparation
prepare_monthly_spatial_data_optimized <- function(monthly_data_list, matched_coordinates, target_year_month) {
  target_date <- as.Date(paste0(target_year_month, "-01"))
  target_ym <- floor_date(target_date, "month")
  
  cat("📊 Preparing spatial data for", format(target_ym, "%Y-%m"), "(optimized)...\n")
  
  available_stations <- matched_coordinates$coordinates$Station
  
  # Pre-allocate result matrix
  n_stations <- length(available_stations)
  result_list <- vector("list", n_stations)
  
  # Extract data efficiently
  for(i in seq_along(available_stations)) {
    station_name <- available_stations[i]
    station_data <- monthly_data_list[[station_name]]
    
    if(!is.null(station_data) && nrow(station_data) > 0) {
      # Use data.table for fast filtering
      station_dt <- as.data.table(station_data)
      target_row <- station_dt[YearMonth == target_ym]
      
      if(nrow(target_row) > 0 && !is.na(target_row$monthly_rainfall[1])) {
        result_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
          Station = station_name,
          Monthly_Precipitation = as.numeric(target_row$monthly_rainfall[1]),
          Data_Source = as.character(target_row$dominant_source[1]),
          Valid_Days = as.numeric(target_row$valid_days[1]),
          Data_Completeness = as.numeric(target_row$data_completeness[1]),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Combine results efficiently
  valid_results <- result_list[!sapply(result_list, is.null)]
  if(length(valid_results) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No valid data found for", format(target_ym, "%Y-%m")))
  }
  
  spatial_data <- do.call(rbind, valid_results)
  
  # Join with coordinates efficiently
  spatial_data <- merge(spatial_data, 
                       matched_coordinates$coordinates[, c("Station", "X_UTM", "Y_UTM", 
                                                          "Longitude", "Latitude", "GPS_Station", 
                                                          "Match_Type", "Match_Score")],
                       by = "Station", all.x = TRUE)
  
  # Filter valid data
  spatial_data <- spatial_data[
    !is.na(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation) & 
    !is.na(spatial_data$X_UTM) & 
    !is.na(spatial_data$Y_UTM) & 
    is.finite(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation) & 
    is.finite(spatial_data$X_UTM) & 
    is.finite(spatial_data$Y_UTM) &
    spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation >= 0, 
  ]
  
  if(nrow(spatial_data) < 3) {
    stop(paste("Insufficient valid data points:", nrow(spatial_data), "< 3 required for Kriging"))
  }
  
  cat("   ✅ Prepared", nrow(spatial_data), "stations with valid data\n")
  
  return(spatial_data)
}

# MAIN OPTIMIZATION: Enhanced Matérn Kriging with automap
# CORRECTED: Enhanced Matérn Kriging with automap
perform_optimized_matern_kriging <- function(spatial_points, prediction_grid, 
                                           optimize_kappa = TRUE, kappa_range = c(0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 5.0)) {
  
  cat("🎯 Performing OPTIMIZED Matérn Kriging with automap...\n")
  
  tryCatch({
    if(optimize_kappa && require(automap, quietly = TRUE)) {
      cat("   🤖 Using automap for optimized Matérn parameter estimation...\n")
      cat("   🔧 Testing kappa values:", paste(kappa_range, collapse = ", "), "\n")
      
      # Use autoKrige with Matérn model and kappa optimization (CORRECTED PARAMETERS)
      auto_result <- autoKrige(
        formula = Monthly_Precipitation ~ 1,
        input_data = spatial_points,
        new_data = prediction_grid,
        model = c("Mat"),  # Only Matérn model
        kappa = kappa_range,  # Test different kappa values
        fix.values = c(NA, NA, NA),  # Allow nugget, sill, and range to be optimized
        verbose = FALSE,
        debug.level = 0t
      )
      
      # Extract results
      kriging_result <- auto_result$krige_output
      vgm_fit <- auto_result$var_model
      
      # Create experimental variogram for plotting
      vgm_emp <- variogram(Monthly_Precipitation ~ 1, spatial_points)
      
      # Display optimized parameters
      cat("   📈 OPTIMIZED Matérn parameters:\n")
      cat("      Model: Matérn\n")
      if(nrow(vgm_fit) >= 2) {
        cat("      Nugget:", round(vgm_fit$psill[1], 3), "\n")
        cat("      Partial Sill:", round(vgm_fit$psill[2], 3), "\n")
        cat("      Range:", round(vgm_fit$range[2], 0), "m\n")
        cat("      Kappa (smoothness):", round(vgm_fit$kappa[2], 3), "\n")
        cat("      Total Sill:", round(sum(vgm_fit$psill), 3), "\n")
      } else {
        cat("      Nugget:", round(vgm_fit$psill[1], 3), "\n")
        cat("      Range:", round(vgm_fit$range[1], 0), "m\n")
        cat("      Kappa:", round(vgm_fit$kappa[1], 3), "\n")
      }
      
      # Calculate some quality metrics
      predictions <- kriging_result$var1.pred
      variances <- kriging_result$var1.var
      
      cat("   📊 Quality metrics:\n")
      cat("      Prediction range:", round(min(predictions, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "-", 
          round(max(predictions, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "mm\n")
      cat("      Mean kriging variance:", round(mean(variances, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      cat("      Max kriging variance:", round(max(variances, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
      
    } else {
      # Fallback to manual Matérn with default kappa
      
      # Experimental variogram
      vgm_emp <- variogram(Monthly_Precipitation ~ 1, spatial_points)
      
      # Try different kappa values manually and pick best
      best_fit <- NULL
      best_kappa <- NULL
      best_sse <- Inf
      
      for(kappa_val in kappa_range) {
        tryCatch({
          test_fit <- fit.variogram(vgm_emp, vgm(model = "Mat", kappa = kappa_val))
          
          # Calculate sum of squared errors as simple quality metric
          vgm_line <- variogramLine(test_fit, dist_vector = vgm_emp$dist)
          sse <- sum((vgm_emp$gamma - vgm_line$gamma)^2)
          
          if(sse < best_sse) {
            best_sse <- sse
            best_fit <- test_fit
            best_kappa <- kappa_val
          }
        }, error = function(e) {
          # Skip this kappa value if fitting fails
        })
      }
      
      if(is.null(best_fit)) {
        # Ultimate fallback to default Matérn
        cat("   🔄 Using default Matérn model (kappa = 0.5)...\n")
        vgm_fit <- fit.variogram(vgm_emp, vgm(model = "Mat"))
      } else {
        vgm_fit <- best_fit
        cat("   🏆 Best kappa selected:", best_kappa, "(SSE:", round(best_sse, 3), ")\n")
      }
      
      # Perform kriging
      kriging_result <- krige(Monthly_Precipitation ~ 1, 
                             spatial_points, 
                             prediction_grid, 
                             model = vgm_fit)
    }
    
    cat("   ✅ Optimized Matérn Kriging completed successfully!\n")
    
    return(list(
      kriging_result = kriging_result,
      variogram_emp = vgm_emp,
      variogram_fit = vgm_fit,
      model = "Matérn (Optimized)",
      optimization_method = ifelse(optimize_kappa && exists("auto_result"), "automap", "manual")
    ))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("   ❌ Optimized Kriging failed:", e$message, "\n")
    
    # Last resort fallback
    cat("   🔄 Attempting basic Matérn fallback...\n")
    vgm_emp <- variogram(Monthly_Precipitation ~ 1, spatial_points)
    vgm_fit <- fit.variogram(vgm_emp, vgm(model = "Mat"))
    kriging_result <- krige(Monthly_Precipitation ~ 1, spatial_points, prediction_grid, model = vgm_fit)
    
    return(list(
      kriging_result = kriging_result,
      variogram_emp = vgm_emp,
      variogram_fit = vgm_fit,
      model = "Matérn (Fallback)",
      optimization_method = "fallback"
    ))
  })
}

# Enhanced visualization function
create_enhanced_matern_kriging_map <- function(kriging_result, spatial_points, target_year_month, 
                                              optimization_method = "optimized") {
  
  cat("   🎨 Creating enhanced Matérn Kriging visualization...\n")
  
  # Get the kriging results (spatial object)
  kriging_sp <- kriging_result$kriging_result
  
  # Print original structure
  cat("   🔍 Original kriging object columns:", paste(names(kriging_sp@data), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Transform to WGS84 WITHOUT losing data
  kriging_wgs84 <- spTransform(kriging_sp, CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"))
  
  # Convert to dataframe PRESERVING ALL COLUMNS
  kriging_df <- as.data.frame(kriging_wgs84)
  
  # Print what we have after transformation
  cat("   🔍 After transformation columns:", paste(names(kriging_df), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Get coordinates (these are automatically added by as.data.frame)
  coords <- coordinates(kriging_wgs84)
  kriging_df$Longitude <- coords[,1]
  kriging_df$Latitude <- coords[,2]
  
  # Transform points
  points_wgs84 <- spTransform(spatial_points, CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"))
  points_df <- as.data.frame(points_wgs84)
  points_coords <- coordinates(points_wgs84)
  points_df$Longitude <- points_coords[,1]
  points_df$Latitude <- points_coords[,2]
  
  cat("   🔍 Points data columns:", paste(names(points_df), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Find prediction column in the ACTUAL data
  pred_col <- NULL
  possible_pred_names <- c("var1.pred", "prediction", "pred", "z", "values")
  for(name in possible_pred_names) {
    if(name %in% names(kriging_df)) {
      pred_col <- name
      cat("   ✅ Found prediction column:", name, "\n")
      break
    }
  }
  
  # If still not found, list all numeric columns and let user see
  if(is.null(pred_col)) {
    numeric_cols <- names(kriging_df)[sapply(kriging_df, is.numeric)]
    non_coord_cols <- numeric_cols[!numeric_cols %in% c("Longitude", "Latitude")]
    cat("   ⚠️ Prediction column not found. Available numeric columns:", paste(non_coord_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    if(length(non_coord_cols) > 0) {
      pred_col <- non_coord_cols[1]
      cat("   🔄 Using first available numeric column:", pred_col, "\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Find variance column
  var_col <- NULL
  possible_var_names <- c("var1.var", "variance", "var", "se", "std_error")
  for(name in possible_var_names) {
    if(name %in% names(kriging_df)) {
      var_col <- name
      cat("   ✅ Found variance column:", name, "\n")
      break
    }
  }
  
  # Validate prediction column exists
  if(is.null(pred_col) || !pred_col %in% names(kriging_df)) {
    stop(paste("Cannot find prediction column. Available columns:", paste(names(kriging_df), collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Show data range BEFORE filtering
  cat("   📊 Prediction column", pred_col, "range:", 
      round(min(kriging_df[[pred_col]], na.rm = TRUE), 2), "to", 
      round(max(kriging_df[[pred_col]], na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
  
  # Clean the data MORE CAREFULLY - only remove clearly invalid values
  original_rows <- nrow(kriging_df)
  
  # Only filter out truly invalid values
  valid_idx <- !is.na(kriging_df[[pred_col]]) & 
               is.finite(kriging_df[[pred_col]])
  
  kriging_df <- kriging_df[valid_idx, ]
  
  cat("   🧹 Filtered", original_rows - nrow(kriging_df), "invalid rows, kept", nrow(kriging_df), "rows\n")
  
  if(nrow(kriging_df) == 0) {
    stop("No valid prediction values remain after filtering")
  }
  
  # Handle points data - find precipitation column
  precip_col <- NULL
  possible_precip_names <- c("Monthly_Precipitation", "monthly_rainfall", "precipitation", "rainfall", "rain")
  for(name in possible_precip_names) {
    if(name %in% names(points_df)) {
      precip_col <- name
      cat("   ✅ Found precipitation column:", name, "\n")
      break
    }
  }
  
  # If not found, show available numeric columns
  if(is.null(precip_col)) {
    numeric_cols <- names(points_df)[sapply(points_df, is.numeric)]
    coord_names <- c("Longitude", "Latitude", "coords.x1", "coords.x2", "X_UTM", "Y_UTM")
    precip_candidates <- numeric_cols[!numeric_cols %in% coord_names]
    cat("   ⚠️ Precipitation column not found. Available options:", paste(precip_candidates, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    if(length(precip_candidates) > 0) {
      precip_col <- precip_candidates[1]
      cat("   🔄 Using:", precip_col, "\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Add default values for missing columns in points
  if(!"Data_Source" %in% names(points_df)) {
    points_df$Data_Source <- "Unknown"
  }
  if(!"Match_Type" %in% names(points_df)) {
    points_df$Match_Type <- "Exact"
  }
  if(!"Station" %in% names(points_df)) {
    points_df$Station <- paste0("S", seq_len(nrow(points_df)))
  }
  
  # Get variogram parameters for subtitle
  vgm_params <- kriging_result$variogram_fit
  kappa_val <- if("kappa" %in% names(vgm_params)) {
    round(vgm_params$kappa[length(vgm_params$kappa)], 2)
  } else {
    "0.5 (default)"
  }
  
  range_val <- if(nrow(vgm_params) > 1) {
    round(vgm_params$range[2], 0)
  } else {
    round(vgm_params$range[1], 0)
  }
  
  cat("   🎨 Creating plot with", nrow(kriging_df), "kriging points and", nrow(points_df), "observation points\n")
  
  # Create the map using CONFIRMED column names
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Interpolated surface - use confirmed prediction column
    geom_tile(data = kriging_df, 
              aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = .data[[pred_col]]),
              alpha = 0.85) +
    
    # Contour lines if enough points
    {if(nrow(kriging_df) > 100) {
      geom_contour(data = kriging_df, 
                  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, z = .data[[pred_col]]),
                  color = "white", alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.3, bins = 10)
    }} +
    
    # Station points - use confirmed precipitation column if available
    {if(!is.null(precip_col) && precip_col %in% names(points_df)) {
      geom_point(data = points_df, 
                 aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, 
                     size = .data[[precip_col]],
                     color = Data_Source,
                     shape = Match_Type),
                 stroke = 1.3, alpha = 0.9)
    } else {
      geom_point(data = points_df, 
                 aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, 
                     color = Data_Source,
                     shape = Match_Type),
                 size = 4, stroke = 1.3, alpha = 0.9)
    }} +
    
    # Station labels
    {if(!is.null(precip_col) && precip_col %in% names(points_df)) {
      geom_text(data = points_df,
                aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, 
                    label = paste0(Station, "\n(", round(.data[[precip_col]], 1), "mm)")),
                color = "white", size = 2.2, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -2.5,
                fontface = "bold", alpha = 0.9)
    } else {
      geom_text(data = points_df,
                aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, label = Station),
                color = "white", size = 2.2, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -2.5,
                fontface = "bold", alpha = 0.9)
    }} +
    
    # Enhanced styling
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Optimized\nMatérn Kriged\nRainfall (mm)", 
                        option = "plasma",
                        na.value = "transparent",
                        trans = "sqrt",
                        labels = function(x) paste0(round(x, 1))) +
    
    # Conditional size scale
    {if(!is.null(precip_col) && precip_col %in% names(points_df)) {
      scale_size_continuous(name = "Observed\nRainfall (mm)", 
                           range = c(2.5, 9),
                           trans = "sqrt",
                           labels = function(x) paste0(round(x, 1)))
    }} +
    
    scale_color_manual(name = "Data Source",
                      values = c("Original" = "#2E86AB", 
                                "CHIRPS" = "#E74C3C", 
                                "Unknown" = "#34495E"),
                      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
    
    scale_shape_manual(name = "Match Type",
                      values = c("Exact" = 16, "Fuzzy" = 17, "Manual" = 15)) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste("Optimized Matérn Kriging - Monthly Rainfall Interpolation"),
      subtitle = paste0("Month: ", target_year_month, " | ", 
                       toupper(optimization_method), " Matérn (κ=", kappa_val, 
                       ", Range=", range_val, "m) | Prediction column: ", pred_col),
      x = "Longitude (°E)",
      y = "Latitude (°N)",
      caption = paste("Optimized using", optimization_method, "| Points show observed values, surface shows Matérn Kriging interpolation")
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.25),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "gray96"),
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm")
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
  
  return(p)
}

# Enhanced variogram plot with optimization info
create_optimized_variogram_plot <- function(kriging_results, target_year_month) {
  vgm_emp <- kriging_results$variogram_emp
  vgm_fit <- kriging_results$variogram_fit
  optimization_method <- kriging_results$optimization_method
  
  # Calculate fitted values
  max_dist <- max(vgm_emp$dist)
  dist_seq <- seq(0, max_dist, length.out = 200)
  fitted_values <- variogramLine(vgm_fit, dist_vector = dist_seq)
  
  # Extract parameters for annotation
  if(nrow(vgm_fit) >= 2) {
    nugget <- round(vgm_fit$psill[1], 3)
    sill <- round(sum(vgm_fit$psill), 3)
    range_m <- round(vgm_fit$range[2], 0)
    kappa <- if("kappa" %in% names(vgm_fit)) round(vgm_fit$kappa[2], 2) else "0.5"
  } else {
    nugget <- round(vgm_fit$psill[1], 3)
    sill <- nugget
    range_m <- round(vgm_fit$range[1], 0)
    kappa <- if("kappa" %in% names(vgm_fit)) round(vgm_fit$kappa[1], 2) else "0.5"
  }
  
  # Create annotation text
  param_text <- paste0(
    "Optimized Parameters:\n",
    "Nugget: ", nugget, "\n",
    "Sill: ", sill, "\n", 
    "Range: ", range_m, "m\n",
    "κ (kappa): ", kappa, "\n",
    "Method: ", toupper(optimization_method)
  )
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Empirical variogram points
    geom_point(data = vgm_emp, 
               aes(x = dist, y = gamma, size = np), 
               color = "#E74C3C", alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.5) +
    
    # Fitted variogram line
    geom_line(data = fitted_values, 
              aes(x = dist, y = gamma), 
              color = "#2E86AB", linewidth = 1.5, alpha = 0.9) +
    
    # Add parameter annotation
    annotate("text", 
             x = max_dist * 0.02, 
             y = max(vgm_emp$gamma) * 0.98,
             label = param_text,
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
             size = 3.2, 
             color = "gray30",
             family = "mono",
             background = "white",
             alpha = 0.9) +
    
    # Add horizontal lines for nugget and sill
    geom_hline(yintercept = nugget, linetype = "dashed", 
               color = "#E74C3C", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = sill, linetype = "dashed", 
               color = "#2E86AB", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.5) +
    
    # Add vertical line for range
    geom_vline(xintercept = range_m, linetype = "dashed", 
               color = "#27AE60", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.5) +
    
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Point\nPairs", range = c(1.5, 6), 
                         trans = "sqrt") +
    
    labs(
      title = "Optimized Matérn Variogram Model",
      subtitle = paste("Month:", target_year_month, "| Automatic parameter optimization"),
      x = "Distance (m)",
      y = "Semivariance",
      caption = "Red points: empirical variogram | Blue line: optimized Matérn model | Dashed lines: key parameters"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50"),
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.25),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Enhanced distance analysis with optimization info
create_optimized_distance_analysis <- function(spatial_points, target_year_month, kriging_results) {
  points_df <- as.data.frame(spatial_points)
  
  # Pre-calculate distance matrix efficiently
  coords <- as.matrix(points_df[, c("X_UTM", "Y_UTM")])
  n_points <- nrow(points_df)
  
  if(n_points < 2) {
    stop("Need at least 2 points for distance analysis")
  }
  
  # Pre-allocate vectors efficiently
  n_pairs <- choose(n_points, 2)
  distances <- numeric(n_pairs)
  precip_diffs <- numeric(n_pairs)
  source_pairs <- character(n_pairs)
  match_pairs <- character(n_pairs)
  completeness_pairs <- numeric(n_pairs)
  
  # Fill vectors efficiently
  idx <- 1
  for(i in 1:(n_points-1)) {
    for(j in (i+1):n_points) {
      distances[idx] <- sqrt(sum((coords[i,] - coords[j,])^2))
      precip_diffs[idx] <- abs(points_df$Monthly_Precipitation[i] - points_df$Monthly_Precipitation[j])
      
      # Create pair descriptors
      sources <- sort(c(points_df$Data_Source[i], points_df$Data_Source[j]))
      source_pairs[idx] <- paste(sources, collapse = "-")
      
      matches <- sort(c(points_df$Match_Type[i], points_df$Match_Type[j]))
      match_pairs[idx] <- paste(matches, collapse = "-")
      
      completeness_pairs[idx] <- min(points_df$Data_Completeness[i], points_df$Data_Completeness[j])
      
      idx <- idx + 1
    }
  }
  
  analysis_df <- data.frame(
    Distance = distances,
    Precipitation_Difference = precip_diffs,
    Source_Pair = source_pairs,
    Match_Pair = match_pairs,
    Min_Completeness = completeness_pairs
  )
  
  # Add variogram model line for comparison
  vgm_fit <- kriging_results$variogram_fit
  dist_range <- seq(0, max(distances), length.out = 100)
  vgm_line <- variogramLine(vgm_fit, dist_vector = dist_range)
  
  # Calculate correlation
  cor_coef <- cor(distances, precip_diffs, use = "complete.obs")
  
  p <- ggplot(analysis_df, aes(x = Distance, y = Precipitation_Difference)) +
    # Add variogram model as reference
    geom_line(data = vgm_line, 
              aes(x = dist, y = gamma), 
              color = "#3498DB", linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.7,
              linetype = "dashed") +
    
    # Scatter plot with styling
    geom_point(aes(color = Match_Pair, size = Min_Completeness), 
               alpha = 0.75, stroke = 0.5) +
    
    # Add trend line
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, 
                color = "#E74C3C", fill = "#E74C3C", 
                alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 1) +
    
    # Add correlation annotation
    annotate("text", 
             x = max(distances) * 0.02, 
             y = max(precip_diffs) * 0.98,
             label = paste0("Correlation: ", round(cor_coef, 3), "\n",
                           "Points: ", nrow(analysis_df), " pairs\n",
                           "Optimization: ", toupper(kriging_results$optimization_method)),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
             size = 3.5, color = "gray30",
             background = "white") +
    
    scale_color_brewer(name = "Station Pair\nMatch Types", 
                      type = "qual", palette = "Set2") +
    
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Min Data\nCompleteness", 
                         range = c(1.5, 5),
                         labels = scales::percent,
                         trans = "sqrt") +
    
    labs(
      title = "Spatial Autocorrelation Analysis with Optimized Matérn Model",
      subtitle = paste("Month:", target_year_month, "| Distance vs Rainfall Difference"),
      x = "Distance between stations (m)",
      y = "Monthly rainfall difference (mm)",
      caption = "Blue dashed line: optimized Matérn variogram | Red line: empirical trend | Closer stations should have similar rainfall"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50"),
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.25),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Create optimized prediction grid
create_optimized_prediction_grid <- function(spatial_data, resolution = 100, buffer_percent = 0.05) {
  # Calculate bounds with validation
  x_coords <- spatial_data$X_UTM
  y_coords <- spatial_data$Y_UTM
  
  if(any(!is.finite(x_coords)) || any(!is.finite(y_coords))) {
    stop("Invalid coordinates detected in spatial data")
  }
  
  x_min <- min(x_coords)
  x_max <- max(x_coords)
  y_min <- min(y_coords)
  y_max <- max(y_coords)
  
  # Calculate dynamic buffer
  x_range <- x_max - x_min
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  buffer_x <- x_range * buffer_percent
  buffer_y <- y_range * buffer_percent
  
  # Apply buffer
  xmin <- x_min - buffer_x
  xmax <- x_max + buffer_x
  ymin <- y_min - buffer_y
  ymax <- y_max + buffer_y
  
  cat("   📏 Optimized grid parameters:\n")
  cat("      Extent: [", round(xmin, 0), ",", round(xmax, 0), "] x [", 
      round(ymin, 0), ",", round(ymax, 0), "]\n")
  cat("      Resolution:", resolution, "m\n")
  cat("      Buffer:", round(buffer_percent*100, 1), "% of data extent\n")
  
  # Create grid with memory consideration
  x_seq <- seq(xmin, xmax, by = resolution)
  y_seq <- seq(ymin, ymax, by = resolution)
  
  n_points <- length(x_seq) * length(y_seq)
  if(n_points > 1000000) {
    warning(paste("Large grid detected:", n_points, "points. Consider increasing resolution."))
  }
  
  # Create spatial grid
  grid_df <- expand.grid(X_UTM = x_seq, Y_UTM = y_seq)
  coordinates(grid_df) <- ~X_UTM + Y_UTM
  gridded(grid_df) <- TRUE
  proj4string(grid_df) <- CRS("+proj=utm +zone=28 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")
  
  cat("      Grid size:", length(x_seq), "x", length(y_seq), "=", n_points, "points\n")
  cat("      Estimated memory:", round(n_points * 8 / 1024^2, 1), "MB\n")
  
  return(grid_df)
}

# Main optimized analysis function
perform_optimized_matern_kriging_analysis <- function(
  target_year_month, 
  shapefile_path = "Pts_GPS_Station_English.shp",
  datasets_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets",
  manual_matches = NULL, 
  similarity_threshold = 0.8,
  resolution = 100, 
  buffer_percent = 0.05,
  optimize_kappa = TRUE,
  kappa_range = c(0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 5.0),
  use_parallel = TRUE
) {
  
  cat("🚀 Starting OPTIMIZED Matérn Kriging Analysis with automap...\n")
  cat("==========================================================\n")
  cat("   Target month:", target_year_month, "\n")
  cat("   Optimization:", ifelse(optimize_kappa, "ENABLED", "DISABLED"), "\n")
  cat("   Kappa range:", paste(kappa_range, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("   Parallel processing:", ifelse(use_parallel, "ENABLED", "DISABLED"), "\n")
  cat("   Grid resolution:", resolution, "m\n")
  cat("   Buffer:", buffer_percent*100, "%\n\n")
  
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  
  # Step 1: Load GPS coordinates
  cat("📍 STEP 1: Loading GPS coordinates...\n")
  gps_coordinates <- load_gps_station_coordinates_optimized(shapefile_path)
  
  # Step 2: Load and aggregate rainfall data
  cat("\n📥 STEP 2: Loading rainfall data...\n")
  monthly_result <- load_and_aggregate_monthly_data_optimized(datasets_dir)
  monthly_data_list <- monthly_result$monthly_data
  
  # Step 3: Match stations
  cat("\n🔗 STEP 3: Matching stations...\n")
  matched_coordinates <- match_rainfall_with_gps_optimized(
    monthly_data_list, gps_coordinates, similarity_threshold, manual_matches
  )
  
  # Step 4: Prepare spatial data
  cat("\n📊 STEP 4: Preparing spatial data...\n")
  spatial_data <- prepare_monthly_spatial_data_optimized(
    monthly_data_list, matched_coordinates, target_year_month
  )
  
  # Create spatial points
  spatial_points <- spatial_data
  coordinates(spatial_points) <- ~X_UTM + Y_UTM
  proj4string(spatial_points) <- CRS("+proj=utm +zone=28 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")
  
  # Step 5: Create prediction grid
  cat("\n🗺️ STEP 5: Creating prediction grid...\n")
  prediction_grid <- create_optimized_prediction_grid(spatial_data, resolution, buffer_percent)
  
  # Step 6: Perform optimized Kriging
  cat("\n🎯 STEP 6: Performing optimized Matérn Kriging...\n")
  kriging_results <- perform_optimized_matern_kriging(
    spatial_points, prediction_grid, optimize_kappa, kappa_range
  )
  
  # Step 7: Create visualizations
  cat("\n🎨 STEP 7: Creating enhanced visualizations...\n")
  
  interpolation_map <- create_enhanced_matern_kriging_map(
    kriging_results, spatial_points, target_year_month, 
    kriging_results$optimization_method
  )
  
  variogram_plot <- create_optimized_variogram_plot(kriging_results, target_year_month)
  
  distance_analysis <- create_optimized_distance_analysis(
    spatial_points, target_year_month, kriging_results
  )
  
  # Calculate performance metrics
  end_time <- Sys.time()
  processing_time <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "secs"))
  
  # Comprehensive summary statistics
  kriging_df <- as.data.frame(kriging_results$kriging_result)
  vgm_fit <- kriging_results$variogram_fit
  
  summary_stats <- list(
    # Analysis parameters
    target_year_month = target_year_month,
    analysis_timestamp = Sys.time(),
    processing_time_seconds = round(processing_time, 2),
    
    # Data statistics
    n_stations_total = length(monthly_data_list),
    n_stations_matched = matched_coordinates$match_count,
    n_stations_used = nrow(spatial_data),
    matching_rate_percent = round(matched_coordinates$match_count / length(monthly_data_list) * 100, 1),
    
    # Spatial statistics
    utm_zone = "28N",
    grid_resolution_m = resolution,
    grid_points = nrow(kriging_df),
    buffer_percent = buffer_percent,
    
    # Data quality
    avg_data_completeness = round(mean(spatial_data$Data_Completeness, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    min_data_completeness = round(min(spatial_data$Data_Completeness, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    n_original_stations = sum(spatial_data$Data_Source == "Original", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_chirps_stations = sum(spatial_data$Data_Source == "CHIRPS", na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Matching statistics
    n_exact_matches = sum(spatial_data$Match_Type == "Exact", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_fuzzy_matches = sum(spatial_data$Match_Type == "Fuzzy", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_manual_matches = sum(spatial_data$Match_Type == "Manual", na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_match_score = round(mean(spatial_data$Match_Score, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    
    # Rainfall statistics
    observed_rainfall_min = round(min(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    observed_rainfall_max = round(max(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    observed_rainfall_mean = round(mean(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    observed_rainfall_median = round(median(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    observed_rainfall_sd = round(sd(spatial_data$Monthly_Precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    
    # Kriging results
    kriged_rainfall_min = round(min(kriging_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    kriged_rainfall_max = round(max(kriging_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    kriged_rainfall_mean = round(mean(kriging_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    kriged_rainfall_median = round(median(kriging_df$var1.pred, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    
    # Kriging uncertainty
    kriging_variance_min = round(min(kriging_df$var1.var, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    kriging_variance_max = round(max(kriging_df$var1.var, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    kriging_variance_mean = round(mean(kriging_df$var1.var, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    kriging_variance_median = round(median(kriging_df$var1.var, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    
    # Variogram parameters
    variogram_model = "Matérn",
    optimization_method = kriging_results$optimization_method,
    variogram_nugget = round(vgm_fit$psill[1], 3),
    variogram_sill = round(sum(vgm_fit$psill), 3),
    variogram_range_m = ifelse(nrow(vgm_fit) > 1, round(vgm_fit$range[2], 0), round(vgm_fit$range[1], 0)),
    variogram_kappa = ifelse("kappa" %in% names(vgm_fit), 
                            round(vgm_fit$kappa[length(vgm_fit$kappa)], 3), 0.5),
    
    # Technical parameters
    similarity_threshold = similarity_threshold,
    kappa_optimization = optimize_kappa,
    kappa_range = paste(kappa_range, collapse = ", "),
    parallel_processing = use_parallel,
    r_version = R.version.string,
    automap_available = require(automap, quietly = TRUE)
  )
  
  cat("\n✅ OPTIMIZED MATÉRN KRIGING ANALYSIS COMPLETED!\n")
  cat("================================================\n")
  cat("Processing time:", round(processing_time, 1), "seconds\n")
  cat("Stations used:", summary_stats$n_stations_used, "/", summary_stats$n_stations_total, 
      "(", summary_stats$matching_rate_percent, "% matched)\n")
  cat("Optimization method:", toupper(summary_stats$optimization_method), "\n")
  cat("Optimized kappa:", summary_stats$variogram_kappa, "\n")
  cat("Variogram range:", summary_stats$variogram_range_m, "m\n")
  cat("Mean kriging variance:", summary_stats$kriging_variance_mean, "\n")
  cat("Rainfall range (observed):", summary_stats$observed_rainfall_min, "-", 
      summary_stats$observed_rainfall_max, "mm\n")
  cat("Rainfall range (kriged):", summary_stats$kriged_rainfall_min, "-", 
      summary_stats$kriged_rainfall_max, "mm\n")
  
  return(list(
    interpolation_map = interpolation_map,
    variogram_plot = variogram_plot,
    distance_analysis = distance_analysis,
    kriging_results = kriging_results,
    spatial_data = spatial_data,
    matched_coordinates = matched_coordinates,
    summary_stats = summary_stats,
    monthly_data_list = monthly_data_list
  ))
}

# Enhanced save function
save_optimized_kriging_results <- function(results, output_dir = "optimized_matern_kriging_results") {
  if(is.null(results)) {
    cat("❌ No results to save\n")
    return()
  }
  
  if(!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    cat("📁 Created output directory:", output_dir, "\n")
  }
  
  target_month_str <- gsub("-", "_", results$summary_stats$target_year_month)
  timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
  
  tryCatch({
    # Save enhanced visualizations
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("optimized_matern_interpolation_", target_month_str, ".png")),
           results$interpolation_map, width = 18, height = 14, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("optimized_variogram_", target_month_str, ".png")),
           results$variogram_plot, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("optimized_distance_analysis_", target_month_str, ".png")),
           results$distance_analysis, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    # Save data with enhanced metadata
    spatial_data_enhanced <- results$spatial_data
    spatial_data_enhanced$Analysis_Timestamp <- results$summary_stats$analysis_timestamp
    spatial_data_enhanced$Optimization_Method <- results$summary_stats$optimization_method
    spatial_data_enhanced$Variogram_Kappa <- results$summary_stats$variogram_kappa
    
    write.csv(spatial_data_enhanced, 
              file.path(output_dir, paste0("optimized_spatial_data_", target_month_str, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save comprehensive summary
    summary_df <- data.frame(
      Parameter = names(results$summary_stats),
      Value = as.character(results$summary_stats),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    write.csv(summary_df,
              file.path(output_dir, paste0("optimized_analysis_summary_", target_month_str, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save variogram parameters in detail
    vgm_detailed <- results$kriging_results$variogram_fit
    vgm_detailed$Analysis_Method <- results$summary_stats$optimization_method
    vgm_detailed$Target_Month <- results$summary_stats$target_year_month
    vgm_detailed$Timestamp <- results$summary_stats$analysis_timestamp
    
    write.csv(vgm_detailed,
              file.path(output_dir, paste0("optimized_variogram_parameters_", target_month_str, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Save kriging results as raster (both UTM and WGS84)
    kriging_raster <- rast(results$kriging_results$kriging_result)
    
    # UTM version
    writeRaster(kriging_raster, 
                file.path(output_dir, paste0("optimized_kriging_utm28n_", target_month_str, ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
    
    # WGS84 version
    kriging_wgs84 <- project(kriging_raster, "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs")
    writeRaster(kriging_wgs84, 
                file.path(output_dir, paste0("optimized_kriging_wgs84_", target_month_str, ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
    
    # Save processing log
    log_content <- c(
      paste("Optimized Matérn Kriging Analysis Log"),
      paste("Generated:", Sys.time()),
      paste("Target Month:", results$summary_stats$target_year_month),
      paste("Processing Time:", results$summary_stats$processing_time_seconds, "seconds"),
      paste("Optimization Method:", results$summary_stats$optimization_method),
      paste("Stations Used:", results$summary_stats$n_stations_used),
      paste("Optimized Kappa:", results$summary_stats$variogram_kappa),
      paste("Variogram Range:", results$summary_stats$variogram_range_m, "m"),
      paste("R Version:", results$summary_stats$r_version),
      "",
      "Files generated:",
      list.files(output_dir, pattern = paste0(".*", target_month_str, ".*"), full.names = FALSE)
    )
    
    writeLines(log_content, file.path(output_dir, paste0("analysis_log_", target_month_str, ".txt")))
    
    cat("💾 Optimized Matérn Kriging results saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
    cat("📊 Generated", length(list.files(output_dir)), "output files\n")
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ Error saving results:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

# Display comprehensive results
display_comprehensive_results <- function(results) {
  if(is.null(results)) {
    cat("❌ No results to display\n")
    return()
  }
  
  cat("\n📊 COMPREHENSIVE OPTIMIZED MATÉRN KRIGING RESULTS\n")
  cat("==================================================\n")
  
  stats <- results$summary_stats
  
  # Analysis overview
  cat("📅 ANALYSIS OVERVIEW:\n")
  cat("   Target month:", stats$target_year_month, "\n")
  cat("   Analysis completed:", format(stats$analysis_timestamp, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n")
  cat("   Processing time:", stats$processing_time_seconds, "seconds\n")
  cat("   Optimization method:", toupper(stats$optimization_method), "\n\n")
  
  # Data statistics
  cat("📊 DATA STATISTICS:\n")
  cat("   Total rainfall stations:", stats$n_stations_total, "\n")
  cat("   Successfully matched:", stats$n_stations_matched, "(", stats$matching_rate_percent, "%)\n")
  cat("   Used for kriging:", stats$n_stations_used, "\n")
  cat("   Average data completeness:", round(stats$avg_data_completeness * 100, 1), "%\n\n")
  
  # Matching performance
  cat("🔗 MATCHING PERFORMANCE:\n")
  cat("   Exact matches:", stats$n_exact_matches, "\n")
  cat("   Fuzzy matches:", stats$n_fuzzy_matches, "\n")
  cat("   Manual matches:", stats$n_manual_matches, "\n")
  cat("   Average match score:", stats$avg_match_score, "\n\n")
  
  # Variogram optimization
  cat("🎯 VARIOGRAM OPTIMIZATION:\n")
  cat("   Model:", stats$variogram_model, "\n")
  cat("   Optimized kappa:", stats$variogram_kappa, "\n")
  cat("   Nugget:", stats$variogram_nugget, "\n")
  cat("   Sill:", stats$variogram_sill, "\n")
  cat("   Range:", stats$variogram_range_m, "meters\n")
  cat("   Kappa range tested:", stats$kappa_range, "\n\n")
  
  # Rainfall statistics
  cat("🌧️ RAINFALL STATISTICS:\n")
  cat("   Observed range:", stats$observed_rainfall_min, "-", stats$observed_rainfall_max, "mm\n")
  cat("   Observed mean:", stats$observed_rainfall_mean, "mm\n")
  cat("   Observed median:", stats$observed_rainfall_median, "mm\n")
  cat("   Observed std dev:", stats$observed_rainfall_sd, "mm\n")
  cat("   Kriged range:", stats$kriged_rainfall_min, "-", stats$kriged_rainfall_max, "mm\n")
  cat("   Kriged mean:", stats$kriged_rainfall_mean, "mm\n\n")
  
  # Uncertainty analysis
  cat("📈 UNCERTAINTY ANALYSIS:\n")
  cat("   Kriging variance range:", stats$kriging_variance_min, "-", stats$kriging_variance_max, "\n")
  cat("   Mean kriging variance:", stats$kriging_variance_mean, "\n")
  cat("   Median kriging variance:", stats$kriging_variance_median, "\n\n")
  
  # Technical details
  cat("⚙️ TECHNICAL DETAILS:\n")
  cat("   UTM zone:", stats$utm_zone, "\n")
  cat("   Grid resolution:", stats$grid_resolution_m, "meters\n")
  cat("   Grid points:", stats$grid_points, "\n")
  cat("   Buffer percentage:", stats$buffer_percent * 100, "%\n")
  cat("   Similarity threshold:", stats$similarity_threshold, "\n")
  cat("   Parallel processing:", ifelse(stats$parallel_processing, "ENABLED", "DISABLED"), "\n")
  cat("   automap available:", ifelse(stats$automap_available, "YES", "NO"), "\n")
  cat("   R version:", stats$r_version, "\n\n")
  
  # Display visualizations
  cat("🎨 DISPLAYING VISUALIZATIONS:\n\n")
  print(results$interpolation_map)
  cat("\n")
  print(results$variogram_plot)
  cat("\n")
  print(results$distance_analysis)
  cat("\n")
  
  return(invisible(results))
}

# Function to test automap availability and performance
test_automap_optimization <- function(spatial_points, n_tests = 3) {
  cat("🧪 TESTING AUTOMAP OPTIMIZATION PERFORMANCE...\n")
  
  if(!require(automap, quietly = TRUE)) {
    cat("❌ automap package not available\n")
    cat("   Install with: install.packages('automap')\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Create small test grid
  test_grid <- spatial_points[1:min(10, length(spatial_points)), ]
  coordinates(test_grid) <- ~X_UTM + Y_UTM
  gridded(test_grid) <- TRUE
  proj4string(test_grid) <- proj4string(spatial_points)
  
  cat("   Running", n_tests, "optimization tests...\n")
  
  times <- numeric(n_tests)
  kappa_values <- numeric(n_tests)
  
  for(i in 1:n_tests) {
    start_time <- Sys.time()
    
    tryCatch({
      auto_result <- autoKrige(
        Monthly_Precipitation ~ 1,
        input_data = spatial_points,
        new_data = test_grid,
        model = c("Mat"),
        kappa = c(0.5, 1.0, 2.0),
        verbose = FALSE
      )
      
      end_time <- Sys.time()
      times[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "secs"))
      
      vgm_fit <- auto_result$var_model
      kappa_values[i] <- if("kappa" %in% names(vgm_fit)) {
        vgm_fit$kappa[length(vgm_fit$kappa)]
      } else {
        0.5
      }
      
      cat("      Test", i, "- Time:", round(times[i], 2), "s, Kappa:", round(kappa_values[i], 3), "\n")
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("      Test", i, "- FAILED:", e$message, "\n")
      times[i] <- NA
      kappa_values[i] <- NA
    })
  }
  
  valid_times <- times[!is.na(times)]
  valid_kappas <- kappa_values[!is.na(kappa_values)]
  
  if(length(valid_times) > 0) {
    cat("   ✅ automap optimization working\n")
    cat("      Average time:", round(mean(valid_times), 2), "seconds\n")
    cat("      Kappa range:", round(min(valid_kappas), 3), "-", round(max(valid_kappas), 3), "\n")
    cat("      Success rate:", round(length(valid_times)/n_tests*100, 1), "%\n")
  } else {
    cat("   ❌ All automap tests failed\n")
  }
  
  return(list(
    times = valid_times,
    kappa_values = valid_kappas,
    success_rate = length(valid_times)/n_tests
  ))
}

# Function to compare manual vs automatic optimization
compare_optimization_methods <- function(spatial_points, prediction_grid, 
                                       kappa_range = c(0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0)) {
  cat("⚖️ COMPARING OPTIMIZATION METHODS...\n")
  
  results <- list()
  
  # Test manual optimization
  cat("   🔧 Testing manual optimization...\n")
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  
  tryCatch({
    manual_result <- perform_optimized_matern_kriging(
      spatial_points, prediction_grid, optimize_kappa = FALSE, kappa_range
    )
    manual_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs"))
    results$manual <- list(result = manual_result, time = manual_time)
    cat("      Manual optimization completed in", round(manual_time, 2), "seconds\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("      Manual optimization failed:", e$message, "\n")
  })
  
  # Test automap optimization
  if(require(automap, quietly = TRUE)) {
    cat("   🤖 Testing automap optimization...\n")
    start_time <- Sys.time()
    
    tryCatch({
      auto_result <- perform_optimized_matern_kriging(
        spatial_points, prediction_grid, optimize_kappa = TRUE, kappa_range
      )
      auto_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs"))
      results$automap <- list(result = auto_result, time = auto_time)
      cat("      automap optimization completed in", round(auto_time, 2), "seconds\n")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("      automap optimization failed:", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
  
  # Compare results
  if(length(results) > 1) {
    cat("\n   📊 COMPARISON RESULTS:\n")
    
    for(method in names(results)) {
      res <- results[[method]]$result
      time <- results[[method]]$time
      vgm <- res$variogram_fit
      
      kappa <- if("kappa" %in% names(vgm)) vgm$kappa[length(vgm$kappa)] else 0.5
      range_m <- if(nrow(vgm) > 1) vgm$range[2] else vgm$range[1]
      nugget <- vgm$psill[1]
      
      cat("      ", toupper(method), ":\n")
      cat("         Time:", round(time, 2), "seconds\n")
      cat("         Kappa:", round(kappa, 3), "\n")
      cat("         Range:", round(range_m, 0), "m\n")
      cat("         Nugget:", round(nugget, 3), "\n")
    }
    
    if("automap" %in% names(results) && "manual" %in% names(results)) {
      speedup <- results$manual$time / results$automap$time
      cat("      Speed ratio (manual/auto):", round(speedup, 2), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  return(results)
}

# Function to validate kriging results quality
validate_kriging_quality <- function(kriging_result, spatial_points, method = "cross_validation") {
  cat("🔍 VALIDATING KRIGING QUALITY...\n")
  
  if(method == "cross_validation") {
    cat("   Using leave-one-out cross-validation...\n")
    
    tryCatch({
      # Perform cross-validation
      cv_result <- krige.cv(Monthly_Precipitation ~ 1, spatial_points, 
                           model = kriging_result$variogram_fit, nfold = nrow(spatial_points))
      
      # Calculate quality metrics
      observed <- cv_result$observed
      predicted <- cv_result$var1.pred
      residuals <- cv_result$residual
      
      # Statistical measures
      rmse <- sqrt(mean(residuals^2, na.rm = TRUE))
      mae <- mean(abs(residuals), na.rm = TRUE)
      correlation <- cor(observed, predicted, use = "complete.obs")
      bias <- mean(residuals, na.rm = TRUE)
      
      cat("   📊 Cross-validation results:\n")
      cat("      RMSE:", round(rmse, 3), "\n")
      cat("      MAE:", round(mae, 3), "\n")
      cat("      Correlation:", round(correlation, 3), "\n")
      cat("      Bias:", round(bias, 3), "\n")
      cat("      R²:", round(correlation^2, 3), "\n")
      
      # Normality test of residuals
      shapiro_test <- shapiro.test(residuals[1:min(length(residuals), 5000)])
      cat("      Residuals normality (p-value):", round(shapiro_test$p.value, 4), "\n")
      
      return(list(
        rmse = rmse,
        mae = mae,
        correlation = correlation,
        bias = bias,
        r_squared = correlation^2,
        residuals = residuals,
        shapiro_p = shapiro_test$p.value
      ))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("   ❌ Cross-validation failed:", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
  }
}
```
