```{r}
# Import TIF and Recreate Enhanced Optimized Matérn Kriging Visualization
# This script imports saved Optimized Matérn Kriging TIF files and recreates the same enhanced visualization
# as the original optimized Matérn Kriging analysis with automap optimization details

# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)        # For raster handling
library(sf)           # Modern spatial data
library(viridis)      # Color palettes
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(lubridate)

# Install and load required packages
install_and_load <- function(packages) {
  new_packages <- packages[!(packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
  if(length(new_packages)) {
    cat("Installing packages:", paste(new_packages, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    install.packages(new_packages, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
  sapply(packages, function(x) {
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(x, character.only = TRUE))
  })
}

required_packages <- c("terra", "sf", "viridis", "scales")
install_and_load(required_packages)

# Helper function for safe NULL coalescing
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (!is.null(x)) x else y

# Function to import Optimized Matérn Kriging TIF file and associated data
import_optimized_matern_kriging_from_tif <- function(results_dir = "optimized_matern_kriging_results", 
                                                    target_year_month = "2021_08") {
  
  cat("📥 Importing OPTIMIZED Matérn Kriging results from TIF files...\n")
  cat("   Directory:", results_dir, "\n")
  cat("   Target month:", target_year_month, "\n")
  
  if(!dir.exists(results_dir)) {
    stop(paste("Results directory not found:", results_dir))
  }
  
  # File paths for optimized Matérn results
  tif_file_utm <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("optimized_kriging_utm28n_", target_year_month, ".tif"))
  tif_file_wgs84 <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("optimized_kriging_wgs84_", target_year_month, ".tif"))
  spatial_data_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("optimized_spatial_data_", target_year_month, ".csv"))
  summary_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("optimized_analysis_summary_", target_year_month, ".csv"))
  variogram_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("optimized_variogram_parameters_", target_year_month, ".csv"))
  
  # Check if required files exist - prefer WGS84 for visualization
  primary_tif <- if(file.exists(tif_file_wgs84)) tif_file_wgs84 else tif_file_utm
  
  required_files <- c(primary_tif, spatial_data_file)
  missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]
  
  if(length(missing_files) > 0) {
    cat("❌ Missing required files:\n")
    for(file in missing_files) {
      cat("   ", file, "\n")
    }
    stop("Cannot proceed without required files")
  }
  
  # Load TIF file
  cat("   📍 Loading Optimized Matérn Kriging raster from TIF...\n")
  kriging_raster <- rast(primary_tif)
  cat("      Raster dimensions:", nrow(kriging_raster), "x", ncol(kriging_raster), "\n")
  cat("      Raster extent:", paste(round(as.vector(ext(kriging_raster)), 4), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("      Raster CRS:", crs(kriging_raster), "\n")
  
  # Convert raster to dataframe for ggplot
  kriging_df <- as.data.frame(kriging_raster, xy = TRUE)
  
  # Handle layer names - automap typically creates var1.pred and var1.var
  prediction_col <- names(kriging_df)[grepl("pred|prediction", names(kriging_df), ignore.case = TRUE)]
  variance_col <- names(kriging_df)[grepl("var|variance", names(kriging_df), ignore.case = TRUE)]
  
  if(length(prediction_col) == 0) {
    # Fallback to first non-coordinate column
    prediction_col <- names(kriging_df)[!names(kriging_df) %in% c("x", "y")][1]
  } else {
    prediction_col <- prediction_col[1]
  }
  
  if(length(variance_col) == 0) {
    variance_col <- NULL
  } else {
    variance_col <- variance_col[1]
  }
  
  cat("      Prediction column:", prediction_col, "\n")
  if(!is.null(variance_col)) {
    cat("      Variance column:", variance_col, "\n")
  }
  
  # Check for duplicate column names and handle them
  if(any(duplicated(names(kriging_df)))) {
    cat("   ⚠️ Duplicate column names detected. Renaming duplicates...\n")
    names(kriging_df) <- make.unique(names(kriging_df))
  }
  
  # Rename columns for consistency with optimized Matérn output
  names(kriging_df)[names(kriging_df) == "x"] <- "Longitude"
  names(kriging_df)[names(kriging_df) == "y"] <- "Latitude"
  
  # Only keep the prediction column, drop variance if it exists with same name
  if(!is.null(variance_col) && variance_col == prediction_col) {
    cat("   ⚠️ Variance column has same name as prediction column. Using only prediction data.\n")
    # Keep only the prediction column and coordinates
    kriging_df <- kriging_df[, c("Longitude", "Latitude", prediction_col)]
    names(kriging_df)[names(kriging_df) == prediction_col] <- "var1.pred"
    has_variance <- FALSE
  } else {
    names(kriging_df)[names(kriging_df) == prediction_col] <- "var1.pred"
    if(!is.null(variance_col)) {
      names(kriging_df)[names(kriging_df) == variance_col] <- "var1.var"
      has_variance <- TRUE
    } else {
      has_variance <- FALSE
    }
  }
  
  # Filter out NA and invalid values - use only the prediction column
  original_rows <- nrow(kriging_df)
  kriging_df <- kriging_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(var1.pred) & is.finite(var1.pred) & var1.pred >= 0)
  
  cat("      Original raster points:", original_rows, "\n")
  cat("      Valid prediction points after filtering:", nrow(kriging_df), "\n")
  cat("      Rainfall range:", round(min(kriging_df$var1.pred), 1), "-", 
      round(max(kriging_df$var1.pred), 1), "mm\n")
  
  # Load spatial station data (enhanced with optimization info)
  cat("   📊 Loading optimized spatial data...\n")
  spatial_data <- read_csv(spatial_data_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cat("      Stations loaded:", nrow(spatial_data), "\n")
  
  # Load analysis summary
  summary_stats <- NULL
  optimization_method <- "automap"
  variogram_kappa <- 0.5
  variogram_range <- 1000
  
  if(file.exists(summary_file)) {
    cat("   📋 Loading optimized analysis summary...\n")
    summary_raw <- read_csv(summary_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    # Check if summary is in key-value format or already a named vector
    if(ncol(summary_raw) == 2 && all(c("Parameter", "Value") %in% names(summary_raw))) {
      summary_stats <- setNames(summary_raw$Value, summary_raw$Parameter)
      
      # Extract key optimization info safely
      optimization_method <- as.character(summary_stats["optimization_method"]) %||% "automap"
      variogram_kappa <- as.numeric(summary_stats["variogram_kappa"]) %||% 0.5
      variogram_range <- as.numeric(summary_stats["variogram_range_m"]) %||% 1000
      
    } else {
      # Handle case where summary is already in a different format
      cat("   ⚠️ Summary file has unexpected format, using default values\n")
      summary_stats <- as.list(summary_raw)
    }
    
    cat("      Optimization method:", toupper(optimization_method), "\n")
    cat("      Optimized kappa:", variogram_kappa, "\n")
    cat("      Variogram range:", variogram_range, "m\n")
  }
  
  # Load detailed variogram parameters
  variogram_params <- NULL
  if(file.exists(variogram_file)) {
    cat("   📈 Loading optimized variogram parameters...\n")
    variogram_params <- read_csv(variogram_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  }
  
  cat("✅ Successfully imported Optimized Matérn Kriging results from TIF!\n")
  
  return(list(
    kriging_df = kriging_df,
    spatial_data = spatial_data,
    summary_stats = summary_stats,
    variogram_params = variogram_params,
    target_year_month = gsub("_", "-", target_year_month),
    optimization_method = optimization_method,
    variogram_kappa = variogram_kappa,
    variogram_range = variogram_range,
    has_variance = has_variance
  ))
}

# Function to recreate the enhanced Optimized Matérn Kriging visualization from TIF
recreate_optimized_matern_map_from_tif <- function(imported_data, 
                                                  title_prefix = "Optimized Matérn Kriging from TIF") {
  
  cat("🎨 Recreating enhanced OPTIMIZED Matérn Kriging visualization from TIF...\n")
  
  # Extract data components
  kriging_df <- imported_data$kriging_df
  spatial_data <- imported_data$spatial_data
  target_year_month <- imported_data$target_year_month
  optimization_method <- imported_data$optimization_method
  kappa_val <- imported_data$variogram_kappa
  range_val <- imported_data$variogram_range
  
  cat("   📊 Kriging points for plotting:", nrow(kriging_df), "\n")
  cat("   📍 Station points for plotting:", nrow(spatial_data), "\n")
  cat("   🎯 Optimization method:", toupper(optimization_method), "\n")
  cat("   📈 Optimized kappa:", kappa_val, "\n")
  
  # Ensure required columns exist in spatial_data with defaults for missing ones
  required_cols <- c("Longitude", "Latitude", "Monthly_Precipitation", "Data_Source", "Match_Type")
  missing_cols <- required_cols[!required_cols %in% names(spatial_data)]
  
  if(length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    cat("   ⚠️ Adding default values for missing columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    if(!"Data_Source" %in% names(spatial_data)) spatial_data$Data_Source <- "Unknown"
    if(!"Match_Type" %in% names(spatial_data)) spatial_data$Match_Type <- "Exact"
    if(!"Data_Completeness" %in% names(spatial_data)) spatial_data$Data_Completeness <- 1.0
    if(!"Station" %in% names(spatial_data)) spatial_data$Station <- paste0("S", seq_len(nrow(spatial_data)))
  }
  
  # Handle precipitation column name variations
  precip_col <- names(spatial_data)[grepl("precipitation|rainfall", names(spatial_data), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
  if(is.na(precip_col)) {
    # Find first numeric column that's not coordinates
    numeric_cols <- names(spatial_data)[sapply(spatial_data, is.numeric)]
    coord_names <- c("Longitude", "Latitude", "X_UTM", "Y_UTM")
    precip_col <- numeric_cols[!numeric_cols %in% coord_names][1]
  }
  
  if(!is.na(precip_col) && precip_col != "Monthly_Precipitation") {
    names(spatial_data)[names(spatial_data) == precip_col] <- "Monthly_Precipitation"
  }
  
  # Create subtitle with optimization details
  subtitle_text <- paste0("Month: ", target_year_month, " | ", 
                         toupper(optimization_method), " Matérn (κ=", round(kappa_val, 2), 
                         ", Range=", round(range_val, 0), "m) | Imported from TIF")
  
  # Create the enhanced map with optimized Matérn styling
  cat("   🗺️ Building enhanced optimized Matérn visualization...\n")
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Interpolated surface - using plasma color scheme as in original optimized version
    geom_tile(data = kriging_df, 
              aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, fill = var1.pred),
              alpha = 0.85) +
    
    # Contour lines if enough points
    {if(nrow(kriging_df) > 100) {
      geom_contour(data = kriging_df, 
                  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, z = var1.pred),
                  color = "white", alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.3, bins = 10)
    }} +
    
    # Station points - enhanced styling matching optimized version
    geom_point(data = spatial_data, 
               aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, 
                   size = Monthly_Precipitation,
                   color = Data_Source,
                   shape = Match_Type),
               stroke = 1.3, alpha = 0.9) +
    
    # Station labels with precipitation values - matching optimized format
    geom_text(data = spatial_data,
              aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, 
                  label = paste0(Station, "\n(", round(Monthly_Precipitation, 1), "mm)")),
              color = "white", size = 2.2, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -2.5,
              fontface = "bold", alpha = 0.9) +
    
    # Enhanced styling - exactly as optimized Matérn version
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Optimized\nMatérn Kriged\nRainfall (mm)", 
                        option = "plasma",
                        na.value = "transparent",
                        trans = "sqrt",
                        labels = function(x) paste0(round(x, 1))) +
    
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Observed\nRainfall (mm)", 
                         range = c(2.5, 9),
                         trans = "sqrt",
                         labels = function(x) paste0(round(x, 1))) +
    
    scale_color_manual(name = "Data Source",
                      values = c("Original" = "#2E86AB", 
                                "CHIRPS" = "#E74C3C", 
                                "Unknown" = "#34495E"),
                      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
    
    scale_shape_manual(name = "Match Type",
                      values = c("Exact" = 16, "Fuzzy" = 17, "Manual" = 15, "Unknown" = 18)) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste("Optimized Matérn Kriging - Monthly Rainfall Interpolation (from TIF)"),
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = "Longitude (°E)",
      y = "Latitude (°N)",
      caption = paste("Imported from TIF | Optimized using", toupper(optimization_method), 
                     "| Points show observed values, surface shows Matérn Kriging interpolation")
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray60"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.25),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "gray96"),
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm")
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
  
  cat("✅ Enhanced Optimized Matérn map recreated from TIF!\n")
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to create uncertainty map if variance data available
create_uncertainty_map_from_tif <- function(imported_data) {
  if(!imported_data$has_variance) {
    cat("⚠️ No variance data available for uncertainty map\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cat("🎨 Creating Kriging uncertainty map from TIF variance data...\n")
  
  kriging_df <- imported_data$kriging_df
  target_year_month <- imported_data$target_year_month
  optimization_method <- imported_data$optimization_method
  
  # Create uncertainty map
  uncertainty_plot <- ggplot(kriging_df, aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = sqrt(var1.var)), alpha = 0.85) +
    
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Kriging\nStd Error\n(mm)", 
                        option = "inferno",
                        na.value = "transparent") +
    
    labs(
      title = "Optimized Matérn Kriging - Uncertainty Map (from TIF)",
      subtitle = paste("Month:", target_year_month, "| Standard errors from", toupper(optimization_method), "optimization"),
      x = "Longitude (°E)",
      y = "Latitude (°N)",
      caption = "Higher values indicate greater prediction uncertainty"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray60"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "gray96"),
      legend.position = "right"
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
  
  return(uncertainty_plot)
}

# Function to display comprehensive optimized results summary
display_optimized_summary_from_tif <- function(imported_data) {
  cat("📊 Creating OPTIMIZED MATÉRN KRIGING summary from imported TIF data...\n")
  
  summary_stats <- imported_data$summary_stats
  variogram_params <- imported_data$variogram_params
  target_year_month <- imported_data$target_year_month
  
  if(is.null(summary_stats)) {
    cat("   ⚠️ No summary statistics available\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cat("\n📊 IMPORTED OPTIMIZED MATÉRN KRIGING RESULTS\n")
  cat("===========================================\n")
  cat("Target month:", target_year_month, "\n")
  
  # Display optimization-specific statistics
  opt_stats <- c("optimization_method", "variogram_kappa", "variogram_range_m", 
                 "variogram_nugget", "variogram_sill", "kappa_range", 
                 "processing_time_seconds", "automap_available")
  
  cat("\n🎯 OPTIMIZATION DETAILS:\n")
  for(stat in opt_stats) {
    if(stat %in% names(summary_stats)) {
      value <- summary_stats[[stat]]
      formatted_value <- switch(stat,
        "optimization_method" = as.character(value),
        "variogram_kappa" = round(as.numeric(value), 3),
        "variogram_range_m" = paste0(round(as.numeric(value), 0), " meters"),
        "variogram_nugget" = round(as.numeric(value), 4),
        "variogram_sill" = round(as.numeric(value), 4),
        "processing_time_seconds" = paste0(round(as.numeric(value), 1), " seconds"),
        "automap_available" = ifelse(as.character(value) == "TRUE", "YES", "NO"),
        as.character(value)
      )
      
      display_name <- switch(stat,
        "optimization_method" = "Optimization method",
        "variogram_kappa" = "Optimized kappa (smoothness)",
        "variogram_range_m" = "Variogram range",
        "variogram_nugget" = "Nugget effect",
        "variogram_sill" = "Total sill",
        "kappa_range" = "Kappa values tested",
        "processing_time_seconds" = "Processing time",
        "automap_available" = "automap package used",
        stat
      )
      
      cat(paste0("   ", display_name, ": ", formatted_value, "\n"))
    }
  }
  
  # Display data quality statistics
  quality_stats <- c("n_stations_used", "matching_rate_percent", "avg_data_completeness",
                    "observed_rainfall_min", "observed_rainfall_max", "observed_rainfall_mean",
                    "kriged_rainfall_min", "kriged_rainfall_max", "kriged_rainfall_mean",
                    "kriging_variance_mean", "grid_points")
  
  cat("\n📈 DATA QUALITY & RESULTS:\n")
  for(stat in quality_stats) {
    if(stat %in% names(summary_stats)) {
      value <- summary_stats[[stat]]
      formatted_value <- switch(stat,
        "matching_rate_percent" = paste0(round(as.numeric(value), 1), "%"),
        "avg_data_completeness" = paste0(round(as.numeric(value) * 100, 1), "%"),
        "observed_rainfall_min" = paste0(round(as.numeric(value), 1), " mm"),
        "observed_rainfall_max" = paste0(round(as.numeric(value), 1), " mm"),
        "observed_rainfall_mean" = paste0(round(as.numeric(value), 1), " mm"),
        "kriged_rainfall_min" = paste0(round(as.numeric(value), 1), " mm"),
        "kriged_rainfall_max" = paste0(round(as.numeric(value), 1), " mm"),
        "kriged_rainfall_mean" = paste0(round(as.numeric(value), 1), " mm"),
        "kriging_variance_mean" = round(as.numeric(value), 4),
        "grid_points" = format(as.numeric(value), big.mark = ","),
        as.character(value)
      )
      
      display_name <- switch(stat,
        "n_stations_used" = "Stations used for kriging",
        "matching_rate_percent" = "Station matching success rate",
        "avg_data_completeness" = "Average data completeness",
        "observed_rainfall_min" = "Minimum observed rainfall",
        "observed_rainfall_max" = "Maximum observed rainfall", 
        "observed_rainfall_mean" = "Mean observed rainfall",
        "kriged_rainfall_min" = "Minimum kriged rainfall",
        "kriged_rainfall_max" = "Maximum kriged rainfall",
        "kriged_rainfall_mean" = "Mean kriged rainfall",
        "kriging_variance_mean" = "Mean kriging variance",
        "grid_points" = "Total prediction grid points",
        stat
      )
      
      cat(paste0("   ", display_name, ": ", formatted_value, "\n"))
    }
  }
  
  return(invisible(summary_stats))
}

# Function to save recreated optimized visualizations
save_optimized_recreated_visualizations <- function(main_map, uncertainty_map = NULL, target_year_month, 
                                                  output_dir = "recreated_optimized_kriging_visualizations") {
  
  if(!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    cat("📁 Created output directory:", output_dir, "\n")
  }
  
  target_month_str <- gsub("-", "_", target_year_month)
  
  # Save main optimized map
  main_output <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("recreated_optimized_matern_map_", target_month_str, ".png"))
  
  tryCatch({
    ggsave(main_output, main_map, width = 18, height = 14, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    cat("💾 Recreated optimized Matérn map saved to:", main_output, "\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ Error saving main map:", e$message, "\n")
  })
  
  # Save uncertainty map if available
  if(!is.null(uncertainty_map)) {
    uncertainty_output <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("recreated_uncertainty_map_", target_month_str, ".png"))
    
    tryCatch({
      ggsave(uncertainty_output, uncertainty_map, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
      cat("💾 Recreated uncertainty map saved to:", uncertainty_output, "\n")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("❌ Error saving uncertainty map:", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
}

# ====================================================================
# MAIN EXECUTION CODE - Import Optimized Matérn TIF and recreate visualization
# ====================================================================

# Set your parameters for optimized Matérn results
results_directory <- "optimized_matern_kriging_results"
target_year_month_str <- "2021_08"  # Use underscore format as saved in files
```

## VII.10. Batch Optimized Monthly Spatial Interpolation using Matérn Kriging with automap

```{r}
# Batch Optimized Monthly Spatial Interpolation using Matérn Kriging with automap
# This script processes ALL months across ALL years in the dataset
# Creates organized output folders and comprehensive summaries

# Load all the optimized functions from the previous script
# (Include all the previous functions here - I'm showing the corrected functions)

# Enhanced function to get all available months from the dataset with proper data validation
get_available_months <- function(monthly_data_list, start_year = 2000, end_year = 2025) {
  cat("📅 Scanning available months in dataset...\n")
  
  all_months <- c()
  data_counts <- c()
  
  # Collect all unique months from all stations
  for(station_name in names(monthly_data_list)) {
    station_data <- monthly_data_list[[station_name]]
    
    if(!is.null(station_data) && nrow(station_data) > 0) {
      station_months <- unique(station_data$YearMonth)
      # Ensure YearMonth is properly formatted as Date
      station_months <- as.Date(station_months)
      all_months <- c(all_months, station_months)
    }
  }
  
  # Get unique months and sort, with proper handling of Date objects
  unique_months <- sort(unique(as.Date(all_months, origin = "1970-01-01")))
  
  # Filter by date range with proper Date handling
  start_date <- as.Date(paste(start_year, "01", "01", sep = "-"))
  end_date <- as.Date(paste(end_year, "12", "31", sep = "-"))
  
  valid_months <- unique_months[unique_months >= start_date & unique_months <= end_date]
  
  # Count stations with data for each month
  month_stats <- data.frame(
    YearMonth = valid_months,
    YearMonth_str = format(valid_months, "%Y-%m"),
    Year = as.numeric(format(valid_months, "%Y")),  # Ensure numeric
    Month = as.numeric(format(valid_months, "%m")), # Ensure numeric
    Month_name = month.name[as.numeric(format(valid_months, "%m"))],
    Station_count = 0L,  # Ensure integer
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(month_stats)) {
    target_month <- month_stats$YearMonth[i]
    count <- 0L
    
    for(station_name in names(monthly_data_list)) {
      station_data <- monthly_data_list[[station_name]]
      if(!is.null(station_data) && any(as.Date(station_data$YearMonth) == target_month)) {
        rainfall_values <- station_data$monthly_rainfall[as.Date(station_data$YearMonth) == target_month]
        if(any(!is.na(rainfall_values) & is.finite(rainfall_values))) {
          count <- count + 1L
        }
      }
    }
    month_stats$Station_count[i] <- count
  }
  
  cat("   📊 Found", nrow(month_stats), "available months from", 
      format(min(valid_months), "%Y-%m"), "to", format(max(valid_months), "%Y-%m"), "\n")
  cat("   📈 Station count range:", min(month_stats$Station_count), "-", 
      max(month_stats$Station_count), "stations per month\n")
  
  return(month_stats)
}

# Safe numeric formatting function to prevent prettyNum errors
safe_format_number <- function(x, digits = 2, scientific = FALSE) {
  if(is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return("NA")
  if(!is.numeric(x)) return(as.character(x))
  if(any(!is.finite(x))) x[!is.finite(x)] <- NA
  
  tryCatch({
    if(scientific) {
      return(formatC(x, format = "e", digits = digits))
    } else {
      return(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(as.character(x))
  })
}

# Enhanced batch processing function with improved error handling
perform_batch_matern_kriging_analysis <- function(
  shapefile_path = "Pts_GPS_Station_English.shp",
  datasets_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets",
  output_base_dir = "batch_matern_kriging_results",
  manual_matches = NULL,
  similarity_threshold = 0.8,
  resolution = 100,
  buffer_percent = 0.5,
  optimize_kappa = TRUE,
  kappa_range = c(0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 5.0),
  use_parallel = TRUE,
  min_stations = 5,
  max_variance_threshold = 1000,
  start_year = 2000,
  end_year = 2025,
  skip_existing = TRUE,
  create_animations = FALSE
) {
  
  cat("🚀 STARTING BATCH OPTIMIZED MATÉRN KRIGING ANALYSIS\n")
  cat("===================================================\n")
  cat("📅 Target period:", start_year, "-", end_year, "\n")
  cat("📊 Minimum stations per month:", min_stations, "\n")
  cat("📁 Output directory:", output_base_dir, "\n")
  cat("⚙️ Optimization:", ifelse(optimize_kappa, "ENABLED", "DISABLED"), "\n")
  cat("🔄 Skip existing:", ifelse(skip_existing, "YES", "NO"), "\n")
  cat("🎬 Create animations:", ifelse(create_animations, "YES", "NO"), "\n\n")
  
  batch_start_time <- Sys.time()
  
  # Create main output directory
  if(!dir.exists(output_base_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_base_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    cat("📁 Created main output directory:", output_base_dir, "\n")
  }
  
  # Step 1: Load GPS coordinates (once)
  cat("📍 STEP 1: Loading GPS coordinates...\n")
  tryCatch({
    gps_coordinates <- load_gps_station_coordinates_optimized(shapefile_path)
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Failed to load GPS coordinates: ", e$message)
  })
  
  # Step 2: Load all rainfall data (once)
  cat("\n📥 STEP 2: Loading all rainfall data...\n")
  tryCatch({
    monthly_result <- load_and_aggregate_monthly_data_optimized(datasets_dir)
    monthly_data_list <- monthly_result$monthly_data
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Failed to load rainfall data: ", e$message)
  })
  
  # Step 3: Match stations (once)
  cat("\n🔗 STEP 3: Matching stations...\n")
  tryCatch({
    matched_coordinates <- match_rainfall_with_gps_optimized(
      monthly_data_list, gps_coordinates, similarity_threshold, manual_matches
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Failed to match stations: ", e$message)
  })
  
  # Step 4: Get available months
  cat("\n📅 STEP 4: Scanning available months...\n")
  tryCatch({
    available_months <- get_available_months(monthly_data_list, start_year, end_year)
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Failed to scan available months: ", e$message)
  })
  
  # Filter months with sufficient data
  valid_months <- available_months[available_months$Station_count >= min_stations, ]
  
  cat("   ✅ Found", nrow(valid_months), "months with >=", min_stations, "stations\n")
  cat("   📊 Will process", nrow(valid_months), "months\n\n")
  
  if(nrow(valid_months) == 0) {
    stop("No months found with sufficient station data")
  }
  
  # Initialize batch tracking with proper data types
  batch_results <- list()
  processing_log <- data.frame(
    YearMonth = character(),
    Status = character(),
    Processing_Time = numeric(),
    Stations_Used = integer(),
    Optimization_Method = character(),
    Kriging_Quality = numeric(),
    Error_Message = character(),
    Output_Folder = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  successful_analyses <- 0L
  failed_analyses <- 0L
  skipped_analyses <- 0L
  
  cat("🔄 STEP 5: Processing months in batch...\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  
  # Process each month
  for(i in 1:nrow(valid_months)) {
    current_month <- valid_months[i, ]
    target_year_month <- current_month$YearMonth_str
    month_folder_name <- paste0("month_", gsub("-", "_", target_year_month))
    month_output_dir <- file.path(output_base_dir, month_folder_name)
    
    cat("\n📅 Processing", i, "/", nrow(valid_months), ":", target_year_month, 
        "(", current_month$Station_count, "stations)\n")
    cat("   📁 Output folder:", month_folder_name, "\n")
    
    # Check if already processed and skip if requested
    if(skip_existing && dir.exists(month_output_dir)) {
      existing_files <- list.files(month_output_dir, pattern = "*.png|*.csv|*.tif")
      if(length(existing_files) > 3) {
        cat("   ⏭️ Skipping - already processed\n")
        skipped_analyses <- skipped_analyses + 1L
        next
      }
    }
    
    # Create month-specific output directory
    if(!dir.exists(month_output_dir)) {
      dir.create(month_output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    }
    
    month_start_time <- Sys.time()
    
    tryCatch({
      # Perform analysis for this month
      cat("   🎯 Running Matérn Kriging analysis...\n")
      
      month_results <- perform_optimized_matern_kriging_analysis(
        target_year_month = target_year_month,
        shapefile_path = shapefile_path,
        datasets_dir = datasets_dir,
        manual_matches = manual_matches,
        similarity_threshold = similarity_threshold,
        resolution = resolution,
        buffer_percent = buffer_percent,
        optimize_kappa = optimize_kappa,
        kappa_range = kappa_range,
        use_parallel = use_parallel
      )
      
      month_end_time <- Sys.time()
      processing_time <- as.numeric(difftime(month_end_time, month_start_time, units = "secs"))
      
      # Quality check with safe numeric handling
      quality_score <- month_results$summary_stats$kriging_variance_mean
      if(is.null(quality_score) || !is.finite(quality_score)) {
        quality_score <- NA_real_
      }
      
      if(!is.na(quality_score) && quality_score > max_variance_threshold) {
        warning(paste("High kriging variance detected for", target_year_month, ":", 
                     safe_format_number(quality_score, 3)))
      }
      
      # Save results in month-specific folder
      save_optimized_kriging_results_batch(month_results, month_output_dir)
      
      # Store batch results
      batch_results[[target_year_month]] <- month_results
      
      # Update processing log with safe data types
      n_stations <- month_results$summary_stats$n_stations_used
      if(is.null(n_stations) || !is.finite(n_stations)) n_stations <- 0L
      
      opt_method <- month_results$summary_stats$optimization_method
      if(is.null(opt_method)) opt_method <- "Unknown"
      
      processing_log <- rbind(processing_log, data.frame(
        YearMonth = as.character(target_year_month),
        Status = "SUCCESS",
        Processing_Time = as.numeric(processing_time),
        Stations_Used = as.integer(n_stations),
        Optimization_Method = as.character(opt_method),
        Kriging_Quality = as.numeric(quality_score),
        Error_Message = "",
        Output_Folder = as.character(month_folder_name),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
      
      successful_analyses <- successful_analyses + 1L
      
      cat("   ✅ SUCCESS - Time:", safe_format_number(processing_time, 1), 
          "s, Quality:", safe_format_number(quality_score, 3), "\n")
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      month_end_time <- Sys.time()
      processing_time <- as.numeric(difftime(month_end_time, month_start_time, units = "secs"))
      
      error_msg <- as.character(e$message)
      cat("   ❌ FAILED:", error_msg, "\n")
      
      # Update processing log with failure
      processing_log <<- rbind(processing_log, data.frame(
        YearMonth = as.character(target_year_month),
        Status = "FAILED",
        Processing_Time = as.numeric(processing_time),
        Stations_Used = 0L,
        Optimization_Method = "N/A",
        Kriging_Quality = NA_real_,
        Error_Message = substr(error_msg, 1, 200),
        Output_Folder = as.character(month_folder_name),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
      
      failed_analyses <<- failed_analyses + 1L
    })
    
    # Progress update with safe formatting
    if(i %% 10 == 0 || i == nrow(valid_months)) {
      progress_pct <- round(i / nrow(valid_months) * 100, 1)
      elapsed_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), batch_start_time, units = "mins"))
      
      cat("\n   📊 PROGRESS UPDATE:", progress_pct, "% complete\n")
      cat("   ⏱️ Elapsed time:", safe_format_number(elapsed_time, 1), "minutes\n")
      cat("   ✅ Successful:", successful_analyses, "| ❌ Failed:", failed_analyses, 
          "| ⏭️ Skipped:", skipped_analyses, "\n")
      
      if(i < nrow(valid_months)) {
        estimated_total_time <- elapsed_time / (i / nrow(valid_months))
        remaining_time <- estimated_total_time - elapsed_time
        cat("   🔮 Estimated remaining time:", safe_format_number(remaining_time, 1), "minutes\n")
      }
    }
  }
  
  batch_end_time <- Sys.time()
  total_processing_time <- as.numeric(difftime(batch_end_time, batch_start_time, units = "mins"))
  
  cat("\n🎉 BATCH PROCESSING COMPLETED!\n")
  cat("==============================\n")
  cat("📊 FINAL SUMMARY:\n")
  cat("   Total months processed:", nrow(valid_months), "\n")
  cat("   ✅ Successful:", successful_analyses, "\n")
  cat("   ❌ Failed:", failed_analyses, "\n")
  cat("   ⏭️ Skipped:", skipped_analyses, "\n")
  
  # Safe calculation of success rate
  if(successful_analyses + failed_analyses > 0) {
    success_rate <- successful_analyses / (successful_analyses + failed_analyses)
    cat("   📈 Success rate:", safe_format_number(success_rate * 100, 1), "%\n")
  } else {
    success_rate <- 0
    cat("   📈 Success rate: 0%\n")
  }
  
  cat("   ⏱️ Total processing time:", safe_format_number(total_processing_time, 1), "minutes\n")
  if(nrow(valid_months) > 0) {
    avg_time <- total_processing_time / nrow(valid_months)
    cat("   ⚡ Average time per month:", safe_format_number(avg_time, 2), "minutes\n\n")
  }
  
  # Create comprehensive summaries
  cat("📋 Creating comprehensive summaries...\n")
  create_batch_summaries(batch_results, processing_log, output_base_dir, 
                        total_processing_time, create_animations)
  
  return(list(
    batch_results = batch_results,
    processing_log = processing_log,
    summary_stats = list(
      total_months = nrow(valid_months),
      successful = successful_analyses,
      failed = failed_analyses,
      skipped = skipped_analyses,
      total_time_minutes = total_processing_time,
      success_rate = success_rate
    )
  ))
}

# Enhanced save function for batch processing with better error handling
save_optimized_kriging_results_batch <- function(results, month_output_dir) {
  if(is.null(results)) {
    return()
  }
  
  target_month_str <- gsub("-", "_", results$summary_stats$target_year_month)
  
  tryCatch({
    # Save enhanced visualizations with consistent naming
    if(!is.null(results$interpolation_map)) {
      ggsave(file.path(month_output_dir, "interpolation_map.png"),
             results$interpolation_map, width = 18, height = 14, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    }
    
    if(!is.null(results$variogram_plot)) {
      ggsave(file.path(month_output_dir, "variogram_plot.png"),
             results$variogram_plot, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    }
    
    if(!is.null(results$distance_analysis)) {
      ggsave(file.path(month_output_dir, "distance_analysis.png"),
             results$distance_analysis, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    }
    
    # Save data with proper validation
    if(!is.null(results$spatial_data) && nrow(results$spatial_data) > 0) {
      write.csv(results$spatial_data, 
                file.path(month_output_dir, "spatial_data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    }
    
    # Save comprehensive summary with safe formatting
    if(!is.null(results$summary_stats)) {
      # Create a safe version of summary stats
      safe_summary <- lapply(results$summary_stats, function(x) {
        if(is.numeric(x) && length(x) == 1) {
          if(!is.finite(x)) return("NA")
          return(safe_format_number(x, 6))
        } else {
          return(as.character(x))
        }
      })
      
      summary_df <- data.frame(
        Parameter = names(safe_summary),
        Value = as.character(safe_summary),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      write.csv(summary_df, file.path(month_output_dir, "analysis_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    }
    
    # Save variogram parameters
    if(!is.null(results$kriging_results) && !is.null(results$kriging_results$variogram_fit)) {
      vgm_detailed <- results$kriging_results$variogram_fit
      write.csv(vgm_detailed, file.path(month_output_dir, "variogram_parameters.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    }
    
    # Save kriging results as raster
    if(!is.null(results$kriging_results) && !is.null(results$kriging_results$kriging_result)) {
      # Convert to terra raster if it's sp object
      if(inherits(results$kriging_results$kriging_result, "SpatialPixelsDataFrame")) {
        kriging_raster <- rast(results$kriging_results$kriging_result)
      } else {
        kriging_raster <- results$kriging_results$kriging_result
      }
      
      if(!is.null(kriging_raster)) {
        writeRaster(kriging_raster, file.path(month_output_dir, "kriging_utm28n.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
        
        # Save WGS84 version
        tryCatch({
          kriging_wgs84 <- project(kriging_raster, "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs")
          writeRaster(kriging_wgs84, file.path(month_output_dir, "kriging_wgs84.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
        }, error = function(e) {
          cat("   ⚠️ Warning: Could not create WGS84 version:", e$message, "\n")
        })
      }
    }
    
    # Save processing log for this month
    log_content <- c(
      paste("Month:", results$summary_stats$target_year_month),
      paste("Processing Time:", safe_format_number(results$summary_stats$processing_time_seconds, 2), "seconds"),
      paste("Stations Used:", results$summary_stats$n_stations_used),
      paste("Optimization Method:", results$summary_stats$optimization_method),
      paste("Optimized Kappa:", safe_format_number(results$summary_stats$variogram_kappa, 4)),
      paste("Generated:", Sys.time())
    )
    writeLines(log_content, file.path(month_output_dir, "processing_log.txt"))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("   ⚠️ Warning saving month results:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

# Comprehensive summary creation function with improved error handling
create_batch_summaries <- function(batch_results, processing_log, output_base_dir, 
                                  total_processing_time, create_animations = FALSE) {
  
  summaries_dir <- file.path(output_base_dir, "BATCH_SUMMARIES")
  if(!dir.exists(summaries_dir)) {
    dir.create(summaries_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  cat("   📊 Creating master processing log...\n")
  # Master processing log
  write.csv(processing_log, file.path(summaries_dir, "master_processing_log.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  # Extract summary statistics from all successful analyses
  successful_results <- batch_results[!sapply(batch_results, is.null)]
  
  if(length(successful_results) > 0) {
    cat("   📈 Creating temporal trend analysis...\n")
    
    # Create temporal trends dataframe with safe data handling
    temporal_stats <- data.frame(
      YearMonth = character(),
      Year = integer(),
      Month = integer(),
      Season = character(),
      Stations_Used = integer(),
      Mean_Rainfall = numeric(),
      Max_Rainfall = numeric(),
      Min_Rainfall = numeric(),
      SD_Rainfall = numeric(),
      Kriging_Variance = numeric(),
      Variogram_Range = numeric(),
      Variogram_Kappa = numeric(),
      Processing_Time = numeric(),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    for(month_key in names(successful_results)) {
      result <- successful_results[[month_key]]
      stats <- result$summary_stats
      
      # Safe extraction with default values
      month_num <- tryCatch({
        as.integer(substr(month_key, 6, 7))
      }, error = function(e) 1L)
      
      year_num <- tryCatch({
        as.integer(substr(month_key, 1, 4))
      }, error = function(e) 2000L)
      
      # Determine season with bounds checking
      season <- "Unknown"
      if(month_num >= 1 && month_num <= 12) {
        season <- case_when(
          month_num %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
          month_num %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring",
          month_num %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
          month_num %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Autumn",
          TRUE ~ "Unknown"
        )
      }
      
      # Safe numeric extraction function
      safe_extract <- function(value, default = NA_real_) {
        if(is.null(value) || !is.numeric(value) || !is.finite(value)) {
          return(default)
        }
        return(as.numeric(value))
      }
      
      temporal_stats <- rbind(temporal_stats, data.frame(
        YearMonth = as.character(month_key),
        Year = year_num,
        Month = month_num,
        Season = season,
        Stations_Used = as.integer(safe_extract(stats$n_stations_used, 0)),
        Mean_Rainfall = safe_extract(stats$observed_rainfall_mean),
        Max_Rainfall = safe_extract(stats$observed_rainfall_max),
        Min_Rainfall = safe_extract(stats$observed_rainfall_min),
        SD_Rainfall = safe_extract(stats$observed_rainfall_sd),
        Kriging_Variance = safe_extract(stats$kriging_variance_mean),
        Variogram_Range = safe_extract(stats$variogram_range_m),
        Variogram_Kappa = safe_extract(stats$variogram_kappa),
        Processing_Time = safe_extract(stats$processing_time_seconds),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }
    
    # Save temporal statistics
    write.csv(temporal_stats, file.path(summaries_dir, "temporal_statistics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Create summary visualizations with better error handling
    cat("   🎨 Creating summary visualizations...\n")
    
    tryCatch({
      # Load required packages
      if(!require(ggplot2, quietly = TRUE)) {
        cat("   ⚠️ ggplot2 not available - skipping visualizations\n")
        return()
      }
      if(!require(dplyr, quietly = TRUE)) {
        cat("   ⚠️ dplyr not available - using base R aggregation\n")
      }
      
      # Filter out invalid data
      valid_temporal <- temporal_stats[
        !is.na(temporal_stats$Mean_Rainfall) & 
        is.finite(temporal_stats$Mean_Rainfall) &
        temporal_stats$Mean_Rainfall >= 0, 
      ]
      
      if(nrow(valid_temporal) == 0) {
        cat("   ⚠️ No valid temporal data for visualizations\n")
        return()
      }
      
      # 1. Temporal rainfall trends
      tryCatch({
        # Create date column safely
        valid_temporal$Date <- as.Date(paste0(valid_temporal$YearMonth, "-01"))
        
        p1 <- ggplot(valid_temporal, aes(x = Date)) +
          geom_line(aes(y = Mean_Rainfall), color = "blue", size = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
          geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(Min_Rainfall, 0, na.rm = TRUE), 
                         ymax = pmax(Max_Rainfall, 0, na.rm = TRUE)), 
                     alpha = 0.3, fill = "blue", na.rm = TRUE) +
          labs(title = "Temporal Rainfall Trends Across All Months",
               subtitle = paste("Period:", min(valid_temporal$Year, na.rm = TRUE), "-", 
                              max(valid_temporal$Year, na.rm = TRUE)),
               x = "Date", y = "Monthly Rainfall (mm)") +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
        
        # Add seasonal faceting if dplyr is available
        if(require(dplyr, quietly = TRUE) && length(unique(valid_temporal$Season)) > 1) {
          p1 <- p1 + facet_wrap(~Season, scales = "free_y")
        }
        
        ggsave(file.path(summaries_dir, "temporal_rainfall_trends.png"), p1, 
               width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("   ⚠️ Could not create temporal trends plot:", e$message, "\n")
      })
      
      # 2. Seasonal analysis
      tryCatch({
        if(require(dplyr, quietly = TRUE)) {
          seasonal_summary <- valid_temporal %>%
            filter(Season != "Unknown") %>%
            group_by(Season) %>%
            summarise(
              Count = n(),
              Mean_Rainfall = mean(Mean_Rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
              SD_Rainfall = mean(SD_Rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
              Mean_Variance = mean(Kriging_Variance, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = 'drop'
            )
        } else {
          # Base R alternative
          valid_seasonal <- valid_temporal[valid_temporal$Season != "Unknown", ]
          seasonal_summary <- aggregate(
            cbind(Mean_Rainfall, SD_Rainfall, Kriging_Variance) ~ Season, 
            data = valid_seasonal, 
            FUN = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
          )
          seasonal_summary$Count <- table(valid_seasonal$Season)[seasonal_summary$Season]
        }
        
        if(nrow(seasonal_summary) > 0) {
          p2 <- ggplot(seasonal_summary, aes(x = Season, y = Mean_Rainfall, fill = Season)) +
            geom_col(alpha = 0.8) +
            labs(title = "Seasonal Rainfall Patterns",
                 subtitle = "Average monthly rainfall by season",
                 x = "Season", y = "Average Monthly Rainfall (mm)") +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(legend.position = "none")
          
          ggsave(file.path(summaries_dir, "seasonal_patterns.png"), p2, 
                 width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
          
          # Save seasonal summary
          write.csv(seasonal_summary, file.path(summaries_dir, "seasonal_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
        }
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("   ⚠️ Could not create seasonal analysis:", e$message, "\n")
      })
      
      # 3. Quality metrics over time
      tryCatch({
        valid_quality <- valid_temporal[!is.na(valid_temporal$Kriging_Variance) & 
                                       is.finite(valid_temporal$Kriging_Variance), ]
        
        if(nrow(valid_quality) > 5) {  # Need sufficient data for smoothing
          p3 <- ggplot(valid_quality, aes(x = Date)) +
            geom_line(aes(y = Kriging_Variance), color = "red", size = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
            geom_smooth(aes(y = Kriging_Variance), method = "loess", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
            labs(title = "Kriging Quality Over Time",
                 subtitle = "Kriging variance as indicator of uncertainty",
                 x = "Date", y = "Average Kriging Variance") +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
          
          ggsave(file.path(summaries_dir, "quality_trends.png"), p3, 
                 width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
        }
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("   ⚠️ Could not create quality trends plot:", e$message, "\n")
      })
      
      # 4. Processing performance
      tryCatch({
        valid_performance <- valid_temporal[!is.na(valid_temporal$Processing_Time) & 
                                          !is.na(valid_temporal$Stations_Used) &
                                          is.finite(valid_temporal$Processing_Time) &
                                          is.finite(valid_temporal$Stations_Used), ]
        
        if(nrow(valid_performance) > 3) {
          p4 <- ggplot(valid_performance, aes(x = Stations_Used, y = Processing_Time)) +
            geom_point(aes(color = Year), alpha = 0.7, size = 2, na.rm = TRUE) +
            geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", na.rm = TRUE) +
            labs(title = "Processing Performance Analysis",
                 subtitle = "Processing time vs number of stations used",
                 x = "Number of Stations Used", y = "Processing Time (seconds)") +
            theme_minimal()
          
          # Add color scale if we have year variation
          if(length(unique(valid_performance$Year)) > 1) {
            p4 <- p4 + scale_color_viridis_c()
          }
          
          ggsave(file.path(summaries_dir, "processing_performance.png"), p4, 
                 width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
        }
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("   ⚠️ Could not create performance plot:", e$message, "\n")
      })
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("   ⚠️ General visualization error:", e$message, "\n")
    })
    
    # Create annual summaries with safe aggregation
    cat("   📅 Creating annual summaries...\n")
    tryCatch({
      if(require(dplyr, quietly = TRUE)) {
        annual_summary <- valid_temporal %>%
          group_by(Year) %>%
          summarise(
            Months_Processed = n(),
            Total_Rainfall_Mean = mean(Mean_Rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
            Total_Rainfall_Sum = sum(Mean_Rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
            Avg_Stations = mean(Stations_Used, na.rm = TRUE),
            Avg_Processing_Time = mean(Processing_Time, na.rm = TRUE),
            Avg_Kriging_Quality = mean(Kriging_Variance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = 'drop'
          )
      } else {
        # Base R alternative for annual summary
        years <- unique(valid_temporal$Year[!is.na(valid_temporal$Year)])
        annual_summary <- data.frame(
          Year = years,
          Months_Processed = sapply(years, function(y) sum(valid_temporal$Year == y, na.rm = TRUE)),
          Total_Rainfall_Mean = sapply(years, function(y) mean(valid_temporal$Mean_Rainfall[valid_temporal$Year == y], na.rm = TRUE)),
          Total_Rainfall_Sum = sapply(years, function(y) sum(valid_temporal$Mean_Rainfall[valid_temporal$Year == y], na.rm = TRUE)),
          Avg_Stations = sapply(years, function(y) mean(valid_temporal$Stations_Used[valid_temporal$Year == y], na.rm = TRUE)),
          Avg_Processing_Time = sapply(years, function(y) mean(valid_temporal$Processing_Time[valid_temporal$Year == y], na.rm = TRUE)),
          Avg_Kriging_Quality = sapply(years, function(y) mean(valid_temporal$Kriging_Variance[valid_temporal$Year == y], na.rm = TRUE))
        )
      }
      
      write.csv(annual_summary, file.path(summaries_dir, "annual_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("   ⚠️ Could not create annual summary:", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
  
  # Create master README with safe formatting
  cat("   📝 Creating master README...\n")
  tryCatch({
    successful_count <- sum(processing_log$Status == "SUCCESS", na.rm = TRUE)
    failed_count <- sum(processing_log$Status == "FAILED", na.rm = TRUE)
    avg_processing_time <- mean(processing_log$Processing_Time[processing_log$Status == "SUCCESS"], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    readme_content <- c(
      "# Batch Optimized Matérn Kriging Analysis Results",
      paste("Generated:", Sys.time()),
      "",
      "## Overview",
      paste("This directory contains results from batch processing of spatial rainfall interpolation"),
      paste("using optimized Matérn Kriging with automatic parameter estimation."),
      "",
      "## Directory Structure",
      "- `month_YYYY_MM/`: Individual month results",
      "  - `interpolation_map.png`: Kriging interpolation map",
      "  - `variogram_plot.png`: Variogram model plot", 
      "  - `distance_analysis.png`: Spatial autocorrelation analysis",
      "  - `spatial_data.csv`: Station data used",
      "  - `analysis_summary.csv`: Complete analysis parameters",
      "  - `variogram_parameters.csv`: Optimized variogram parameters",
      "  - `kriging_utm28n.tif`: Kriging raster (UTM projection)",
      "  - `kriging_wgs84.tif`: Kriging raster (WGS84 projection)",
      "",
      "- `BATCH_SUMMARIES/`: Overall analysis summaries",
      "  - `master_processing_log.csv`: Complete processing log",
      "  - `temporal_statistics.csv`: Time series analysis",
      "  - `annual_summary.csv`: Yearly aggregated statistics",
      "  - `seasonal_summary.csv`: Seasonal pattern analysis",
      "  - Various summary visualization plots",
      "",
      "## Key Statistics",
      paste("- Total processing time:", safe_format_number(total_processing_time, 1), "minutes"),
      paste("- Successful analyses:", successful_count),
      paste("- Failed analyses:", failed_count),
      paste("- Average processing time per month:", 
            safe_format_number(avg_processing_time, 2), "seconds"),
      "",
      "## Data Quality",
      if(length(successful_results) > 0 && exists("valid_temporal")) {
        paste("- Average stations per month:", safe_format_number(mean(valid_temporal$Stations_Used, na.rm = TRUE), 1))
      } else {
        "- No successful results to analyze"
      },
      "",
      "## Methodology", 
      "- Spatial interpolation: Matérn Kriging with automap optimization",
      "- Parameter optimization: Automatic kappa selection",
      "- Coordinate system: UTM Zone 28N / WGS84",
      "- Grid resolution: Variable based on data extent",
      "",
      "For detailed methodology, see individual month analysis summaries."
    )
    
    writeLines(readme_content, file.path(output_base_dir, "README.md"))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("   ⚠️ Could not create README:", e$message, "\n")
  })
  
  # Create final summary report
  tryCatch({
    summary_report <- list(
      processing_summary = processing_log,
      temporal_analysis = if(exists("valid_temporal")) valid_temporal else NULL,
      annual_summary = if(exists("annual_summary")) annual_summary else NULL,
      seasonal_summary = if(exists("seasonal_summary")) seasonal_summary else NULL,
      batch_metadata = list(
        total_processing_time_minutes = total_processing_time,
        generated_timestamp = Sys.time(),
        r_version = R.version.string,
        successful_months = sum(processing_log$Status == "SUCCESS", na.rm = TRUE),
        failed_months = sum(processing_log$Status == "FAILED", na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
    
    saveRDS(summary_report, file.path(summaries_dir, "complete_batch_summary.rds"))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("   ⚠️ Could not save summary report:", e$message, "\n")
  })
  
  cat("   ✅ All summaries created successfully!\n")
}

# Additional validation function for input data
validate_batch_inputs <- function(shapefile_path, datasets_dir, output_base_dir) {
  cat("🔍 VALIDATING INPUT PARAMETERS...\n")
  
  errors <- character()
  warnings <- character()
  
  # Check shapefile
  if(!file.exists(shapefile_path)) {
    errors <- c(errors, paste("Shapefile not found:", shapefile_path))
  }
  
  # Check datasets directory
  if(!dir.exists(datasets_dir)) {
    errors <- c(errors, paste("Datasets directory not found:", datasets_dir))
  } else {
    csv_files <- list.files(datasets_dir, pattern = "*.csv", recursive = TRUE)
    if(length(csv_files) == 0) {
      warnings <- c(warnings, paste("No CSV files found in:", datasets_dir))
    }
  }
  
  # Check output directory permissions
  if(!dir.exists(dirname(output_base_dir))) {
    tryCatch({
      dir.create(dirname(output_base_dir), recursive = TRUE)
    }, error = function(e) {
      errors <- c(errors, paste("Cannot create output directory:", dirname(output_base_dir)))
    })
  }
  
  # Check required packages
  required_packages <- c("sp", "gstat", "automap", "terra", "sf", "ggplot2")
  missing_packages <- character()
  
  for(pkg in required_packages) {
    if(!require(pkg, quietly = TRUE, character.only = TRUE)) {
      missing_packages <- c(missing_packages, pkg)
    }
  }
  
  if(length(missing_packages) > 0) {
    errors <- c(errors, paste("Missing required packages:", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Report results
  if(length(errors) > 0) {
    cat("❌ VALIDATION ERRORS:\n")
    for(error in errors) {
      cat("   •", error, "\n")
    }
    stop("Please fix validation errors before proceeding.")
  }
  
  if(length(warnings) > 0) {
    cat("⚠️ VALIDATION WARNINGS:\n")
    for(warning in warnings) {
      cat("   •", warning, "\n")
    }
  }
  
  if(length(warnings) == 0 && length(errors) == 0) {
    cat("✅ All validation checks passed!\n\n")
  }
  
  return(list(errors = errors, warnings = warnings))
}

  )

# Display final batch results with improved formatting

          safe_format_number(min(successful_log$Processing_Time, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "-",

      if(any(!is.na(successful_log$Kriging_Quality))) {

} else {
}

  tryCatch({
    rainfall_test <- load_and_aggregate_monthly_data_optimized(batch_config$datasets_dir)
    station_count <- length(rainfall_test$monthly_data)
    cat("   ✅ Rainfall data loaded successfully (", station_count, "stations)\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("   ❌ Rainfall loading failed:", e$message, "\n")
  })
  
  # Test 3: Available months scanning
  cat("3. Testing available months scanning...\n")
  tryCatch({
    if(exists("rainfall_test")) {
      months_test <- get_available_months(rainfall_test$monthly_data, 
                                         batch_config$start_year, batch_config$end_year)
      cat("   ✅ Month scanning successful (", nrow(months_test), "months found)\n")
    } else {
      cat("   ⏭️ Skipping - rainfall data not available\n")
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("   ❌ Month scanning failed:", e$message, "\n")
  })
  
  cat("\n🏁 Component testing complete!\n\n")
}

# Function to create a minimal test run
run_minimal_test <- function(batch_config, test_months = 2) {
  cat("🧪 RUNNING MINIMAL TEST...\n")
  cat("=========================\n")
  cat("Processing only", test_months, "months for testing\n\n")
  
  test_config <- batch_config
  test_config$output_base_dir <- file.path(batch_config$output_base_dir, "TEST_RUN")
  test_config$start_year <- 2020  # More recent data likely to be better
  test_config$end_year <- 2021
  test_config$skip_existing <- FALSE
  
  tryCatch({
    test_results <- perform_batch_matern_kriging_analysis(
      shapefile_path = test_config$shapefile_path,
      datasets_dir = test_config$datasets_dir,
      output_base_dir = test_config$output_base_dir,
      similarity_threshold = test_config$similarity_threshold,
      resolution = test_config$resolution,
      buffer_percent = test_config$buffer_percent,
      optimize_kappa = test_config$optimize_kappa,
      kappa_range = test_config$kappa_range,
      use_parallel = test_config$use_parallel,
      min_stations = test_config$min_stations,
      max_variance_threshold = test_config$max_variance_threshold,
      start_year = test_config$start_year,
      end_year = test_config$end_year,
      skip_existing = test_config$skip_existing,
      create_animations = test_config$create_animations
    )
    
    if(!is.null(test_results)) {
      cat("✅ MINIMAL TEST SUCCESSFUL!\n")
      cat("   Processed:", test_results$summary_stats$successful, "months\n")
      cat("   You can now run the full batch with confidence\n\n")
      return(TRUE)
    } else {
      cat("❌ MINIMAL TEST FAILED\n")
      return(FALSE)
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ MINIMAL TEST ERROR:", e$message, "\n")
    return(FALSE)
  })
}
```
