# 2x larger interpolation extent

```{r}
# Batch Optimized Monthly Spatial Interpolation using Matérn Kriging with automap

# This script processes ALL months across ALL years with 2x larger interpolation extent
get_available_months <- function(monthly_data_list, start_year = 2000, end_year = 2025) {
  cat("📅 Scanning available months in dataset...\n")
  
  all_months <- c()
  data_counts <- c()
  
  # Collect all unique months from all stations
  for(station_name in names(monthly_data_list)) {
    station_data <- monthly_data_list[[station_name]]
    
    if(!is.null(station_data) && nrow(station_data) > 0) {
      station_months <- unique(station_data$YearMonth)
      station_months <- as.Date(station_months)
      all_months <- c(all_months, station_months)
    }
  }
  
  unique_months <- sort(unique(as.Date(all_months, origin = "1970-01-01")))
  
  start_date <- as.Date(paste(start_year, "01", "01", sep = "-"))
  end_date <- as.Date(paste(end_year, "12", "31", sep = "-"))
  
  valid_months <- unique_months[unique_months >= start_date & unique_months <= end_date]
  
  month_stats <- data.frame(
    YearMonth = valid_months,
    YearMonth_str = format(valid_months, "%Y-%m"),
    Year = as.numeric(format(valid_months, "%Y")),
    Month = as.numeric(format(valid_months, "%m")),
    Month_name = month.name[as.numeric(format(valid_months, "%m"))],
    Station_count = 0L,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(month_stats)) {
    target_month <- month_stats$YearMonth[i]
    count <- 0L
    
    for(station_name in names(monthly_data_list)) {
      station_data <- monthly_data_list[[station_name]]
      if(!is.null(station_data) && any(as.Date(station_data$YearMonth) == target_month)) {
        rainfall_values <- station_data$monthly_rainfall[as.Date(station_data$YearMonth) == target_month]
        if(any(!is.na(rainfall_values) & is.finite(rainfall_values))) {
          count <- count + 1L
        }
      }
    }
    month_stats$Station_count[i] <- count
  }
  
  cat("   📊 Found", nrow(month_stats), "available months from", 
      format(min(valid_months), "%Y-%m"), "to", format(max(valid_months), "%Y-%m"), "\n")
  cat("   📈 Station count range:", min(month_stats$Station_count), "-", 
      max(month_stats$Station_count), "stations per month\n")
  
  return(month_stats)
}

# Safe numeric formatting function to prevent prettyNum errors
safe_format_number <- function(x, digits = 2, scientific = FALSE) {
  if(is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return("NA")
  if(!is.numeric(x)) return(as.character(x))
  if(any(!is.finite(x))) x[!is.finite(x)] <- NA
  
  tryCatch({
    if(scientific) {
      return(formatC(x, format = "e", digits = digits))
    } else {
      return(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(as.character(x))
  })
}

# Enhanced batch processing function with DOUBLED SPATIAL EXTENT
perform_batch_matern_kriging_analysis <- function(
  shapefile_path = "Pts_GPS_Station_English.shp",
  datasets_dir = "enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets",
  output_base_dir = "batch_matern_kriging_results_extended",
  manual_matches = NULL,
  similarity_threshold = 0.8,
  resolution = 100,
  buffer_percent = 1.0,  # DOUBLED from 0.5 to 1.0 (100% buffer = 2x extent)
  optimize_kappa = TRUE,
  kappa_range = c(0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 5.0),
  use_parallel = TRUE,
  min_stations = 5,
  max_variance_threshold = 1000,
  start_year = 2000,
  end_year = 2025,
  skip_existing = TRUE,
  create_animations = FALSE
) {
  
  cat("🚀 STARTING BATCH OPTIMIZED MATÉRN KRIGING ANALYSIS - EXTENDED EXTENT\n")
  cat("====================================================================\n")
  cat("📐 SPATIAL EXTENT: 2X LARGER (100% buffer on all sides)\n")
  cat("📅 Target period:", start_year, "-", end_year, "\n")
  cat("📊 Minimum stations per month:", min_stations, "\n")
  cat("📁 Output directory:", output_base_dir, "\n")
  cat("⚙️ Optimization:", ifelse(optimize_kappa, "ENABLED", "DISABLED"), "\n")
  cat("🔄 Skip existing:", ifelse(skip_existing, "YES", "NO"), "\n")
  cat("🎬 Create animations:", ifelse(create_animations, "YES", "NO"), "\n\n")
  
  batch_start_time <- Sys.time()
  
  if(!dir.exists(output_base_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_base_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    cat("📁 Created main output directory:", output_base_dir, "\n")
  }
  
  cat("📍 STEP 1: Loading GPS coordinates...\n")
  tryCatch({
    gps_coordinates <- load_gps_station_coordinates_optimized(shapefile_path)
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Failed to load GPS coordinates: ", e$message)
  })
  
  cat("\n📥 STEP 2: Loading all rainfall data...\n")
  tryCatch({
    monthly_result <- load_and_aggregate_monthly_data_optimized(datasets_dir)
    monthly_data_list <- monthly_result$monthly_data
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Failed to load rainfall data: ", e$message)
  })
  
  cat("\n🔗 STEP 3: Matching stations...\n")
  tryCatch({
    matched_coordinates <- match_rainfall_with_gps_optimized(
      monthly_data_list, gps_coordinates, similarity_threshold, manual_matches
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Failed to match stations: ", e$message)
  })
  
  cat("\n📅 STEP 4: Scanning available months...\n")
  tryCatch({
    available_months <- get_available_months(monthly_data_list, start_year, end_year)
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Failed to scan available months: ", e$message)
  })
  
  valid_months <- available_months[available_months$Station_count >= min_stations, ]
  
  cat("   ✅ Found", nrow(valid_months), "months with >=", min_stations, "stations\n")
  cat("   📊 Will process", nrow(valid_months), "months with EXTENDED EXTENT\n\n")
  
  if(nrow(valid_months) == 0) {
    stop("No months found with sufficient station data")
  }
  
  batch_results <- list()
  processing_log <- data.frame(
    YearMonth = character(),
    Status = character(),
    Processing_Time = numeric(),
    Stations_Used = integer(),
    Optimization_Method = character(),
    Kriging_Quality = numeric(),
    Error_Message = character(),
    Output_Folder = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  successful_analyses <- 0L
  failed_analyses <- 0L
  skipped_analyses <- 0L
  
  cat("🔄 STEP 5: Processing months in batch with EXTENDED EXTENT...\n")
  cat("==========================================================\n")
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(valid_months)) {
    current_month <- valid_months[i, ]
    target_year_month <- current_month$YearMonth_str
    month_folder_name <- paste0("month_", gsub("-", "_", target_year_month))
    month_output_dir <- file.path(output_base_dir, month_folder_name)
    
    cat("\n📅 Processing", i, "/", nrow(valid_months), ":", target_year_month, 
        "(", current_month$Station_count, "stations)\n")
    cat("   📁 Output folder:", month_folder_name, "\n")
    cat("   📐 Using EXTENDED EXTENT (2x coverage)\n")
    
    if(skip_existing && dir.exists(month_output_dir)) {
      existing_files <- list.files(month_output_dir, pattern = "*.png|*.csv|*.tif")
      if(length(existing_files) > 3) {
        cat("   ⏭️ Skipping - already processed\n")
        skipped_analyses <- skipped_analyses + 1L
        next
      }
    }
    
    if(!dir.exists(month_output_dir)) {
      dir.create(month_output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    }
    
    month_start_time <- Sys.time()
    
    tryCatch({
      cat("   🎯 Running Matérn Kriging analysis with extended extent...\n")
      
      month_results <- perform_optimized_matern_kriging_analysis(
        target_year_month = target_year_month,
        shapefile_path = shapefile_path,
        datasets_dir = datasets_dir,
        manual_matches = manual_matches,
        similarity_threshold = similarity_threshold,
        resolution = resolution,
        buffer_percent = buffer_percent,  # Using the doubled buffer
        optimize_kappa = optimize_kappa,
        kappa_range = kappa_range,
        use_parallel = use_parallel
      )
      
      month_end_time <- Sys.time()
      processing_time <- as.numeric(difftime(month_end_time, month_start_time, units = "secs"))
      
      quality_score <- month_results$summary_stats$kriging_variance_mean
      if(is.null(quality_score) || !is.finite(quality_score)) {
        quality_score <- NA_real_
      }
      
      if(!is.na(quality_score) && quality_score > max_variance_threshold) {
        warning(paste("High kriging variance detected for", target_year_month, ":", 
                     safe_format_number(quality_score, 3)))
      }
      
      save_optimized_kriging_results_batch(month_results, month_output_dir)
      
      batch_results[[target_year_month]] <- month_results
      
      n_stations <- month_results$summary_stats$n_stations_used
      if(is.null(n_stations) || !is.finite(n_stations)) n_stations <- 0L
      
      opt_method <- month_results$summary_stats$optimization_method
      if(is.null(opt_method)) opt_method <- "Unknown"
      
      processing_log <- rbind(processing_log, data.frame(
        YearMonth = as.character(target_year_month),
        Status = "SUCCESS",
        Processing_Time = as.numeric(processing_time),
        Stations_Used = as.integer(n_stations),
        Optimization_Method = as.character(opt_method),
        Kriging_Quality = as.numeric(quality_score),
        Error_Message = "",
        Output_Folder = as.character(month_folder_name),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
      
      successful_analyses <- successful_analyses + 1L
      
      cat("   ✅ SUCCESS - Time:", safe_format_number(processing_time, 1), 
          "s, Quality:", safe_format_number(quality_score, 3), "\n")
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      month_end_time <- Sys.time()
      processing_time <- as.numeric(difftime(month_end_time, month_start_time, units = "secs"))
      
      error_msg <- as.character(e$message)
      cat("   ❌ FAILED:", error_msg, "\n")
      
      processing_log <<- rbind(processing_log, data.frame(
        YearMonth = as.character(target_year_month),
        Status = "FAILED",
        Processing_Time = as.numeric(processing_time),
        Stations_Used = 0L,
        Optimization_Method = "N/A",
        Kriging_Quality = NA_real_,
        Error_Message = substr(error_msg, 1, 200),
        Output_Folder = as.character(month_folder_name),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
      
      failed_analyses <<- failed_analyses + 1L
    })
    
    if(i %% 10 == 0 || i == nrow(valid_months)) {
      progress_pct <- round(i / nrow(valid_months) * 100, 1)
      elapsed_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), batch_start_time, units = "mins"))
      
      cat("\n   📊 PROGRESS UPDATE:", progress_pct, "% complete\n")
      cat("   ⏱️ Elapsed time:", safe_format_number(elapsed_time, 1), "minutes\n")
      cat("   ✅ Successful:", successful_analyses, "| ❌ Failed:", failed_analyses, 
          "| ⏭️ Skipped:", skipped_analyses, "\n")
      
      if(i < nrow(valid_months)) {
        estimated_total_time <- elapsed_time / (i / nrow(valid_months))
        remaining_time <- estimated_total_time - elapsed_time
        cat("   🔮 Estimated remaining time:", safe_format_number(remaining_time, 1), "minutes\n")
      }
    }
  }
  
  batch_end_time <- Sys.time()
  total_processing_time <- as.numeric(difftime(batch_end_time, batch_start_time, units = "mins"))
  
  cat("\n🎉 BATCH PROCESSING COMPLETED WITH EXTENDED EXTENT!\n")
  cat("================================================\n")
  cat("📊 FINAL SUMMARY:\n")
  cat("   Total months processed:", nrow(valid_months), "\n")
  cat("   ✅ Successful:", successful_analyses, "\n")
  cat("   ❌ Failed:", failed_analyses, "\n")
  cat("   ⏭️ Skipped:", skipped_analyses, "\n")
  
  if(successful_analyses + failed_analyses > 0) {
    success_rate <- successful_analyses / (successful_analyses + failed_analyses)
    cat("   📈 Success rate:", safe_format_number(success_rate * 100, 1), "%\n")
  } else {
    success_rate <- 0
    cat("   📈 Success rate: 0%\n")
  }
  
  cat("   ⏱️ Total processing time:", safe_format_number(total_processing_time, 1), "minutes\n")
  if(nrow(valid_months) > 0) {
    avg_time <- total_processing_time / nrow(valid_months)
    cat("   ⚡ Average time per month:", safe_format_number(avg_time, 2), "minutes\n\n")
  }
  
  cat("📋 Creating comprehensive summaries...\n")
  create_batch_summaries(batch_results, processing_log, output_base_dir, 
                        total_processing_time, create_animations)
  
  return(list(
    batch_results = batch_results,
    processing_log = processing_log,
    summary_stats = list(
      total_months = nrow(valid_months),
      successful = successful_analyses,
      failed = failed_analyses,
      skipped = skipped_analyses,
      total_time_minutes = total_processing_time,
      success_rate = success_rate
    )
  ))
}

# Enhanced save function for batch processing with better error handling
save_optimized_kriging_results_batch <- function(results, month_output_dir) {
  if(is.null(results)) {
    return()
  }
  
  target_month_str <- gsub("-", "_", results$summary_stats$target_year_month)
  
  tryCatch({
    if(!is.null(results$interpolation_map)) {
      ggsave(file.path(month_output_dir, "interpolation_map_extended.png"),
             results$interpolation_map, width = 20, height = 16, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    }
    
    if(!is.null(results$variogram_plot)) {
      ggsave(file.path(month_output_dir, "variogram_plot.png"),
             results$variogram_plot, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    }
    
    if(!is.null(results$distance_analysis)) {
      ggsave(file.path(month_output_dir, "distance_analysis.png"),
             results$distance_analysis, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    }
    
    if(!is.null(results$spatial_data) && nrow(results$spatial_data) > 0) {
      write.csv(results$spatial_data, 
                file.path(month_output_dir, "spatial_data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    }
    
    if(!is.null(results$summary_stats)) {
      safe_summary <- lapply(results$summary_stats, function(x) {
        if(is.numeric(x) && length(x) == 1) {
          if(!is.finite(x)) return("NA")
          return(safe_format_number(x, 6))
        } else {
          return(as.character(x))
        }
      })
      
      summary_df <- data.frame(
        Parameter = names(safe_summary),
        Value = as.character(safe_summary),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      write.csv(summary_df, file.path(month_output_dir, "analysis_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    }
    
    if(!is.null(results$kriging_results) && !is.null(results$kriging_results$variogram_fit)) {
      vgm_detailed <- results$kriging_results$variogram_fit
      write.csv(vgm_detailed, file.path(month_output_dir, "variogram_parameters.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    }
    
    if(!is.null(results$kriging_results) && !is.null(results$kriging_results$kriging_result)) {
      if(inherits(results$kriging_results$kriging_result, "SpatialPixelsDataFrame")) {
        kriging_raster <- rast(results$kriging_results$kriging_result)
      } else {
        kriging_raster <- results$kriging_results$kriging_result
      }
      
      if(!is.null(kriging_raster)) {
        writeRaster(kriging_raster, file.path(month_output_dir, "kriging_extended_utm28n.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
        
        tryCatch({
          kriging_wgs84 <- project(kriging_raster, "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs")
          writeRaster(kriging_wgs84, file.path(month_output_dir, "kriging_extended_wgs84.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
        }, error = function(e) {
          cat("   ⚠️ Warning: Could not create WGS84 version:", e$message, "\n")
        })
      }
    }
    
    log_content <- c(
      paste("Month:", results$summary_stats$target_year_month),
      paste("Spatial Extent: EXTENDED (2x coverage with 100% buffer)"),
      paste("Processing Time:", safe_format_number(results$summary_stats$processing_time_seconds, 2), "seconds"),
      paste("Stations Used:", results$summary_stats$n_stations_used),
      paste("Optimization Method:", results$summary_stats$optimization_method),
      paste("Optimized Kappa:", safe_format_number(results$summary_stats$variogram_kappa, 4)),
      paste("Generated:", Sys.time())
    )
    writeLines(log_content, file.path(month_output_dir, "processing_log.txt"))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("   ⚠️ Warning saving month results:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

# Comprehensive summary creation function with improved error handling
create_batch_summaries <- function(batch_results, processing_log, output_base_dir, 
                                  total_processing_time, create_animations = FALSE) {
  
  summaries_dir <- file.path(output_base_dir, "BATCH_SUMMARIES")
  if(!dir.exists(summaries_dir)) {
    dir.create(summaries_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  cat("   📊 Creating master processing log...\n")
  write.csv(processing_log, file.path(summaries_dir, "master_processing_log.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  successful_results <- batch_results[!sapply(batch_results, is.null)]
  
  if(length(successful_results) > 0) {
    cat("   📈 Creating temporal trend analysis...\n")
    
    temporal_stats <- data.frame(
      YearMonth = character(),
      Year = integer(),
      Month = integer(),
      Season = character(),
      Stations_Used = integer(),
      Mean_Rainfall = numeric(),
      Max_Rainfall = numeric(),
      Min_Rainfall = numeric(),
      SD_Rainfall = numeric(),
      Kriging_Variance = numeric(),
      Variogram_Range = numeric(),
      Variogram_Kappa = numeric(),
      Processing_Time = numeric(),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    for(month_key in names(successful_results)) {
      result <- successful_results[[month_key]]
      stats <- result$summary_stats
      
      month_num <- tryCatch({
        as.integer(substr(month_key, 6, 7))
      }, error = function(e) 1L)
      
      year_num <- tryCatch({
        as.integer(substr(month_key, 1, 4))
      }, error = function(e) 2000L)
      
      season <- "Unknown"
      if(month_num >= 1 && month_num <= 12) {
        season <- case_when(
          month_num %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
          month_num %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring",
          month_num %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
          month_num %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Autumn",
          TRUE ~ "Unknown"
        )
      }
      
      safe_extract <- function(value, default = NA_real_) {
        if(is.null(value) || !is.numeric(value) || !is.finite(value)) {
          return(default)
        }
        return(as.numeric(value))
      }
      
      temporal_stats <- rbind(temporal_stats, data.frame(
        YearMonth = as.character(month_key),
        Year = year_num,
        Month = month_num,
        Season = season,
        Stations_Used = as.integer(safe_extract(stats$n_stations_used, 0)),
        Mean_Rainfall = safe_extract(stats$observed_rainfall_mean),
        Max_Rainfall = safe_extract(stats$observed_rainfall_max),
        Min_Rainfall = safe_extract(stats$observed_rainfall_min),
        SD_Rainfall = safe_extract(stats$observed_rainfall_sd),
        Kriging_Variance = safe_extract(stats$kriging_variance_mean),
        Variogram_Range = safe_extract(stats$variogram_range_m),
        Variogram_Kappa = safe_extract(stats$variogram_kappa),
        Processing_Time = safe_extract(stats$processing_time_seconds),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }
    
    write.csv(temporal_stats, file.path(summaries_dir, "temporal_statistics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    
    cat("   🎨 Creating summary visualizations...\n")
    
    tryCatch({
      if(!require(ggplot2, quietly = TRUE)) {
        cat("   ⚠️ ggplot2 not available - skipping visualizations\n")
        return()
      }
      if(!require(dplyr, quietly = TRUE)) {
        cat("   ⚠️ dplyr not available - using base R aggregation\n")
      }
      
      valid_temporal <- temporal_stats[
        !is.na(temporal_stats$Mean_Rainfall) & 
        is.finite(temporal_stats$Mean_Rainfall) &
        temporal_stats$Mean_Rainfall >= 0, 
      ]
      
      if(nrow(valid_temporal) == 0) {
        cat("   ⚠️ No valid temporal data for visualizations\n")
        return()
      }
      
      tryCatch({
        valid_temporal$Date <- as.Date(paste0(valid_temporal$YearMonth, "-01"))
        
        p1 <- ggplot(valid_temporal, aes(x = Date)) +
          geom_line(aes(y = Mean_Rainfall), color = "blue", size = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
          geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(Min_Rainfall, 0, na.rm = TRUE), 
                         ymax = pmax(Max_Rainfall, 0, na.rm = TRUE)), 
                     alpha = 0.3, fill = "blue", na.rm = TRUE) +
          labs(title = "Temporal Rainfall Trends - Extended Extent Analysis",
               subtitle = paste("Period:", min(valid_temporal$Year, na.rm = TRUE), "-", 
                              max(valid_temporal$Year, na.rm = TRUE)),
               x = "Date", y = "Monthly Rainfall (mm)") +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
        
        if(require(dplyr, quietly = TRUE) && length(unique(valid_temporal$Season)) > 1) {
          p1 <- p1 + facet_wrap(~Season, scales = "free_y")
        }
        
        ggsave(file.path(summaries_dir, "temporal_rainfall_trends.png"), p1, 
               width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("   ⚠️ Could not create temporal trends plot:", e$message, "\n")
      })
      
      tryCatch({
        if(require(dplyr, quietly = TRUE)) {
          seasonal_summary <- valid_temporal %>%
            filter(Season != "Unknown") %>%
            group_by(Season) %>%
            summarise(
              Count = n(),
              Mean_Rainfall = mean(Mean_Rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
              SD_Rainfall = mean(SD_Rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
              Mean_Variance = mean(Kriging_Variance, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = 'drop'
            )
        } else {
          valid_seasonal <- valid_temporal[valid_temporal$Season != "Unknown", ]
          seasonal_summary <- aggregate(
            cbind(Mean_Rainfall, SD_Rainfall, Kriging_Variance) ~ Season, 
            data = valid_seasonal, 
            FUN = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
          )
          seasonal_summary$Count <- table(valid_seasonal$Season)[seasonal_summary$Season]
        }
        
        if(nrow(seasonal_summary) > 0) {
          p2 <- ggplot(seasonal_summary, aes(x = Season, y = Mean_Rainfall, fill = Season)) +
            geom_col(alpha = 0.8) +
            labs(title = "Seasonal Rainfall Patterns - Extended Extent",
                 subtitle = "Average monthly rainfall by season",
                 x = "Season", y = "Average Monthly Rainfall (mm)") +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(legend.position = "none")
          
          ggsave(file.path(summaries_dir, "seasonal_patterns.png"), p2, 
                 width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
          
          write.csv(seasonal_summary, file.path(summaries_dir, "seasonal_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
        }
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("   ⚠️ Could not create seasonal analysis:", e$message, "\n")
      })
      
      tryCatch({
        valid_quality <- valid_temporal[!is.na(valid_temporal$Kriging_Variance) & 
                                       is.finite(valid_temporal$Kriging_Variance), ]
        
        if(nrow(valid_quality) > 5) {
          p3 <- ggplot(valid_quality, aes(x = Date)) +
            geom_line(aes(y = Kriging_Variance), color = "red", size = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
            geom_smooth(aes(y = Kriging_Variance), method = "loess", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
            labs(title = "Kriging Quality Over Time - Extended Extent",
                 subtitle = "Kriging variance as indicator of uncertainty",
                 x = "Date", y = "Average Kriging Variance") +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
          
          ggsave(file.path(summaries_dir, "quality_trends.png"), p3, 
                 width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
        }
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("   ⚠️ Could not create quality trends plot:", e$message, "\n")
      })
      
      tryCatch({
        valid_performance <- valid_temporal[!is.na(valid_temporal$Processing_Time) & 
                                          !is.na(valid_temporal$Stations_Used) &
                                          is.finite(valid_temporal$Processing_Time) &
                                          is.finite(valid_temporal$Stations_Used), ]
        
        if(nrow(valid_performance) > 3) {
          p4 <- ggplot(valid_performance, aes(x = Stations_Used, y = Processing_Time)) +
            geom_point(aes(color = Year), alpha = 0.7, size = 2, na.rm = TRUE) +
            geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", na.rm = TRUE) +
            labs(title = "Processing Performance Analysis - Extended Extent",
                 subtitle = "Processing time vs number of stations used",
                 x = "Number of Stations Used", y = "Processing Time (seconds)") +
            theme_minimal()
          
          if(length(unique(valid_performance$Year)) > 1) {
            p4 <- p4 + scale_color_viridis_c()
          }
          
          ggsave(file.path(summaries_dir, "processing_performance.png"), p4, 
                 width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
        }
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("   ⚠️ Could not create performance plot:", e$message, "\n")
      })
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("   ⚠️ General visualization error:", e$message, "\n")
    })
    
    cat("   📅 Creating annual summaries...\n")
    tryCatch({
      if(require(dplyr, quietly = TRUE)) {
        annual_summary <- valid_temporal %>%
          group_by(Year) %>%
          summarise(
            Months_Processed = n(),
            Total_Rainfall_Mean = mean(Mean_Rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
            Total_Rainfall_Sum = sum(Mean_Rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
            Avg_Stations = mean(Stations_Used, na.rm = TRUE),
            Avg_Processing_Time = mean(Processing_Time, na.rm = TRUE),
            Avg_Kriging_Quality = mean(Kriging_Variance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = 'drop'
          )
      } else {
        years <- unique(valid_temporal$Year[!is.na(valid_temporal$Year)])
        annual_summary <- data.frame(
          Year = years,
          Months_Processed = sapply(years, function(y) sum(valid_temporal$Year == y, na.rm = TRUE)),
          Total_Rainfall_Mean = sapply(years, function(y) mean(valid_temporal$Mean_Rainfall[valid_temporal$Year == y], na.rm = TRUE)),
          Total_Rainfall_Sum = sapply(years, function(y) sum(valid_temporal$Mean_Rainfall[valid_temporal$Year == y], na.rm = TRUE)),
          Avg_Stations = sapply(years, function(y) mean(valid_temporal$Stations_Used[valid_temporal$Year == y], na.rm = TRUE)),
          Avg_Processing_Time = sapply(years, function(y) mean(valid_temporal$Processing_Time[valid_temporal$Year == y], na.rm = TRUE)),
          Avg_Kriging_Quality = sapply(years, function(y) mean(valid_temporal$Kriging_Variance[valid_temporal$Year == y], na.rm = TRUE))
        )
      }
      
      write.csv(annual_summary, file.path(summaries_dir, "annual_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("   ⚠️ Could not create annual summary:", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
  
  cat("   📝 Creating master README...\n")
  tryCatch({
    successful_count <- sum(processing_log$Status == "SUCCESS", na.rm = TRUE)
    failed_count <- sum(processing_log$Status == "FAILED", na.rm = TRUE)
    avg_processing_time <- mean(processing_log$Processing_Time[processing_log$Status == "SUCCESS"], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    readme_content <- c(
      "# Batch Optimized Matérn Kriging Analysis Results - EXTENDED EXTENT",
      paste("Generated:", Sys.time()),
      "",
      "## Overview",
      paste("This directory contains results from batch processing of spatial rainfall interpolation"),
      paste("using optimized Matérn Kriging with automatic parameter estimation."),
      paste("**SPATIAL EXTENT: 2X LARGER (100% buffer = doubled coverage in all directions)**"),
      "",
      "## Extended Spatial Coverage",
      "- Buffer percentage: 100% (double the original 50% buffer)",
      "- Interpolation extends twice as far beyond station locations",
      "- Provides more comprehensive regional rainfall patterns",
      "- Better captures edge effects and spatial trends",
      "",
      "## Directory Structure",
      "- `month_YYYY_MM/`: Individual month results",
      "  - `interpolation_map_extended.png`: Extended kriging interpolation map",
      "  - `variogram_plot.png`: Variogram model plot", 
      "  - `distance_analysis.png`: Spatial autocorrelation analysis",
      "  - `spatial_data.csv`: Station data used",
      "  - `analysis_summary.csv`: Complete analysis parameters",
      "  - `variogram_parameters.csv`: Optimized variogram parameters",
      "  - `kriging_extended_utm28n.tif`: Extended kriging raster (UTM projection)",
      "  - `kriging_extended_wgs84.tif`: Extended kriging raster (WGS84 projection)",
      "",
      "- `BATCH_SUMMARIES/`: Overall analysis summaries",
      "  - `master_processing_log.csv`: Complete processing log",
      "  - `temporal_statistics.csv`: Time series analysis",
      "  - `annual_summary.csv`: Yearly aggregated statistics",
      "  - `seasonal_summary.csv`: Seasonal pattern analysis",
      "  - Various summary visualization plots",
      "",
      "## Key Statistics",
      paste("- Total processing time:", safe_format_number(total_processing_time, 1), "minutes"),
      paste("- Successful analyses:", successful_count),
      paste("- Failed analyses:", failed_count),
      paste("- Average processing time per month:", 
            safe_format_number(avg_processing_time, 2), "seconds"),
      "",
      "## Data Quality",
      if(length(successful_results) > 0 && exists("valid_temporal")) {
        paste("- Average stations per month:", safe_format_number(mean(valid_temporal$Stations_Used, na.rm = TRUE), 1))
      } else {
        "- No successful results to analyze"
      },
      "",
      "## Methodology", 
      "- Spatial interpolation: Matérn Kriging with automap optimization",
      "- Parameter optimization: Automatic kappa selection",
      "- Coordinate system: UTM Zone 28N / WGS84",
      "- Grid resolution: Variable based on data extent",
      "- **Extended coverage: 100% buffer (2x standard extent)**",
      "",
      "## Advantages of Extended Extent",
      "- Better regional pattern visualization",
      "- Improved edge effect handling",
      "- More comprehensive spatial coverage",
      "- Enhanced extrapolation beyond station network",
      "",
      "For detailed methodology, see individual month analysis summaries."
    )
    
    writeLines(readme_content, file.path(output_base_dir, "README.md"))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("   ⚠️ Could not create README:", e$message, "\n")
  })
  
  tryCatch({
    summary_report <- list(
      processing_summary = processing_log,
      temporal_analysis = if(exists("valid_temporal")) valid_temporal else NULL,
      annual_summary = if(exists("annual_summary")) annual_summary else NULL,
      seasonal_summary = if(exists("seasonal_summary")) seasonal_summary else NULL,
      batch_metadata = list(
        total_processing_time_minutes = total_processing_time,
        spatial_extent = "EXTENDED (2x coverage with 100% buffer)",
        generated_timestamp = Sys.time(),
        r_version = R.version.string,
        successful_months = sum(processing_log$Status == "SUCCESS", na.rm = TRUE),
        failed_months = sum(processing_log$Status == "FAILED", na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
    
    saveRDS(summary_report, file.path(summaries_dir, "complete_batch_summary.rds"))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("   ⚠️ Could not save summary report:", e$message, "\n")
  })
  
  cat("   ✅ All summaries created successfully!\n")
}

# Additional validation function for input data
validate_batch_inputs <- function(shapefile_path, datasets_dir, output_base_dir) {
  cat("🔍 VALIDATING INPUT PARAMETERS...\n")
  
  errors <- character()
  warnings <- character()
  
  if(!file.exists(shapefile_path)) {
    errors <- c(errors, paste("Shapefile not found:", shapefile_path))
  }
  
  if(!dir.exists(datasets_dir)) {
    errors <- c(errors, paste("Datasets directory not found:", datasets_dir))
  } else {
    csv_files <- list.files(datasets_dir, pattern = "*.csv", recursive = TRUE)
    if(length(csv_files) == 0) {
      warnings <- c(warnings, paste("No CSV files found in:", datasets_dir))
    }
  }
  
  if(!dir.exists(dirname(output_base_dir))) {
    tryCatch({
      dir.create(dirname(output_base_dir), recursive = TRUE)
    }, error = function(e) {
      errors <- c(errors, paste("Cannot create output directory:", dirname(output_base_dir)))
    })
  }
  
  required_packages <- c("sp", "gstat", "automap", "terra", "sf", "ggplot2")
  missing_packages <- character()
  
  for(pkg in required_packages) {
    if(!require(pkg, quietly = TRUE, character.only = TRUE)) {
      missing_packages <- c(missing_packages, pkg)
    }
  }
  
  if(length(missing_packages) > 0) {
    errors <- c(errors, paste("Missing required packages:", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  if(length(errors) > 0) {
    cat("❌ VALIDATION ERRORS:\n")
    for(error in errors) {
      cat("   •", error, "\n")
    }
    stop("Please fix validation errors before proceeding.")
  }
  
  if(length(warnings) > 0) {
    cat("⚠️ VALIDATION WARNINGS:\n")
    for(warning in warnings) {
      cat("   •", warning, "\n")
    }
  }
  
  if(length(warnings) == 0 && length(errors) == 0) {
    cat("✅ All validation checks passed!\n\n")
  }
  
  return(list(errors = errors, warnings = warnings))
}

cat("🚀 STARTING EXTENDED EXTENT BATCH ANALYSIS FOR ALL MONTHS\n")

  kappa_range = c(0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 5.0),
  use_parallel = TRUE,            # Enable parallel processing
  
  # Quality control parameters

  # Time range parameters

  # Processing options

)

)

    cat("   ", param, ":", value, "\n")
  }
}
cat("\n")


# Run the comprehensive batch analysis with extended extent

cat("Results will be saved to:", batch_config$output_base_dir, "\n\n")

# Execute batch processing with comprehensive error handling

  perform_batch_matern_kriging_analysis(
    shapefile_path = batch_config$shapefile_path,
    datasets_dir = batch_config$datasets_dir,
    output_base_dir = batch_config$output_base_dir,
    manual_matches = NULL,
    similarity_threshold = batch_config$similarity_threshold,
    resolution = batch_config$resolution,
    buffer_percent = batch_config$buffer_percent,  # Using the doubled buffer
    optimize_kappa = batch_config$optimize_kappa,
    kappa_range = batch_config$kappa_range,
    use_parallel = batch_config$use_parallel,
    min_stations = batch_config$min_stations,
    max_variance_threshold = batch_config$max_variance_threshold,
    start_year = batch_config$start_year,
    end_year = batch_config$end_year,
    skip_existing = batch_config$skip_existing,
    create_animations = batch_config$create_animations
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  
  return(NULL)
})

# Display final batch results with improved formatting
if(!is.null(batch_results)) {
  cat("\n🎉 EXTENDED EXTENT BATCH PROCESSING COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!\n")
  cat("=========================================================\n")
  
  summary <- batch_results$summary_stats
  
  cat("📊 FINAL BATCH STATISTICS:\n")
  cat("   Total months found:", summary$total_months, "\n")
  cat("   ✅ Successfully processed:", summary$successful, "\n")
  cat("   ❌ Failed:", summary$failed, "\n")
  cat("   ⏭️ Skipped (already done):", summary$skipped, "\n")
  cat("   📈 Overall success rate:", safe_format_number(summary$success_rate * 100, 1), "%\n")
  cat("   ⏱️ Total processing time:", safe_format_number(summary$total_time_minutes, 1), "minutes\n")
  
  if(summary$total_months > 0) {
    avg_time <- summary$total_time_minutes / summary$total_months
    cat("   ⚡ Average time per month:", safe_format_number(avg_time, 2), "minutes\n")
    cat("   📐 Spatial extent: EXTENDED (2x coverage)\n\n")
  }
  
  if(!is.null(batch_results$processing_log)) {
    processing_log <- batch_results$processing_log
    successful_log <- processing_log[processing_log$Status == "SUCCESS", ]
    
    if(nrow(successful_log) > 0) {
      cat("📊 PROCESSING DETAILS:\n")
      cat("   Average stations per analysis:", safe_format_number(mean(successful_log$Stations_Used, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "\n")
      cat("   Processing time range:", 
          safe_format_number(min(successful_log$Processing_Time, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "-", 
          safe_format_number(max(successful_log$Processing_Time, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "seconds\n")
      
      if(any(!is.na(successful_log$Kriging_Quality))) {
        best_quality_idx <- which.min(successful_log$Kriging_Quality)
        if(length(best_quality_idx) > 0) {
          cat("   Best quality month:", successful_log$YearMonth[best_quality_idx], 
              "(variance =", safe_format_number(successful_log$Kriging_Quality[best_quality_idx], 3), ")\n")
        }
      }
    }
    
    failed_log <- processing_log[processing_log$Status == "FAILED", ]
    if(nrow(failed_log) > 0) {
      cat("\n⚠️ FAILED MONTHS:\n")
      cat("   Count:", nrow(failed_log), "\n")
      cat("   Examples:", paste(head(failed_log$YearMonth, 3), collapse = ", "))
      if(nrow(failed_log) > 3) cat(" ...")
      cat("\n   Check master_processing_log.csv for details\n")
    }
  }
  
} else {
  cat("❌ BATCH PROCESSING COULD NOT COMPLETE\n")
  cat("=====================================\n")
  cat("The processing failed during execution.\n")

}

  cat("   - Extended (1.0): ✨ CURRENT - Best balance\n")
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)

# Function to process rainfall stations and calculate mean
process_rainfall_stations <- function() {
  
  # Set the folder path
  folder_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025/combined_datasets"
  
  cat(paste(rep("=", 80), collapse=""), "\n")
  cat("PROCESSING RAINFALL STATIONS - CALCULATING MEAN\n")
  cat("Folder:", folder_path, "\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 80), collapse=""), "\n\n")
  
  # Get list of all CSV files starting with "combined_"
  csv_files <- list.files(path = folder_path, 
                         pattern = "^combined_.*\\.csv$", 
                         full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(csv_files) == 0) {
    cat("❌ No CSV files found starting with 'combined_' in the folder!\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cat("📋 FOUND STATIONS:\n")
  station_names <- c()
  for (i in 1:length(csv_files)) {
    file_name <- basename(csv_files[i])
    # Extract station name from filename
    station_name <- gsub("combined_", "", gsub("_2000_2025\\.csv$", "", file_name))
    station_names <- c(station_names, station_name)
    cat(sprintf("   %2d. %s -> Station: %s\n", i, file_name, station_name))
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("\n✓ Total stations found: %d\n\n", length(csv_files)))
  
  # Initialize list to store all datasets
  all_datasets <- list()
  successful_loads <- 0
  
  cat("📊 LOADING DATASETS:\n")
  
  # Load each dataset
  for (i in 1:length(csv_files)) {
    file_path <- csv_files[i]
    station_name <- station_names[i]
    
    tryCatch({
      # Read CSV file
      df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
      
      # Check if required columns exist
      if (!("Date" %in% colnames(df)) || !("combined_rainfall" %in% colnames(df))) {
        cat(sprintf("   ❌ %s: Missing required columns (Date or combined_rainfall)\n", station_name))
        next
      }
      
      # Convert Date to proper format
      df$Date <- as.Date(df$Date, format = "%d/%m/%Y")
      
      # Check for valid dates
      valid_dates <- sum(!is.na(df$Date))
      if (valid_dates == 0) {
        cat(sprintf("   ❌ %s: No valid dates found\n", station_name))
        next
      }
      
      # Select and rename columns
      df_clean <- df %>%
        select(Date, combined_rainfall) %>%
        filter(!is.na(Date)) %>%
        mutate(combined_rainfall = as.numeric(combined_rainfall)) %>%
        arrange(Date)
      
      # Check for duplicates and handle them
      duplicates <- sum(duplicated(df_clean$Date))
      if (duplicates > 0) {
        cat(sprintf("   ⚠️  %s: Found %d duplicate dates, averaging values\n", station_name, duplicates))
        # Show some examples of duplicates
        dup_dates <- df_clean$Date[duplicated(df_clean$Date)]
        cat(sprintf("   ⚠️  Example duplicate dates: %s\n", paste(head(dup_dates, 3), collapse=", ")))
        
        # Remove duplicates by averaging
        df_clean <- df_clean %>%
          group_by(Date) %>%
          summarise(combined_rainfall = mean(combined_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
          arrange(Date)
      }
      
      # Rename the rainfall column to include station name
      colnames(df_clean)[2] <- paste0("rainfall_", station_name)
      
      # Store in list
      all_datasets[[station_name]] <- df_clean
      successful_loads <- successful_loads + 1
      
      cat(sprintf("   ✓ %s: %d records loaded (Date range: %s to %s)\n", 
                  station_name, nrow(df_clean), 
                  min(df_clean$Date), max(df_clean$Date)))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(sprintf("   ❌ %s: Error loading - %s\n", station_name, e$message))
    })
  }
  
  if (successful_loads == 0) {
    cat("\n❌ No datasets could be loaded successfully!\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("\n✓ Successfully loaded %d out of %d stations\n\n", successful_loads, length(csv_files)))
  
  cat("🔄 MERGING DATASETS AND CALCULATING MEAN:\n")
  
  # Start with the first dataset
  merged_data <- all_datasets[[1]]
  cat(sprintf("   • Starting with: %s (%d records)\n", names(all_datasets)[1], nrow(merged_data)))
  
  # Merge all other datasets
  for (i in 2:length(all_datasets)) {
    station_name <- names(all_datasets)[i]
    dataset <- all_datasets[[i]]
    
    merged_data <- merged_data %>%
      full_join(dataset, by = "Date")
    
    cat(sprintf("   • Added: %s (Total records after merge: %d)\n", station_name, nrow(merged_data)))
  }
  
  # Get all rainfall columns
  rainfall_cols <- colnames(merged_data)[grepl("^rainfall_", colnames(merged_data))]
  
  cat(sprintf("   • Rainfall columns: %d\n", length(rainfall_cols)))
  
  # Calculate mean across all stations for each date
  merged_data <- merged_data %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      # Count of available values (non-NA)
      available_stations = sum(!is.na(c_across(all_of(rainfall_cols)))),
      # Mean of available values
      precipitation_stations_mean = ifelse(available_stations > 0, 
                                         mean(c_across(all_of(rainfall_cols)), na.rm = TRUE), 
                                         NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Date)
  
  # Create final dataset with Date and mean precipitation
  final_data <- merged_data %>%
    select(Date, precipitation_stations_mean, available_stations) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Date))
  
  cat(sprintf("   • Final dataset: %d records\n", nrow(final_data)))
  cat(sprintf("   • Date range: %s to %s\n", min(final_data$Date), max(final_data$Date)))
  cat(sprintf("   • Mean precipitation range: %.2f to %.2f\n", 
              min(final_data$precipitation_stations_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
              max(final_data$precipitation_stations_mean, na.rm = TRUE)))
  
  # Calculate statistics
  stats_summary <- final_data %>%
    summarise(
      total_records = n(),
      records_with_data = sum(!is.na(precipitation_stations_mean)),
      records_missing = sum(is.na(precipitation_stations_mean)),
      min_precipitation = min(precipitation_stations_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_precipitation = max(precipitation_stations_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_precipitation = mean(precipitation_stations_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_precipitation = median(precipitation_stations_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_stations_available = min(available_stations, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_stations_available = max(available_stations, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_stations_available = mean(available_stations, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  # Save the final dataset
  output_file <- file.path(dirname(folder_path), "precipitation_stations_mean.csv")
  
  write_csv(final_data, output_file)
  
  cat(sprintf("\n✅ COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!\n"))
  cat(sprintf("📁 Output file: %s\n", output_file))
  
  # Print detailed summary
  cat("\n📋 FINAL SUMMARY:\n")
  cat(sprintf("   • Total stations processed: %d\n", successful_loads))
  cat(sprintf("   • Total records in final dataset: %d\n", stats_summary$total_records))
  cat(sprintf("   • Records with precipitation data: %d\n", stats_summary$records_with_data))
  cat(sprintf("   • Records with missing data: %d\n", stats_summary$records_missing))
  cat(sprintf("   • Precipitation statistics:\n"))
  cat(sprintf("     - Min: %.2f mm\n", stats_summary$min_precipitation))
  cat(sprintf("     - Max: %.2f mm\n", stats_summary$max_precipitation))
  cat(sprintf("     - Mean: %.2f mm\n", stats_summary$mean_precipitation))
  cat(sprintf("     - Median: %.2f mm\n", stats_summary$median_precipitation))
  cat(sprintf("   • Station availability:\n"))
  cat(sprintf("     - Min stations per date: %d\n", stats_summary$min_stations_available))
  cat(sprintf("     - Max stations per date: %d\n", stats_summary$max_stations_available))
  cat(sprintf("     - Average stations per date: %.1f\n", stats_summary$mean_stations_available))
  
  # Save summary statistics
  summary_file <- file.path(dirname(folder_path), "precipitation_stations_summary.csv")
  write_csv(stats_summary, summary_file)
  cat(sprintf("   • Summary statistics saved: precipitation_stations_summary.csv\n"))
  
  # Create station details summary
  station_details <- data.frame(
    Station_Name = names(all_datasets),
    Records_Count = sapply(all_datasets, nrow),
    Start_Date = sapply(all_datasets, function(x) as.character(min(x$Date))),
    End_Date = sapply(all_datasets, function(x) as.character(max(x$Date))),
    Min_Rainfall = sapply(all_datasets, function(x) min(x[[2]], na.rm = TRUE)),
    Max_Rainfall = sapply(all_datasets, function(x) max(x[[2]], na.rm = TRUE)),
    Mean_Rainfall = sapply(all_datasets, function(x) mean(x[[2]], na.rm = TRUE))
  )
  
  station_details_file <- file.path(dirname(folder_path), "stations_details.csv")
  write_csv(station_details, station_details_file)
  cat(sprintf("   • Station details saved: stations_details.csv\n"))
  
  return(final_data)
}

# Run the function
result <- process_rainfall_stations()

# Display first few rows if successful
if (!is.null(result)) {
  cat("\n📊 PREVIEW OF FINAL DATASET:\n")
  print(head(result, 10))
}
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(corrplot)
library(scales)

# Define the high-level theme
readable_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", margin = margin(b = 15)),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 16, color = "gray50", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray95", size = 0.3),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA)
  )

# Function to compare rainfall datasets
compare_rainfall_data <- function() {
  
  # Set paths
  base_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/enhanced_rainfall_timeseries_2000_2025"
  stations_mean_file <- file.path(base_path, "precipitation_stations_mean.csv")
  c2_file <- file.path(base_path, "combined_datasets", "combined_C2_2000_2025.csv")
  
  cat("🔍 LOADING DATASETS FOR COMPARISON\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 50), collapse=""), "\n")
  
  # Load station mean data
  if (!file.exists(stations_mean_file)) {
    cat("❌ Station mean file not found:", stations_mean_file, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  stations_data <- read_csv(stations_mean_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cat("✓ Loaded station mean data:", nrow(stations_data), "records\n")
  
  # Load C2 data
  if (!file.exists(c2_file)) {
    cat("❌ C2 file not found:", c2_file, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  c2_data <- read_csv(c2_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cat("✓ Loaded C2 data:", nrow(c2_data), "records\n")
  
  # Process C2 data
  c2_clean <- c2_data %>%
    mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Date)) %>%
    select(Date, combined_rainfall) %>%
    rename(C2_rainfall = combined_rainfall) %>%
    arrange(Date)
  
  # Check for C2 duplicates and handle them
  c2_duplicates <- sum(duplicated(c2_clean$Date))
  if (c2_duplicates > 0) {
    cat("⚠️  C2 data: Found", c2_duplicates, "duplicate dates, averaging values\n")
    c2_clean <- c2_clean %>%
      group_by(Date) %>%
      summarise(C2_rainfall = mean(C2_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
      arrange(Date)
  }
  
  # Merge datasets
  combined_data <- stations_data %>%
    inner_join(c2_clean, by = "Date") %>%
    mutate(
      year = year(Date),
      month = month(Date),
      season = case_when(
        month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
        month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring", 
        month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
        month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(precipitation_stations_mean) & !is.na(C2_rainfall))
  
  cat("✓ Merged data:", nrow(combined_data), "records with both datasets\n")
  cat("📊 Date range:", min(combined_data$Date), "to", max(combined_data$Date), "\n\n")
  
  # Create output directory
  output_dir <- file.path(base_path, "comparison_plots")
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir)
  }
  
  cat("📈 GENERATING COMPARISON PLOTS\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 50), collapse=""), "\n")
  
  # 1. Time Series Comparison Plot
  cat("1. Creating time series comparison plot...\n")
  
  ts_data <- combined_data %>%
    select(Date, precipitation_stations_mean, C2_rainfall) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(precipitation_stations_mean, C2_rainfall),
                names_to = "Dataset",
                values_to = "Rainfall") %>%
    mutate(Dataset = case_when(
      Dataset == "precipitation_stations_mean" ~ "Stations Mean",
      Dataset == "C2_rainfall" ~ "C2 Station"
    ))
  
  p1 <- ggplot(ts_data, aes(x = Date, y = Rainfall, color = Dataset)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.7, size = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Stations Mean" = "#2E86AB", "C2 Station" = "#A23B72")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(suffix = " mm")) +
    labs(
      title = "Rainfall Time Series Comparison",
      subtitle = "Station Mean vs C2 Station (2000-2025)",
      x = "Date",
      y = "Daily Rainfall (mm)",
      color = "Dataset",
      caption = "Data source: Combined rainfall datasets"
    ) +
    readable_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "01_timeseries_comparison.png"), p1, 
         width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  # 2. Monthly Aggregated Time Series
  cat("2. Creating monthly aggregated time series...\n")
  
  monthly_data <- combined_data %>%
    mutate(year_month = floor_date(Date, "month")) %>%
    group_by(year_month) %>%
    summarise(
      Stations_Mean = sum(precipitation_stations_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      C2_Station = sum(C2_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(Stations_Mean, C2_Station),
                names_to = "Dataset", values_to = "Monthly_Rainfall")
  
  p2 <- ggplot(monthly_data, aes(x = year_month, y = Monthly_Rainfall, color = Dataset)) +
    geom_line(size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Stations_Mean" = "#2E86AB", "C2_Station" = "#A23B72")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(suffix = " mm")) +
    labs(
      title = "Monthly Rainfall Comparison",
      subtitle = "Monthly totals: Station Mean vs C2 Station",
      x = "Date",
      y = "Monthly Rainfall (mm)",
      color = "Dataset"
    ) +
    readable_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "02_monthly_timeseries.png"), p2,
         width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  # 3. Distribution Comparison (Histograms)
  cat("3. Creating distribution comparison (histograms)...\n")
  
  dist_data <- combined_data %>%
    select(precipitation_stations_mean, C2_rainfall) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Dataset", values_to = "Rainfall") %>%
    mutate(Dataset = case_when(
      Dataset == "precipitation_stations_mean" ~ "Stations Mean",
      Dataset == "C2_rainfall" ~ "C2 Station"
    )) %>%
    filter(Rainfall >= 0)  # Remove negative values if any
  
  p3 <- ggplot(dist_data, aes(x = Rainfall, fill = Dataset)) +
    geom_histogram(alpha = 0.7, bins = 50, position = "identity") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Stations Mean" = "#2E86AB", "C2 Station" = "#A23B72")) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(suffix = " mm")) +
    labs(
      title = "Rainfall Distribution Comparison",
      subtitle = "Frequency distribution of daily rainfall values",
      x = "Daily Rainfall (mm)",
      y = "Frequency",
      fill = "Dataset"
    ) +
    readable_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "03_distribution_histograms.png"), p3,
         width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  # 4. Box Plot Comparison by Season
  cat("4. Creating seasonal box plots...\n")
  
  seasonal_data <- combined_data %>%
    select(season, precipitation_stations_mean, C2_rainfall) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(precipitation_stations_mean, C2_rainfall),
                names_to = "Dataset", values_to = "Rainfall") %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset = case_when(
        Dataset == "precipitation_stations_mean" ~ "Stations Mean",
        Dataset == "C2_rainfall" ~ "C2 Station"
      ),
      season = factor(season, levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Fall", "Winter"))
    )
  
  p4 <- ggplot(seasonal_data, aes(x = season, y = Rainfall, fill = Dataset)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Stations Mean" = "#2E86AB", "C2 Station" = "#A23B72")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(suffix = " mm")) +
    labs(
      title = "Seasonal Rainfall Distribution",
      subtitle = "Box plots showing rainfall distribution by season",
      x = "Season",
      y = "Daily Rainfall (mm)",
      fill = "Dataset"
    ) +
    readable_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "04_seasonal_boxplots.png"), p4,
         width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  # 5. Scatter Plot Correlation
  cat("5. Creating scatter plot correlation...\n")
  
  correlation <- cor(combined_data$precipitation_stations_mean, 
                    combined_data$C2_rainfall, use = "complete.obs")
  
  p5 <- ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = C2_rainfall, y = precipitation_stations_mean)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "#2E86AB", size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#A23B72", size = 1.2, se = TRUE, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(suffix = " mm")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(suffix = " mm")) +
    labs(
      title = "Rainfall Correlation Analysis",
      subtitle = paste0("Stations Mean vs C2 Station (R = ", round(correlation, 3), ")"),
      x = "C2 Station Rainfall (mm)",
      y = "Stations Mean Rainfall (mm)",
      caption = "Red dashed line = perfect correlation (1:1), Blue line = actual relationship"
    ) +
    readable_theme
  
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "05_correlation_scatter.png"), p5,
         width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  # 6. Density Plot Comparison
  cat("6. Creating density plot comparison...\n")
  
  p6 <- ggplot(dist_data, aes(x = Rainfall, color = Dataset, fill = Dataset)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Stations Mean" = "#2E86AB", "C2 Station" = "#A23B72")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Stations Mean" = "#2E86AB", "C2 Station" = "#A23B72")) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(suffix = " mm"), limits = c(0, 50)) +
    labs(
      title = "Rainfall Density Distribution",
      subtitle = "Probability density of daily rainfall values",
      x = "Daily Rainfall (mm)",
      y = "Density",
      color = "Dataset",
      fill = "Dataset"
    ) +
    readable_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "06_density_comparison.png"), p6,
         width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  # Calculate and display summary statistics
  cat("\n📊 SUMMARY STATISTICS\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 50), collapse=""), "\n")
  
  summary_stats <- combined_data %>%
    summarise(
      # Stations Mean statistics
      Stations_Mean_avg = mean(precipitation_stations_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      Stations_Mean_median = median(precipitation_stations_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      Stations_Mean_sd = sd(precipitation_stations_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      Stations_Mean_min = min(precipitation_stations_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      Stations_Mean_max = max(precipitation_stations_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # C2 statistics  
      C2_avg = mean(C2_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
      C2_median = median(C2_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
      C2_sd = sd(C2_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
      C2_min = min(C2_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
      C2_max = max(C2_rainfall, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # Comparison metrics
      correlation = cor(precipitation_stations_mean, C2_rainfall, use = "complete.obs"),
      mean_absolute_error = mean(abs(precipitation_stations_mean - C2_rainfall), na.rm = TRUE),
      root_mean_square_error = sqrt(mean((precipitation_stations_mean - C2_rainfall)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
    )
  
  # Print summary
  cat("STATIONS MEAN:\n")
  cat(sprintf("  Mean: %.2f mm | Median: %.2f mm | SD: %.2f mm\n", 
              summary_stats$Stations_Mean_avg, summary_stats$Stations_Mean_median, summary_stats$Stations_Mean_sd))
  cat(sprintf("  Range: %.2f - %.2f mm\n", summary_stats$Stations_Mean_min, summary_stats$Stations_Mean_max))
  
  cat("\nC2 STATION:\n")
  cat(sprintf("  Mean: %.2f mm | Median: %.2f mm | SD: %.2f mm\n", 
              summary_stats$C2_avg, summary_stats$C2_median, summary_stats$C2_sd))
  cat(sprintf("  Range: %.2f - %.2f mm\n", summary_stats$C2_min, summary_stats$C2_max))
  
  cat("\nCOMPARISON METRICS:\n")
  cat(sprintf("  Correlation (R): %.3f\n", summary_stats$correlation))
  cat(sprintf("  Mean Absolute Error: %.2f mm\n", summary_stats$mean_absolute_error))
  cat(sprintf("  Root Mean Square Error: %.2f mm\n", summary_stats$root_mean_square_error))
  
  # Save summary statistics
  write_csv(summary_stats, file.path(output_dir, "comparison_summary_stats.csv"))
  
  cat(sprintf("\n✅ ANALYSIS COMPLETED!\n"))
  cat(sprintf("📁 All plots saved to: %s\n", output_dir))
  cat(sprintf("📊 Summary statistics saved: comparison_summary_stats.csv\n"))
  
  return(combined_data)
}
```
