# VIII. YEARLY RAINFALL AGGREGATION AND ZONAL STATISTICS

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# YEARLY RAINFALL AGGREGATION AND ZONAL STATISTICS
# ============================================================================
# This script:
# 1. Aggregates monthly kriged rainfall to yearly sums
# 2. Performs zonal statistics for parcels
# 3. Creates beautiful faceted and standalone maps
# ============================================================================

library(terra)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(viridis)

# ============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================================

# Paths
monthly_results_dir <- "batch_matern_kriging_results_extended"
gpkg_path <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_MERGED_soil_sugarcane.gpkg"
output_dir <- "yearly_rainfall_maps"

# Create output directory
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  YEARLY RAINFALL AGGREGATION          \n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD AND AGGREGATE MONTHLY RASTERS TO YEARLY
# ============================================================================

cat("📂 STEP 1: Loading monthly rasters and aggregating to yearly...\n")

# Find all monthly raster files (UTM28N projection)
monthly_folders <- list.dirs(monthly_results_dir, recursive = FALSE)
monthly_folders <- monthly_folders[grepl("month_\\d{4}_\\d{2}", basename(monthly_folders))]

cat("Found", length(monthly_folders), "monthly folders\n")

# Extract year-month information from folder names
raster_info <- data.frame(
  folder = monthly_folders,
  basename = basename(monthly_folders),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

raster_info <- raster_info %>%
  mutate(
    year_month = gsub("month_", "", basename),
    year = as.integer(substr(year_month, 1, 4)),
    month = as.integer(substr(year_month, 6, 7))
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, month)

cat("Date range:", min(raster_info$year), "-", max(raster_info$year), "\n\n")

# Function to safely load raster and extract var1.pred band only
load_monthly_raster <- function(folder_path) {
  # Try UTM28N first, then WGS84
  utm_path <- file.path(folder_path, "kriging_extended_utm28n.tif")
  wgs_path <- file.path(folder_path, "kriging_extended_wgs84.tif")
  
  raster_path <- NULL
  if (file.exists(utm_path)) {
    raster_path <- utm_path
  } else if (file.exists(wgs_path)) {
    raster_path <- wgs_path
  }
  
  if (is.null(raster_path)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Load raster
  r <- rast(raster_path)
  
  # Check if it has multiple bands
  if (nlyr(r) > 1) {
    # Get band names
    band_names <- names(r)
    
    # Find var1.pred band
    pred_band_idx <- which(band_names == "var1.pred")
    
    if (length(pred_band_idx) > 0) {
      # Extract only var1.pred band
      r <- r[[pred_band_idx]]
    } else {
      # If var1.pred not found, use first band and warn
      cat("      Warning: var1.pred band not found, using first band\n")
      r <- r[[1]]
    }
  }
  
  return(r)
}

# Aggregate by year
unique_years <- sort(unique(raster_info$year))
yearly_rasters <- list()

cat("Aggregating monthly data to yearly sums...\n")

for (year in unique_years) {
  cat("  Processing year", year, "...")
  
  # Get all months for this year
  year_folders <- raster_info %>%
    filter(year == !!year) %>%
    pull(folder)
  
  if (length(year_folders) == 0) {
    cat(" No data\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Load all monthly rasters for this year (var1.pred band only)
  monthly_rasters <- list()
  valid_months <- 0
  
  for (folder in year_folders) {
    r <- load_monthly_raster(folder)
    if (!is.null(r)) {
      monthly_rasters[[length(monthly_rasters) + 1]] <- r
      valid_months <- valid_months + 1
    }
  }
  
  if (length(monthly_rasters) == 0) {
    cat(" No valid rasters\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Stack and sum monthly rasters
  monthly_stack <- rast(monthly_rasters)
  yearly_sum <- sum(monthly_stack, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Get rainfall range for this year
  year_min <- global(yearly_sum, "min", na.rm = TRUE)[1,1]
  year_max <- global(yearly_sum, "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1,1]
  year_mean <- global(yearly_sum, "mean", na.rm = TRUE)[1,1]
  
  # Store
  yearly_rasters[[as.character(year)]] <- yearly_sum
  
  # Save yearly raster
  yearly_output <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("rainfall_yearly_", year, ".tif"))
  writeRaster(yearly_sum, yearly_output, overwrite = TRUE)
  
  cat(" ✓", valid_months, "months summed\n")
  cat("    Rainfall range:", round(year_min, 1), "-", round(year_max, 1), 
      "mm | Mean:", round(year_mean, 1), "mm\n")
}

cat("\n✅ Created", length(yearly_rasters), "yearly rainfall rasters\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: LOAD PARCELS AND PERFORM ZONAL STATISTICS
# ============================================================================

cat("📊 STEP 2: Loading parcels and performing zonal statistics...\n")

# Load parcels
parcels_raw <- st_read(gpkg_path, quiet = TRUE)

cat("Loaded", nrow(parcels_raw), "records from geopackage\n")

# Check for 'field' column
if (!"field" %in% names(parcels_raw)) {
  stop("❌ 'field' column not found in geopackage!")
}

# Get unique parcels only (remove duplicates by field, keeping first occurrence)
parcels <- parcels_raw %>%
  group_by(field) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("After removing duplicates:", nrow(parcels), "unique parcels\n")
cat("Using 'field' column as unique parcel identifier\n")

# Ensure parcels are in same CRS as rasters
first_raster <- yearly_rasters[[1]]
target_crs <- crs(first_raster)

parcels_projected <- st_transform(parcels, target_crs)

cat("Projected parcels to:", target_crs, "\n\n")

# Extract zonal statistics for each year
cat("Extracting zonal statistics for each year...\n")

zonal_results_list <- list()

for (year_name in names(yearly_rasters)) {
  cat("  Year", year_name, "...")
  
  yearly_raster <- yearly_rasters[[year_name]]
  
  # Extract values for each parcel
  parcel_stats <- terra::extract(
    yearly_raster,
    vect(parcels_projected),
    fun = mean,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    ID = TRUE
  )
  
  # Add field identifier
  parcel_stats$field <- parcels_projected$field[parcel_stats$ID]
  parcel_stats$year <- as.integer(year_name)
  
  # Rename rainfall column
  names(parcel_stats)[2] <- "yearly_rainfall_mm"
  
  zonal_results_list[[year_name]] <- parcel_stats
  
  cat(" ✓\n")
}

# Combine all years
zonal_stats_all <- bind_rows(zonal_results_list)

# Save zonal statistics
write.csv(
  zonal_stats_all,
  file.path(output_dir, "zonal_statistics_yearly_rainfall.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n✅ Zonal statistics completed and saved\n")
cat("   Total records:", nrow(zonal_stats_all), "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: MERGE ZONAL STATS WITH PARCEL GEOMETRY
# ============================================================================

cat("🗺️ STEP 3: Preparing data for mapping...\n")

# Get geometry column name (it might not be called "geometry")
geom_col <- attr(parcels, "sf_column")

# Create a wide format for easier mapping
parcels_with_rainfall <- parcels %>%
  select(field)  # sf automatically keeps geometry

# Pivot zonal stats to wide format
zonal_wide <- zonal_stats_all %>%
  select(field, year, yearly_rainfall_mm) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = yearly_rainfall_mm,
    names_prefix = "rainfall_"
  )

# Merge with geometry (set relationship to many-to-many since each parcel has multiple years)
parcels_rainfall <- parcels_with_rainfall %>%
  left_join(zonal_wide, by = "field", relationship = "many-to-one")

# Also create long format for faceting
parcels_rainfall_long <- parcels %>%
  select(field) %>%  # sf automatically keeps geometry
  left_join(
    zonal_stats_all %>% select(field, year, yearly_rainfall_mm),
    by = "field",
    relationship = "one-to-many"  # One parcel geometry to many years
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(yearly_rainfall_mm))

cat("✅ Data prepared for mapping\n")
cat("   Parcels with rainfall data:", 
    nrow(parcels_rainfall_long %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% distinct(field)), "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: CREATE MAPS WITH BEAUTIFUL STYLING
# ============================================================================

cat("🎨 STEP 4: Creating maps...\n\n")

# Smart color palette for rainfall
rainfall_colors <- rev(brewer.pal(9, "RdYlBu"))

# Get global rainfall range for consistent legend
rainfall_range <- range(parcels_rainfall_long$yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Rainfall range:", round(rainfall_range[1], 1), "-", 
    round(rainfall_range[2], 1), "mm\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# A. CREATE FACETED MAP (ALL YEARS)
# ============================================================================

cat("  Creating faceted map (all years)...\n")

facet_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = parcels_rainfall_long,
    aes(fill = yearly_rainfall_mm),
    color = "white",
    size = 0.1
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = rainfall_colors,
    name = "Annual Rainfall (mm)",
    limits = rainfall_range,
    labels = function(x) format(round(x, 0), big.mark = ","),
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth = 1.5,
      barheight = 15,
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~year, ncol = 3) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                             margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, 
                                 margin = margin(b = 15), color = "grey30"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", 
                             margin = margin(b = 5, t = 5)),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual Rainfall Distribution by Parcel",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Range: %s - %s mm | %d parcels across %d years",
      format(round(rainfall_range[1], 0), big.mark = ","),
      format(round(rainfall_range[2], 0), big.mark = ","),
      length(unique(parcels_rainfall_long$field)),
      length(unique(parcels_rainfall_long$year))
    )
  )

# Save faceted map
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "rainfall_yearly_faceted.png"),
  plot = facet_plot,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300,
  units = "in",
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "rainfall_yearly_faceted.pdf"),
  plot = facet_plot,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  units = "in",
  bg = "white"
)

cat("    ✓ Saved: rainfall_yearly_faceted.png/.pdf\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# B. CREATE STANDALONE MAPS (ONE PER YEAR)
# ============================================================================

cat("  Creating standalone maps for each year...\n")

standalone_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "standalone_yearly_maps")
if (!dir.exists(standalone_dir)) {
  dir.create(standalone_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

years_available <- sort(unique(parcels_rainfall_long$year))

for (year in years_available) {
  cat("    Year", year, "...")
  
  # Filter data for this year
  data_year <- parcels_rainfall_long %>%
    filter(year == !!year)
  
  # Calculate stats for this year
  year_stats <- data_year %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    summarise(
      mean_rainfall = mean(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_rainfall = min(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_rainfall = max(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_rainfall = sd(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_parcels = n()
    )
  
  # Create map
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(
      data = data_year,
      aes(fill = yearly_rainfall_mm),
      color = "white",
      size = 0.2,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = rainfall_colors,
      name = "Annual Rainfall (mm)",
      limits = rainfall_range,
      labels = function(x) format(round(x, 0), big.mark = ","),
      guide = guide_colorbar(
        barwidth = 1.5,
        barheight = 15,
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5
      )
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                               margin = margin(b = 5)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5, 
                                   margin = margin(b = 10), color = "grey30"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, 
                                 margin = margin(t = 10), color = "grey40"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Annual Rainfall Distribution - Year", year),
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "Mean: %s mm | Range: %s - %s mm | SD: %s mm | %d parcels",
        format(round(year_stats$mean_rainfall, 1), big.mark = ","),
        format(round(year_stats$min_rainfall, 0), big.mark = ","),
        format(round(year_stats$max_rainfall, 0), big.mark = ","),
        format(round(year_stats$sd_rainfall, 1), big.mark = ","),
        year_stats$n_parcels
      ),
      caption = "Data source: Kriged rainfall interpolation with extended spatial extent"
    )
  
  # Save
  filename <- sprintf("rainfall_year_%d.png", year)
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(standalone_dir, filename),
    plot = p,
    width = 12,
    height = 10,
    dpi = 300,
    units = "in",
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(standalone_dir, gsub(".png", ".pdf", filename)),
    plot = p,
    width = 12,
    height = 10,
    units = "in",
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  cat(" ✓\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: CREATE SUMMARY STATISTICS
# ============================================================================

cat("\n📊 STEP 5: Creating summary statistics...\n")

# Annual summary
annual_summary <- parcels_rainfall_long %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_parcels = n(),
    mean_rainfall = mean(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rainfall = median(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_rainfall = min(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_rainfall = max(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rainfall = sd(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv_rainfall = sd_rainfall / mean_rainfall * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(year)

write.csv(
  annual_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, "annual_rainfall_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Parcel-level summary
parcel_summary <- parcels_rainfall_long %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(field) %>%
  summarise(
    n_years = n(),
    mean_rainfall = mean(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rainfall = median(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_rainfall = min(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_rainfall = max(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rainfall = sd(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv_rainfall = sd_rainfall / mean_rainfall * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_rainfall))

write.csv(
  parcel_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, "parcel_rainfall_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("  ✓ Annual summary saved\n")
cat("  ✓ Parcel summary saved\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# FINAL SUMMARY
# ============================================================================

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  PROCESSING COMPLETE!                 \n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

cat("Summary:\n")
cat("  • Years processed:", length(unique_years), "\n")
cat("  • Parcels analyzed:", length(unique(parcels_rainfall_long$field)), "\n")
cat("  • Total parcel-year combinations:", nrow(parcels_rainfall_long), "\n")
cat("  • Rainfall range:", round(rainfall_range[1], 1), "-", 
    round(rainfall_range[2], 1), "mm\n\n")

# Display top 5 wettest and driest years
cat("\n🌧️ Wettest years (by mean rainfall):\n")
top_wet <- annual_summary %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_rainfall)) %>%
  head(5)

for (i in 1:nrow(top_wet)) {
  cat("  ", i, ". Year ", top_wet$year[i], ": ", 
      format(round(top_wet$mean_rainfall[i], 1), big.mark = ","), " mm\n", sep = "")
}

cat("\n🏜️ Driest years (by mean rainfall):\n")
top_dry <- annual_summary %>%
  arrange(mean_rainfall) %>%
  head(5)

for (i in 1:nrow(top_dry)) {
  cat("  ", i, ". Year ", top_dry$year[i], ": ", 
      format(round(top_dry$mean_rainfall[i], 1), big.mark = ","), " mm\n", sep = "")
}

cat("\n")

```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# CREATE RAINFALL MAPS WITH INDIVIDUAL YEAR LEGENDS
# ============================================================================
# This script creates faceted and standalone maps where each year uses
# its own rainfall range for the legend (not a global range)
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)

# ============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================================

# Input: parcels_rainfall_long object from previous script
# This should already exist in your environment
if (!exists("parcels_rainfall_long")) {
  stop("Error: parcels_rainfall_long not found. Run the aggregation script first.")
}

output_dir <- "yearly_rainfall_maps_individual_legends"

# Create output directory
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  RAINFALL MAPS - INDIVIDUAL LEGENDS   \n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# Smart color palette for rainfall
rainfall_colors <- rev(brewer.pal(9, "RdYlBu"))

# Get available years
years_available <- sort(unique(parcels_rainfall_long$year))
n_years <- length(years_available)

cat("Creating maps for", n_years, "years\n")

# ============================================================================
# A. CREATE FACETED MAP WITH INDIVIDUAL LEGENDS PER FACET
# ============================================================================

cat("Creating faceted map with individual legends...\n")

# Calculate statistics per year for subtitle
year_stats <- parcels_rainfall_long %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_parcels = n(),
    min_rain = min(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_rain = max(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rain = mean(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Overall statistics
overall_min <- min(year_stats$min_rain, na.rm = TRUE)
overall_max <- max(year_stats$max_rain, na.rm = TRUE)
total_parcels <- length(unique(parcels_rainfall_long$field))

facet_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = parcels_rainfall_long,
    aes(fill = yearly_rainfall_mm),
    color = "white",
    size = 0.1
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = rainfall_colors,
    name = "Annual Rainfall (mm)",
    labels = function(x) format(round(x, 0), big.mark = ","),
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth = 1.5,
      barheight = 15,
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~year, ncol = 3) +  # No free scales - not supported with coord_sf
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                             margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, 
                                 margin = margin(b = 15), color = "grey30"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", 
                             margin = margin(b = 5, t = 5)),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual Rainfall Distribution by Parcel",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Overall range: %s - %s mm | %d parcels across %d years\nNote: All years share the same color scale for direct comparison",
      format(round(overall_min, 0), big.mark = ","),
      format(round(overall_max, 0), big.mark = ","),
      total_parcels,
      n_years
    )
  )

# Save faceted map
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "rainfall_yearly_faceted_individual_legends.png"),
  plot = facet_plot,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300,
  units = "in",
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "rainfall_yearly_faceted_individual_legends.pdf"),
  plot = facet_plot,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  units = "in",
  bg = "white"
)

cat("  Saved: rainfall_yearly_faceted_individual_legends.png/.pdf\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# B. CREATE STANDALONE MAPS WITH INDIVIDUAL LEGENDS
# ============================================================================

cat("Creating standalone maps with individual legends for each year...\n")

standalone_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "standalone_yearly_maps")
if (!dir.exists(standalone_dir)) {
  dir.create(standalone_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

for (year in years_available) {
  cat("  Year", year, "...")
  
  # Filter data for this year
  data_year <- parcels_rainfall_long %>%
    filter(year == !!year)
  
  # Calculate stats for this year ONLY
  year_min <- min(data_year$yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  year_max <- max(data_year$yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  year_mean <- mean(data_year$yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  year_sd <- sd(data_year$yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_parcels <- nrow(data_year)
  
  # Create map with THIS YEAR'S range only
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(
      data = data_year,
      aes(fill = yearly_rainfall_mm),
      color = "white",
      size = 0.2,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = rainfall_colors,
      name = "Annual Rainfall (mm)",
      limits = c(year_min, year_max),  # Use year-specific limits
      labels = function(x) format(round(x, 0), big.mark = ","),
      guide = guide_colorbar(
        barwidth = 1.5,
        barheight = 15,
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5
      )
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                               margin = margin(b = 5)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5, 
                                   margin = margin(b = 10), color = "grey30"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, 
                                 margin = margin(t = 10), color = "grey40"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Annual Rainfall Distribution - Year", year),
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "Mean: %s mm | Range: %s - %s mm | SD: %s mm | %d parcels",
        format(round(year_mean, 1), big.mark = ","),
        format(round(year_min, 0), big.mark = ","),
        format(round(year_max, 0), big.mark = ","),
        format(round(year_sd, 1), big.mark = ","),
        n_parcels
      ),
      caption = sprintf(
        "Legend scale: %s - %s mm (specific to year %d)\nData source: Kriged rainfall interpolation",
        format(round(year_min, 0), big.mark = ","),
        format(round(year_max, 0), big.mark = ","),
        year
      )
    )
  
  # Save
  filename <- sprintf("rainfall_year_%d_individual_legend.png", year)
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(standalone_dir, filename),
    plot = p,
    width = 12,
    height = 10,
    dpi = 300,
    units = "in",
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(standalone_dir, gsub(".png", ".pdf", filename)),
    plot = p,
    width = 12,
    height = 10,
    units = "in",
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  cat(" Saved\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# C. CREATE COMPARISON TABLE OF YEAR RANGES
# ============================================================================

cat("\nCreating year-by-year comparison table...\n")

comparison_table <- parcels_rainfall_long %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_parcels = n(),
    min_rainfall = min(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_rainfall = max(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rainfall = mean(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rainfall = median(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rainfall = sd(yearly_rainfall_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    range_span = max_rainfall - min_rainfall,
    .groups = 'drop'  # Add this to avoid grouping issues
  ) %>%
  arrange(year)

# Add rank columns
comparison_table <- comparison_table %>%
  mutate(
    wetness_rank = rank(-mean_rainfall),
    variability_rank = rank(-sd_rainfall)
  )

write.csv(
  comparison_table,
  file.path(output_dir, "year_comparison_individual_ranges.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("  Saved: year_comparison_individual_ranges.csv\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# FINAL SUMMARY
# ============================================================================

cat("========================================\n")
cat("  PROCESSING COMPLETE!                 \n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

cat("Output directory:", output_dir, "\n\n")
cat("Year-by-year rainfall ranges:\n")
cat(rep("-", 70), "\n", sep = "")
cat(sprintf("%-6s | %-12s | %-12s | %-12s | %-8s\n", 
            "Year", "Min (mm)", "Max (mm)", "Mean (mm)", "Parcels"))
cat(rep("-", 70), "\n", sep = "")

for (i in 1:nrow(comparison_table)) {
  cat(sprintf("%-6d | %12s | %12s | %12s | %8d\n",
              comparison_table$year[i],
              format(round(comparison_table$min_rainfall[i], 1), big.mark = ","),
              format(round(comparison_table$max_rainfall[i], 1), big.mark = ","),
              format(round(comparison_table$mean_rainfall[i], 1), big.mark = ","),
              comparison_table$n_parcels[i]))
}
cat(rep("-", 70), "\n", sep = "")
```

# IX. CALCULATE GROWING SEASON RAINFALL WITH PRO-RATA FOR PARTIAL MONTH

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# ============================================================================
# This script calculates total rainfall during the growing season for each
# parcel, using pro-rata calculation for partial months at start/end dates
# ============================================================================

library(sf)
library(terra)
library(dplyr)

# ============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================================

output_gpkg <- "C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy/clean_soil_dataset/parcels_MERGED_soil_sugarcane_with_growing_season_rainfall.gpkg"

cat("============================================\n")

# ============================================================================

cat("  Loaded", nrow(parcels), "records\n")

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(parcels))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

cat("  Required columns found\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: PARSE AND VALIDATE DATES
# ============================================================================

cat("Step 2: Parsing dates...\n")

# First, check what format the dates are in
cat("  Checking date format...\n")
sample_planting <- head(parcels$SC_planting_date, 3)
sample_harvest <- head(parcels$SC_harvest_date, 3)
cat("  Sample planting dates:", paste(sample_planting, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("  Sample harvest dates:", paste(sample_harvest, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Try multiple date parsing strategies
parse_flexible_date <- function(date_string) {
  # If already a Date object, return as is
  if (inherits(date_string, "Date")) {
    return(date_string)
  }
  
  # Convert to character if factor
  date_string <- as.character(date_string)
  
  # Try different formats
  result <- suppressWarnings(dmy(date_string))  # DD/MM/YYYY
  if (!is.na(result)) return(result)
  
  result <- suppressWarnings(mdy(date_string))  # MM/DD/YYYY
  if (!is.na(result)) return(result)
  
  result <- suppressWarnings(ymd(date_string))  # YYYY-MM-DD
  if (!is.na(result)) return(result)
  
  result <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(date_string, format = "%d/%m/%Y"))
  if (!is.na(result)) return(result)
  
  result <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(date_string, format = "%m/%d/%Y"))
  if (!is.na(result)) return(result)
  
  result <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(date_string, format = "%Y-%m-%d"))
  if (!is.na(result)) return(result)
  
  result <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(date_string))
  if (!is.na(result)) return(result)
  
  # If all fail, return NA
  return(as.Date(NA))
}

# Parse dates with flexible function
parcels <- parcels %>%
  mutate(
    planting_date = sapply(SC_planting_date, parse_flexible_date) %>% as.Date(origin = "1970-01-01"),
    harvest_date = sapply(SC_harvest_date, parse_flexible_date) %>% as.Date(origin = "1970-01-01")
  )

# Check for parsing issues
n_valid <- sum(!is.na(parcels$planting_date) & !is.na(parcels$harvest_date))
n_invalid <- nrow(parcels) - n_valid

cat("  Valid date pairs:", n_valid, "\n")
cat("  Invalid date pairs:", n_invalid, "\n")

if (n_invalid > 0) {
  cat("  Warning: Some records have invalid dates and will be skipped\n")
  cat("  Example invalid dates:\n")
  invalid_examples <- parcels %>%
    filter(is.na(planting_date) | is.na(harvest_date)) %>%
    select(field, SC_planting_date, SC_harvest_date) %>%
    head(3)
  print(invalid_examples)
}

# Filter to valid dates only
parcels_valid <- parcels %>%
  filter(!is.na(planting_date), !is.na(harvest_date), harvest_date > planting_date)

cat("  Working with", nrow(parcels_valid), "valid records\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: LOAD MONTHLY RASTERS AND CREATE INDEX
# ============================================================================

cat("Step 3: Loading monthly rainfall rasters...\n")

# Find all monthly folders
monthly_folders <- list.dirs(monthly_results_dir, recursive = FALSE)
monthly_folders <- monthly_folders[grepl("month_\\d{4}_\\d{2}", basename(monthly_folders))]

# Function to load var1.pred band only
load_monthly_raster <- function(folder_path) {
  utm_path <- file.path(folder_path, "kriging_extended_utm28n.tif")
  wgs_path <- file.path(folder_path, "kriging_extended_wgs84.tif")
  
  raster_path <- NULL
  if (file.exists(utm_path)) {
    raster_path <- utm_path
  } else if (file.exists(wgs_path)) {
    raster_path <- wgs_path
  }
  
  if (is.null(raster_path)) return(NULL)
  
  r <- rast(raster_path)
  
  if (nlyr(r) > 1) {
    band_names <- names(r)
    pred_band_idx <- which(band_names == "var1.pred")
    if (length(pred_band_idx) > 0) {
      r <- r[[pred_band_idx]]
    } else {
      r <- r[[1]]
    }
  }
  
  return(r)
}

# Create raster index
raster_index <- data.frame(
  folder = monthly_folders,
  basename = basename(monthly_folders),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    year_month = gsub("month_", "", basename),
    year = as.integer(substr(year_month, 1, 4)),
    month = as.integer(substr(year_month, 6, 7)),
    date = as.Date(paste(year, month, "01", sep = "-"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(date)

cat("  Found", nrow(raster_index), "monthly rasters\n")
min_date_str <- format(min(raster_index$date), "%Y-%m")
max_date_str <- format(max(raster_index$date), "%Y-%m")
cat("  Date range:", min_date_str, "to", max_date_str, "\n\n")

# Load all rasters into a list
monthly_rasters <- list()
cat("  Loading rasters into memory...\n")

for (i in 1:nrow(raster_index)) {
  r <- load_monthly_raster(raster_index$folder[i])
  if (!is.null(r)) {
    key <- format(raster_index$date[i], "%Y-%m")
    monthly_rasters[[key]] <- r
    if (i %% 50 == 0) cat("    Loaded", i, "/", nrow(raster_index), "\n")
  }
}

cat("  Successfully loaded", length(monthly_rasters), "rasters\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: CALCULATE GROWING SEASON RAINFALL FOR EACH PARCEL
# ============================================================================

cat("Step 4: Calculating growing season rainfall...\n")

# Ensure parcels are in same CRS as rasters
first_raster <- monthly_rasters[[1]]
parcels_projected <- st_transform(parcels_valid, crs(first_raster))

# Function to calculate pro-rata rainfall for a date range
calculate_growing_season_rainfall <- function(parcel_geom, planting_date, harvest_date, 
                                              raster_index, monthly_rasters) {
  
  # Get all months in the growing season
  start_year_month <- floor_date(planting_date, "month")
  end_year_month <- floor_date(harvest_date, "month")
  
  # Generate sequence of months
  month_seq <- seq(start_year_month, end_year_month, by = "month")
  
  total_rainfall <- 0
  months_processed <- 0
  
  for (i in seq_along(month_seq)) {
    month_date <- as.Date(month_seq[i], origin = "1970-01-01")
    month_key <- format(month_date, "%Y-%m")
    
    # Check if we have data for this month
    if (!month_key %in% names(monthly_rasters)) {
      next
    }
    
    # Get the raster
    month_raster <- monthly_rasters[[month_key]]
    
    # Extract rainfall value for this parcel
    rainfall_value <- terra::extract(
      month_raster,
      vect(parcel_geom),
      fun = mean,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )[1, 2]
    
    if (is.na(rainfall_value)) {
      next
    }
    
    # Calculate days in this month
    days_in_month <- days_in_month(month_date)
    
    # Calculate pro-rata factor
    if (month_date == start_year_month && month_date == end_year_month) {
      # Both planting and harvest in same month
      days_used <- as.numeric(harvest_date - planting_date) + 1
      pro_rata_factor <- days_used / days_in_month
      
    } else if (month_date == start_year_month) {
      # First month (partial)
      days_used <- days_in_month - day(planting_date) + 1
      pro_rata_factor <- days_used / days_in_month
      
    } else if (month_date == end_year_month) {
      # Last month (partial)
      days_used <- day(harvest_date)
      pro_rata_factor <- days_used / days_in_month
      
    } else {
      # Full month
      pro_rata_factor <- 1.0
    }
    
    # Add pro-rated rainfall
    total_rainfall <- total_rainfall + (rainfall_value * pro_rata_factor)
    months_processed <- months_processed + 1
  }
  
  return(list(
    total_rainfall = total_rainfall,
    months_processed = months_processed,
    growing_days = as.numeric(harvest_date - planting_date) + 1
  ))
}

# Process each parcel
results_list <- list()

cat("  Processing parcels...\n")

for (i in 1:nrow(parcels_projected)) {
  
  if (i %% 100 == 0) {
    cat("    Progress:", i, "/", nrow(parcels_projected), "\n")
  }
  
  result <- calculate_growing_season_rainfall(
    parcel_geom = parcels_projected[i, ],
    planting_date = parcels_projected$planting_date[i],
    harvest_date = parcels_projected$harvest_date[i],
    raster_index = raster_index,
    monthly_rasters = monthly_rasters
  )
  
  results_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
    row_id = i,
    field = parcels_projected$field[i],
    growing_season_rainfall_mm = result$total_rainfall,
    growing_season_days = result$growing_days,
    months_with_data = result$months_processed,
    avg_daily_rainfall_mm = result$total_rainfall / result$growing_days
  )
}

# Combine results
results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)

cat("  Completed!\n\n")

# ============================================================================

# Add a unique identifier to match exact rows

results_df$row_num <- results_df$row_id

# Create results with row matching info
results_for_merge <- results_df %>%
  select(row_num, growing_season_rainfall_mm, growing_season_days, 
         months_with_data, avg_daily_rainfall_mm)

# Add row numbers to original parcels based on valid dates
parcels <- parcels %>%

               harvest_date_temp > planting_date_temp
  )

# Assign row numbers only to valid parcels
valid_indices <- which(parcels$is_valid)
parcels$row_num <- NA_integer_
parcels$row_num[valid_indices] <- 1:length(valid_indices)

# Merge results only for valid parcels
parcels_final <- parcels %>%
  left_join(

    by = "row_num"
  ) %>%
  select(-planting_date_temp, -harvest_date_temp, -is_valid, -row_num)

# Count results
n_with_rainfall <- sum(!is.na(parcels_final$growing_season_rainfall_mm))
n_without_rainfall <- sum(is.na(parcels_final$growing_season_rainfall_mm))

cat("  Merged successfully\n")

cat("  Records without rainfall data (invalid dates):", n_without_rainfall, "\n\n")

cat("Parcels processed:", as.character(summary_stats$n_parcels), "\n")

    sprintf("%.1f", summary_stats$max_rainfall), "\n")

cat("Growing season length:\n")

cat("  Mean daily rainfall:", sprintf("%.2f", summary_stats$mean_daily_rain), "mm/day\n\n")

# Show examples
cat("Example parcels:\n")

  filter(growing_season_rainfall_mm > 0) %>%
```
